# FHFHockey.com calculation inventory (Opus)

Generated 2026-11-10 by the calc-inventory-opus lane for the Fable math audit. Read-only inventory: every entry is a calculation found in code or SQL definitions in the repo. **Red flags are observations, not audited.** Machine-readable copy: [calculations-opus.json](calculations-opus.json). How it was searched and what may be missing: [coverage-notes.md](coverage-notes.md).

## xG (XG, 70)

### XG-001 xG model: includes/excludes

- **Purpose:** Explicit checklist of what the production-candidate FHFH xG model includes and excludes.
- **Where:** `web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.ts:214 (BASELINE_FEATURE_FAMILY_PRESETS)`; `web/scripts/output/xg-corrected-candidate/logistic_l2-s20252026-p1-st1-f1-cfg2afcf561/model-artifact.json`; `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:1750 (main)`; `web/lib/xg/shotFeaturePersistence.ts:611 (scoring)`
- **Inputs:** NhlShotFeatureRow (first_pass_v1 family)
- **Source tables:** nhl_xg_shot_features, nhl_api_pbp_events, nhl_api_shift_rows
- **Method:** SHOT UNIVERSE: INCLUDED unblocked attempts (goal, SOG, missed); EXCLUDED blocked shots, own goals, penalty shots, shootout, 'delayed-penalty' event rows — web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.ts:281, web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlEventInclusion.ts:106 \| X,Y + RINK/SIDE NORMALIZATION: INCLUDED (mirror both x and y when team attacks left, using homeTeamDefendingSide; net at (89,0)); normalizedX/normalizedY are model inputs; EXCLUDED arena/rink-bias adjustment — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.ts:51 \| DISTANCE: INCLUDED, linear feet to (89,0), z-scored — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:182 \| ANGLE: INCLUDED, abs degrees atan2(\|y\|,\|89-x\|), z-scored; behind-net not distinguished — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:192 \| SHOT TYPE: INCLUDED one-hot (backhand, bat, between-legs, cradle, deflected, poke, slap, snap, tip-in, wrap-around, wrist) — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:176 \| REBOUND: INCLUDED boolean isReboundShot = immediately previous event is same-team SOG/missed/blocked attempt, same period, 0<dt<=3 s, no distance limit; ### XG-002 xG team aggregate reconciliation (xGF/xGA symmetry) and operations alerts

- **Purpose:** Check that summed team xG for equals summed team xG against per game (and for flurry-adjusted aggregates) and raise operations alerts.
- **Where:** `web/lib/xg/operationsHealth.ts:17 (buildXgTeamAggregateReconciliation)`; `web/lib/xg/operationsHealth.ts:58 (buildXgOperationsAlerts)`
- **Inputs:** model_version; feature_version; game_id; xg_for; xg_against; feature/prediction counts; calibration segments
- **Source tables:** xG team aggregate sample (operations route)
- **Method:** Group rows by model_version:feature_version:game_id; sum xg_for and xg_against (nulls -> 0); delta = \|sum xGF - sum xGA\|; issue if delta > tolerance 0.0001; report games checked, issues, max delta (6 dp). Alerts: coverage, feature drift, registry/prediction model parity, running leases, aggregate coverage, symmetry, flurry completeness (adjusted == total), calibration segments below confidence thresholds.
- **Outputs:** status; gamesChecked; issueCount; maximumAbsoluteDelta; alerts
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** expected goals
- **Output scale:** absolute xG delta; ok/warning
- **Status:** live — /api/v1/xg/operations
- **Tests:** `web/lib/xg/operationsHealth.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/pages/api/v1/xg/operations.ts:146-159
- **Reference standard:** Accounting identity: league/game xGF = xGA
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - Number(x)\|\|0 turns missing xG into 0, which can hide a missing side
  - identity only proves both team rows exist with mirrored totals, not that per-shot xG is right; this does not cover what the xG model includes/excludes (see XG-001)

### XG-004 Platt and isotonic calibrators

- **Sub-family:** xG / calibration
- **Purpose:** Map raw probabilities to calibrated probabilities.
- **Where:** `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:101 (logit)`; `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:292 (fitPlattCalibrator)`; `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:318 (fitIsotonicCalibrator)`; `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:368 (fitProbabilityCalibrator)`; `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:401 (predictWithSerializedCalibrator)`; `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:416 (predictIsotonicProbability)`
- **Inputs:** raw probability; label
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** Platt: in-house logistic on logit(p) (400 iters, lr 0.05, l2 0.001), needs >=10 rows and both classes. Isotonic: pool-adjacent-violators on predictions sorted ascending, blocks store max prediction & mean label; predict = first block whose maxPrediction >= p (step function, no interpolation); above last block -> last block mean.
- **Outputs:** calibrated probability
- **Tables written:** artifact calibration.model
- **Input units:** probability 0-1
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1
- **Status:** live (offline) — run manually via `tsx web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts`; produced artifacts consumed by update-nhl-xg-shot-predictions via artifact path env; applied at scoring when artifact.calibration.applied
- **Tests:** `web/lib/xg/calibration.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** predictShotGoalProbabilities
- **Reference standard:** sklearn CalibratedClassifierCV / IsotonicRegression
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - isotonic blocks can return exactly 0 or 1 (clipped to 1e-9) for extreme bins
  - Platt via GD may be unconverged

### XG-005 Calibration requirement and cross-validated method selection

- **Sub-family:** xG / calibration
- **Purpose:** Decide whether post-calibration is needed and pick raw/Platt/isotonic.
- **Where:** `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:218 (estimateMaximumCalibrationGap)`; `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:242 (determineCalibrationRequirement)`; `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:273 (assignFoldIndices)`; `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:428 (runCrossValidatedCalibrationMethod)`; `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:468 (pickBestMethod)`; `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:491 (assessCalibration)`; `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:1532 (buildValidationCalibration)`
- **Inputs:** validation predictions; labels
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** Requires post-calibration if \|mean pred - goal rate\| >= 0.02 or any 10-equal-width-bin gap >= 0.10 (bins with >=5 rows). Folds = min(5, max(2, positives)), stratified round-robin by sorted rowId. Compare raw vs CV Platt vs CV isotonic by log loss then Brier. Calibrator fit on VALIDATION split only, then applied to all splits.
- **Outputs:** requiresPostCalibration; adoptableMethod; calibration.selectedMethod
- **Tables written:** model-artifact.json calibration, calibrationAssessment
- **Input units:** probabilities 0-1
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1
- **Status:** live (offline) — run manually via `tsx web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts`; produced artifacts consumed by update-nhl-xg-shot-predictions via artifact path env
- **Tests:** `web/lib/xg/calibration.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** scoring (calibrated_probability)
- **Reference standard:** Platt scaling / isotonic regression (Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana); MoneyPuck/EH report calibration plots
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - tolerance 0.02 absolute on a ~0.07 base rate is ~30% relative — loose
  - equal-width [0,1] bins: ~78% of test shots fall in bin 0 in corrected candidate, so the max-gap check is nearly blind
  - holdout metrics later reported over validation+test although calibrator was fit on validation (optimistic)
  - corrected candidate selected 'raw'

### XG-008 xG evaluation metrics: log loss, Brier, calibration bins, slice evaluation

- **Sub-family:** xG / evaluation
- **Purpose:** Score xG model quality per split and per slice
- **Where:** `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:1426 (buildCalibrationBins)`; `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:1459 (evaluateScoredExamples)`; `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:1507 (evaluateSlices)`; `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:345 (binaryLogLossBaseline)`; `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:356 (binaryBrierBaseline)`
- **Inputs:** prediction; label; strengthState; isReboundShot; isRushShot
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** logLoss = mean(-ln p \| y=1, -ln(1-p) \| y=0) without clipping; Brier = mean((p-y)^2); 10 equal-width probability bins with avgPrediction & observedGoalRate; base-rate baselines: LL0 = -(r ln r + (1-r) ln(1-r)), Brier0 = r(1-r); slices by strength state, rebound, rush; metrics rounded
- **Outputs:** SplitEvaluation{logLoss,brierScore,goalRate,averagePrediction,calibrationBins}
- **Tables written:** model-artifact.json
- **Input units:** probability 0-1, label 0/1
- **Output scale:** log loss (nats), Brier 0-1, bin rates 0-1
- **Status:** live — computed on every training run
- **Tests:** `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.test.ts`; `web/scripts/benchmark-nhl-xg-baselines.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** approval gates; benchmark markdown
- **Reference standard:** standard proper scoring rules
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - log loss unclipped (contrast: rebound-heads script clips 1e-9, Python challengers clip 1e-7) so the three xG evaluators can disagree

### XG-012 Shot coordinate normalization to attacking direction

- **Sub-family:** xG / features
- **Purpose:** Mirror raw NHL x,y so every shot attacks the net at (+89,0).
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.ts:20 (OFFENSIVE_NET_X/Y)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.ts:37 (getTeamAttackingSide)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.ts:51 (normalizeCoordinatesToAttackingDirection)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:476 (call)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlPriorEventContext.ts:64 (call)`; `web/lib/xg/reboundRichLabels.ts:88 (shotGeometry)`
- **Inputs:** x_coord; y_coord; home_team_defending_side; event_owner_side
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** attackingSide = home: opposite of homeTeamDefendingSide; away: = homeTeamDefendingSide. If attacking 'left', normalizedX=-x and normalizedY=-y (180-degree rotation), else unchanged. Net fixed at x=89 ft, y=0. No rink/arena bias adjustment.
- **Outputs:** normalizedX; normalizedY; isMirrored; attackingSide
- **Tables written:** nhl_xg_shot_features.normalized_x/normalized_y
- **Input units:** feet (NHL rink coords x in [-100,100], y in [-42.5,42.5])
- **Output scale:** feet, attacking +x
- **Status:** live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** shot distance/angle; rebound geometry; royal-road/movement features; xG model features normalizedX/Y
- **Reference standard:** MoneyPuck arena-adjusted coordinates; Evolving-Hockey/HockeyViz coordinate flipping by period/home side
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - owner side is NHL eventOwnerTeamId; for blocked-shot events the NHL API owner is believed to be the blocking team, which would mirror blocked-shot coords/strength to the wrong team (no flip found in nhlPlayByPlayParser.ts:362)
  - null homeTeamDefendingSide yields null coords (later imputed as 0 in model encoding)
  - no arena/rink-bias correction (MoneyPuck adjusts)

### XG-017 Rebound shot definition and rebound geometry

- **Sub-family:** xG / features

- **Inputs:** previous event; timeSincePreviousEventSeconds; previousEventSameTeam; normalized coords
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** isReboundShot = immediately previous event (no intervening events allowed) is an eligible SOG/missed/blocked attempt by the SAME owner team, same period, and 0 < dt <= 3 s. Geometry: lateral displacement \|dY\|, distance delta (cur-src), angle change \|dAngle\|, distance from source (raw), speed = dist/dt.
- **Outputs:** isReboundShot; reboundSourceEventId; reboundTimeDeltaSeconds; reboundLateralDisplacementFeet; reboundDistanceDeltaFeet; reboundAngleChangeDegrees; reboundSpeedFromSourceFeetPerSecond
- **Tables written:** nhl_xg_shot_features
- **Input units:** seconds, feet, degrees
- **Output scale:** boolean; feet; degrees; ft/s
- **Status:** live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** xG boolean feature isReboundShot; rush exclusion; shot assists/transitions exclusion; NST-parity rebound counts; heuristic xG +0.03
- **Reference standard:** MoneyPuck rebound = shot within 3 s of prior shot; Evolving-Hockey rebound <=2-3 s
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - strict dt>0 excludes same-second rebounds (1-s clock resolution) — likely undercounts rebounds vs MoneyPuck
  - requires same owner team: if NHL blocked-shot owner is the blocker, rebounds after blocked shots are never flagged
  - only the immediately previous event is checked; any intervening event (e.g., hit, giveaway) breaks it

### XG-018 Rush shot definition

- **Sub-family:** xG / features
- **Purpose:** Flag non-rebound shots preceded within 10 s by a qualifying turnover/faceoff/block in the shooting team's D or N zone.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:5 (DEFAULT_RUSH_WINDOW_SECONDS=10)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:91 (isQualifyingRushSource)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:122 (isHardRushBreak)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:149 (buildRushContexts)`
- **Inputs:** prior events within window; zone_code; event owner
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** Scan backward up to 10 s (same period, dt>0). Qualifying sources: own takeaway, own faceoff win, opponent giveaway, opponent-owned blocked-shot. Source zone converted to shooting-team-relative (invert O/D for opponent events); rush if relative zone is D or N. Break on stoppage/penalty/period events, any other shot, opponent takeaway/faceoff, own giveaway. Rebound shots are never rush. Distance from source uses raw coords.
- **Outputs:** isRushShot; rushSourceEventId; rushTimeSinceSourceSeconds; rushDistanceFromSourceFeet; rushSpeedFromSourceFeetPerSecond; rushSourceTeamRelativeZoneCode
- **Tables written:** nhl_xg_shot_features
- **Input units:** seconds, feet
- **Output scale:** boolean; seconds; feet; ft/s
- **Status:** live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** xG boolean isRushShot; transition proxies; NST-parity rush_attempts; heuristic xG +0.02
- **Reference standard:** MoneyPuck rush = within 4 s of an event in neutral/defensive zone; Evolving-Hockey ~ similar
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 10 s window is much wider than MoneyPuck's 4 s and has no speed/distance requirement
  - 'opponent-owned blocked-shot' as rush source depends on NHL owner semantics for blocked shots (unverified)
  - faceoff win in D/N zone counts as rush source

### XG-022 Shot distance and angle

- **Sub-family:** xG / features
- **Purpose:** Euclidean distance (ft) and absolute angle (deg) from normalized shot location to net.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:182 (computeShotDistanceFeet)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:192 (computeShotAngleDegrees)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.ts:49,59 (duplicate copies)`; `web/lib/xg/reboundRichLabels.ts:88 (shotGeometry duplicate)`
- **Inputs:** normalizedX; normalizedY
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** distance = sqrt((89-x)^2 + (0-y)^2); angle = atan2(\|y\|,\|89-x\|)*180/pi (0 = straight on, 90 = goal line). Shots from behind the net (x>89) get the same angle as mirrored front shots because abs(89-x) is used.
- **Outputs:** shotDistanceFeet; shotAngleDegrees
- **Tables written:** nhl_xg_shot_features.shot_distance_feet/shot_angle_degrees
- **Input units:** feet
- **Output scale:** distance feet 0..~190; angle degrees 0..90
- **Status:** live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** xG logistic model; NST-parity danger buckets; goalie avg_shot_distance; rebound deltas
- **Reference standard:** MoneyPuck/Evolving-Hockey shot distance & angle (EH uses signed/abs angle, behind-net handled separately)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - behind-the-net shots indistinguishable from in-front shots by angle (abs on deltaX)
  - logic duplicated in 3 files (nhlShotFeatureBuilder, nhlRebounds, reboundRichLabels)
  - model uses raw linear distance/angle (no log/spline), see model entry

High danger = target distance<=20 ft and angle<=35 deg.
- **Outputs:** termination; conditionalHighDanger; goalieFreezeCoveredPuck; conditionalNextAttemptGoal
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** seconds, feet, degrees
- **Output scale:** labels 0/1
- **Status:** draft — offline only; caller web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-rebound-heads-offline.ts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/xg/reboundRichLabels.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** train-nhl-xg-rebound-heads-offline.ts
- **Reference standard:** MoneyPuck expected rebounds / rebound control
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - high-danger box (20 ft, 35 deg) duplicates NST-parity heuristic, not NST's HD zone

### XG-028 xG model specification as trained (includes / excludes)

- **Sub-family:** xG / model spec
- **Purpose:** Record exactly what the in-house shot xG model uses, per the trainer defaults and saved artifacts
- **Where:** `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:616 (parseCliArgs defaults)`; `web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.ts:70 (DEFAULT_NUMERIC_FEATURE_KEYS)`; `web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.ts:160 (DEFAULT_BOOLEAN_FEATURE_KEYS)`; `web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.ts:170 (DEFAULT_CATEGORICAL_FEATURE_KEYS)`; `web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.ts:241 (FORBIDDEN_BASELINE_FEATURE_INPUT_KEYS)`; `web/scripts/output/xg-corrected-candidate/logistic_l2-s20252026-p1-st1-f1-cfg2afcf561/model-artifact.json`; `web/scripts/output/xg-approval-run-20260522/logistic_l2-s20252026-p1-st1-f1-cfg9bac2706/model-artifact.json`
- **Inputs:** NHL API play-by-play shots (nhl_api_pbp_events), shifts (nhl_api_shift_rows), handedness/positions
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events, nhl_api_shift_rows, games, player_stats_unified, goalie_stats_unified, players
- **Method:** INCLUDES (first_pass_v1 preset, the one in both saved logistic_l2 artifacts): normalizedX/normalizedY (raw x,y mirrored by -1 when attacking toward negative side, using homeTeamDefendingSide; net at x=89,y=0), shotDistanceFeet, shotAngleDegrees = atan2(\|dy\|,\|dx\|) in degrees (unsigned, so no left/right side), shotType (categorical), strengthState + strengthExact (categorical), zoneCode, previousEventTypeDescKey, previousEventSameTeam, timeSincePreviousEventSeconds, distanceFromPreviousEvent, east-west/north-south movement feet, isReboundShot (3 s window), isRushShot (10 s window), isFlurryShot (5 s gap), crossedRoyalRoad, isEmptyNetEvent, isOvertimeEvent, period/periodSeconds/gameSeconds, ownerPowerPlayAgeSeconds, shooterShiftAgeSeconds. Optional presets: expanded_v2 adds score differential (home/away/owner + ownerScoreDiffBucket), possession chain counts/duration/start type, defenseman shooter, roster position, late-game close/trailing; speed_context_v3 adds speed-from-previous-event and rebound/rush speeds. Trainer also enriches shooter handedness, goalie catch hand and handedness matchup, and on-ice deployment context. EXCLUDES: score state in default preset (only in expanded_v2), shooter identity/talent effects, goalie identity/quality effects, rink-bias (arena) adjustment, pre-shot pass/royal-road beyond crossedRoyalRoad flag, post-event fields (shotEventType, missReasonBucket, isShortSideMiss are forbidden). TRAINING SET: single season 20252026 (default --season), 70/15/15 chronological game split: train 2025-10-07..2026-03-03 (82,636 shots), validation 2026-03-03..03-30 (17,829), test 2026-03-30..05-21 (17,834, includes playoffs). MODEL TYPE: default CLI family xgboost_js, but saved candidates are logistic_l2 (800 iters, lr 0.05, l2 0.01, train-only z-scored numerics, one-hot categoricals). CALIBRATION: validation-fit post-calibration chosen by lib/xg/calibration (corrected candidate: raw; approval run: isotonic)
- **Outputs:** P(goal \| unblocked/shot attempt features)
- **Tables written:** model artifacts on disk; production persistence via lib/xg/shotFeaturePersistence (other slice)
- **Input units:** feet (coordinates, distance, movement), degrees (angle), seconds (time features)
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1 per shot
- **Status:** live — logistic_l2 candidate artifacts exist; promotion/serving managed elsewhere (lib/xg releaseArtifactReference)
- **Tests:** `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.test.ts`; `web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.test.ts`; `web/lib/xg/binaryLogistic.test.ts`; `web/lib/xg/calibration.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** xG shot scoring, NST-parity metrics, rebound heads, CTPI/team ratings via xG columns (other slices)
- **Reference standard:** MoneyPuck / Evolving-Hockey xG (multi-season training, score-state and shooter/rebound angle-change features)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - approval-run artifact cfg9bac2706 (default reference for audit-xg-registry-feature-coverage.ts and rebound-heads script) includes now-forbidden post-event features isShortSideMiss and missReasonBucket; its test log loss 0.142 vs 0.243 for the corrected candidate
  - trained on one partial season with playoffs in the test split; no multi-season training
  - shot angle is unsigned (atan2 of absolute deltas)
  - trainer CLI default family is xgboost_js while saved/approved artifacts are logistic_l2

### XG-031 Binary logistic regression trainer (in-house gradient descent)

- **Sub-family:** xG / model training
- **Purpose:** Fit the production shot-goal model (logistic_l2) and calibrators.
- **Where:** `web/lib/xg/binaryLogistic.ts:84 (trainBinaryLogisticModel)`; `web/lib/xg/binaryLogistic.ts:135 (predictBinaryLogisticProbability)`; `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:931 (resolveFitOptions)`; `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:2008 (call)`
- **Inputs:** standardized features; labels; optional weights
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** Full-batch gradient descent from zero weights/bias: grad = sum(error*x*w)/totalWeight; update w -= lr*(grad + l1*sign(w) + l2*w); bias unpenalized. Defaults: 800 iterations, lr 0.05. Families: logistic_unregularized (l1=0,l2=0), logistic_l2 (l2=0.01), logistic_elastic_net (l1=0.001,l2=0.01). Output clipped to [1e-9, 1-1e-9]. No convergence check.
- **Outputs:** weights; bias
- **Tables written:** model-artifact.json model
- **Input units:** standardized features
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1
- **Status:** live (offline) — run manually via `tsx web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts`; produced artifacts consumed by update-nhl-xg-shot-predictions via artifact path env; corrected candidate approved=true
- **Tests:** `web/lib/xg/binaryLogistic.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** shot xG scoring; Platt calibrator; rebound heads
- **Reference standard:** scikit-learn LogisticRegression (lbfgs, converged); Evolving-Hockey/MoneyPuck use gradient boosting (XGBoost/GBM)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 800 fixed GD steps with lr 0.05 from zero is likely unconverged (corrected candidate test log loss 0.2434 vs null-model ~0.260; typical public xG ~0.20-0.21)
  - approval run cfg56c3fc2f used lr 1e-4 and collapsed to mean prediction 0.0008 (log loss 1.43)
  - subgradient L1 (not proximal)
  - purely linear in distance/angle (no log/spline/interaction terms)

### XG-035 xgboost_js boosted-tree family (third-party @fractal-solutions/xgboost-js)

- **Sub-family:** xG / model training
- **Purpose:** Alternative tree model; CLI default family.
- **Where:** `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:968 (resolveBoostingFitOptions)`; `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:2013 (new XGBoost)`; `web/lib/xg/shotFeaturePersistence.ts:585 (predictXgBoostNode)`; `web/lib/xg/shotFeaturePersistence.ts:593 (predictXgBoost)`; `web/node_modules/@fractal-solutions/xgboost-js/src/xgboost.js:22 (fit), :121 (predictSingle)`
- **Inputs:** features; labels
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** lr 0.1, maxDepth 3, minChildWeight 5, numRounds 60. Library fits residuals (y - p) in PROBABILITY space starting at 0.5, leaf = mean residual, split gain = sum^2/n; prediction = sigmoid(0.5 + lr*sum(leaves)). Repo scorer re-implements the same (prediction starts 0.5, sigmoid at end).
- **Outputs:** trees; featureImportance
- **Tables written:** model-artifact.json
- **Input units:** standardized features
- **Output scale:** claimed probability 0-1 (miscalibrated)
- **Status:** legacy/draft — artifacts in web/scripts/output/xg-baselines/xgboost_js-*; production candidate is logistic_l2
- **Tests:** `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.test.ts`; `web/scripts/benchmark-nhl-xg-baselines.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** benchmark-nhl-xg-baselines.ts; scoring if artifact.family=='xgboost_js'
- **Reference standard:** XGBoost binary:logistic (gradient+hessian in logit space) as used by Evolving-Hockey
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - train/predict mismatch: training accumulates in probability space but prediction applies sigmoid to that sum, so outputs cluster near sigmoid(~0.07..0.5) ~ 0.52-0.62 — not valid probabilities without heavy recalibration
  - it is the CLI default family (train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:665 default 'xgboost_js')
  - not true XGBoost (no hessian, no regularization)

### XG-037 xG-adjusted player impact (shot-level ridge, 'RAPM-like')

- **Sub-family:** xG / player impacts
- **Purpose:** Estimate one coefficient per skater for on-ice xG differential with teammate/opponent and context controls.
- **Where:** `web/lib/xg/adjustedImpact.ts:216 (buildContextFeatures)`; `web/lib/xg/adjustedImpact.ts:310 (buildAdjustedImpactDesignRows)`; `web/lib/xg/adjustedImpact.ts:430 (fitAdjustedImpactBaseline)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-adjusted-impact.ts:292 (defaults)`
- **Inputs:** approved shot xg; on-ice skaters from shift stint at event time; strength, score diff, period seconds, zone, rest days
- **Source tables:** nhl_xg_shot_predictions, nhl_xg_shot_features, nhl_api_shift_rows, games
- **Method:** One design row PER SHOT (no rows for shot-free time). Response = shot xG (response_xg_differential = xg, always >=0). Shooting-team skaters coded +1, opponents -1 (goalies removed), single coefficient per player (offense and defense pooled). Context: is_home +/-1, period_seconds/1200, owner score diff, rest-day diff, one-hot strength_state, strength_exact, score bucket, zone_code, shot_zone_code. Fit: full-batch GD on squared error, intercept init = mean response, 500 iterations, lr 0.03, L2 0.1 on player and context weights; minPlayerRows=100 (route default). SE approx = sqrt(MSE / player rows).
- **Outputs:** player coefficient; standard_error_approx; offensive_rows; defensive_rows; context coefficients
- **Tables written:** nhl_xg_adjusted_impact_model_runs, nhl_xg_adjusted_player_impacts
- **Input units:** xG per shot; seconds/1200; goal diff; days
- **Output scale:** regression coefficient in xG-per-shot units
- **Status:** live (diagnostic) — route update-nhl-xg-adjusted-impact.ts; adjustedImpactPromotionContract currentStatus 'diagnostic_live', 'do not render as a rankings metric'
- **Tests:** `web/lib/xg/adjustedImpact.test.ts`; `web/lib/rankings/adjustedImpactPromotionContract.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/lib/rankings/defensiveCompositeMethodology.ts:38 (cited as diagnostic source); web/lib/rankings/adjustedImpactPromotionContract.ts (gate); web/lib/ml/featureLeakageRegistry.ts
- **Reference standard:** Macdonald (2011/2012) xG RAPM / Schuckers-Curro THoR; Evolving-Hockey RAPM (stint rows, per-60 response, TOI weights, separate O/D coefficients, ridge via cross-validated lambda)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - NOT RAPM in the standard sense: rows are shots not stints, so shot volume/rate is not modeled — only xG per shot conditional on a shot; response is never negative
  - single pooled coefficient per player conflates offense (+1 rows) and defense (-1 rows) — promotion contract itself lists 'defense_specific_target' as missing
  - no TOI weighting, no per-60 normalization, no separate PP/SH models (strength only as context dummy); EN shots included
  - GD with fixed 500 steps likely unconverged; L2 0.1 not cross-validated
  - SE formula is heuristic

- **Outputs:** created_xg; shot_assist_created_xg; transition_created_xg
- **Tables written:** nhl_xg_player_created_xg_game_aggregates, nhl_xg_player_created_xg_rolling_aggregates

- **Reference standard:** EH/MoneyPuck xA-like 'xG created'

### XG-042 Lagged residual shooter/goalie skill layer

- **Sub-family:** xG / player impacts
- **Purpose:** Adjust baseline xG with shrunken prior-to-date shooter finishing and goalie save residuals.
- **Where:** `web/lib/xg/residualSkill.ts:23 (effect)`; `web/lib/xg/residualSkill.ts:32 (buildLaggedResidualSkillLayers)`; `web/pages/api/v1/xg/operations.ts:15 (import)`
- **Inputs:** baselineXg; label; shooterId; goalieId; gameDate
- **Source tables:** nhl_xg_shot_predictions
- **Method:** Process shots chronologically; effect = mean(residual) * n/(n+200), only if n >= 50 prior shots; shooter residual = label - xg; goalie residual = xg - label. adjusted = clamp(xg + shooterEffect - goalieEffect, 0, 1). State updated after each shot (strictly lagged).
- **Outputs:** shooterFinishingEffect; goalieSaveEffect; adjustedProbability
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** probability
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1
- **Status:** live (diagnostic) — only caller web/pages/api/v1/xg/operations.ts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/xg/residualSkill.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/pages/api/v1/xg/operations.ts (diagnostic)
- **Reference standard:** Shooter talent regression to mean (Tango-style n/(n+k)); MoneyPuck shooting talent adjusted xG; EH xFSh%/goalie GSAx
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - additive adjustment in probability space (not logit) can go negative/clamped
  - same-game events update state before later shots in that game (within-game lag only)
  - k=200 and min 50 are magic numbers

### XG-043 Shot-assist candidates / expected primary assists

- **Sub-family:** xG / player impacts
- **Purpose:** Heuristic credit of shot xG to the prior same-team event actor.
- **Where:** `web/lib/xg/shotAssists.ts:75 (MAX_SHOT_ASSIST_WINDOW_SECONDS=8)`; `web/lib/xg/shotAssists.ts:133 (scoreShotAssistConfidence)`; `web/lib/xg/shotAssists.ts:177 (buildShotAssistCandidateRows)`
- **Inputs:** shot features (time/distance from previous); previous event; approved xg
- **Source tables:** nhl_xg_shot_features, nhl_xg_shot_predictions, nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** Eligible: unblocked, non-rebound shot; previous event same team, 0<dt<=8 s, previous type not in excluded set (faceoff, shots, goal, giveaway, stoppage, penalties, period events...) -> effectively takeaways and hits. confidence = 0.35 +0.25 (dt<=3) or +0.15 (dt<=5) +0.15 (dist<=35) or +0.05 (dist<=70) +0.10 (entered OZ) +0.05 (regained) -0.20 (hit), clamped [0.1,0.85]; tiers >=0.7 high, >=0.45 medium. expected_primary_assists = xg * confidence.
- **Outputs:** expected_primary_assists; confidence; confidence_tier
- **Tables written:** nhl_xg_shot_assist_candidates
- **Input units:** seconds, feet
- **Output scale:** xG goals x confidence 0.1-0.85
- **Status:** live — route update-nhl-xg-shot-assists.ts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/xg/shotAssists.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** created xG; xgExplorer
- **Reference standard:** Tracked passing data (Corey Sznajder/AllThreeZones), MoneyPuck/EH xA
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - NHL PBP has no pass events — 'shot assists' are takeaway/hit-to-shot proxies; resolvePriorEventActor branches for faceoff/blocked-shot are unreachable (types excluded)
  - confidence weights are hand-set

### XG-044 Transition proxies (controlled entry/exit, transition-created xG)

- **Sub-family:** xG / player impacts
- **Purpose:** Proxy zone transitions from PBP and credit shot xG to transition actors.
- **Where:** `web/lib/xg/transitions.ts:142 (isControlledSource)`; `web/lib/xg/transitions.ts:159 (isTransitionShot)`; `web/lib/xg/transitions.ts:178 (addAggregateMetric)`; `web/lib/xg/transitions.ts:237 (buildTransitionRows)`
- **Inputs:** shot features (rush, possession); source events; approved xg
- **Source tables:** nhl_xg_shot_features, nhl_xg_shot_predictions, nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** Transition shot = unblocked non-rebound shot that is a rush, or possession entered OZ with possession duration <=15 s. Source = rush source, else possession start, else previous event; faceoff sources skipped. Shooter gets transition_created_shot with confidence 0.7 (rush) / 0.5, minus 0.15 if source zone not D/N; actor gets controlled_entry_proxy (0.7/0.5) when source zone N/D and same team; controlled_exit_proxy (0.65/0.45) when source zone D; dump_in 0.3 if type contains 'dump'. transition_created_xg = xg * confidence.
- **Outputs:** transition events; controlled_entries; controlled_exits; transition_created_xg
- **Tables written:** nhl_xg_transition_events, nhl_xg_transition_game_aggregates
- **Input units:** seconds
- **Output scale:** xG x confidence
- **Status:** live — route update-nhl-xg-transitions.ts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/xg/transitions.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** created xG; xgExplorer
- **Reference standard:** Tracked zone-entry data (Sznajder AllThreeZones), EH/MoneyPuck rush stats
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - dump_in_entry_proxy increments controlled_entries in aggregates
  - isDumpInSource can never be true for NHL type_desc_key values (no 'dump' events) — dead branch
  - one shot can credit the same xg to shooter + entry + exit actors (sum > shot xG)
  - failed_exit_against_proxy / entry_assist_proxy rules hand-set (0.35/0.45)

### XG-050 Flurry-adjusted xG

- **Sub-family:** xG / prediction
- **Purpose:** Discount later shots in a flurry by prior non-scoring probability.
- **Where:** `web/lib/xg/flurryAdjusted.ts:22 (buildFlurryAdjustedPredictions)`; `web/lib/xg/flurryAdjusted.ts:50 (summarizeFlurryAdjustedXg)`; `web/lib/xg/aggregates.ts:312 (mergeXgFlurryMetadata)`

- **Input units:** probability
- **Output scale:** xG goals

- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - sequence ordering sorts by sequence id string then shot index — fine within a sequence

### XG-056 xG baseline trainer: train-only z-score standardization

- **Sub-family:** xG / training
- **Purpose:** Standardize numeric shot features before logistic/boosted xG training
- **Where:** `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:789 (buildNumericStandardization)`; `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:811 (applyFeatureTransforms)`
- **Inputs:** encoded numeric feature vectors (NUMERIC_FEATURE_KEYS / preset numericKeys)
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events, nhl_api_shift_rows, games, player_stats_unified, goalie_stats_unified, players

- **Input units:** feet, degrees, seconds (raw feature units before scaling)

- **Reference standard:** standard z-score scaling (sklearn StandardScaler uses population std too)

### XG-058 NST-parity goalie metrics (Sv%, GAA, 'gsaa', danger splits)

- **Outputs:** sv_percentage; gaa; gsaa; xg_against; hd/md/ld_*
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** seconds TOI
- **Output scale:** percent 0-100; per-60; goals

- **Consumers:** playerStatsLandingServer; release validation
- **Reference standard:** NST GSAA = SA*(league Sv%) - GA; GSAx = xGA - GA (MoneyPuck/EH)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - field named gsaa is actually GSAx vs heuristic xG (NST GSAA is vs league-average Sv%) — web/lib/socialShare/modules/goalieGsax.ts:14 explicitly warns about this naming

  - xg_against sums attempts incl. blocked while Sv% uses SOG

### XG-059 NST-parity heuristic xG and danger buckets

- **Sub-family:** xG / validation
- **Purpose:** Fallback xG and HD/MD/LD classification used when no model xG is attached to parity shots.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:399 (getDangerBucket)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:407 (getApproximateXgValue)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:421 (isScoringChance)`
- **Inputs:** shotDistanceFeet; shotAngleDegrees; isReboundShot; isRushShot; crossedRoyalRoad; isGoal
- **Source tables:** nhl_xg_shot_features
- **Method:** Danger: high if dist<=20 and angle<=35; medium if dist<=40 and angle<=50; else low. xG = 0.18/0.08/0.02 + 0.03 rebound + 0.02 rush + 0.02 royal road; if isGoal, xG = max(xG, 0.25); cap 0.95. Scoring chance = medium or high.
- **Outputs:** dangerBucket; approx xg; isScoringChance
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** feet, degrees
- **Output scale:** xG 0.02-0.95
- **Status:** live — used by buildNstParityMetrics (playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1086, release validation)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** buildNstParityMetrics (ixg, xgf, xga, goalie xg_against, gsaa)
- **Reference standard:** NST scoring-chance/high-danger zones (polygon-based), NST xG model
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - OUTCOME LEAKAGE: goals get xG floor 0.25, so heuristic xG depends on the result
  - danger boxes are distance/angle approximations, not NST's zone polygons
  - applied to blocked shots too (shot rows include blocked) — NST xG/scoring chances treat blocked shots differently

### XG-060 NST-parity skater individual and on-ice counts/rates

- **Sub-family:** xG / validation
- **Purpose:** Rebuild NST-style skater tables (counts, per-60, percentages) from NHL PBP + shifts.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:427 (toPct)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:432 (toPer60)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:1103 (buildNstParityMetrics)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:1341 (ixg accumulation)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:1423 (on-ice xgf/xga)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:1543 (zone starts)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:1601 (ipp, pdo, pct block)`
- **Inputs:** events; shot features; shift rows; split; score state filter
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events, nhl_api_shift_rows, nhl_xg_shot_features
- **Method:** Individual: goals, assists, shots (goal+SOG), iCF (all attempts), iFF, ixG (heuristic or attached xG), iSCF, iHDCF, rush attempts, rebounds created, PIM, hits, blocks, faceoffs. On-ice: CF/CA, FF/FA, SF/SA, GF/GA, xGF/xGA, SCF/SCA, HD/MD/LD CF/CA/GF/GA. per60 = value*3600/toiSeconds; pct = 100*for/(for+against); on-ice Sh% = 100*GF/SF; on-ice Sv% = 100*(SA-GA)/SA; PDO = Sh%+Sv% (~100 scale); IPP = 100*(G+A)/GF; OZS% = 100*OZ/(OZ+DZ) from faceoffs following stoppage/period start/goal/penalty for players starting shifts at that second. Splits: all, ev, 5v5, pp, pk, 5v4, 4v5, 3v3, withEmptyNet, againstEmptyNet; score filters tied/upOne/downOne/leading(>=2)/trailing(<=-2)/withinOne.
- **Outputs:** skater counts/rates/on-ice tables
- **Tables written:** (in-memory; served by underlying-stats landing; compared to nst_gamelog_* in validation)
- **Input units:** seconds TOI
- **Output scale:** per-60; percent 0-100; counts
- **Status:** live — via playerStatsLandingServer.ts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1086; web/scripts/run-nhl-xg-release-validation.ts
- **Reference standard:** Natural Stat Trick definitions (CF%, xGF%, PDO, IPP, OZS%)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - on-ice GF counts own goals (isGoal) while CF/SF exclude them
  - 'leading'/'trailing' score buckets mean >=2, not >=1 (NST 'leading' = any lead)
  - blocked shots contribute heuristic xG to xGF/xGA
  - ev split = owner-state EV which excludes EN but 'withEmptyNet' etc. overlap with pp/pk splits

### XG-065 Probability metrics: log loss, Brier, calibration bins, slice evaluation

- **Sub-family:** xG / validation

- **Inputs:** predictions; labels; strengthState; isReboundShot; isRushShot

### FRG-012 Horizon per-game scalars

- **Purpose:** Scale per-game projections across a multi-game horizon with decay and rest penalties
- **Where:** `web/lib/projections/utils/date-utils.ts:41 (buildSequentialHorizonScalarsFromDates)`; `web/lib/projections/stages/skater-stage.ts:1272 (fetchTeamHorizonScalars)`; `web/lib/projections/stages/goalie-stage.ts:719 (goalieHorizonScalars)`; `web/lib/projections/constants/projection-weights.ts:46`
- **Inputs:** team future game dates; horizonGames

- **Method:** Horizon clamped 1..10 (MAX_SUPPORTED_HORIZON_GAMES). Goalie horizon scalar = mean of own and opponent team scalars per index.
- **Outputs:** teamHorizonScalars; teamHorizonTotalScalar
- **Tables written:** forge_player_projections.proj_* (scaled), forge_team_projections, forge_goalie_projections

- **Output scale:** dimensionless multiplier 0.75-1.08 per game; sum ~ horizon
- **Status:** live — every run; horizon=1 returns [1]

### FRG-016 FORGE projection miss attribution (skater TOI/shot-rate/conversion; goalie starter/SA/SV%)

- **Purpose:** Attribute absolute fantasy-point misses to component drivers for diagnostics.
- **Where:** `web/pages/api/v1/db/run-projection-accuracy.ts:1960-2016 (skater loop)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/run-projection-accuracy.ts:922 (finalizeSkaterMissAttributionDiagnostics)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/run-projection-accuracy.ts:2236-2262 (goalie loop)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/run-projection-accuracy.ts:862 (finalizeMissAttributionDiagnostics)`
- **Inputs:** predicted/actual TOI, shots, goals, assists, PP points; DEFAULT_SKATER_FANTASY_POINTS; goalie projected/actual SA, saves, GA, starter_probability, modeled save%
- **Source tables:** forge_player_projections, forge_goalie_projections, wgo_skater_stats, goalie_stats_unified
- **Method:** Skater: FP = TOI * shotRate * FPperShot, with FPperShot = SOG weight + scoringFP/max(0.1,shots). Sequential substitution: TOI effect = \|FP(actTOI) - FP(pred)\|, shot-rate effect = \|FP(actTOI,actRate) - FP(actTOI)\|, conversion effect = \|FP(all actual) - FP(actTOI,actRate)\|. Goalie: starter = (1 - starterProb)*\|GA error\|; SA = \|(predSA-actSA)*(1-modeledSv)\|; SV% = \|actSA*(modeledSv-actSv)\|. Shares of explainable sum; primary driver = max share, 'MIXED' if another within 0.05.
- **Outputs:** share_of_explainable_error per driver; primary_driver
- **Tables written:** forge_projection_calibration_daily (metrics json, via accuracy run)
- **Input units:** TOI seconds; counts; fantasy points
- **Output scale:** shares 0-1
- **Status:** live — part of run-projection-accuracy
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/run-projection-accuracy.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** FORGE diagnostics / cron report
- **Reference standard:** Shapley-style or variance decomposition; sequential substitution is order-dependent
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - decomposition order (TOI, then rate, then conversion) changes attributions; hits/blocks fantasy points excluded from FP model here
  - modeled save% falls back to 0.9 when unknown

### FRG-017 FORGE projection accuracy metrics (MAE/RMSE/accuracy, Brier, interval coverage, holdout baselines)

- **Purpose:** Score settled FORGE skater and goalie projections against actuals and persist daily accuracy, calibration and launch-gate diagnostics.
- **Where:** `web/pages/api/v1/db/run-projection-accuracy.ts:508 (computeAggregate)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/run-projection-accuracy.ts:795 (updateCoverage)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/run-projection-accuracy.ts:968 (buildGoalieLaunchGates)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/run-projection-accuracy.ts:1111 (finalizeMetricComparison)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/run-projection-accuracy.ts:1185 (updateCalibrationAccumulator)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/run-projection-accuracy.ts:2119 (goalie baseline)`
- **Inputs:** forge_player_projections / forge_goalie_projections predictions and uncertainty p10/p90; actuals from wgo_skater_stats, goalie_stats_unified, forge_goalie_game; holdout baselines in uncertainty.model.holdout_baselines
- **Source tables:** forge_player_projections, forge_goalie_projections, forge_runs, wgo_skater_stats, goalie_stats_unified, forge_goalie_game, games, forge_projection_calibration_daily
- **Method:** Fantasy points via lib/projections/accuracy/fantasyPoints (computeSkaterFantasyPoints/computeGoalieFantasyPoints/computeAccuracyScore). MAE = mean\|pred-act\|, RMSE = sqrt(mean sq). Per-stat MAE/RMSE daily and rolling windows (30d). Probability calibration: clamp p and outcome to [0,1], Brier = mean (p-o)^2, 10 equal-width bins. Interval hit-rate = share of actuals within [p10,p90]. Model vs baseline compared on identical rows (deltas). Goalie baseline: GA = projected SA*(1-0.900), saves = SA-GA. Launch gates: saves MAE30 <= 4.5, GA MAE30 <= 1.4, starter Brier <= 0.20, win Brier <= 0.22, shutout Brier <= 0.08, saves and GA p10-p90 hit rate in [0.72, 0.90].
- **Outputs:** forge_projection_accuracy_daily; forge_projection_accuracy_player; forge_projection_accuracy_stat_daily; forge_projection_calibration_daily metrics; launch gate PASS/FAIL
- **Tables written:** forge_projection_accuracy_daily, forge_projection_accuracy_player, forge_projection_accuracy_stat_daily, forge_projection_calibration_daily
- **Input units:** fantasy points; stat counts; probabilities 0-1; TOI seconds or minutes (inferred)
- **Output scale:** MAE/RMSE in fantasy points or stat units; Brier 0-1; hit rate 0-1
- **Status:** live — final stage of /api/v1/db/run-rolling-forge-pipeline (vercel.json cron); route ledger calls=8
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/run-projection-accuracy.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/run-rolling-forge-pipeline.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/pages/api/v1/forge/accuracy.ts; web/pages/api/v1/forge/goalies.ts (calibration hints); web/lib/rollingForgePipeline.ts; web/lib/projections/goaliePipeline.ts
- **Reference standard:** Brier score and reliability diagrams; nominal 80% interval coverage for p10-p90; MAE/RMSE vs naive baseline
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - actual TOI unit inferred by magnitude (<= 80 treated as minutes, else seconds)
  - p10-p90 should cover 80% nominally; gate band [0.72,0.90] is asymmetric
  - goalie baseline uses a fixed 0.900 save% (same magic constant as goalie-projections-v2)
  - predictions and outcomes are clamped to [0,1] before Brier, hiding out-of-range model output

### FRG-020 FORGE goalie matchup win-probability normalization

- **Purpose:** Rescale projected goalie win probabilities in a matchup so they sum to 100%.
- **Where:** `web/pages/api/v1/forge/goalies.ts:151 (normalizeLikelyStarterWinProbabilities)`
- **Inputs:** forge_goalie_projections proj_win_prob, starter_probability, team_id, opponent_team_id
- **Source tables:** forge_goalie_projections, forge_runs, forge_projection_calibration_daily
- **Method:** Group rows by unordered team pair. Skip if any proj_win_prob is null. denominator = sum(max(0,win_prob)) else sum(starter_probability) else equal split 1/n. Each row = value/denominator rounded 4 dp; last row = 1 - running sum.
- **Outputs:** proj_win_prob (normalized); adjustedMatchups count
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** probabilities 0-1
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1
- **Status:** live — GoalieRiskCard; route ledger calls=13
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/forge/goalies.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/components/forge-dashboard/GoalieRiskCard.tsx; web/lib/dashboard/dataFetchers.ts
- **Reference standard:** Team win probabilities P(home)+P(away)=1; goalie-level win prob = P(start)*P(win\|start)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - every goalie row of both teams in the matchup (not just one likely starter per team) is normalized to sum to 1, so with two goalies per team team-level win probability is split, not preserved
  - run query filters run_id/as_of_date/horizon only; no starter filter before normalization
  - last-row remainder absorbs rounding, so ordering affects values

### FRG-023 FORGE skater counterfactual: conversion rates, used-rate clamps, bootstrap blend inversion

- **Purpose:** Re-derive FORGE skater G/A/PPP projections under alternative rules (Q7 no second shrink, Q8 B2B rest tiers, assist-denominator refits) from stored support counts
- **Where:** `web/scripts/forge-counterfactual-backtest.ts:54 (bayesSplitRates)`; `web/scripts/forge-counterfactual-backtest.ts:89 (usedRates)`; `web/scripts/forge-counterfactual-backtest.ts:112 (bootstrapWeights)`; `web/scripts/forge-counterfactual-backtest.ts:124 (counterfactualHeads)`; `web/scripts/forge-counterfactual-backtest.ts:171 (evaluateRow)`; `web/scripts/forge-counterfactual-backtest.ts:28 (VARIANTS)`
- **Inputs:** support_counts ev/pp goalPerShot & assistPerGoal (all, last5); goal/assist rate multipliers; trend multipliers; teammate coupling es/pp; season_bootstrap {currentSeasonGames, transitionGames, historyGames, historyWeight, fantasyWeight, sourceIds}; stored final G/A/PPP
- **Source tables:** local JSON exports of forecast runs, forge projections (S2), actuals (S3), games (S4)
- **Method:** audit re-derivation mirroring lib/projections/calculators/skater-adjustments: split conversion rates from ev/pp numerators/denominators (all + last5); goal rate clamps ES [0.025,0.30], PP [0.04,0.45]; assist trend clamps ES [0.2,1.7] / PP [0.3,2.0] (per-goal scale ES [0.4,3.4] / PP [0.6,4.0]); outer coupling clamps ES [0.2,1.8] / PP [0.3,2.1] (wideCoupling 3.0/3.5; per-goal 3.6/4.2); bootstrap organic share p = min(1, currentSeasonGames/(transitionGames\|\|20)), W = p + historyWeight(if history) + fantasyWeight(if sources); inversion residual R = W*final - p*organic, counterfactual = (p*organic' + restScale*R)/W; organic' scales goals by rg'/rg and assists by (rg'/rg)(ra'/ra); PPP optionally capped at G+A; tolerances rate 5e-4, rest 1.5e-4, residual 1e-3 drop mismatched rows
- **Outputs:** per-row counterfactual G/A/PPP per variant (baseline,q7,q8,q7q8,a1..a5)
- **Tables written:** --output markdown/JSON file only
- **Input units:** counts per player (goals, shots, assists), rates per shot/per goal, multipliers unitless
- **Output scale:** expected counts per game (G, A, PPP)
- **Status:** draft — offline research backtest, run manually on local exports
- **Tests:** `web/scripts/forge-counterfactual-backtest.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** FORGE methodology decisions (Q7/Q8, assist denominator R18); forge-skater-candidate-ablation.ts imports summarize/clusterBootstrap
- **Reference standard:** empirical-Bayes rate shrinkage; held-out MAE/RMSE comparison
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - per-goal clamps copied by hand from skater-stage.ts (comment says not imported) so can drift
  - assist denominator 'per_two_goals' (assists per 2 goals) is the stored legacy scale; calculators' omitted default is 'mixed' per code comment

### FRG-036 FORGE v2 issuance: joint-distribution coherence gate and category support

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / FORGE v2 pipeline stage (issuance)
- **Purpose:** Before publishing a vintage, pick the categories the joint distribution must cover and refuse joints whose implied means disagree with the conditional means.
- **Where:** `web/lib/forge-v2/pipeline.server.ts:236 (runPreparedIssuance)`; `web/lib/forge-v2/pipeline.server.ts:262-276 (support, coherent, joint retry)`; `web/lib/forge-v2/pipeline.server.ts:285 (generation_crossed_lock)`
- **Inputs:** conditional category means (predictConditional); joint outcomes {probability, values}; scoring profiles (issued + calibration-bundle profiles); lockAt
- **Source tables:** FORGE v2 prepared ledger / artifacts store (forge-v2 isolated persistence)
- **Method:** Support = categories with a non-zero weight in any selected profile; if PPP is included, G and A are added. Coherent iff every support category's mean equals Σ outcome.probability × outcome.value within an absolute 1e-10. If incoherent and more than one profile, retry with only the issued profile's categories; otherwise the distribution is unavailable ('joint_mean_mismatch'). profileIds keep only profiles whose non-zero categories are all supported. Vintage refused if generatedAt >= lockAt. Means are flagged 'private_development_unqualified'.
- **Outputs:** distribution ArtifactReference (joint_distribution) or unavailable reason; vintage draft
- **Tables written:** FORGE v2 artifacts store (joint distribution, calibration), FORGE v2 vintage ledger
- **Input units:** per-game category counts
- **Output scale:** probability-weighted category counts; categorical availability
- **Status:** draft — FORGE v2 research pipeline; unqualified, private (PRD open gates 7.x/14.x)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/forge-v2/pipeline.test.ts`; `web/lib/forge-v2/lifecycle.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** FORGE v2 read API /api/v2/forge/[operation] via qualification; interval/score evaluation (horizonEvaluation)
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 1e-10 absolute tolerance on means does not scale with the size of the totals; float summation over large outcome tables could fail coherence by itself
  - the PPP → G and A coupling is hard-coded and does not include PP-specific components

### FRG-037 FORGE v2 operational health summary and alarms

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / FORGE v2 pipeline stage (operations)
- **Purpose:** Summarize FORGE v2 operations (latency, source age, missingness, queue, outcome lag, qualification drift) against approved limits and estimate retention size.
- **Where:** `web/lib/forge-v2/operations.ts:22 (summarizeOperations)`; `web/lib/forge-v2/operations.ts:18-19 (maximum, average)`; `web/lib/forge-v2/operations.ts:140 (estimateRetention)`
- **Inputs:** opportunities; refresh queue; publications with receipts; integrity incidents; settlements (endedAt, outcome); qualification checks; limits (maximumPublicationLatencyMs, maximumSourceAgeMs, maximumOutcomeLagMs, maximumQueued, maximumRetries)
- **Source tables:** FORGE v2 queue/publication/settlement records (supplied)
- **Method:** Alarms: limits missing; source age (now − observedAt) > maximumSourceAgeMs; pending > maximumQueued; retries = Σ max(0, attempts − 1) > maximumRetries; outcome lag ((settled ? recordedAt : now) − endedAt) > maximumOutcomeLagMs; qualification drift (decision unavailable or scope hash changed); integrity incidents. Publication latency is reported as mean and maximum. Missingness = count of unavailable means per category, plus opportunities without a publication. health = blocked if any alarm; readyForActivation is always false. Retention estimate: rows = scopes × dailyRevisions × days; bytes = rows × canonical-JSON bytes of a sample.
- **Outputs:** health blocked\|within_supplied_limits; alarms[]; latency/sourceAge/outcomeLag mean & max; missingness by category; retention rows/bytes
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** milliseconds; counts; bytes
- **Output scale:** ms, counts, bytes; categorical health

- **Consumers:** FORGE v2 release transitions (transitionRelease); lifecycle rehearsal tests
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**

  - latency is summarized as mean/max only (no percentiles), and the retention estimate is uncompressed JSON, not a storage bill

### FRG-038 FORGE v2 qualification gate (serving eligibility of means and participation)

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / FORGE v2 pipeline stage (qualification)
- **Purpose:** Decide whether a vintage's category means and participation probability can be served publicly under a qualified manifest.
- **Where:** `web/lib/forge-v2/qualification.ts:28 (qualificationScope)`; `web/lib/forge-v2/qualification.ts:43 (assessQualification)`; `web/lib/forge-v2/qualification.ts:75 (qualifiedMeans)`; `web/lib/forge-v2/qualification.ts:80 (qualifiedParticipation)`
- **Inputs:** vintage (horizon, cohort, means, scoring profile, versions); QualificationManifest (horizons, categories, profileIds, intervalLevels, jointGenerator); evidence records (frozen_protocol, independent_final, prospective_shadow, independent_review)
- **Source tables:** FORGE v2 qualification manifests/evidence (trusted read layer)
- **Method:** Scope: horizons must be contiguous 1..k with k <= 10. Categories must be valid and include every non-zero DEFAULT_SCORING category. The default profile, participationQualified, and interval levels 0.5 and 0.9 are required, as is a hashed joint generator. Scope is full_v2 iff 10 horizons and all 7 categories, else contiguous_subset. Vintage must be public_serving, share target/conditioning/model/feature/code versions with the manifest, have a supported horizon and cohort, and use scoring rule 'linear-seven-v1'. Every contributing category must be available. Four evidence records must have matching hashes and scope digest, be approved, passed and independent with author != reviewer, and be in chronological order. The final evaluation must be untouched, with a sample manifest different from the prospective one, and review issued after both evaluations. qualifiedMeans masks unqualified categories; participation must be a finite value in [0,1].
- **Outputs:** QualificationDecision {id, scope full_v2\|contiguous_subset, horizons} or unavailable reason; qualified CategoryMeans; qualified participation probability
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** horizon index 1..10; probabilities 0-1
- **Output scale:** categorical decision; participation probability 0-1
- **Status:** draft — fail-closed gate on /api/v2/forge/[operation]; no qualified evidence yet
- **Tests:** `web/lib/forge-v2/lifecycle.test.ts`; `web/lib/forge-v2/integration.test.ts`; `web/lib/forge-v2/uncertainty.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/lib/forge-v2/api.server.ts (public read); web/lib/forge-v2/operations.ts (qualification drift, release transitions); uncertainty.ts / participation.ts / integration.ts
- **Reference standard:** Pre-registered evaluation / holdout discipline

### FRG-039 FORGE v2 refresh cadence and material-event coalescing

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / FORGE v2 pipeline stage (scheduling)
- **Purpose:** Plan when FORGE v2 player-game forecasts are reissued (daily, pregame, material events), capped at game lock, and track horizon episodes.
- **Where:** `web/lib/forge-v2/refresh.ts:126 (easternDailyDeadline)`; `web/lib/forge-v2/refresh.ts:137 (planScheduledRefresh)`; `web/lib/forge-v2/refresh.ts:251 (enqueueMaterialEvent)`; `web/lib/forge-v2/refresh.ts:298 (claimRefreshBatch)`; `web/lib/forge-v2/schedule.ts:94 (observeHorizonEpisodes)`; `web/lib/forge-v2/schedule.ts:120 (advanceLock)`
- **Inputs:** opportunities (player, game, horizon, scheduledStartAt); accepted lock times; material events (affected players/games/teams); now; bounds (batchSize, concurrency)
- **Source tables:** FORGE v2 refresh queue state and schedule observations (isolated persistence)
- **Method:** lock = min(scheduled start, accepted lock). Daily job: deadline = min(08:00 America/New_York, found DST-safely as 12:00 or 13:00 UTC, lock), ready = min(now, deadline). Pregame: ready = deadline = min(start − 30 min, lock). Material event: ready = min(received + 5 min, deadline, lock − 1 ms), deadline = min(received + 15 min, lock). Pending unissued material jobs for the same target are coalesced, taking the minimum of lock/deadline/ready (≤1000 events). Scopes are capped at 100,000. Claim slots = min(batchSize, concurrency − running). A horizon episode number increments when a player-game re-enters the same horizon; episodes close when the horizon changes.
- **Outputs:** RefreshPlan/RefreshJob readyAt, deadlineAt, lockAt; horizon episode ledger; lock epochs
- **Tables written:** FORGE v2 refresh queue state, horizon episode / lock ledger
- **Input units:** ISO instants; minutes
- **Output scale:** timestamps
- **Status:** draft — FORGE v2 local implementation; hosted operation gated (PRD 13.2/14.x)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/forge-v2/refresh.test.ts`; `web/lib/forge-v2/schedule.test.ts`; `web/lib/forge-v2/lifecycle.test.ts`; `web/lib/forge-v2/history.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** FORGE v2 pipeline runPreparedQueueBatch; operations summary (due/on-time/late)
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**

### FRG-041 Goalie starter probability (FORGE logit/softmax)

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / goalie
- **Purpose:** Probability each candidate goalie starts
- **Where:** `web/lib/projections/calculators/goalie-starter.ts:126 (computeStarterProbabilities)`; `web/lib/projections/calculators/goalie-starter.ts:76 (selectStarterCandidateGoalieIds)`; `web/lib/projections/queries/goalie-queries.ts:86 (fetchTeamGoalieStarterContext)`; `web/lib/projections/queries/goalie-queries.ts:21 (fetchTeamLineComboGoaliePrior)`; `web/lib/projections/constants/projection-weights.ts:11-25`
- **Inputs:** L10 starts by goalie; prior start prob; line-combo goalie prior; projected GSAA/60; season start pct; season GP; B2B; team/opponent goals for; days since last played
- **Source tables:** forge_goalie_game, games, goalie_start_projections, lineCombinations, players
- **Method:** Starter per team date = goalie row with max toi_seconds; L10 share = starts/10. score = 2.4(l10-0.5) + 0.7 logit(prior) + 0.45 logit(lineComboPrior; decay 0.82^i over 12 combos) + 0.5*clamp(GSAA60,±0.6) + 0.28(seasonPct-0.5)*gw + 0.2*gw (gw=GP/(GP+10)); -2.75 if played yesterday on B2B, +0.65 other goalie on B2B; weaker-team B2B -1.1 primary/+0.45 backup (gap 0.35 goals); weak opponent (<=2.6 GF) -0.7 primary/+0.3 backup; staleness -6 (>75 d), -3 (>30 d), -0.8 (>14 d), +0.2 (<=7 d). 2 candidates: sigmoid(diff) clamp 0.02-0.98; >2: softmax then each clamp 0.01-0.98; 1 candidate = 1. Candidate ranking score: override 100, confirmed 25, prior*10, starts*1.5, -min(days,120)/30, limit 3.
- **Outputs:** probability by goalie; selected starter; topStarterScenarios
- **Tables written:** forge_goalie_projections.starter_probability
- **Input units:** counts; probabilities; GSAA per 60

NST: w = G/(G+30); dangerEdge clamp((defXGA60-2.5)/2.5,±0.25), pace clamp ±0.2 on opp xGA60; contextPct = clamp((0.32*danger+0.12*pace)*w,±0.05). In-house prior: xga/games_count over 10-game window; nhl_team_data row chosen where xga/xga_per_game matches standings GP within 1.5.

### FRG-046 Modeled save percentage (beta-binomial) with context shifts

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / goalie
- **Purpose:** Goalie save% posterior plus fitted rest/workload and damped context shifts
- **Where:** `web/lib/projections/goalie/goalieOutcomes.ts:56 (posteriorSavePct)`; `web/lib/projections/goalieModel.ts:127 (computeModeledSavePct)`; `web/lib/projections/goalie/goalieOutcomes.ts:69 (goalieRestSavePctAdjustment)`; `web/lib/projections/stages/goalie-stage.ts:535 (savePctAdjustment)`; `web/lib/projections/stages/goalie-stage.ts:369 (contextSavePctShift)`; `web/lib/projections/calculators/goalie-save-pct-context.ts:41 (computeGoalieRestSplitSavePctAdjustment)`
- **Inputs:** baseline or season shots/goals; league sv%; workload; rest split profile; contextPct; team 5v5 save edge
- **Source tables:** forge_goalie_game, wgo_goalie_stats, wgo_team_stats
- **Method:** posterior = (saves + 6000*league)/(shots + 6000) using baseline window if baseline shots >= season shots else season. Adjustment = rest term (-0.003 if goalie B2B else -0.002 if >=5 starts in 14 days) + 0.25 x (contextShift + restSplit). contextShift = clamp(-0.04*contextPct + teamFiveOnFive.leagueSavePctAdjustment, ±0.02). restSplit = clamp((bucketSv - games-weighted mean sv)*g/(g+6), ±0.012), min 2 games. final clamp 0.85-0.94; GA = SA*(1-sv); saves = SA-GA.
- **Outputs:** modeledSavePct; projectedGoalsAllowed; projectedSaves
- **Tables written:** forge_goalie_projections.proj_goals_allowed/proj_saves
- **Input units:** counts; save fraction
- **Output scale:** save fraction 0.85-0.94
- **Status:** live
- **Tests:** `web/lib/projections/goalieModel.test.ts`; `web/lib/projections/goalie/goalieOutcomes.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** win/shutout probabilities; fantasy points; accuracy
- **Reference standard:** Beta-binomial save% shrinkage (k ~3,000-11,000 shots in literature); GSAx
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - observation: no shot-quality (xG) adjustment; raw sv%
  - observation: team 5v5 save% (largely this goalie's own) feeds back in as a context shift (double counting)
  - observation: rest-split adjustment chases WGO days-rest splits (known noise) with k=6 games
  - observation: 'workload' counts appearances (relief included) from forge_goalie_game

### FRG-047 Team win probability (Poisson race) and goalie win populations

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / goalie
- **Purpose:** P(team wins incl. OT/SO), goalie-conditional win, credited goalie W including relief
- **Where:** `web/lib/projections/goalie/goalieOutcomes.ts:92 (teamWinProbability)`; `web/lib/projections/goalie/goalieOutcomes.ts:130 (marketTeamWinProbability)`; `web/lib/projections/goalie/goalieOutcomes.ts:157 (goalieConditionalWinProbability)`; `web/lib/projections/goalie/goalieOutcomes.ts:235 (goalieWinPopulations)`; `web/lib/projections/stages/goalie-stage.ts:382 (teamWinProb)`; `web/lib/projections/stages/goalie-stage.ts:564 (teamGoalsPerShot)`
- **Inputs:** team and opponent projected goals (ES+PP sums); h2h moneyline; goalie save% vs team start-weighted
- **Source tables:** forge_player_projections (summed), market_prices_daily
- **Method:** Shrink expected goals toward their mean by 0.75 (Brier optimum 0.5 on trailing-10 inputs); independent Poisson regulation; ties x1.33 (cap 0.95); regulation win = W/(W+L)*(1-tie); OT share f/(f+a). Market: de-vigged proportional h2h if book sum in [0.98,1.35]. Goalie-conditional: team prob + [P(λf, λa*ratio) - P(λf, λa)], ratio = goalie GA/shot over start-weighted team GA/shot, clamp 0.01-0.99. Credited W = P(start) x P(win\|start) x 0.984 + relief share (1-0.984) distributed by start probability.
- **Outputs:** teamWinProb; winProbability (goalie); win_populations metadata
- **Tables written:** forge_goalie_projections.proj_win_prob, uncertainty.win_populations
- **Input units:** expected goals per game; American odds or implied prob
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1 (or expected wins for horizon>1)
- **Status:** live
- **Tests:** `web/lib/projections/goalie/goalieOutcomes.test.ts`; `web/lib/projections/goalieModel.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** goalie fantasy points; accuracy win Brier; forge/goalies API
- **Reference standard:** Poisson/Skellam goal models; de-vigged moneyline
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - observation: lambdas come from teamGoalsByTeamId = sum of horizon-scaled ES+PP player goals; for horizon >1 a multi-game total is used as a single-game Poisson mean
  - observation: ES+PP only (no SH, empty-net, OT goals), so lambdas are biased low
  - observation: proj_win_prob is multiplied by the horizon scalar sum (goalie-stage.ts:820) so it can exceed 1

### FRG-049 Goalie profile tiers (volatility, blowup risk, confidence, quality, recommendation)

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / goalie
- **Purpose:** Descriptive goalie risk tiers and START/SIT recommendation

Recommendation: AVOID if pStart<0.42; START if elite+stable or (pStart>=0.62 & blowup<=0.32); SIT if blowup>=0.42 & volatile; STREAM if pStart>=0.5 and above-average.

### FRG-062 Sportsbook de-vig

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / served forecasts
- **Purpose:** Convert American odds to implied probability and remove margin
- **Where:** `web/lib/projections/utils/devig.ts:77 (americanToDecimal)`; `web/lib/projections/utils/devig.ts:106 (devigShin)`; `web/lib/projections/utils/devig.ts:140 (devigProportional)`; `web/lib/projections/utils/devig.ts:150 (devigEqualMargin)`; `web/lib/projections/utils/devig.ts:183 (devigTwoWayAmerican)`; `web/lib/projections/utils/devig.ts:220 (devigYesOnly)`; `web/lib/projections/utils/devig.ts:246 (expectedValueAtAmericanPrice)`
- **Inputs:** American prices
- **Source tables:** prop_market_prices_daily, market_prices_daily
- **Method:** decimal = 1+p/100 (p>0) or 1+100/\|p\|; implied = 1/decimal; invalid in (-100,100). Shin: bisection on insider share z; proportional p/sum; equal-margin subtract (sum-1)/n (fallback proportional if <=0). Valid two-way book sum 0.98-1.35. Yes-only: estimate = implied - overround/2 (default 0.08, env FORGE_YES_ONLY_OVERROUND, max 0.3). EV = p*(decimal-1) - (1-p).
- **Outputs:** fair probabilities; overround; EV
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** American odds
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1
- **Status:** live
- **Tests:** `web/lib/projections/utils/devig.test.ts`

- **Reference standard:** Shin (1993); standard de-vig methods

### FRG-063 Model vs market prop comparison

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / served forecasts

- **Where:** `web/lib/projections/utils/market-output-builders.ts:385 (compareModelWithMarket)`; `web/lib/projections/utils/market-output-builders.ts:206 (getModelLineProbabilities)`; `web/lib/projections/utils/market-output-builders.ts:187 (forgePropOverProbability)`; `web/lib/projections/utils/market-output-builders.ts:159 (poissonOverProbability)`; `web/lib/projections/utils/market-output-builders.ts:33 (getProjectionValueForPropMarket)`; `web/lib/projections/queries/market-queries.ts:62 (summary averaging)`

### FRG-069 Small-sample shrinkage weight

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / skater
- **Purpose:** Evidence weight used to shrink TOI and goal conversion toward priors for thin samples
- **Where:** `web/lib/projections/calculators/skater-adjustments.ts:423 (computeSkaterSampleShrinkageAdjustments)`; `web/lib/projections/stages/skater-stage.ts:2163 (shrunkToiEs/Pp)`; `web/lib/projections/stages/skater-stage.ts:2297 (goalRateEs shrink)`; `web/lib/projections/reserveProjections.ts:63`
- **Inputs:** ev toi_seconds_avg_all; pp toi_seconds_avg_all; shots_total_all (ev, pp)
- **Source tables:** rolling_player_game_metrics
- **Method:** toiW = T/(T+900) with T = ev+pp TOI (SKATER_SMALL_SAMPLE_TOI_SECONDS_SCALE=900); shotW = S/(S+45); sampleWeight = 0.58*toiW + 0.42*shotW. isLowSample <0.45, callup fallback <0.22. Shrunk TOI = w*adjustedTOI + (1-w)*season avg TOI; goal rate = w*splitRate + (1-w)*F/D prior.
- **Outputs:** sampleWeight; isLowSample; usedCallupFallback
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** seconds (per-game average) and shot counts (cumulative)
- **Output scale:** weight 0-1
- **Status:** live
- **Tests:** `web/lib/projections/runProjectionV2.test.ts`; `web/lib/projections/reserveProjections.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** skater TOI; goal conversion; reserve lines; uncertainty metadata
- **Reference standard:** Tango regression to the mean (k = exposure where reliability = 0.5)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - observation: TOI evidence uses toi_seconds_avg_all (a per-game AVERAGE, ~800-1200 s) against a 900 s scale, so toiW is ~0.5 for nearly every player regardless of games played (likely unit mismatch: average vs cumulative)

### FRG-070 Hits and blocks per 60 (physical rates)

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / skater
- **Purpose:** All-situation hits/blocks per 60 blended recent vs three-season baseline shrunk to position prior with league rescale
- **Where:** `web/lib/projections/calculators/skater-adjustments.ts:467 (computeSkaterPhysicalEventRates)`; `web/lib/projections/constants/projection-weights.ts:93-109`; `web/lib/projections/queries/skater-queries.ts:448 (fetchLeaguePhysicalTotals)`; `web/lib/projections/stages/skater-stage.ts:2807`

League per60 = (60*events + prior60*S)/(minutes + S), S=9000 (F)/5750 (D) minutes; scale = clamp(per60/prior60,0.7,1.3). Baseline = (seasonEvents + 0.5*scale*(events3y - seasonEvents))*60 + priorMin*ref) / (seasonMin + 0.5*(min3y-seasonMin) + priorMin), priorMin hits 50 / blocks 300. Recent weight = m5/(m5+240) hits, m5/(m5+1000) blocks. Projected = rate x (ES+PP TOI x clamp(allTOI5/esPpTOI,1,1.3))/3600.

If any player's ES share >0.24 or PP share >0.58, blend 60% reconciled + 40% pre-reconciliation and renormalise to targets.
- **Outputs:** reconciled toi/shots per player
- **Tables written:** forge_player_projections.proj_toi_*, proj_shots_*
- **Input units:** seconds; shot counts
- **Output scale:** seconds and shots per game
- **Status:** live
- **Tests:** `web/lib/projections/reconcile.test.ts`; `web/lib/projections/runProjectionV2.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** goals (shots x rate); assists; goalie shots against (opponent)
- **Reference standard:** Top-down team-total constraints
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - observation: team shot totals are pinned to the team's own last-10 average, so opponent, pace, rest, trend and shot-quality multipliers only redistribute shots among teammates and never change team volume
  - observation: availability/recency/role-stability TOI reductions are undone by rescaling to 18,000 s
  - observation: last-10 strength averages have no game-type filter

### FRG-091 Player uncertainty Monte Carlo (p10/p50/p90)

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / uncertainty
- **Purpose:** Simulated quantiles for skater TOI, shots, goals, assists, points, PPP, hits, blocks
- **Where:** `web/lib/projections/uncertainty.ts:153 (buildPlayerUncertainty)`; `web/lib/projections/uncertainty.ts:63 (samplePoisson)`; `web/lib/projections/uncertainty.ts:969 (sampleGammaMeanOne)`; `web/lib/projections/uncertainty.ts:762 (simulationAlpha)`; `web/lib/projections/uncertainty.ts:102 (widenQuantiles)`; `web/lib/projections/uncertainty.ts:80 (quantilesFromSamples)`
- **Inputs:** per-game means; horizon scalars; scenario mixture; trend volatility multiplier; position
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** 400 samples, deterministic FNV-seeded RNG. Per game: TOI ~ Normal(mean, 10% ES / 15% PP SD), toiScale = drawn/base; shots ~ Poisson(mean*toiScale*Gamma(1/alpha)) with NB alpha from dispersion fit (TOI-conditional compounded with residual TOI CV); goals ~ Poisson(goal mean*toiScale) independent of drawn shots; assists ~ Poisson independent of goals; hits/blocks NB. Totals summed over horizon; quantiles at floor(p*(n-1)); spreads widened by trend volatility (0.75-1.8). Poisson >=30 uses rounded normal approx.
- **Outputs:** uncertainty.{toi_es_seconds,...,g,a,pts,sog,ppp,hit,blk}.p10/p50/p90
- **Tables written:** forge_player_projections.uncertainty
- **Input units:** seconds; counts per game
- **Output scale:** count quantiles over horizon
- **Status:** live (negativeBinomial:true passed from skater stage)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/projections/uncertainty.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** accuracy interval coverage; start chart; FORGE player pages
- **Reference standard:** NB2 count models; predictive intervals
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - observation: goals are not conditioned on simulated shots (gamma shot multiplier not propagated), assists independent of goals, so points/PPP spreads ignore G-A correlation
  - observation: no parameter uncertainty in rates; dispersion fit uses within-player-season variance, so bands may be too narrow
  - observation: p10/p90 of discrete counts with inclusive coverage scoring

### FRG-094 FORGE count dispersion fit (NB2 method of moments) and holdout scoring

- **Sub-family:** FORGE projections / uncertainty
- **Purpose:** Fit Var = mu + a*mu^2 + b*mu overdispersion for SOG/hits/blocks/G/A/saves and score on 2025-26 holdout
- **Where:** `web/scripts/fit-forge-dispersion.ts:35 (FIT_SQL)`; `web/scripts/fit-forge-dispersion.ts:78 (HOLDOUT_SQL)`; `web/scripts/fit-forge-dispersion.ts:177 (fitQuadraticLinear)`; `web/scripts/fit-forge-dispersion.ts:210 (scoreCells)`; `web/scripts/fit-forge-dispersion.ts:251 (runFit)`

- **Method:** fit seasons 2023-24 & 2024-25, date Oct 1-Apr 30, games_played=1, player-seasons with >=20 games; within player-season moments binned by mean; unconditional nu=sum n(s^2-m), du=sum n(m^2 - s^2/n); TOI-conditional mu_g = player-season count per second * game TOI; NNLS through origin of (Var-mu) on mu^2 and mu (fallback single-term by SSE); holdout = 2025-26 games, predictive mean = player's prior up-to-40-game mean (>=10 prior games, crosses seasons), 20 ntile bins of mu by stat/pos; score with lib countPmf: mean negative log score, ranked probability score, randomized PIT 10-bin total variation
