### PFC-010 Deterministic Gaussian copula simulation for season quantiles

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / advanced inference
- **Purpose:** Draws joint samples of all v4+v5 targets to produce reconciled p10/p50/p90
- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/advanced.py:1867 (_simulation_quantiles)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/advanced.py:2040 (player_rows)`
- **Inputs:** season means; variances (advanced summed or derived from v4 p10-p90 width)
- **Source tables:** v4 player aggregates, advanced aggregates
- **Method:** LCG (1664525, 1013904223) Box-Muller normals seeded by SHA-256; one common factor with correlation 0.65 for every target pair; value = mean + sd*(0.65*common + sqrt(1-0.65^2)*idio), clipped >=0; GP/GS capped at components (ROS) or 84; GA capped at SA; each draw reconciled; 256 draws; nearest-rank quantiles
- **Outputs:** p10; p50; p90 (advanced release)
- **Tables written:** advanced player-aggregates.jsonl
- **Input units:** season means and variances
- **Output scale:** p10/p50/p90 season totals
- **Status:** unknown — manual CLI season-advanced-train/-evaluate/-project (modeling/player_forecasts/__main__.py:163-175, docs/player-projections/player-forecasts-runbook.md advanced-v5 section); output imported with the season bundle; no scheduler found
- **Tests:** `modeling/player_forecasts/tests/test_harness.py`
- **Consumers:** advanced release import
- **Reference standard:** Gaussian copula with estimated correlation matrix
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - a single 0.65 correlation for all targets (including GA vs saves, hits vs goals) is unestimated and forbids negative correlations
  - 256 draws give noisy p10/p90
  - non-ROS cap of 84 games while the schedule has 82

### PFC-011 Advanced per-game mean/variance and team season totals

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / advanced inference
- **Purpose:** Builds per-game advanced components and team ROS totals with intervals
- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/advanced.py:1965 (game_rows)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/advanced.py:2159 (team_rows)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/advanced.py:1859 (_advanced_rate)`
- **Inputs:** entity rate; playingProbability; residual80PerGame; games
- **Source tables:** advanced artifact, v4 bundle
- **Method:** mean = rate*p; conditional variance = max(rate, residual80^2); variance = p*cv + p(1-p)*rate^2; p10/p90 = mean -/+ 1.2815515655*sd; team mean = rate*games (pace stays per game); team width = residual80*sqrt(games)
- **Outputs:** advanced unconditional means; variances; team p10/p50/p90
- **Tables written:** advanced bundles
- **Input units:** per-game rate; residual80 in target units; probability 0-1
- **Output scale:** per-game means/variances; team totals
- **Status:** unknown — manual CLI season-advanced-train/-evaluate/-project (modeling/player_forecasts/__main__.py:163-175, docs/player-projections/player-forecasts-runbook.md advanced-v5 section); output imported with the season bundle; no scheduler found
- **Tests:** none found
- **Consumers:** _simulation_quantiles; team aggregates
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - residual80 (80th percentile of \|error\| ~ 1.28 sd) is used as if it were one standard deviation, then multiplied by 1.28 again - intervals ~1.6x too wide in variance
  - team interval mean +/- residual80*sqrt(n) treats an 80% half-width as p10/p90 offsets but applies to totals assuming independence

### PFC-015 Contextual EB profile: age curve, back-to-back and home/away multipliers

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / aging
- **Purpose:** Estimates multiplicative age, rest and venue effects as ratios of game value to player mean
- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/season.py:1711 (_fit_context_profile)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/season.py:1817 (_row_context_multiplier)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/season.py:1691 (_age_on_date)`
- **Inputs:** game value; player all-history mean; age on game date (clamped 16..45); position; is_back_to_back; is_home
- **Source tables:** season freeze, fhfh_player_identities.birth_date
- **Method:** ratio = value/player_mean (unclipped); age curve per (position, integer age) = (sum ratios + 100)/(n + 100) clipped [0.8,1.2]; player age baseline = mean of curve over the player's games; B2B = (sum+200)/(n+200) clipped [0.85,1.15]; home/away likewise k=200; row multiplier = (age_curve/player_baseline) * rest * venue clipped [0.7,1.3]; PLUS_MINUS excluded
- **Outputs:** ageCurves; playerAgeBaselines; backToBackMultiplier; homeMultiplier; awayMultiplier
- **Tables written:** season-artifact.json contextProfile
- **Input units:** ratio of game value to player mean (unitless); age in integer years
- **Output scale:** multipliers (age 0.8-1.2, B2B/venue 0.85-1.15, row 0.7-1.3)
- **Status:** unknown — run manually via `python -m modeling.player_forecasts season-train/season-project` (modeling/player_forecasts/__main__.py:112,130; docs/player-projections/player-forecasts-runbook.md:512-531); bundles imported by web/scripts/import-player-forecast-season.ts (npm import:player-forecast-season) into player_forecast_season_* read by pages/api/v1/player-forecasts/*; no cron in web/vercel.json or .github/workflows; hosted season inference gated by PLAYER_FORECAST_SEASON_INFERENCE_ENABLED (runbook:469 sets false)
- **Tests:** `modeling/player_forecasts/tests/test_harness.py`
- **Consumers:** contextual_empirical_bayes family; _target_multiplier; _future_age_multiplier
- **Reference standard:** Hockey aging curves (delta method; scoring peak ~24-27, decline after ~28-30); Marcel age adjustment
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - ratio-to-own-career-mean is a within-player cross-section, prone to survivor bias (players who decline leave the sample) and to era/role confounding
  - integer-age buckets per position with k=100 pseudo-games; no smoothing across adjacent ages
  - home and away multipliers are estimated separately, each shrunk to 1.0, so both can sit above or below 1 simultaneously

### PFC-017 Current-appearance skater rate (current-season-only decayed mean)

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / baseline rates

Targets GOALS, ASSISTS, POINTS, PP_POINTS, SHOTS_ON_GOAL, HITS, BLOCKED_SHOTS, PENALTY_MINUTES, TIME_ON_ICE_PER_GAME (minutes = seconds/60). No prior, no shrinkage; target missing if no valid observation.

  - PIM conditioned on positive minutes excludes penalty-only zero-TOI games

### PFC-019 Legacy skater baseline per-appearance rate (projection consensus + prior season prior, decayed recent form)

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / baseline rates
- **Purpose:** Per-appearance skater count rates blending public projection consensus, previous-season history and decayed current-season games.
- **Where:** `web/lib/player-forecasts/baselineRates.ts:90 (buildSkaterBaselineRates)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/baselineRates.ts:139 (consensusRate)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/baselineRates.ts:146 (prior blend)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/baselineRates.ts:154 (recent decay loop)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/baselineRates.ts:167 (ratePerAppearance)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/baselinePolicy.ts:56 (BASELINE_CANDIDATE_POLICY)`
- **Inputs:** projections[].totals[target]; projections[].projectedAppearances (Games_Played); appearances[].targets[target] (boxscore counts); seasonId; cutoffAt
- **Source tables:** PROJECTIONS_{season}_AG_SKATERS, PROJECTIONS_{season}_CULLEN_SKATERS, PROJECTIONS_{season}_DTZ_SKATERS, PROJECTIONS_{season}_5V5_SKATERS, nhl_api_game_payloads_raw (boxscore), games
- **Method:** consensusRate = equal-weight mean over available sources of total/projectedGP. previousSeasonRate = arithmetic mean over up to 82 most recent prior-season (seasonId-10001) regular-season appearances. prior = 0.6*consensus + 0.4*previous (falls back to whichever exists). Recent = up to 20 current-season appearances, weight 0.9^index (index counts all appearances in window, missing targets skip numerator+denominator but keep age). rate = (20*prior + sum(w*x)) / (20 + sum(w)), i.e. prior counts as 20 pseudo-appearances (max recent weight ~8.78, so recent form <=~30%). PLUS_MINUS may be negative; other targets must be >=0. Skips GP, SH%, FO%, TOI, SV%, GAA.
- **Outputs:** targets[].ratePerAppearance; consensusRate; previousSeasonRate; recentAppearanceCount
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** projection season totals and projected games played; boxscore counts per game (all strengths); TOI not a target here
- **Output scale:** count per appearance (non-negative except PLUS_MINUS)
- **Status:** legacy/dead — (projection-blend path) skater-baseline-rates-v1 is not in NATIVE_DAILY_APPROVED_METHODS (nativeDailyPipelineV2.ts:35); function still live as the kernel of the prior-appearance policy (baselineRates.ts:215)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/player-forecasts/contributions.test.ts`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/nativeBaselinePublication.test.ts`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/nativeContributionAdmission.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** baselineGeneration.buildBaselineContributionBundle; buildNativeSkaterBaselineSnapshot (legacy branch); contributions.resolveContribution baseline source
- **Reference standard:** Marcel projections (weighted seasons + regression to mean); Tango regression to the mean with k pseudo-games
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - reads draft-dashboard PROJECTIONS_* tables (equal-weight external consensus); native path excludes them, check against the 10-26 'FORGE must not read PROJECTIONS_* tables' rule
  - fixed k=20 pseudo-appearances for every target regardless of stat stability (goals vs hits), not stat-specific regression
  - whole-game all-strength boxscore counts; no TOI, role, opponent or participation adjustment
  - legacy 20252026 schema hard-coded with per-source column allowlists; dtz/5v5 skaters unsupported for legacy season
  - definition hash pinned at module load (throws if policy changes)

### PFC-024 Native power-play points per game (landing scoring summary)

### PFC-025 Daily-board opponent/home/player-residual ridge context model

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / daily board

- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/daily_board_context.py:42 (context_features)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/daily_board_context.py:140 (fit_context)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/daily_board_context.py:166 (predict_context)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/daily_board_context.py:24 (POLICY)`

### PFC-028 Goalie start probability temperature scaling

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / daily board
- **Purpose:** Calibrates FORGE goalie-start probabilities within a team by temperature
- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/daily_board_models.py:140 (goalie_start_probabilities)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/daily_board_models.py:147 (fit_goalie_temperature)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/daily_board_goalies.py:24 (goalie_groups)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/daily_board_goalies.py:82 (train_goalie_calibration)`
- **Inputs:** issued FORGE goalie_start probabilities per team; official starter labels
- **Source tables:** settled FORGE forecast bundles
- **Method:** p_i' proportional to p_i^(1/T); T grid {0.5,0.75,1,1.25,1.5,2,3}; choose min mean log loss (tie toward T=1); evaluate Brier/log loss/calibration bins on later window; team-games need >=2 candidates and exactly one starter
- **Outputs:** temperature; calibrated probabilities; report
- **Tables written:** file: model.json, evaluation.jsonl, report.json
- **Input units:** probabilities 0-1 summing to 1 per team
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1; temperature 0.5-3

### PFC-031 Joint game scenario simulator (Poisson shot process, goal odds, assists, OT/shootout)

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / daily board
- **Purpose:** Simulates joint per-player and goalie outcomes for a game under deployment scenarios
- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/daily_board_scenarios.py:43 (_count)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/daily_board_scenarios.py:145 (simulate_game)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/daily_board_scenarios.py:255 (write_game_scenarios)`
- **Inputs:** scenario probabilities; per-strength minutes, shotsPerMinute, goalProbability, assistWeight, hits/blocks per minute; goalie goalOddsMultiplier; paceShape; assist count probabilities; OT multiplier, home shootout probability
- **Source tables:** supplied game JSON (no DB)
- **Method:** pace ~ Gamma(shape, 1/shape) mean 1; SOG count per team-strength = Poisson(sum minutes*shotRate*pace) via exponential arrivals; shooter chosen by weight; goal prob p' = p*m/(1-p+p*m) (odds multiplier); 0/1/2 assists by weights excluding shooter; OT 5 min sudden death with 3v3 shares and rate multiplier; shootout winner Bernoulli; hits/blocks Poisson(minutes*rate*pace); goalie SA/GA/saves/W/SO; TOI = 60 + OT
- **Outputs:** draws with player category outcomes, official score, winner
- **Tables written:** file: scenarios output
- **Input units:** minutes; shots per minute; probabilities 0-1; odds multiplier
- **Output scale:** per-draw integer counts; minutes
- **Status:** draft — Starter Board research CLI (module main()); promotionEligible False, servingDecision retain_FORGE; challenger and scheduler activation default off (docs/start-chart/launch-validation.md:20)
- **Tests:** `modeling/player_forecasts/tests/test_harness.py`
- **Consumers:** joint_fantasy_samples; CRPS evaluation
- **Reference standard:** Poisson/odds-ratio goal models; shot-based game simulators (e.g. MoneyPuck/HockeyViz)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - no empty-net, goalie pulls or relief (acknowledged)
  - shutout credited when GA=0 even if goalie loses in shootout (consistent with NHL rule) but SO goals not modeled as shots/saves

### PFC-043 Market implied mean from de-vigged props and moneyline team win

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / evaluation
- **Purpose:** Derive market-implied stat means and team win probabilities for comparison with served forecasts.
- **Where:** `web/lib/player-forecasts/servedForecastLedger.ts:193 (impliedMeanFromMarket)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/servedForecastLedger.ts:204 (buildMarketLedgerRows)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/servedForecastLedger.ts:243 (devigTwoWayAmerican, median)`
- **Inputs:** prop quotes (line, American prices); h2h moneylines; player position
- **Source tables:** prop_market_prices_daily, market_prices_daily
- **Method:** Implied mean = bisection (60 iterations, bracket [0, max(1, 4*line+10)]) for the mean whose model P(over \| no push) equals de-vigged market P(over), using FORGE fitted count distribution by position (Poisson fallback). Team win = median across books of two-way de-vigged fair probability. Quotes must be observed before snapshot and puck drop. Head preference e.g. goals: player_goals then anytime scorer.
- **Outputs:** market_lines.props[head] {line, market_p_over, implied_mean, model_p_over}; team_win.market_p_win; exp_* for source market
- **Tables written:** forge_served_forecast_ledger (source market, market_lines)
- **Input units:** American odds (price_american); prop line in stat units
- **Output scale:** market P(over) 0-1; implied mean in stat units; team win probability 0-1
- **Status:** live — LEDGER_MARKET_ENABLED = true (servedForecastLedger.ts:169); snapshot cron

### PFC-054 Rolling-origin randomized conformal 80% interval calibration

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / evaluation metrics
- **Purpose:** Scales per-player predictive variance so p10-p90 intervals cover 80% in validation
- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/season.py:2391 (_select_rate_policy standardized residuals)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/season.py:2474 (interval multiplier and variance scale)`
- **Inputs:** fold predictions of selected family; player weighted variance; prior
- **Source tables:** season freeze
- **Method:** predictive variance = (support*player_var + k*max(\|prior\|,0.01))/(support+k); z = \|y - estimate\|/sqrt(max(var,0.01)); interval multiplier = ceil(0.8n)-th order statistic of z; tie probability randomizes coverage to exactly 0.8; intervalVarianceScale = (multiplier/1.281551565545)^2
- **Outputs:** intervalStandardDeviationMultiplier; intervalVarianceScale; calibration80Coverage; calibrationObservedCoverage
- **Tables written:** season-artifact.json
- **Input units:** standardized absolute residuals (unitless)
- **Output scale:** sd multiplier; variance scale; coverage fraction 0-1
- **Status:** unknown — run manually via `python -m modeling.player_forecasts season-train/season-project` (modeling/player_forecasts/__main__.py:112,130; docs/player-projections/player-forecasts-runbook.md:512-531); bundles imported by web/scripts/import-player-forecast-season.ts (npm import:player-forecast-season) into player_forecast_season_* read by pages/api/v1/player-forecasts/*; no cron in web/vercel.json or .github/workflows; hosted season inference gated by PLAYER_FORECAST_SEASON_INFERENCE_ENABLED (runbook:469 sets false)
- **Tests:** `modeling/player_forecasts/tests/test_harness.py`
- **Consumers:** variances in train_season_artifact; evaluate_fantasy_batch gate 0.75..0.85
- **Reference standard:** split conformal prediction (absolute standardized residual)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - calibration is fit on the same folds it then reports, so calibration80Coverage is ~0.8 by construction (randomized ties) and the 0.75-0.85 gate cannot fail
  - calibrated on single games but applied to season sums assuming independence

### PFC-058 Historical-core feature engineering (career, season, last-N, EWMA, EB, opportunity-adjusted)

### PFC-067 Native goalie win rate per appearance (boxscore decision)

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / goalie
- **Purpose:** Observed win credits per positive-minute appearance over last 20 current-season appearances.
- **Where:** `web/lib/player-forecasts/goalieBaselineRates.ts:184 (buildNativeGoalieWinRates)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/goalieBaselineRates.ts:207 (wins/selected.length)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/nativeGoalieOutcomes.ts:19 (deriveNativeGoalieOutcomes)`
- **Inputs:** boxscore goalie decision W/L/O; starter flag; team scores; periodDescriptor
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_game_payloads_raw (boxscore)
- **Method:** Equal-weight mean of winCredit (W=1, L/O=0) over up to 20 most recent current-season positive-minute appearances incl. relief; any missing decision withholds whole rate. Decision validity: exactly one W on winning side, O only if period>3, one-goal margin in OT/SO.
- **Outputs:** WINS_GOALIE rate per_appearance
- **Tables written:** player_forecast_source_observations
- **Input units:** boxscore goalie decision W/L/O per positive-minute appearance
- **Output scale:** probability-like rate 0-1 (wins per appearance)
- **Status:** live — approved native-goalie-appearance-win-rates-v1 (nativeDailyPipelineV2.ts:35)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/player-forecasts/goalieBaseline.test.ts`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/nativeGoalieOutcomes.test.ts`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/nativeContributionAdmission.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** goalie contribution bundle; planning contributions x appearance probability
- **Reference standard:** Team win probability models (Elo/xG); goalie wins largely team-driven
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - no prior/shrinkage; with few appearances W rate can be 0 or 1
  - relief appearances rarely get decisions, mixing them depresses per-appearance W rate vs per-start
  - ignores opponent/team strength entirely

### PFC-075 Per-game evaluation: unconditional mean and mixture variance

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / inference
- **Purpose:** Converts conditional rates into per-game unconditional means, variances and quantiles
- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/season.py:4348 (evaluate_season_game)`
- **Inputs:** conditionalRates; conditionalVariances; playProbability/startProbability; multiplier
- **Source tables:** season artifact, schedule.json
- **Method:** mean = rate*multiplier (GP/GS = 1); unconditional = mean*p; conditional variance scaled by multiplier (not squared); variance = p*var + p*(1-p)*mean^2; baseline means use baselineConditionalRates and baseline probabilities; quantiles via _quantiles with maximum_games=1
- **Outputs:** conditionalMeans; unconditionalMeans; baselineUnconditionalMeans; variances; quantiles; componentHash
- **Tables written:** file: game-outputs.jsonl -> player_forecast_season_game_outputs via importer
- **Input units:** per-game rates; probabilities 0-1; TOI seconds
- **Output scale:** per-game means, variances, quantiles

### PFC-077 Season skater game-label construction (TOI split, assists, strength splits)

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / labels
- **Purpose:** Builds per-player-game training labels for 37 skater targets from boxscore, normalized PBP and WGO rows
- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/season.py:186 (SKATER_QUERY)`
- **Inputs:** skatersGameStats toi/powerPlayToi/shorthandedToi/goals/assists/shots/hits/blockedShots/pim/faceoffs; nhl_api_pbp_events strength_state/period_type/assist1/assist2; wgo_skater_stats per-game fields

- **Tables written:** file: season freeze skaters.jsonl

- **Output scale:** per-player-game counts and seconds
- **Status:** unknown — run manually via `python -m modeling.player_forecasts season-freeze` (modeling/player_forecasts/__main__.py:102; docs/player-projections/player-forecasts-runbook.md:512-531); bundles imported by web/scripts/import-player-forecast-season.ts (npm import:player-forecast-season) into player_forecast_season_* read by pages/api/v1/player-forecasts/*; no cron in web/vercel.json or .github/workflows; hosted season inference gated by PLAYER_FORECAST_SEASON_INFERENCE_ENABLED (runbook:469 sets false)
- **Tests:** `modeling/player_forecasts/tests/test_harness.py`
- **Consumers:** _select_rate_policy / train_season_artifact (season.py); _assist_label_audit; _fantasy_metric_source_audit
- **Reference standard:** NHL official boxscore/Gamecenter definitions; NST per-strength TOI convention (EV=5v5+4v4+3v3)

### PFC-079 Season goalie game labels (starter, decisions, shutout, quality start)

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / labels
- **Purpose:** Derives goalie per-game targets including wins/losses/OTL, shutouts and quality starts

- **Inputs:** goaliesGameStats toi/saveShotsAgainst/goalsAgainst; gameOutcomes outcome; nhl_api_pbp_events period_type

- **Method:** goalie_order = row_number by TOI desc per team-game; GAMES_STARTED=1 for order 1 with TOI>0; WINS for order 1 when team outcome WIN; LOSSES when LOSS and no OT/SO period; OTL when LOSS and any OT/SO period; SHOTS_AGAINST = denominator of 'saves/shots'; SHUTOUTS when GA=0, order 1 and TOI>=3540s; QUALITY_STARTS when order 1, TOI>=3540s and (GA<=2 or SV%>=0.917)
- **Outputs:** GAMES_PLAYED; GAMES_STARTED; TOTAL_TOI; WINS_GOALIE; LOSSES_GOALIE; OTL_GOALIE; SHOTS_AGAINST_GOALIE; GOALS_AGAINST_GOALIE; SHUTOUTS_GOALIE; QUALITY_STARTS_GOALIE
- **Tables written:** file: season freeze goalies.jsonl

- **Output scale:** 0/1 per game indicators; counts; seconds

- **Tests:** none found
- **Consumers:** season goalie rate policies; evaluate_season_game
- **Reference standard:** NHL decision rules (win/loss credited to goalie in net for the deciding goal, not the max-TOI goalie); Vollman quality start (SV% >= league average ~.913, or >= .885 with <=20 shots)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - starter is defined as max-TOI goalie, and W/L/OTL are credited to that goalie, which mislabels games where the relief goalie got the decision
  - quality start uses an ad-hoc 'GA<=2 OR SV%>=.917' rule, not Vollman's definition and not a named fantasy-platform rule
  - shutout requires 59 minutes, so shared shutouts and relief appearances are excluded; GA includes empty-net goals only if boxscore includes them

### PFC-082 Skater participation frequency (eligible-opportunity appearance rate)

### PFC-085 Lineup/goalie text classification and lineup completeness

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / participation

- **Where:** `web/lib/player-forecasts/sourceObservations.ts:94 (goalieObservationStatus)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/sourceObservations.ts:108 (injuryObservationStatus)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/sourceObservations.ts:439 (completeness denominator)`
- **Inputs:** source text; assignments
- **Source tables:** line/goalie source rows (tweets, lines sites)
- **Method:** Regex keyword precedence: could/might/may/if -> projected; ruled out/not starting -> ruled_out; confirmed/will start/gets the start -> confirmed; likely/probable -> likely; projected/expected -> projected; else unconfirmed. ### PFC-088 Adjusted defense rating (on-ice suppression goal-equivalents per 60)

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / ratings
- **Purpose:** Estimates a skater's chance and goal suppression vs team/opponent expectation
- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/season.py:2781 (_adjusted_defense_ratings)`
- **Inputs:** defense_history rows
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_shift_rows, nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** expected chances per game = sqrt(team avg chances allowed * opponent avg chances generated); same for goals; scaled by ice share min(1, toi/3600); suppression = (expected chances - actual)*league goals per chance + (expected goals - actual goals); per 60 = total*3600/toi; shrink to position median with k=20 equivalent games (1200 s each)
- **Outputs:** defenseSuppressionPer60
- **Tables written:** season-artifact.json ratingSignals
- **Input units:** events per game; TOI seconds
- **Output scale:** goal-equivalents per 60 minutes
- **Status:** unknown — run manually via `python -m modeling.player_forecasts season-train/season-project` (modeling/player_forecasts/__main__.py:112,130; docs/player-projections/player-forecasts-runbook.md:512-531); bundles imported by web/scripts/import-player-forecast-season.ts (npm import:player-forecast-season) into player_forecast_season_* read by pages/api/v1/player-forecasts/*; no cron in web/vercel.json or .github/workflows; hosted season inference gated by PLAYER_FORECAST_SEASON_INFERENCE_ENABLED (runbook:469 sets false)
- **Tests:** `modeling/player_forecasts/tests/test_harness.py`
- **Consumers:** defense rating percentile; _roster_adjusted_team_contexts
- **Reference standard:** Evolving-Hockey RAPM / xGA-based defensive ratings; NST on-ice CA/60 relative
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - expected chances are a full-team per-game rate scaled by the player's TOI share, which ignores that 5 skaters share the ice - expectation is per team-60 not per player
  - no teammate/QoC adjustment and all strengths mixed (PK specialists penalized)
  - '20 equivalent games' uses 1200 s (20 min) per game for all positions

### PFC-091 Normal-approximation quantiles and ratio-interval reconciliation

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / reconciliation

- **Outputs:** p10; p50; p90

- **Status:** unknown — run manually via `python -m modeling.player_forecasts season-train/season-project` (modeling/player_forecasts/__main__.py:112,130; docs/player-projections/player-forecasts-runbook.md:512-531); bundles imported by web/scripts/import-player-forecast-season.ts (npm import:player-forecast-season) into player_forecast_season_* read by pages/api/v1/player-forecasts/*; no cron in web/vercel.json or .github/workflows; hosted season inference gated by PLAYER_FORECAST_SEASON_INFERENCE_ENABLED (runbook:469 sets false)

### PFC-092 Season projection draft validation gates

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / release validation
- **Purpose:** Block a season projection release whose schedule shape, rosters, expected games/starts, derived stat identities, quantiles or role probabilities are invalid.
- **Where:** `web/lib/fantasy-projections/validation.ts:41 (validateSeasonDraft)`; `web/lib/fantasy-projections/validation.ts:37 (nearlyEqual)`; `web/lib/fantasy-projections/contracts.ts:457 (reconcileProjectionValues, used for identities)`; `web/lib/fantasy-projections/admin.ts:1086 (caller)`
- **Inputs:** contractVersion/checksum; scheduleGameCount; gamesPerTeam; rosterCounts F/D/G; per-player expectedGames, expectedStarts, publishedValues, p10/p50/p90, deployment.roleProbabilities
- **Source tables:** season draft artifacts assembled by fantasy-projections admin/seasonJobs
- **Method:** Contract checksum must match the supported contract. Schedule must have exactly 1344 games, 32 teams with 84 games each. Each non-waived team needs at least 12 F, 6 D and 2 G. expectedGames must be in [0,84], and goalie expectedStarts in [0, expectedGames]. The required primitive targets for the contract (v4 fantasy / v5 advanced batches) must be finite. Each published value must equal its reconciled identity (e.g. SAVES = SA − GA, SV% = saves/SA, GAA = 3600·GA/TOI_seconds) within a relative tolerance of 1e-6·max(1,\|a\|,\|b\|). p10 <= p50 <= p90 for every target. Each role-probability family must have values in [0,1] that sum to 1 within the same tolerance.
- **Outputs:** SeasonValidationIssue[] (contract_mismatch, schedule_game_count, roster_incomplete, expected_games_invalid, derived_identity_invalid, quantile_order_invalid, role_probability_sum_invalid ...)
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** season totals; TOI in seconds (GAA uses 3600); probabilities 0-1
- **Output scale:** list of issue codes (pass/fail gate)
- **Status:** live — called from fantasy-projections admin release flow
- **Tests:** `web/lib/fantasy-projections/fantasyProjections.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** fantasy-projections admin release/publish path (admin.ts:1086)
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - NHL season shape is hard-coded (1344 games, 32 teams, 84 games); any schedule change or expansion fails every release
  - identity check uses publishedValues[target] ?? expected, so a missing derived target passes silently (only primitives are checked for presence)
  - reconcileProjectionValues coerces non-finite inputs to 0 before deriving identities

### PFC-094 Rest-of-season aggregation (normal approximation with participation mixture)

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / rest of season
- **Purpose:** Sum per-game means/variances to remaining-season totals and quantiles.
- **Where:** `web/lib/player-forecasts/restOfSeason.ts:9 (NORMAL_QUANTILES)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/restOfSeason.ts:17 (aggregatePlayerForecastRestOfSeason)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/restOfSeason.ts:83 (loadPlayerForecastRestOfSeason)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/restOfSeason.ts:140 (persistPlayerForecastRestOfSeason)`
- **Inputs:** components[].mean, variance, playsProbability; seasonToDateActual
- **Source tables:** player_forecast_rest_of_season_outputs, players
- **Method:** Unconditional: mean += p*mu; var += p*sigma^2 + p(1-p)*mu^2 (Bernoulli mixture). Conditional: plain sums. Independence across games. Quantiles p10/p25/p50/p75/p90 = max(0, mean + z*sd) with z = -1.2816, -0.6745, 0, 0.6745, 1.2816. fullSeason = seasonToDateActual + remaining.
- **Outputs:** remainingMean; remainingVariance; remainingQuantiles; fullSeasonMean; fullSeasonQuantiles
- **Tables written:** player_forecast_rest_of_season_outputs
- **Input units:** per-game mean and variance (counts); playsProbability 0-1
- **Output scale:** remaining-season count totals, variance, quantiles p10-p90 (floored at 0)
- **Status:** legacy/dead — (writer) aggregate/persist have no non-test callers; reader live at /api/v1/player-forecasts/rest-of-season (pages/player-forecasts.tsx)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/player-forecasts/playerForecasts.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** pages/api/v1/player-forecasts/rest-of-season.ts (load only)
- **Reference standard:** Poisson / negative-binomial count totals; law of total variance
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - aggregatePlayerForecastRestOfSeason and persist have no non-test callers (likely dead writer; API only reads)
  - normal approximation clipped at 0 for low counts (goals) misstates lower quantiles; independence ignores shared role/injury correlation
  - seasonToDateActual defaults to 0 when absent

### PFC-096 Rookie league-transition model (NHLe-style equivalency and roster probability)

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / rookies
- **Purpose:** Learns per-league probability of reaching the NHL next season, conditional games and NHL equivalency factors
- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/rookies.py:350 (learn_rookie_transition_model)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/rookies.py:263 (_latest_source_before)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/rookies.py:277 (_nhl_row)`
- **Inputs:** NHL player landing seasonTotals per league-season
- **Source tables:** api-web.nhle.com player/{id}/landing (frozen)
- **Method:** transition = non-NHL source season (max GP league) -> NHL next season; global P(made) = (made+8)/(n+16); league P = (made + 20*global)/(n+20); conditional games = mean NHL GP of made; factor per target (G, A, PIM) = sum(nhl_rate*min(82,GP))/sum(source_rate*min(82,GP)); global factor = median of leagues with >=3 transitions (default 0.35); league factor shrunk (n*f + 10*global)/(n+10); global NHL rates per GP
- **Outputs:** leagues.rosterProbability; conditionalNhlGames; equivalencyFactors; globalNhlRates
- **Tables written:** file: rookie transitionModel JSON
- **Input units:** per-game source-league rates; GP
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1; equivalency factor; games
- **Status:** unknown — manual CLI season-rookie-freeze (modeling/player_forecasts/__main__.py:121) feeding v4 season-train; serving only when validation eligibleForServing
- **Tests:** `modeling/player_forecasts/tests/test_harness.py`
- **Consumers:** rookie_projection_profile; train_season_artifact
- **Reference standard:** NHLe (Desjardins 2004; Bader/CapFriendly; e.g. KHL ~0.77, SHL ~0.57, AHL ~0.39-0.47, NCAA ~0.4, CHL ~0.14-0.3)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - sample is drawn only from players captured for the current pool, so transitions are survivor-selected and P(made NHL) is inflated
  - equivalency factors use only players who made the NHL next season (selection bias toward over-performers) and per-game rates without TOI/age
  - only the highest-GP non-NHL league in the latest season is used; split seasons drop data

### PFC-100 Season roster consensus and roster_confidence ladder

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / roster integrity
- **Purpose:** Decide a player's organization and roster status from official observations (two-source agreement) and assign the roster_confidence that feeds the season projection model.
- **Where:** `web/lib/fantasy-projections/rosterIntegrity.ts:76 (resolveSeasonRosterConsensus)`; `web/lib/fantasy-projections/rosterIntegrity.ts:39 (finiteConfidence)`; `web/lib/fantasy-projections/rosterReconciliation.ts:214 (pool-status default 0.7/0.4)`; `web/lib/fantasy-projections/rosterReconciliation.ts:472-474 (observation confidence bands)`; `web/lib/fantasy-projections/rosterReconciliation.ts:823-827 (roster_confidence assignment)`; `web/lib/fantasy-projections/readiness.ts:271 and :303 (36 h roster / transaction staleness)`
- **Inputs:** season roster observations (official_roster, player_landing, official_transaction, trusted_ifttt) with confidence, availableAt and supersedesId; current team / roster status; pool_status
- **Source tables:** player_forecast_season_roster_observations (latest_player_forecast_season_roster_observations RPC), player_forecast_season_roster_snapshots, IFTTT/X transaction events (normalized evidence)
- **Method:** Take the latest non-superseded observation per kind. Fewer than 2 official kinds → review_required, confidence = that single source's confidence (or 0). Distinct teams, or unsigned plus a team → review_required, confidence = max. Automatic only when roster+landing agree on a team, or landing+transaction agree (team, or both unsigned); then confidence = min of the agreeing pair, with roster status from the pair (disagreement → review, max). Observation confidence bands: official transaction = clamp(conf, 0.9, 1), default 0.95; other evidence = clamp(conf, 0, 0.89), default 0.75. roster_confidence = consensus.confidence when automatic, 1 when manually resolved, otherwise the prior value or 0.4. Pool-status default is 0.7 if verified_active, else 0.4. Roster and transaction data count as stale after 36 h.
- **Outputs:** resolution automatic\|review_required; organizationTeamId; rosterStatus; roster_confidence 0..1; conflictType
- **Tables written:** player_forecast_season_roster_observations (confidence), player_forecast_season_roster_conflicts / _conflict_members / _conflict_resolutions, player_forecast_season_roster_snapshots members (roster_confidence), player_forecast_season_player_pool_review
- **Input units:** confidence fraction 0-1; timestamps ISO
- **Output scale:** confidence 0-1; categorical resolution
- **Status:** live — player-forecasts season roster reconciliation jobs (rosterReconciliation.ts → seasonJobs.ts)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/fantasy-projections/fantasyProjections.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/lib/fantasy-projections/seasonJobs.ts:912 (rosterAdjustedPrior.rosterConfidence); modeling/player_forecasts/season.py:3625 (rating confidence = max(historical*0.75, evidence) * roster_confidence); web/pages/fantasy-projections.tsx:236 (confidenceLabel High >= 0.8, Medium >= 0.55, else Low; confidence filter); web/lib/fantasy-projections/queries.ts:278/338
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - three unrelated default confidence ladders: TS pool status 0.7/0.4 (rosterReconciliation.ts:214), Python 0.85/0.55/0.4 (season.py:1490), and observation bands 0.95/0.75 capped at 0.89 for non-official sources
  - roster_confidence multiplies the season model's rating confidence, so roster-bookkeeping heuristics change projection confidence
  - review_required conflict cases still report the MAX confidence of the disagreeing sources, so a conflicted player can look highly confident
  - manual resolution sets confidence to 1, the highest possible
  - transaction coverage windowStart is hard-coded to 2026-06-16T00:00:00Z (readiness.ts) and staleness to 36 h

### PFC-103 Contribution resolver: detailed/baseline blend and unconditional mean

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / serving
- **Purpose:** Pick or blend detailed (FORGE) and baseline rates per player-game-target and multiply by participation probability.
- **Where:** `web/lib/player-forecasts/contributions.ts:267 (resolveContribution)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/contributions.ts:307 (blend weight)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/contributions.ts:332 (unconditionalMean)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/contributions.ts:146 (assessSource)`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/contributions.ts:9 (forecastCalendarPolicy)`
- **Inputs:** detailed source mean; baseline source mean; participation probability; calendar lead day; horizonDays (default 14, 1-21)
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** lead = UTC-day difference (game - now). Detailed excluded if lead >= horizon. If both valid and compatible (same unit/basis/integration): w = clamp((horizonDays - lead)/7, 0, 1); mean = w*detailed + (1-w)*baseline (so detailed only for lead <= horizon-7, linear fade over last 7 days). unconditionalMean = conditionalMean * participationProbability (1 if participationIntegrated). Falls back to baseline when detailed lacks participation. Exclusion reasons: stale, future_input, identity_conflict, outside_horizon, use_not_approved, etc.
- **Outputs:** conditionalMean; unconditionalMean; blendWeight; allowedUses; exclusionReasons
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-appearance/per-start means (count or minutes); probability 0-1; calendar days
- **Output scale:** expected count/minutes per game (unconditional) and conditional mean; blend weight 0-1
- **Status:** live — via resolvePlanningContributions in lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/planning.ts, /api/v1/start-chart, /api/v1/forge/forecasts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/player-forecasts/contributions.test.ts`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/currentSeasonSogContribution.test.ts`; `web/lib/player-forecasts/planComparison.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/components/RosterScheduleOptimizer/RosterScheduleOptimizer.test.tsx`
- **Consumers:** planningContributions.resolvePlanningContributions; RSO planning.ts; gameExpectations; calendarCoverage
- **Reference standard:** Forecast combination / horizon-dependent blending
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - blend weight is a fixed linear ramp on calendar days, not tuned to measured skill
  - lead computed on UTC days, so late-evening ET games shift a day
  - E[X]=p*E[X\|play] assumes count independent of participation; fine for means, not variance

### PFC-112 Team contexts: offense/defense/pace multipliers, schedule-neutral goal differential, team ratings

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / team context
- **Purpose:** Derives team strength multipliers and percentile ratings from last-season team game stats
- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/season.py:2554 (_team_contexts)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/season.py:569 (TEAM_HISTORY_QUERY)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/season.py:4882 (team rating confidence)`
- **Inputs:** goals for/against, shots for/against, PP 'goals/opps' strings per team-game (2025-26 only)
- **Source tables:** teamGameStats, games
- **Method:** offense = clip(GF/league GF, 0.65..1.35); defense = clip(league GF/GA, 0.65..1.35); pace = clip((SF+SA)/league, 0.75..1.25); save% = 1 - GA/SA; PP% = PPG/opps; PK% = 1 - PPGA/opps; schedule-neutral GD: 20 iterations of GD + mean opponent rating, centered, damped 0.5; ratings = percentiles; confidence = min(1, games/82)
- **Outputs:** offenseMultiplier; defenseMultiplier; paceMultiplier; ratings; scheduleNeutralGoalDifferential
- **Tables written:** season-artifact.json teams, player_forecast_season_team_aggregates via importer

### PFC-115 Hierarchical hits (Poisson-Gamma partial pooling)

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / training
- **Purpose:** Predicts hits per game using a per-position Gamma prior on hits per TOI second
- **Where:** `modeling/player_forecasts/challenger_math.py:67 (fit_hierarchical_hits)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/challenger_math.py:103 (hierarchical_hits_prediction)`; `modeling/player_forecasts/challenger_model.py:139 (_hits_artifact)`
- **Inputs:** hits; TOI seconds; position
- **Source tables:** skaters.jsonl (challenger freeze)
- **Method:** player rate = hits/TOI; position mean and variance of unweighted player rates; Gamma alpha = mean^2/var, beta = mean/var (seconds); posterior rate = (hits + alpha)/(TOI + beta); prediction = rate * projected TOI
- **Outputs:** priors per position; hits estimate
- **Tables written:** validation-challenger-artifact.json finalDevelopmentHitsArtifact
- **Input units:** hits per TOI second
- **Output scale:** hits per game

- **Consumers:** challenger tournament (hits)
- **Reference standard:** Gamma-Poisson conjugate empirical Bayes
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - method-of-moments variance uses unweighted per-player rates, so low-TOI players inflate the variance and weaken the prior (should subtract Poisson noise / weight by exposure)
  - prior spans all seasons in freeze up to cutoff, mixing eras/rinks

### PFC-121 Penalized log-link rate GLM (Poisson IRLS with ridge)

- **Sub-family:** Player forecasts (season) / training

- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**

  - working response subtracts log(exposure) although mean already = exposure*rate - check the offset algebra

- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**

  - shrinkage k is reused from the GAMES_PLAYED rate policy (weighted games), not a participation-specific prior

### RSO-011 Streaming best-player-available ranking (blended FPts score)

- **Sub-family:** RSO / roster optimizer / BPA scoring
- **Purpose:** Rank available players within a streaming window.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/streamingChain.ts:187 (blended)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/streamingChain.ts:73 (rankOptions)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/streamingChain.ts:55 (NEAR_TIE)`
- **Inputs:** projected FPts per game (forecastPointsReader); last-10 FPts/G (recentPointsPerGame); games in window; waiver status
- **Source tables:** FORGE bridge forecasts, wgo_skater_stats, wgo_goalie_stats
- **Method:** Per player-game score = (projected + last10FPtsPerGame)/2 when both known, else projected (null if projection unknown). Window score = sum over play days. Order: (most-starts objective) more games first; then score diff > 0.1 (NEAR_TIE); known score before unknown; more games; free agents before waiver; higher last-10 FPts/G; score; id. Goalie goal: rank by min(goal, expected starts) first.
- **Outputs:** ranked candidates per window; netScore of chains
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** projected fantasy points per game (unconditional) + last-10 fantasy points per game played
- **Output scale:** blended fantasy points per window
- **Status:** live — pages/roster-schedule-optimizer.tsx -> components/RosterScheduleOptimizer/RosterScheduleOptimizer.tsx -> lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/executionAdapter.ts (planRoster, candidatePlanMetrics, healthyReserves)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/streamingChain.test.ts`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/recentForm.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** streaming chain DP; StreamingItinerary options
- **Reference standard:** Rest-of-season projection vs recent form weighting (regression to mean; recency usually small weight)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 50/50 blend of projection with raw unshrunk last-10 FPts/G gives heavy recency weight (10-game samples are mostly noise)
  - unit mismatch: projected FPts are unconditional (goalie expected = per-start x start probability, skater includes participation) while last-10 FPts/G is per game actually played (conditional) - a backup goalie's form inflates his blended score
  - magic number: NEAR_TIE 0.1 absolute points regardless of window length
  - intent mismatch: recentForm.ts:49-50 says recent FPts/G is 'A hint only: never a projection input', yet streamingChain.ts:187 uses it as half of the ranking score

### RSO-019 FORGE bridge skater line reuse and opponent/rest/tilt retargeting

- **Sub-family:** RSO / roster optimizer / forecast bridge

Goals x team x goal x toi x tilt.points; assists x team x assist x toi x tilt.points; shots x team x shot x toi x tilt.shots; TOI/hits/blocks x toi; POINTS/PP_POINTS/SH_POINTS re-summed; round 4 dp. Skaters missing from team's latest run get no line (stale). Conditioning 'unconditional', startProbability null; expires min(puck drop, issuedAt + 8 days). Runs: lookback 7, ahead 7 days, proof of excluded third-party inputs required.
- **Outputs:** GameForecast rows (stats, conditionalStats, expiresAt)

### RSO-024 Later-period impact (Delta F rate scenario)

- **Sub-family:** RSO / roster optimizer / future impact
- **Purpose:** Informational value of a plan's end roster vs no-move roster over the next league period.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/futureImpact.ts:241 (evaluateLaterImpact)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/futureImpact.ts:48 (resolveLaterPeriod)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/futureImpact.ts:110 (sourceTiming)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/futureImpact.ts:154 (selectSourceRow)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/futureImpact.ts:297 (evaluateArm)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/futureImpact.ts:236 (laterImpactForApp)`
- **Inputs:** boundary rosters (plan vs no-move); later schedule; basis rows (latest FORGE per-game line); capture receipts; calendar policy
- **Source tables:** forge_player_projections, forge_goalie_projections, forge_reserve_projections, roster_optimizer_team_games, yahoo_matchup_weeks
- **Method:** Period F = next actual league period after window, else assumed 7 days; must lie within decision date + calendarDays-1 and season. Source row = admitted h1 row with greatest capture completion <= decision; stale if issue/input age > 8 days (MAX_SOURCE_AGE_MS). Each arm: stationary per-game line applied to every F game (goalies forced 'conditional'; reserve rows zeroed), evaluated by evaluateScenarioPlan with realized 0, no opponent, goalie minimum restarted. Delta = plan - noMove (points, components, pooled category ratios). No discounting.

### RSO-025 Bridge goalie per-start line, wins and expected stats

- **Sub-family:** RSO / roster optimizer / goalie starts
- **Purpose:** Per-start goalie line re-aimed to the opponent, win credit, and expected (x start chance) stats.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleData/forgeDailyBridge.ts:284 (goalieLine)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleData/forgeDailyBridge.ts:200 (retargetGoalieLine)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleData/forgeDailyBridge.ts:165 (goalieShotContext)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleData/forgeDailyBridge.ts:521 (teamWin)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleData/forgeDailyBridge.ts:626 (wins/losses line)`
- **Inputs:** forge_goalie_projections (saves, GA, SA, shutout prob, win prob); team strength context; rest/venue; STARTER_DECISION_SHARE 0.984
- **Source tables:** forge_goalie_projections, nhl_team_data, games
- **Method:** Per start: SAVES, GA, SA, SHUTOUTS=shutout prob, GOALIE_MINUTES 60, GAMES_STARTED 1. Retarget: shots factor = (1+SA_to)/(1+SA_from) x (1+venue_to)/(1+venue_from); GA factor similarly; shutout = min(1, p/GAfactor). Venue/rest context = clamp(oppRest(+0.03 rested / -0.04 B2B) + ownB2B 0.02 + (home -0.01 / away +0.02), -0.15, 0.2). Team win: own/(own+other) if both FORGE values, own/0.984, 1-other/0.984, else FORGE Poisson model on xG priors x rest goal multipliers. WINS = win x 0.984; LOSSES = 1 - WINS. Expected stats = round4(line x startProbability).
- **Outputs:** stats (expected); conditionalStats (per start); teamWins
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-start saves/GA/SA counts, shutout prob 0-1, team win prob 0-1, venue/rest fractional adjustments
- **Output scale:** expected per-game goalie stats (counts x start prob); wins/losses expected per game 0-1
- **Status:** live — (interim fallback) loadPlanningData(..., forgeDailyBridge: true) from pages/api/v1/roster-schedule-optimizer/data.ts:23, yahoo-current-data.ts:27, lib/integrations/yahoo/rosterPlanning.ts:417; runs only when no native/shared forecasts are admitted and env RSO_FORGE_DAILY_BRIDGE != 'off' (web/lib/rosterScheduleData/planning.ts:213)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleData/forgeDailyBridge.test.ts`; `web/lib/projections/goalie/goalieOutcomes.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** planner goalie scoring; applyProviderGoalieStarts
- **Reference standard:** Goalie W = team win x decision share; Poisson/Skellam goal models
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - unit/definition: LOSSES_GOALIE = 1 - 0.984 x P(team win) counts no-decisions as losses (should be about (1-P(win)) x 0.984)
  - shutout retarget divides a probability by a goals-against ratio (not a Poisson P(0) recomputation)
  - a starter's per-start line is reused for backups with no line of their own ('team_line')

### RSO-026 Bridge goalie start probabilities

- **Sub-family:** RSO / roster optimizer / goalie starts
- **Purpose:** Per team-game start chances for each identified goalie.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleData/forgeDailyBridge.ts:565 (goalie loop)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleData/forgeDailyBridge.ts:576 (rescale)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleData/forgeDailyBridge.ts:590 (back-to-back)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleData/forgeDailyBridge.ts:602 (news floors)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleData/forgeDailyBridge.ts:40 (FORGE_DAILY_BRIDGE_GOALIE_NEWS_FLOORS)`
- **Inputs:** goalie_start_projections l10_start_pct / season_start_pct; FORGE starter_probability for projected game; IFTTT goalie news; rest days
- **Source tables:** goalie_start_projections, forge_goalie_projections, daily board evidence (IFTTT news), games
- **Method:** Share = exact game row else latest current-team current-season row (l10 share, else season share). FORGE starter_probability overrides for exact game; others rescaled to 1-p. Rescale: if any roster goalie unknown, only scale down (min(1, mass/total)), so sum may be < 1. Back-to-back second night (no exact row): starter keeps 55% of his chance, rest redistributed proportionally (unless open). News: confirmed -> 1 (others 0), ruled_out -> 0 (others rescaled to 1), likely floor 0.8, projected floor 0.65; disputed ignored. Unknown share -> forecast counts 0 starts (reserve 'start_unknown').
- **Outputs:** startProbability; confirmedStart
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** start shares fraction 0-1 (l10_start_pct, season_start_pct); starter_probability 0-1; rest days
- **Output scale:** start probability 0-1 per goalie-game (team sum <= 1)
- **Status:** live — (interim fallback) loadPlanningData(..., forgeDailyBridge: true) from pages/api/v1/roster-schedule-optimizer/data.ts:23, yahoo-current-data.ts:27, lib/integrations/yahoo/rosterPlanning.ts:417; runs only when no native/shared forecasts are admitted and env RSO_FORGE_DAILY_BRIDGE != 'off' (web/lib/rosterScheduleData/planning.ts:213)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleData/forgeDailyBridge.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** bridge goalie forecasts; goalie minimum coverage; streaming goalie starts
- **Reference standard:** Goalie start models (rest-based, last-N share); B2B starter repeat rates (~25-35% historically)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - magic numbers: B2B starter share 0.55, news floors 0.8/0.65
  - 0.55 retention on the second night of a back-to-back is high vs typical NHL starter back-to-back rates
  - unknown-share goalies counted as 0 starts while teammates are not scaled up, so team expected starts < 1

### RSO-028 Projected goalie starts and minimum risk

- **Sub-family:** RSO / roster optimizer / goalie starts
- **Purpose:** Expected goalie starts from chosen goalie games and whether the league minimum is at risk.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/planning.ts:955 (goalie block in evaluatePreparedPlan)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/planning.ts:537 (refine score goalieGroups)`
- **Inputs:** chosen goalie plays; forecast.startProbability / confirmedStart; goalieMinimum
- **Source tables:** FORGE goalie start shares, Yahoo starting status

- **Outputs:** goalie.expectedStarts; goalie.projected; goalie.confirmed; goalie.risk; minimumSatisfied
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** start probability fraction 0-1; credited starts count
- **Output scale:** expected starts (real >= 0); risk boolean

- **Consumers:** compareEvaluations; streaming chain goalie need; candidatePlanMetrics goalieBoost; CandidateBrowser
- **Reference standard:** Expected value of Bernoulli starts; P(meet minimum) would need a Poisson-binomial

  - risk uses expected starts vs required (no probability of reaching the minimum), so 1.9 expected vs 2 required is 'risk' while P(>=2) may be high/low

### RSO-033 DUST daily lineup assignment (min-cost max-flow)

- **Sub-family:** RSO / roster optimizer / lineup slotting
- **Purpose:** Assign a day's scheduled roster players to active slot instances, maximising starts then player value.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/matching.ts:105 (assignPlayersToActiveSlots)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/matching.ts:52 (normalizePlayers)`
- **Inputs:** players (id, eligiblePositions, value); active slot instances; date; yahooWeek
- **Source tables:** roster_optimizer_team_games (via schedule)
- **Method:** Bipartite graph source->player(cap1,cost0)->eligible slot(cap1,cost -value)->sink. Successive shortest augmenting paths with Bellman-Ford (EPSILON 1e-10) until no path: maximum cardinality first, then minimum cost (max total value) among max-cardinality matchings. Non-finite value -> 0 with warning. Players/slots sorted by id for deterministic ties; benched = valid players unmatched; invalid-eligibility players are 'unresolved' and excluded.
- **Outputs:** assignments[]; benchedPlayerIds; scheduledGames; startableGames; benchGames; unresolvedGames
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** player.value (external canonical value, unitless); one game per player-date
- **Output scale:** integer counts of started/benched player-games per day
- **Status:** live — lib/draft-pro/dust.ts called by pages/api/v1/draft-pro/dust.ts and lib/draftDashboard/draftProDustPresentation.ts; docs/roster-schedule-optimizer.md:83 says the Draft Dashboard route sits behind a maintenance notice
- **Tests:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/optimizer.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** evaluateRosterSchedule; calculateCandidateDust; web/lib/draft-pro/dust.ts (Draft Dashboard DUST badge)
- **Reference standard:** Exact bipartite / min-cost-flow lineup assignment (Hungarian equivalent); Yahoo daily lineup rules
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - augments every path regardless of cost sign, so negative-value players still start (cardinality strictly dominates value) - intended per docs, but differs from planner assign() which can leave slots empty
  - Bellman-Ford per augmentation is O(V*E) per path; fine for one roster-day but repeated for every candidate x date in DUST loops

### RSO-034 Planner daily lineup assignment (Hungarian, AGP lexicographic bonus)

- **Sub-family:** RSO / roster optimizer / lineup slotting
- **Purpose:** Choose each day's (or weekly window's) starters for the planner under objective 'agp' (most active games) or 'outcome' (most points).
- **Where:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/planning.ts:400 (assign)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/planning.ts:469 (agpBonus)`; `web/lib/projections/weightedAssignment.ts:2 (weightedAssignment)`
- **Inputs:** plays (player, game, forecast, gamesCount); locked assignments; objective; scoring mode
- **Source tables:** FORGE forecasts, provider lineup locks
- **Method:** Locked slots fixed first. Exact rectangular max-weight matching (Hungarian, cost -value, ineligible 1e12, each slot may stay empty at cost 0). Weight: agp objective or category mode -> gamesCount x agpBonus + value where agpBonus = 1 + sum\|values\| (lexicographic: games first, value tie-break); outcome (points) -> value only (null excluded); unknown-quality components -> gamesCount x agpBonus + conditional tie-break; forced player +agpBonus.
- **Outputs:** PlanningAssignment rows
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** fantasy points per play; gamesCount
- **Output scale:** slot->player assignment; internal weight = games x (1+sum\|values\|) + points
- **Status:** live — pages/roster-schedule-optimizer.tsx -> components/RosterScheduleOptimizer/RosterScheduleOptimizer.tsx -> lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/executionAdapter.ts (planRoster, candidatePlanMetrics, healthyReserves)

- **Consumers:** evaluatePreparedPlan; bench decision forced placements

- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**

### RSO-045 Acquisition timeline, effective time and budget accounting

- **Sub-family:** RSO / roster optimizer / period boundaries

### RSO-058 Roster plan beam search (add/drop/reserve sequences)

- **Sub-family:** RSO / roster optimizer / streaming chain
- **Purpose:** Search multi-step acquisition plans under agp and outcome objectives.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/planning.ts:1331 (planRoster)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/planning.ts:1257 (extensions)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/planning.ts:1329 (BEAM_RESERVE, DISTINCT_DROP_SLOTS)`
- **Inputs:** snapshot; intent; options (maxEvaluations, beamWidth, maxCandidates, maxSteps)
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** Objective = outcome only if no-move outcome is recommendation-eligible else agp. Depth loop maxSteps (default 4), beam width 8 (frontier = no-move + top 7), per-depth phase budget floor((maxEvals-3)/(maxSteps x 2)); proposals interleave candidates by date index; action time = zoned midnight (minus 1 day for next_day); each proposal yields add-only, reserve-prerequisite, top-2 drops, then remaining drops. Beam reserve: up to 2 pruned states with unseen drop sets get one more move. Category mode keeps non-dominated plans; up to 2 distinct-drop alternatives shown.
- **Outputs:** baseline; selected; alternatives; noClaimContinuations; search stats; streaming
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** plan steps (ISO instants), evaluations
- **Output scale:** ranked PlanEvaluation list; search stats
- **Status:** live — pages/roster-schedule-optimizer.tsx -> components/RosterScheduleOptimizer/RosterScheduleOptimizer.tsx -> lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/executionAdapter.ts (planRoster, candidatePlanMetrics, healthyReserves)

- **Consumers:** executionAdapter -> RosterScheduleOptimizer UI

  - magic numbers: beam 8, maxSteps 4, maxCandidates 40, reserve 2, distinct drops 2
  - search 'complete' flag is usually false (any pruning) - plans are best-found, not optimal

### RSO-059 Streaming chain certification and ranking

Kept if netGames>0, or meets goalie need, or pointsFirst and points>1e-9.

### RSO-060 Streaming chain window DP (1 vs 2 spots)

- **Sub-family:** RSO / roster optimizer / streaming chain
- **Purpose:** Build day-by-day add/drop chains that spend the period's adds for most added active games, then points.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/streamingChain.ts:96 (buildStreamingChains)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/streamingChain.ts:205 (runSpot)`; `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/streamingChain.ts:63 (better)`
- **Inputs:** snapshot; baseline; dropOrder; period remaining adds; acquisitionCost; points reader
- **Source tables:** FORGE forecasts, wgo_skater_stats / wgo_goalie_stats (recent form)
- **Method:** Daily leagues only. budget = floor(period.remaining / acquisitionCost), one acquisition period. Per drop: capacity gain per day = maxMatch(with player) - maxMatch(without). Windows [start,end): candidate plays on days with gain>0 (first day only if claim before puck drop); ranked list top 12. DP best[start][used] = max over end of leg(ranked[0]) + best[end][used+1] (last leg held to end); value compares min(need, starts), then (pointsFirst) points, then games, then points, then fewer adds (1e-9 tolerance). Subtract dropped player's lost games/points/starts from start. Singles: first 3 drops always, more while work <= 2,000,000 and before deadline. Pairs: top 4 single drops, all splits of budget, second spot on top of first. Two-spot recommended only if it beats one-spot.
- **Outputs:** chains[]; recommended (1\|2); alternatives (<=3 other first drops + other-goal best); limitations
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-day capacity counts; blended fantasy points; adds (acquisition allowance / cost)
- **Output scale:** chains with netGames integer, netPoints/netScore fantasy points
- **Status:** live — pages/roster-schedule-optimizer.tsx -> components/RosterScheduleOptimizer/RosterScheduleOptimizer.tsx -> lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/executionAdapter.ts (planRoster, candidatePlanMetrics, healthyReserves) (planRoster result.streaming; StreamingItinerary.tsx)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/rosterScheduleOptimizer/streamingChain.test.ts`; `web/components/RosterScheduleOptimizer/StreamingItinerary.test.tsx`
- **Consumers:** StreamingItinerary.tsx; planRoster result.streaming
- **Reference standard:** Streaming games-per-week maximisation; DP over add budget
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - DP leg value uses each window's ranked[0], but picks later skip players already taken (dedupe), so the chosen chain's DP value can exceed what its actual picks deliver until certify() recomputes
  - magic numbers: OPTION_COUNT 5, RANKED_COUNT 12, GUARANTEED_DROPS 3, PAIR_DROPS 4, EXTRA_WORK 2,000,000, ALTERNATIVE_DROPS 3
  - chains limited to the current acquisition period; budget/unknown waiver leagues excluded

### FSC-016 Category z-score value (calculateCategoryScores)

- **Sub-family:** Fantasy scoring / category value
- **Purpose:** Weighted sum of per-category z-scores with goalie rate regression.
- **Where:** `web/lib/scoring/categoryScores.ts:84 (calculateCategoryScores)`; `web/lib/scoring/categoryScores.ts:67 (regressedGoalieRate)`; `web/lib/scoring/categoryScores.ts:35 (isInvertedCategory)`
- **Inputs:** players[].values per category; categoryWeights
- **Source tables:** caller-provided projections
- **Method:** Per role, mean and sample SD (n-1) of raw values; goalie SV% regressed: (SA*v + 1200*mean)/(SA+1200); GAA: (GS*v + 25*mean)/(GS+25); z = (v-mean)/sd, inverted for GAA, GA, Losses; score = sum weight*z (weight default 1). Default categories G,A,PPP,SOG,HIT,BLK when no weights.
- **Outputs:** score per player
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** season totals for counts; SV% fraction; GAA goals/60
- **Output scale:** sum of z-scores (unbounded)
- **Status:** live — /fantasy-projections page and draft-pro recommendations
- **Tests:** `web/lib/scoring/categoryScores.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** pages/fantasy-projections.tsx:1059; web/lib/draft-pro/recommendations.ts; draft-pro scenarios/reports (inversion helpers)
- **Reference standard:** Standard category z-score / SGP valuation (replacement-level-relative, rate stats weighted by volume, e.g., Razzball/FanGraphs z-scores)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - Goalie values regressed but mean/SD come from unregressed population: shrunk goalies get understated z
  - Rate stats (SV%, GAA) not volume-weighted (no 'impact' conversion), so a 5-start goalie with good SV% scores like a starter after only 1200-shot shrink
  - Population = all players passed (no replacement-level or rostered-pool cut)
  - OTL_GOALIE not inverted although losses are

### FSC-039 weekScore (Game Grid Week Score)

- **Sub-family:** Fantasy scoring / schedule (Game Grid)
- **Purpose:** Rank each team's selected week for streaming by games volume, off-night games, win odds and slate crowding.
- **Where:** `web/components/GameGrid/utils/calcWeekScore.ts:54 (calcWeekScore)`; `web/components/GameGrid/utils/scheduleSummary.ts:58 (getTeamScheduleSummary)`; `web/components/GameGrid/GameGrid.tsx:291 (filteredColumns)`; `web/components/GameGrid/GameGrid.tsx:418 (sortedByScoreDesc rank)`; `web/components/RosterScheduleOptimizer/TeamScheduleContext.tsx:37`; `web/lib/socialShare/modules/offNightEdge.ts:147`
- **Inputs:** winOddsList (0-100 per included game); offNights (count); totalGamesPerWeek (league regular-season games on included days); totalTeamGames; slateCounts; scheduleComplete
- **Source tables:** NHL api-web /schedule/{date}, expected_goals (home/away_win_odds)
- **Method:** If totalTeamGames==0 return sentinel -100. score = 6*(teamGames - leagueGames/16) + 4*offNights + matchupBonus(+-0.5) + slateCrowding(+-0.25). leagueGames/16 = average team appearances (2 per game / 32 teams). Version string 'schedule-v2-crowding-0.25'. Rank = sort desc, index+1.
- **Outputs:** weekScore; scoreDecomposition{games,offNights,matchup,crowding,version}; rank
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** games (counts); win odds percent 0-100
- **Output scale:** unbounded points around 0 (roughly -20..+30); -100 sentinel for no games
- **Status:** live — used by /game-grid page (pages/game-grid/[mode].tsx -> GameGrid.tsx:291) and RSO TeamScheduleContext
- **Tests:** `web/components/GameGrid/utils/calcWeekScore.test.js`; `web/components/GameGrid/utils/scheduleSummary.test.ts`; `web/components/RosterScheduleOptimizer/TeamScheduleContext.test.tsx`; `web/lib/socialShare/modules/offNightEdge.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** /game-grid page (GameGrid TeamRow, sort, rank); PlayerPickupTable team boost; RSO TeamScheduleContext; socialShare offNightEdge
- **Reference standard:** Common fantasy 'games-per-week / off-night' streaming heuristics (e.g., Frozen Tools/Left Wing Lock off-night counts); no calibrated standard
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - Hard-coded 32 teams (/16) and weights 6/4 with no calibration; doc string itself calls it an 'interim heuristic'
  - Sentinel -100 for no games leaks into PlayerPickupTable min/max normalisation (team boost)
  - offNights weight 4 on top of the games term double-counts: an off-night game earns 6 (game) + 4
  - Off-night threshold <=8 duplicated in at least 8 files (helper.ts, TotalGamesPerDayRow, DateRangeTeamGrid, useDateRangeTeamGrid, scheduleOpportunity, TransposedGrid, lib/draftDashboard/scheduleMetrics.ts)

### RNK-001 Player percentile rank across skaters (avg stats)

- **Purpose:** Percentile of a player's per-game goals, assists, +/-, PIM, hits, blocks, PPP and shots among all skaters in a date window.
- **Where:** `web/pages/api/v1/player/[id]/percentile-rank.ts:27 (getPercentileRank)`; `web/pages/api/v1/player/[id]/percentile-rank.ts:83 (getSinglePercentileRank)`
- **Inputs:** Season, StartTime, EndTime (req.body); RPC get_skaters_avg_stats rows avggoals, avgassists, avgplusminus, avgpim, avghits, avgblockedshots, avgpowerplaypoints, avgshots
- **Source tables:** rpc get_skaters_avg_stats
- **Method:** percentile = index of player's value in the sorted array / N * 100 (rounded 2 dp). No minimum games filter.
- **Outputs:** goals, assists, plusMinus, pim, hits, blockedShots, powerPlayPoints, shots percentiles (0-100)
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-game averages from the RPC
- **Output scale:** 0-100 percentile
- **Status:** legacy/dead — no callers found; route ledger incoming_counts {}
- **Tests:** none found
- **Consumers:** none found
- **Reference standard:** Standard percentile rank (count below + 0.5*ties)/N
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - Array.sort() with no comparator sorts numbers as strings (e.g. 10 < 9, negatives misplaced), so percentiles are wrong
  - findIndex returns the first tie, so ties get the lowest percentile; top player maxes at (N-1)/N*100
  - no games-played floor; one-game players distort the distribution
  - when player is absent returns 0 for all, indistinguishable from a real 0th percentile

### RNK-003 Skater contextual metric catalogue (per-60 rates, shares, regression metrics)

- **Sub-family:** Rankings / contextual matrix
- **Purpose:** Definitions, formulas, directionality and minimums for every contextual skater ranking metric.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rankings/metricDefinitions.ts:195 (CONTEXTUAL_RANKING_METRIC_DEFINITION_INPUTS)`; `web/lib/rankings/metricDefinitions.ts:92 (defaultDenominatorKey)`; `web/lib/rankings/metricDefinitions.ts:141 (defaultSourceQualityFlags)`
- **Inputs:** rolling_player_game_metrics window fields
- **Source tables:** rolling_player_game_metrics, skater_composite_ratings
- **Method:** goals/assists/primary_assists/points/sog/shot_attempts(NST iCF)/hits/blocks/ixG/penalties_taken per 60 = count/TOIsec*3600; pp_points_per_60 = PP points / PP TOI *3600 (minToi 120); xGA/60 on-ice (5v5 only, lower better, minToi 600); xS% = ixG/unblocked attempts*100; SAX% = Sh% - xS%; GAx = G - ixG; unrealized xG = ixG - G; on-ice GF% = GF/(GF+GA); on-ice xGF% = xGF/(xGF+xGA) (5v5 only); rel 5v5 GF%/xGF% planned (blocked); offense/defense/MCM/BEAST/results_luck read from skater_composite_ratings. methodologyVersion contextual_rankings_v1.
- **Outputs:** metric definitions (higherIsBetter, minimumGp, minimumToiSeconds, isRateStat, denominatorKey, sourceQualityFlags)
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** counts and TOI seconds from rolling windows; xG in goals
- **Output scale:** per-60 rates; percentages 0-100; goal differences (counts)
- **Status:** live — registry for /rankings pages and writers; rel_5v5_* are 'planned' (blockedFromLiveMatrix)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/rankings/metricDefinitions.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** rankingCalculator; skaterWindowAggregation; rankingQueries; entityMetricRanking*; Rankings UI
- **Reference standard:** NST per-60 and on-ice share conventions; Evolving-Hockey RAPM for relative metrics
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - shot_attempts_per_60 is documented as NST iCF (incl. blocked), but expected_shooting_percentage/SAX% describe the same shot_attempts field as unblocked (Fenwick) — inconsistent denominator semantics
  - SAX% uses attempts not SOG, so 'actual shooting %' is goals/attempts, not NHL Sh% (goals/SOG)
  - GAx and unrealized xG are raw counts (not rate) ranked across players with very different TOI
  - penalties_taken_per_60 counts penalties not PIM and is not net of penalties drawn

### RNK-008 Contextual ranking percentile & dense rank (rankNormalizedMetricValues)

- **Sub-family:** Rankings / contextual matrix
- **Purpose:** Shared rank/percentile convention for every contextual ranking surface (skater metrics, matrices, deployment tiers, entity_metric_rankings).
- **Where:** `web/lib/rankings/rankingCalculator.ts:84 (rankNormalizedMetricValues)`; `web/lib/rankings/rankingCalculator.ts:231 (rankQualifiedRows)`
- **Inputs:** id; normalizedValue (direction-adjusted value)
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** Drop non-finite values; sort desc by normalized value (ties by id). Dense rank (ties share rank, next distinct value rank+1). Percentile = 100 * (count of strictly worse qualified peers) / (N-1), rounded to 3 dp; N==1 -> 100. Ties share percentile.
- **Outputs:** rank; percentile (0-100); qualifiedPeerCount
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** direction-adjusted metric value (any unit)
- **Output scale:** rank 1..N (dense); percentile 0-100
- **Status:** live — used by /api/v1/contextual-rankings*, matrices, update-entity-metric-rankings, update-skater-composite-ratings
- **Tests:** `web/lib/rankings/rankingCalculator.test.ts`; `web/lib/rankings/rankingCalculator.lowerIsBetter.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/contextual-rankings.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** buildContextualRankingRows; teamMatrix.ts; playerMatrix.ts; goalieMatrix.ts; entityMetricRankingReader.ts; deploymentTiers.ts; skaterCompositeWriter metricPercentilesMatchPopulation (re-derives the same convention)
- **Reference standard:** Standard percentile rank (exclusive, (#below)/(N-1)); compare to mid-rank convention (#below + 0.5*#ties)/N used by NST/HockeyViz-style percentile cards.
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - dense ranking (1,1,2) instead of competition ranking (1,1,3) means rank and 'of N' text can understate distance
  - strictly-worse/(N-1) convention gives tied-at-bottom 0 and tied-at-top <100 when ties exist; not mid-rank

### RNK-013 QoT / QoC (quality of teammates / competition) features

- **Sub-family:** Rankings / contextual matrix
- **Purpose:** Per-game and rolling TOI-weighted average teammate and opponent impact percentiles from shift stints.
- **Where:** `web/lib/xg/qotQoc.ts:101 (percentileRank)`; `web/lib/xg/qotQoc.ts:110 (buildBucketByPlayer)`; `web/lib/xg/qotQoc.ts:137 (buildQotQocPlayerRatings)`; `web/lib/xg/qotQoc.ts:183 (averageRating)`; `web/lib/xg/qotQoc.ts:336 (buildRollingRows)`; `web/lib/xg/qotQoc.ts:407 (buildQotQocFeatureRows)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-qot-qoc.ts:90 (resolveRatingSnapshotDate)`
- **Inputs:** player impact rating_0_to_100/100 (offense, defense) at one snapshot; sample_toi_seconds; player position; NHL shift stints (durationSeconds, playerIds by team)
- **Source tables:** skater_offensive_ratings_daily, skater_defensive_ratings_daily, players, shift stints (nhl_api_shift_rows-derived)
- **Method:** Re-percentile ratings within position group x TOI tercile (low/middle/high by TOI rank) using (count<=value - 1)/(N-1). Per stint: QoT = mean teammate offensive/defensive percentile (own skaters excl. self), QoC = mean of all opposing players' percentiles; accumulate weighted by stint seconds; per-game value = sum/TOI. Rolling windows 5/10/20 games = TOI-weighted mean over window. Unit-level QoT/QoC also built.
- **Outputs:** qot_offensive_percentile; qot_defensive_percentile; qoc_offensive_percentile; qoc_defensive_percentile; teammate/opponent count weighted
- **Tables written:** QoT/QoC feature tables (via update-nhl-xg-qot-qoc; exact names in route)
- **Input units:** ratings fraction 0-1; seconds
- **Output scale:** percentile fraction 0-1
- **Status:** live — /api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-qot-qoc
- **Tests:** `web/lib/xg/qotQoc.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** xG adjusted-impact / game-prediction features (lib/xg)
- **Reference standard:** Evolving-Hockey / NST QoT-QoC (TOI-weighted teammate/opponent TOI% or xGF%); HockeyViz competition metrics
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - a single (latest by default) rating snapshot is applied to all historical games — look-ahead leakage when used as model features
  - QoC averages all opposing players without filtering goalies (own-team list filters goalies only); goalies with ratings would enter QoC
  - percentiles of percentiles within TOI terciles compress differences; tercile bucketing by TOI couples quality and usage
  - likely overlaps the xG agent's slice (lib/xg) — listed here for QoC/QoT coverage

### RNK-017 Team unit TOI builder (5v5 lines/pairs and PP units, pooled player-seconds)

- **Sub-family:** Rankings / deployment tiers
- **Purpose:** Derive per-game forward-line, defense-pair and PP-unit TOI and shares from raw shifts.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiBuilder.ts:239 (buildEvenStrengthTeamUnitToiRows)`; `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiBuilder.ts:346 (buildPowerPlayTeamUnitToiRows)`; `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiBuilder.ts:195 (emitRankedRows)`; `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiWriter.ts:92`; `web/supabase/migrations/20260622150500_create_team_unit_toi.sql:23 (unit_share generated column)`
- **Inputs:** nhl_api_shift_rows start/end seconds per player; players.position; powerPlayCombinations unit, PPTOI
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_shift_rows, players, powerPlayCombinations, games
- **Method:** Per game-period, split time at every shift boundary; a segment is 5v5 if both teams have exactly 5 skaters (F or D) on ice; only exact 3F+2D configurations counted. Unit seconds = segment duration x player count (pooled player-seconds); units are exact player sets ranked by pooled seconds -> unit_number 1..k. Coverage partial if any skater has an unclassified position. PP: unit from powerPlayCombinations, pool = sum of PPTOI across all PP players; unit seconds = sum of its players' PPTOI. unit_share (DB generated) = unit_toi_seconds / team_unit_pool_toi_seconds.
- **Outputs:** unit_number; unit_toi_seconds; team_unit_pool_toi_seconds; unit_share; coverage_status
- **Tables written:** team_unit_toi
- **Input units:** shift seconds within period; PPTOI seconds
- **Output scale:** seconds; share fraction 0-1
- **Status:** live — update-team-unit-toi registered in route runner (web/lib/routeRunner/registry.ts:156)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiBuilder.test.ts`; `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiWriter.test.ts`; `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiNightly.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/update-team-unit-toi.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** teamMatrix.aggregateTeamUnitToiRows; web/pages/api/v1/db/update-team-unit-toi.ts (route runner nightly)
- **Reference standard:** NST/HockeyViz line-combination TOI (5v5 shared ice time)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 5v5 detection counts skaters only (goalie presence not checked), so 5v5 with a pulled goalie in some edge cases may be included
  - line 1 is defined as the most-used exact trio in that game, so line shuffles fragment units and lower 'top load'
  - PP unit membership comes from powerPlayCombinations.unit (external), while pool is total PPTOI incl. units 3+ — PP1/PP2 share depends on that labelling
