### RNK-025 Results Luck Index (component-aware, written)

- **Sub-family:** Rankings / skater composite
- **Purpose:** Index (100 = normal) of whether a skater's current-window results run hot/cold vs a non-overlapping season-remainder baseline.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rankings/resultsLuckSources.ts:87 (buildResultsLuckRollingSourceFromRow)`; `web/lib/rankings/resultsLuckSources.ts:249 (fetchResultsLuckRollingSources)`; `web/lib/rankings/resultsLuckIndex.ts:121 (componentIndexFor)`; `web/lib/rankings/resultsLuckIndex.ts:157 (calculateComponentAwareResultsLuckIndex)`; `web/lib/rankings/resultsLuckIndex.ts:226 (canPersistComponentAwareResultsLuckIndex)`; `web/lib/rankings/skaterCompositeWriter.ts:545`
- **Inputs:** goals/ixG/shot_attempts totals for window and season; ipp_points, ipp_on_ice_goals_for; oi_gf_total/oi_xgf_total window; oi_gf_avg_season/oi_xgf_avg_season * season GP
- **Source tables:** rolling_player_game_metrics
- **Method:** Baseline = season total minus current-window total. Components: GAx (G-ixG) signed, scale 2, weight 0.35; SAX% (G/att - ixG/att, x100) signed, scale 10, weight 0.25; IPP% ratio, weight 0.20; on-ice GF-xGF signed, scale 4, weight 0.20. Signed component index = clamp(100 + (current-baseline)/scale*100, 0, 200); ratio index = clamp(current/baseline*100, 0, 200). Index = weighted mean of usable components. Publish only if all weights usable and baseline window excluded (or season + peer_fallback). Season window uses last20 as current and has no baseline. Interpretation bands: >=120 hot, 105-119 slightly hot, 95-105 normal, 80-94 slightly cold, <=79 cold.
- **Outputs:** results_luck_index; components_json.resultsLuck
- **Tables written:** skater_composite_ratings.results_luck_index, skater_composite_ratings.components_json
- **Input units:** goal counts, xG goals, attempt counts, IPP percent 0-100
- **Output scale:** index centred at 100, clamped 0-200
- **Status:** live — update-skater-composite-ratings when source coverage verified
- **Tests:** `web/lib/rankings/resultsLuckIndex.test.ts`; `web/lib/rankings/resultsLuckSources.test.ts`; `web/lib/rankings/skaterCompositeWriter.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** metric results_luck_index (ranked higherIsBetter=false); playerMatrix; PlayerSnapshotPanel
- **Reference standard:** PDO / regression-to-mean of shooting % and on-ice Sh% (Tango-style true-talent regression)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - GAx and on-ice GF-xGF components compare a last-N window COUNT with a season-remainder COUNT (different sample sizes) — signed difference is not rate-normalized
  - baseline = season total minus last-N total, but last-N windows can include prior-season games (skaterWindowAggregation.ts:243), so the remainder can be wrong or negative
  - SAX% uses shot_attempts (iCF vs Fenwick ambiguity) as denominator
  - scales 2/10/4 and 0-200 clamp are magic numbers
  - season-window rows can never publish (no peer fallback wired), so season results_luck_index is always null

### RNK-028 Offense Rating (skater composite)

- **Sub-family:** Rankings / skater composite
- **Purpose:** Percentile-weighted contextual offensive composite per skater/window/strength/peer group.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rankings/skaterCompositeWriter.ts:333 (calculateOffenseRating)`; `web/lib/rankings/skaterCompositeMethodology.ts:9 (OFFENSE_RATING_CONTRACT)`; `web/lib/rankings/skaterCompositeWriter.ts:161 (weightedAverage)`
- **Inputs:** percentiles of goals_per_60, points_per_60, ixg_per_60, shot_attempts_per_60, sog_per_60, primary_assists_per_60, assists_per_60, expected_shooting_percentage, sax_percentage, goals_above_expected
- **Source tables:** rolling_player_game_metrics (via contextual ranking surfaces)
- **Method:** Sub-scores = mean of available component percentiles: scoring_rate(G/60,P/60), chance_creation(ixG/60, iCF/60, SOG/60), playmaking(A1/60, A/60), finishing_context(xS%, SAX%, GAx). Offense = weighted mean 0.35/0.30/0.20/0.15 over non-null sub-scores (weights renormalized), clamp 0-100, round 2. Written to offense_rating_overall or _deployment depending on deployment filter.
- **Outputs:** offense_rating_overall; offense_rating_deployment
- **Tables written:** skater_composite_ratings.offense_rating_overall, skater_composite_ratings.offense_rating_deployment
- **Input units:** percentiles 0-100
- **Output scale:** 0-100 weighted percentile score (not itself a percentile)
- **Status:** live — written by /api/v1/db/update-skater-composite-ratings (methodology contextual_composites_v2)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/rankings/skaterCompositeWriter.test.ts`; `web/lib/rankings/skaterCompositeMethodology.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/update-skater-composite-ratings.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** metric offense_rating in rankings; playerMatrix.ts; snapshot.ts; comparison.ts; PlayerSnapshotPanel
- **Reference standard:** Evolving-Hockey EV/PP offense GAR components; percentile-card composites (JFresh)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - missing components are silently dropped and weights renormalized, unlike MCM which requires all inputs ('never reweight') — inconsistent policies in the same writer
  - components are highly collinear (G/60 and P/60; ixG/60, iCF/60, SOG/60; A1/60 and A/60), so effective weight on shot volume is larger than labelled
  - a rating built from a single available component still publishes as a full 0-100 rating
  - finishing context includes GAx (count, TOI-dependent) alongside percentages

- **Sub-family:** Rankings / trending & splits
- **Purpose:** Turn one rolling_player_game_metrics row into per-window metric values, numerators, denominators, GP and TOI for ranking.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rankings/skaterWindowAggregation.ts:180 (ratePer60)`; `web/lib/rankings/skaterWindowAggregation.ts:185 (percent)`; `web/lib/rankings/skaterWindowAggregation.ts:324 (extractDerivedWindowMetric)`; `web/lib/rankings/skaterWindowAggregation.ts:434 (extractWindowMetric)`; `web/lib/rankings/skaterWindowAggregation.ts:514 (buildSkaterWindowAggregatesFromRollingRow)`

Rate = num/den*3600 (6dp); direct stored *_per_60_{window} value preferred over recomputation. points/pp_points season = avg_season * season GP (num and den). Derived: xS% = ixG/shot_attempts*100; SAX% = G/att*100 - ixG/att*100; GAx = G-ixG; unrealized = ixG-G; xGA/60 = oi_xga/toi*3600; on-ice GF% = GF/(GF+GA)*100; xGF% likewise. Season derived on-ice/xGA metrics use *_avg_season fields (ratio of per-game averages).

- **Consumers:** rankingQueries.buildCandidates; deploymentTiers; entityMetricRankingWriter; skaterCompositeWriter (via surfaces)
- **Reference standard:** NST per-60 convention; on-ice GF%/xGF% = For/(For+Against)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - for season xGA/60 the denominator is toi_seconds_avg_season (a per-game average) and resolveToiSeconds returns it as the sample TOI, so the 600s minimum TOI gate is compared to per-game TOI, not total TOI

  - derived season GAx/unrealized xG use season totals but last-N use totals — not rate-normalized, so season vs last5 values are not comparable

### RNK-038 Last-N window games-played / TOI resolution

- **Sub-family:** Rankings / trending & splits

Season TOI = denominator or avgTOI*GP.

### RNK-040 Trending percentile deltas, trend score & opportunity signals

- **Sub-family:** Rankings / trending & splits
- **Purpose:** Detect skaters whose recent percentiles/TOI moved vs longer windows.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rankings/trending.ts:286 (delta)`; `web/lib/rankings/trending.ts:359 (severityFromMagnitude)`; `web/lib/rankings/trending.ts:368 (buildToiOpportunitySignal)`; `web/lib/rankings/trending.ts:397 (buildShotVolumeOpportunitySignal)`; `web/lib/rankings/trending.ts:471 (buildTrendingSurface)`
- **Inputs:** per-metric percentiles for season,last20,last10,last5; TOI/GP per window
- **Source tables:** rolling_player_game_metrics (via contextual surfaces)
- **Method:** deltaLast5VsLast20 = pct(last5) - pct(last20); deltaLast5VsSeason likewise (1dp). trendScore = mean of last5-vs-last20 percentile deltas across selected metrics. TOI signal if \|TOI/G last5 - last20\| >= 30 s; severity 30/60/120 s. Shot-volume spike if iCF/60 (else SOG/60) percentile delta >= 8; severity 8/15/25 pts. Rows sorted by trendScore. Min GP per window via minGpForComparisonWindow.
- **Outputs:** trendScore; deltaLast5VsLast20; deltaLast5VsSeason; toiTrend; opportunitySignals
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** percentiles 0-100; TOI seconds per game
- **Output scale:** percentile-point deltas (-100..100); seconds; severity enum
- **Status:** live — /api/v1/contextual-rankings/trending
- **Tests:** `web/lib/rankings/trending.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/contextual-rankings-trending.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** /api/v1/contextual-rankings/trending; components/Rankings/TrendingPanel.tsx
- **Reference standard:** Rolling-window form indicators; compare with EWMA or Bayesian updated rates
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - last5 is a subset of last20 (overlapping windows) so deltas understate change and are partially self-correlated
  - percentiles in each window come from different qualified peer pools (min GP 2 vs 5), so percentile deltas mix player change with population change
  - no sample-size/regression adjustment — a 5-game percentile is very noisy; thresholds 8/15/25 and 30/60/120 are magic numbers

### RNK-045 Player impact ratings (skater offense/defense, goalie) — z-score composite with TOI shrinkage

- **Sub-family:** Rankings / WAR-like
- **Purpose:** Season-to-date 0-100 impact ratings for skaters (offense, defense) and goalies from NST game logs.
- **Where:** `web/lib/ratings/playerImpactRatings.ts:88 (OFFENSE_COMPONENTS)`; `web/lib/ratings/playerImpactRatings.ts:99 (DEFENSE_COMPONENTS)`; `web/lib/ratings/playerImpactRatings.ts:110 (GOALIE_COMPONENTS)`; `web/lib/ratings/playerImpactRatings.ts:190 (aggregateSkaters)`; `web/lib/ratings/playerImpactRatings.ts:293 (aggregateGoalies)`; `web/lib/ratings/playerImpactRatings.ts:161 (zScore)`; `web/lib/ratings/playerImpactRatings.ts:166 (meanAndStdDev)`; `web/lib/ratings/playerImpactRatings.ts:437 (buildRows)`; `web/lib/ratings/playerImpactRatings.ts:636 (buildPlayerImpactRatings)`
- **Inputs:** nst_*_per_60 (points, goals, first assists, ixG, shots, iCF, oi xGF/xGA/CA/SCA, blocks, takeaways, giveaways, def zone starts); nst_oi_xgf_pct, nst_oi_cf_pct; nst_toi ?? toi_per_game; goalie saves, SA, GA, TOI, nst_all/5v5 GSAA, gsaa_per_60, quality_starts_pct
- **Source tables:** player_stats_unified, vw_goalie_stats_unified
- **Method:** Per player, TOI-weighted mean of per-game per-60 rates over all game rows <= snapshot. Components z-scored across all players (population SD; missing -> z=0). Offense = 0.24 P/60 + 0.16 G/60 + 0.12 A1/60 + 0.16 ixG/60 + 0.10 SOG/60 + 0.08 iCF/60 + 0.08 oiXGF/60 + 0.06 (oiXGF%-50). Defense = 0.24 -oiXGA/60 + 0.14 -oiCA/60 + 0.12 -oiSCA/60 + 0.16 (oiXGF%-50) + 0.12 (oiCF%-50) + 0.10 blocks/60 + 0.08 (TK-GV)/60 + 0.04 DZS/60. Goalie = 0.50 GSAA/60 + 0.28 SV% + 0.12 QS% + 0.10 -GA/60. Raw x shrink factor TOI/(TOI+k), k=3600 s skaters, 2400 s goalies. rating_0_to_100 = ordinal percentile 100*(1 - index/(N-1)).
- **Outputs:** rating_0_to_100; rating_raw; league_rank; percentile; components.shrinkage
- **Tables written:** skater_offensive_ratings_daily, skater_defensive_ratings_daily, goalie_ratings_daily (via web/pages/api/v1/db/update-player-impact-ratings.ts)
- **Input units:** per-60 rates; percentages 0-100 for oi%; TOI seconds (assumed); SV% fraction
- **Output scale:** 0-100 ordinal percentile; raw weighted z-score
- **Status:** live — /api/v1/db/update-player-impact-ratings
- **Tests:** `web/lib/ratings/playerImpactRatings.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** lib/xg/qotQoc.ts (QoT/QoC inputs); lib/game-predictions/featureBuilder.ts; lib/underlying-stats/entityRatingsOverlay.ts; update-nhl-xg-qot-qoc
- **Reference standard:** Evolving-Hockey RAPM/GAR; standard z-score composites with position-specific pools
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - forwards and defensemen z-scored in one pool (no position adjustment)
  - missing components contribute z=0 (imputed league mean) rather than being excluded
  - no minimum-TOI filter before percentile ranking — every player with any TOI gets a 0-100 rating; shrinkage only scales raw score
  - TOI weight uses nst_toi ?? toi_per_game — units (minutes vs seconds) of nst_toi not verified; if nst_toi is minutes and toi_per_game seconds, weights mix units
  - goalie GSAA uses nst_all_counts_gsaa ?? nst_5v5_counts_gsaa per row (mixed strengths across rows)
  - defense rewards more defensive-zone starts per 60 (usage, not impact); oiXGF% edge counted in both offense and defense
  - weights are hand-set magic numbers, collinear components (P/60 & G/60 & A1/60)

### SUS-006 Legacy NST career averages (unweighted mean of season rows)

- **Purpose:** Return a player's career-average S%, xS%, IPP, oiSH%, secA%, A1, A2, points, SOG/60, oZS%, iHDCF, iSCF, ixG, xG%, CF%, goals for the sustainability-vs-career chart.

- **Source tables:** Natural Stat Trick playerreport.php (scraped)
- **Method:** Each metric = sum over every season row of the per-season value / number of rows (unweighted). xS% = mean of per-season ixG/Shots; secA% = mean of A2/A; SOG/60 = mean of Shots/parseTime(TOI)*60 using lib/NHL/TOI parseTime (minutes). Percent fields divided by 100 at the end (S%, IPP, oiSH%, oZS%).
- **Outputs:** S%; xS%; IPP; oiSH%; secA%; Primary Assists; Secondary Assists; Total Points; SOG/60; oZS%; iHDCF; iSCF; ixG; ixG% (on-ice xG%); iCF% (on-ice CF%); goals
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** NST percentages 0-100; TOI minutes (mm:ss or decimal via lib/NHL/TOI parseTime)
- **Output scale:** fractions 0-1 for percentages; per-season mean counts; SOG/60 per-60
- **Status:** live (CareerAverages) — called by hooks/useCareerAveragesStats.ts; Teams/[teamAbbreviation] legacy/dead — no callers, route ledger incoming {}
- **Tests:** `web/lib/nst/callerLifecycle.test.ts (lifecycle only)`
- **Consumers:** web/hooks/useCareerAveragesStats.ts; web/components/SustainabilityVSCareerChart/SustainabilityVSCareerChart.tsx
- **Reference standard:** Career rates should pool totals (sum G / sum SOG), not average seasonal percentages; Tango regression references for sustainability baselines
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - reducers use prev + X \|\| 0, so one NaN season resets the running sum to 0 (precedence), silently dropping earlier seasons
  - unweighted mean of seasonal percentages (S%, IPP, oiSH%) rather than pooled totals; a tiny season weighs as much as a full one
  - includes every row in the NST table (current partial season and any TOT/team split rows), so traded seasons may be double counted
  - 'ixG' key on the output is on-ice xG% and 'iCF' pct is on-ice CF%, misleading names
  - Teams/[teamAbbreviation].ts reads req.query.playerId although the dynamic segment is teamAbbreviation, so it always returns 'Player Id is required' (dead duplicate)

- **Where:** `web/pages/api/SustainabilityStats/[playerId].ts:53 (getStats)`
- **Inputs:** Season, StartTime, EndTime, player team; NST playerteams.php sit=all rate=n std and oi tables
- **Source tables:** Natural Stat Trick playerteams.php (scraped), NHL player lookup via lib/NHL/server
- **Method:** Single-row reads; xS% = ixG/Shots; secA% = A2/Total Assists; SOG/60 = Shots / TOI minutes (lib/NHL/TOI parseTime) * 60; S%, IPP, oiSH%, oZS% divided by 100.
- **Outputs:** S%; xS%; IPP; oiSH%; secA%; SOG/60; oZS%; iHDCF; iSCF; ixG; goals
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** NST percentages 0-100; TOI decimal minutes
- **Output scale:** fractions 0-1; SOG/60 per-60
- **Status:** live — hooks/useSustainabilityStats.ts; route ledger calls=1
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/api/SustainabilityStats/[playerId].test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/hooks/useSustainabilityStats.ts
- **Reference standard:** NST per-60 convention
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - NST team filter uses the player's CURRENT team, so a traded player's earlier-team games in the window are excluded
  - 'TOI' from NST with rate=n is decimal minutes; lib/NHL/TOI parseTime returns Number() for dotted strings, so correct, but the same helper name in ThreeYearAverages returns seconds

### SUS-008 Sustainability luck pressure (served)

- **Purpose:** Rank hot/cold sustainability rows by a weighted luck z-sum.
- **Where:** `web/pages/api/v1/sustainability/trends.ts:196-247 (handler row map)`
- **Inputs:** sustainability_scores.components z_shp, z_oishp, z_ipp, z_ppshp and components.weights.luck; s_raw, s_100
- **Source tables:** sustainability_scores
- **Method:** luck_pressure = -(w_shp*z_shp + w_oishp*z_oishp + w_ipp*z_ipp + w_ppshp*z_ppshp) (missing -> 0), passed through lib/sustainability/guardrails; component_breakdown contrib = z*w; sort desc for 'hot', asc for 'cold'.
- **Outputs:** luck_pressure; component_breakdown; s_100
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** z-scores; weights from config
- **Output scale:** signed weighted z-sum
- **Status:** live — SustainabilityCard on FORGE dashboard; route ledger calls=8
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/sustainability/trends.test.ts`; `web/hooks/useDashboardData.test.tsx`
- **Consumers:** web/components/forge-dashboard/SustainabilityCard.tsx; web/pages/FORGE.tsx
- **Reference standard:** Shooting% / on-ice SH% / IPP regression to mean (Tango); PDO luck
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - luck_pressure is the NEGATED weighted sum but component_breakdown contrib is not negated, so components do not add up to the shown total
  - z_soft is set equal to z_raw and r/n are null (placeholder fields)
  - missing z values default to 0 (neutral) silently

### SUS-009 trendsDebug sustainability-model feature engineering (recent-vs-career z-like, aggregate delta, usage delta) and demo model

- **Purpose:** Admin debug page derives features from a rolling-metric row and feeds lib/sustainability/model (probabilities, score, count projections) using an in-page demo-trained model.
- **Where:** `web/pages/trendsDebug.tsx:140 (DEMO_MODEL = trainSustainabilityProbabilityModel on 6 synthetic rows)`; `web/pages/trendsDebug.tsx:317 (normalizePercentLike: >1 -> /100)`; `web/pages/trendsDebug.tsx:322 (normalizePdo: >10 -> /1000, null -> 1)`; `web/pages/trendsDebug.tsx:332 (safePercentChange)`; `web/pages/trendsDebug.tsx:337 (toPer60 = count*3600/toiSeconds)`; `web/pages/trendsDebug.tsx:1229 (aggregateDelta)`; `web/pages/trendsDebug.tsx:1234 (zLike)`; `web/pages/trendsDebug.tsx:1332 (computed: predict, projectCountMetric, buildSustainabilityScore)`
- **Inputs:** sog_per_60_last5/career; ixg_per_60_last5/career; toi_seconds_avg_last5/career; pp_share_pct_last5/career; pdo_last5; goals/assists/points/pp_points/hits/blocks _avg_last5; faceoff totals
- **Source tables:** rolling_player_game_metrics (via rollingPlayerValidationPayload)
- **Method:** usageDelta = (toiRecent - toiCareer)/\|toiCareer\|; aggregateDelta = mean of pct-changes of shots/60, ixG/60, PP share (last5 vs career); zLike = mean of (shotsRecent-shotsCareer)/max(0.2*shotsCareer, 0.4) and (ixgRecent-ixgCareer)/max(0.2*ixgCareer, 0.08); recent per-60 for counts = avg per-game count (last5)*3600 / avg TOI seconds (last5), default TOI 900 s if missing. Features [shots/60, ixG/60, PP TOI pct, usageDelta, PDO] go to predictSustainabilityProbabilities(DEMO_MODEL); DEMO_MODEL trained in-page (900 iterations, lr 0.12, 350 calibration iterations) on 6 hand-written z-scale vectors (2 cold, 2 normal, 2 hot).
- **Outputs:** recentZScore; recentDelta; usageDelta; ratePer60; sustainability probabilities/score/flags (via lib SUS-038/SUS-039/SUS-029/SUS-030)
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-60 rates, TOI seconds, PP share percent or fraction (auto-detected), PDO ratio or x1000 (auto-detected)
- **Output scale:** z-like (unbounded), fractional deltas, per-60 rate; downstream probabilities 0-1
- **Status:** draft — admin-only debug page /trendsDebug
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/trendsDebug.test.tsx`
- **Consumers:** /trendsDebug admin page (user.role === 'admin')
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - DEMO_MODEL is trained on 6 synthetic vectors in roughly -2..+2 z units but scored on raw features (shots/60 ~ 5-12, PDO ~ 1.0, PP pct 0-1) — scale mismatch makes the displayed probabilities meaningless
  - 'zLike' is not a z-score; denominators of 20% of career with floors 0.4 / 0.08 are magic numbers
  - normalizePdo divides by 1000 whenever >10, so a 100-scale PDO (e.g. 101.2) becomes 0.1012
  - per-60 from ratio of averages (avg count / avg TOI) differs from the stored per-60 rolling fields used for shots/ixG in the same feature vector

### SUS-010 Sustainability Sandbox band-status streaks, streak intensity and barometer pointer

- **Purpose:** Classify each snapshot as hot/cold/neutral against its trend band, build streak segments, and map the raw sustainability score onto a 0-100 barometer.
- **Where:** `web/pages/trendsSandbox.tsx:115 (BAROMETER_MIN=-3, BAROMETER_MAX=3)`; `web/pages/trendsSandbox.tsx:439 (buildStatusTrendBundle: streak segments, intensity, fallback rolling avg)`; `web/pages/trendsSandbox.tsx:593 (ElasticityBandChart status)`; `web/pages/trendsSandbox.tsx:2300 (fallbackBaseline)`; `web/pages/trendsSandbox.tsx:2318 (history status vs ciUpper/ciLower)`; `web/pages/trendsSandbox.tsx:2458 (barometerPointer)`; `web/pages/trendsSandbox.tsx:2961 (table status)`
- **Inputs:** band history rows {value, ciLower, ciUpper, ewma, baseline}; activeRow.rawScore
- **Source tables:** sustainability trend bands / scores via /api/v1/sustainability/entity-bands, entity-history, entity-scores (lib/sustainability/entitySurface)
- **Method:** status = hot if value > ciUpper, cold if value < ciLower, else neutral; consecutive same-status rows form a segment; segment intensity = min(1, 0.25 + 0.18*length); point opacity min(1, 0.4 + 0.12*streakLength); rolling line uses row.ewma, falling back to a client rollingAverage with window min(5, n); baseline = latest non-null band baseline else mean of values. Barometer = (clamp(rawScore, -3, 3) + 3)/6 * 100, 50 when missing.
- **Outputs:** status per snapshot; StreakSegment list; barometer pointer 0-100
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** metric units of the band (rates, percentages); rawScore z-like
- **Output scale:** categorical status; intensity 0-1; barometer 0-100
- **Status:** live — /trendsSandbox
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/trendsSandbox.test.tsx (barometerPointer presence)`
- **Consumers:** /trendsSandbox band chart, streak shading, barometer
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - separate client streak logic from ROLL-028 (lib/trends/utils hot/cold streak detection) — two definitions of 'hot streak' on trend surfaces
  - barometer assumes rawScore is on a +/-3 z-like scale; values beyond are clipped silently
  - fallback baseline = mean of displayed history when no band baseline exists (mixes windows)

Without denom key: numer=Σw*rate, denom=Σw*games_played, result=numer/denom; career=Σ(rate*GP)/ΣGP. sigma set to SIGMA_MIN placeholder. win_season_prev = copy of newest season totals. ### SUS-028 Player 3-season blended Beta posterior (player priors)

- **Sub-family:** Sustainability / priors
- **Purpose:** Shrink each current-season player's own last-three-completed-season rates to the league Beta prior to get a personal baseline.
- **Where:** `web/lib/sustainability/priors.ts:49 (getHistorySeasonIds)`; `web/lib/sustainability/priors.ts:125 (fetchPlayerSeasonCounts)`; `web/lib/sustainability/priors.ts:295 (blendCounts)`; `web/lib/sustainability/priors.ts:324 (betaPosterior)`; `web/lib/sustainability/priors.ts:425 (upsertPlayerPosteriors)`
- **Inputs:** per-season goals/shots, nst_oi_gf/nst_oi_sf, points, pp_goals/pp_shots; league alpha0/beta0
- **Source tables:** player_totals_unified, sustainability_priors
- **Method:** History seasons = three completed seasons before current (seasonId-10001 offsets). blendCounts: s_blend=sum(w_i*s_i), n_blend=sum(w_i*n_i) with fixed w=[0.6,0.3,0.1] most-recent first, NOT renormalised when seasons missing. Rookie fallback applied first (see separate entry). Posterior alpha=alpha0+s, beta=beta0+(n-s); post_mean=alpha/(alpha+beta); post_var=ab/((a+b)^2(a+b+1)). If n<=0 returns prior. Mixed-position players forced to F.
- **Outputs:** successes_blend; trials_blend; post_alpha; post_beta; post_mean; post_var; n_effective
- **Tables written:** sustainability_player_priors (player_id, season_id, position_group, stat_code, ...)
- **Input units:** counts
- **Output scale:** Beta posterior; post_mean fraction 0-1
- **Status:** live — vercel.json cron 10:42-10:4x UTC daily (rebuild-priors 42 10, rebuild-window-z 43 10, rebuild-score ...); read by /api/v1/sustainability/trends used on pages/FORGE.tsx and components/forge-dashboard/SustainabilityCard.tsx (same rebuild-priors call)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/sustainability/priors.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/sustainability/rebuild-priors.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** fetchPlayerPosteriors -> rebuildBetaWindowZForSnapshot (own-history baseline)
- **Reference standard:** Beta-binomial empirical Bayes; Marcel-style 5/4/3 season weighting (here 6/3/1)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - weights not renormalised when a season is missing (Python player_priors.py renormalises) — missing seasons silently shrink harder
  - n_effective written = blended trials, not an effective sample size
  - posterior from history seasons is shrunk to a league prior computed from the CURRENT season (season mismatch)
  - inline __sanity() at priors.ts:511 runs at import time (side effect)

### SUS-029 League Beta priors per position (shp, oishp, ipp, ppshp)

- **Sub-family:** Sustainability / priors
- **Purpose:** Build league-level Beta(alpha0,beta0) priors for luck-type rate stats by position group.
- **Where:** `web/lib/sustainability/priors.ts:54 (fetchLeagueMeans)`; `web/lib/sustainability/priors.ts:110 (betaFromMuK)`; `web/lib/sustainability/priors.ts:383 (upsertLeaguePriors)`; `web/pages/api/v1/sustainability/rebuild-priors.ts:47 (k defaults)`
- **Inputs:** goals; shots; nst_oi_gf; nst_oi_sf; points; pp_goals; pp_shots; position_code; season_id; k_shp/k_oishp/k_ipp query params
- **Source tables:** player_totals_unified
- **Method:** Pooled league means over all F (C/L/R/LW/RW) or D rows of ONE season: shp=sum(goals)/sum(shots); oishp=sum(nst_oi_gf)/sum(nst_oi_sf); ipp=sum(points)/sum(nst_oi_gf); ppshp=sum(pp_goals)/sum(pp_shots) (0 if denominator 0). alpha0=max(mu*k,1e-9), beta0=max((1-mu)*k,1e-9). Route defaults k: shp 200, oishp 800, ipp 60; ppshp falls back to 80 inside upsertLeaguePriors (function default 200 for others).
- **Outputs:** season_id; position_group; stat_code; k; league_mu; alpha0; beta0
- **Tables written:** sustainability_priors (season_id, position_group, stat_code, k, league_mu, alpha0, beta0)
- **Input units:** counts (season totals); rates as fraction 0-1
- **Output scale:** Beta parameters; league_mu fraction 0-1
- **Status:** live — vercel.json cron 10:42-10:4x UTC daily (rebuild-priors 42 10, rebuild-window-z 43 10, rebuild-score ...); read by /api/v1/sustainability/trends used on pages/FORGE.tsx and components/forge-dashboard/SustainabilityCard.tsx (rebuild-priors?season=current&limit=2000 at 42 10 * * *)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/sustainability/priors.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/sustainability/rebuild-priors.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** upsertPlayerPosteriors; rebuildBetaWindowZForSnapshot (fallback prior); rebuild-window-z route
- **Reference standard:** Beta-binomial empirical Bayes; Tango regression-to-mean (k = league-average stabilization constant, e.g. sh% ~ 375 shots in community estimates)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - league mean is computed from the CURRENT season passed in (season=current in cron), so early-season priors rest on a few weeks of data and include the windows later compared against them
  - IPP mu = points/on-ice GF can exceed 1 if points include games without NST on-ice rows; betaFromMuK then floors beta0 at 1e-9 (no Python-style guard expanding trials)
  - k values (200/800/60/80) are hand-set in the route; Python config uses k_r 50/150/30 — inconsistent definitions
  - mixed sources — WGO goals/shots/points vs NST on-ice GF/SF; strength scope of nst_oi_* columns assumed all-situations

### SUS-031 Count projections (Poisson / NB normal-approx bands, 5/10-game horizons)

- **Sub-family:** Sustainability / projections
- **Purpose:** Project per-game and multi-game totals for goals, assists, points, shots, PPP, hits, blocks.
- **Where:** `web/lib/sustainability/model.ts:740 (projectCountMetric)`; `web/lib/sustainability/features.ts:782 (buildCountDistribution)`; `web/lib/sustainability/features.ts:813 (aggregateCountDistributions)`; `web/lib/sustainability/features.ts:848 (emitForecastBands)`; `web/lib/sustainability/recompute.ts:58 (normalizeToiSeconds)`; `web/lib/sustainability/recompute.ts:109 (buildProjectionRows)`
- **Inputs:** per-game rates from latest wgo_skater_stats row; toi_per_game; opponent strength
- **Source tables:** wgo_skater_stats, rosters, players, schedule (getUpcomingOpponents)
- **Method:** toiSeconds = toi_per_game if >180 else ×60. ratePer60 = perGame*3600/toi; adjusted rate = rate × opponent multiplier; expectedPerGame = rate*toi/3600. Poisson: var=mean, p10/p90 = mean ∓1.2816*sqrt(mean) floored 0. NB: var=mean+disp*mean^2. Horizon h: totalMean=h*mean; bands 50% (±0.6745 sd) and 80% (±1.2816 sd) normal approximation, floored 0. Horizons 5,10 (snapshot) and 1 per upcoming game (≤10).
- **Outputs:** expected_value; band50_lower/upper; band80_lower/upper; rate_per_60; distribution_summary
- **Tables written:** sustainability_projections
- **Input units:** toi seconds (heuristic); per-game rates
- **Output scale:** counts per horizon; bands
- **Status:** live — /api/v1/sustainability/recompute (process-recompute-queue); cron schedule not found in vercel.json
- **Tests:** `web/lib/sustainability/recompute.test.ts`; `web/lib/sustainability/model.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/sustainability/recompute.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** /api/v1/sustainability/player/[playerId]; /api/v1/sustainability/upcoming/[playerId]; backtestHarness
- **Reference standard:** Poisson goal/point models; negative binomial overdispersion
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - rate is derived from per-game and converted back with the same TOI, so the snapshot projection is just season-to-date per-game × horizon (no sustainability adjustment)
  - 'Poisson quantiles' are normal approximations — poor for small means (e.g. goals ~0.3/game)
  - toi>180 heuristic to guess seconds vs minutes
  - pp_points/GP uses season pp_points from same cumulative row

### SUS-045 Sustainability process-support score s_raw / s_100 (canonical v3)

- **Sub-family:** Sustainability / scores
- **Purpose:** Weighted sum of clipped luck and skill z-scores mapped through a logistic to a 0-100 index.
- **Where:** `web/lib/sustainability/score.ts:154 (zClip)`; `web/lib/sustainability/score.ts:165 (DEFAULT_WEIGHTS)`; `web/lib/sustainability/score.ts:175 (buildScoreForPlayerWindow)`; `web/lib/sustainability/config.ts:85 (canonicalSustainabilityConfigSeed)`; `web/pages/api/v1/sustainability/rebuild-score.ts:77 (windows)`

Guardrails clamp sRaw to ±8, s_100=round(100*sigmoid(sRaw),2). Windows l3/l5/l10/l20. No reliability factor or soft (tanh) clipping in TS (unlike Python).

### SUS-048 Gamma / Beta / Normal trend band (value, CI, z, percentile)

- **Sub-family:** Sustainability / trend bands
- **Purpose:** Per player/metric/window: decayed EWMA, shrunk value, 80% band, pseudo-z and band percentile.
- **Where:** `web/lib/sustainability/bandCalculator.ts:524 (computeGammaBand)`; `web/lib/sustainability/bandCalculator.ts:567 (computeBetaBand)`; `web/lib/sustainability/bandCalculator.ts:608 (computeNormalBand)`; `web/lib/sustainability/bandCalculator.ts:88 (estimateZScoreFromBand)`; `web/lib/sustainability/bandCalculator.ts:100 (estimatePercentileFromBand)`; `web/lib/sustainability/bandCalculator.ts:655 (computeTrendBandsForPlayer)`
- **Inputs:** samples; baseline; window size (l3/l5/l10/l20); spec
- **Source tables:** player_stats_unified, player_totals_unified
- **Method:** Take first N samples. Gamma: decayed counts/minutes, ewma=60*Σwc/Σwe; value=blend(ewma,baseline,nEff=Σwe minutes,k=prior); prior shape0=baseline/60*k+1e-3, rate0=k+1e-3; CI = gamma 10/90% quantiles*60. Beta: ewma=Σws/Σwt; value=blend(n=Σwt); alpha0=baseline*k+0.5, beta0=(1-baseline)*k+0.5; CI beta 10/90%. Normal: ewma=Σwv/Σw; var=max(Σwv²/Σw-ewma²,1e-4); margin=1.28155*sd/max(sqrt(Σw),1); value=blend. z=(value-baseline)/((upper-lower)/(2*1.28155)); percentile=clamp(10+80*(value-lower)/(upper-lower),0,100).
- **Outputs:** baseline; ewma; value; ci_lower; ci_upper; n_eff; prior_weight; z_score; percentile; exposure; distribution
- **Tables written:** sustainability_trend_bands
- **Input units:** rates per 60 (minutes exposure) or fraction 0-1
- **Output scale:** metric units; z dimensionless; percentile 0-100
- **Status:** live — vercel.json cron rebuild-trend-bands (limit 250, offsets 0-750); read by /api/v1/sustainability/trend-bands, entity-bands, pages/trendsSandbox.tsx
- **Tests:** `web/lib/sustainability/bandCalculator.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/sustainability/rebuild-trend-bands.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/sustainability/trend-bands.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** /api/v1/sustainability/trend-bands; entity-bands; trendsSandbox; entitySurfaceServer comparisons
- **Reference standard:** Bayesian shrinkage bands; compare with NST rolling averages
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - point value (linear credibility blend) and interval (conjugate posterior) come from two different estimators, so value may sit off-centre or outside its own band
  - z uses posterior band width, which shrinks with exposure, so z grows with sample size; not comparable to window_z
  - 'percentile' is a linear position within the 80% band, not a population percentile
  - normal-band SD from weighted second moment, margin divided by sqrt(sum of decay weights) — not a standard error of a decayed mean

### SUS-058 Beta-binomial empirical-Bayes window z (eb_z)

- **Sub-family:** Sustainability / z-scores
- **Purpose:** Standardise a window rate against the player's (or league) Beta baseline using beta-binomial predictive variance.
- **Where:** `web/lib/sustainability/windows.ts:161 (ebZ_generic)`; `web/lib/sustainability/windows.ts:187 (rebuildBetaWindowZForSnapshot)`; `web/lib/sustainability/windows.ts:129 (fetchPlayerPosteriors)`
- **Inputs:** window s,n; alpha0,beta0 (player posterior if same position group, else league prior)
- **Source tables:** sustainability_player_priors, sustainability_priors, player_stats_unified, player_baselines (player list)
- **Method:** strength=a+b; priorMean=a/strength; priorVar=ab/(strength^2(strength+1)); p_hat=s/n; shrink=strength/(strength+n); varMixed=priorMean(1-priorMean)(strength+n)/(n(strength+1)) [beta-binomial predictive variance of s/n]; z=(p_hat-priorMean)/max(sqrt(varMixed),sqrt(1e-9)). n=0 -> z=0. Non-finite outputs replaced by 0 before persist. Rounded z to 6dp.
- **Outputs:** rate; prior_mean; prior_var; shrink; var_mixed; eb_z; k
- **Tables written:** sustainability_window_z
- **Input units:** counts; rates fraction 0-1
- **Output scale:** z-score (unbounded here; clipped ±3 downstream)
- **Status:** live — vercel.json cron 10:42-10:4x UTC daily (rebuild-priors 42 10, rebuild-window-z 43 10, rebuild-score ...); read by /api/v1/sustainability/trends used on pages/FORGE.tsx and components/forge-dashboard/SustainabilityCard.tsx
- **Tests:** `web/lib/sustainability/windows.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/sustainability/rebuild-window-z.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** buildScoreForPlayerWindow (luck z); trends route z_* fields
- **Reference standard:** Beta-binomial predictive distribution; Tango regression to the mean
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - non-finite z coerced to 0 (indistinguishable from 'at baseline')
  - player list comes from player_baselines at the snapshot date, so players without a baseline row get no z
  - sequential per-player DB call per window (N×4 queries) — cost, not math

### BLSH-002 BLSH forecast development comparison (arms P0-P3, gamma transfer, cluster bootstrap)

- **Purpose:** Exploratory test of whether BLSH references predict next-5-game production.
- **Where:** `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/forecastEvaluation.ts:25 (DEFAULT_CONFIG)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/forecastEvaluation.ts:66 (priorSeasonMean)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/forecastEvaluation.ts:108 (fitGamma)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/forecastEvaluation.ts:125 (shifted)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/forecastEvaluation.ts:137 (buildOrigins)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/forecastEvaluation.ts:202 (applyGamma)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/forecastEvaluation.ts:225 (compositeWeights)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/forecastEvaluation.ts:248 (contrast)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/forecastEvaluation.ts:268 (armMetrics)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/forecastEvaluation.ts:279 (decision)`
- **Inputs:** slots by player; training blocks
- **Source tables:** development history export
- **Method:** Origins: 5-game window + next 5 games in same season, gaps ≤30 days, no team change. P0 = mean of previous season's last 50 games; P1 = shrunk reference rate × window TOI/game; P1_H = rate × history TOI/game; P2_transfer = (rate + delta·beta/3600)·tau; P2 = rate shifted by gamma (no-intercept WLS of 3600·(next5 rate − reference rate) on ΔX, equal weight per player, ×0.5); P3 = window mean. FP/G+A floored 0. Composite weights a_t=(1/3)/sd_t/sqrt(w'Rw) from training targets. Paired MAE/RMSE differences with player cluster bootstrap (2000 draws, mulberry32 seed 20261029), 95% percentile CI. Decision: FP P2<P0 CI below 0, P2<P1 point, G+A and GS not worse.
- **Outputs:** maeDiff; rmseDiff; CIs; decision.forwardPromise
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-appearance totals; seconds
- **Output scale:** MAE/RMSE differences
- **Status:** draft — offline research harness (forecastDevRun.test.ts); result in tasks/artifacts/blsh-independent-review-2026-10-28/forecast-dev-v2
- **Tests:** `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/forecastEvaluation.test.ts`; `web/scripts/blsh/forecastDevRun.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/scripts/blsh/forecastDevRun.test.ts (offline run)
- **Reference standard:** Forecast verification; paired cluster bootstrap

  - training 2022-23 / evaluation 2023-24 fixed in DEFAULT_CONFIG

- **Inputs:** goals; assists; pp_points; shots; hits; blocked_shots; total_primary_assists; total_secondary_assists; penalties_drawn; penalties; total_fow; total_fol; sat_for; sat_against; es/pp/sh_goals_for; es/pp/sh_goals_against; points
- **Source tables:** WGO game rows (development export 2022-24 / current wgo_skater_stats capture)
- **Method:** FP = 3G + 2A + 1PPP + 0.2SOG + 0.2HIT + 0.25BLK. G+A = goals+assists (null if != points). Game Score = 0.75G + 0.7A1 + 0.55A2 + 0.075SOG + 0.05BLK + 0.15(PD-PT) + 0.01(FOW-FOL) + 0.05(SATF-SATA) + 0.15(GF-GA) with GF/GA = ES+PP+SH on-ice goals. Missing input -> null track (never 0); negative counts -> null.
- **Outputs:** tracks[fp, g+a, gs]
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-game counts
- **Output scale:** fantasy points / points / game score per game
- **Status:** live (frozen) — runs offline via web/scripts/blsh/currentDryRun.test.ts; output frozen JSON web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/research-snapshots/2026-10-28.arm-a-canonical-repaired.v2.json served by pages/buy-low-sell-high/preview.tsx
- **Tests:** `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/productionReference.test.ts`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/currentWindows.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** BLSH stage 2-5; opportunity; forecastEvaluation
- **Reference standard:** Dom Luszczyszyn Game Score (2016) — standard uses 5v5 on-ice GF/GA; Yahoo/ESPN points scoring
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - Game Score GF/GA term uses all-situations (ES+PP+SH) on-ice goals; Luszczyszyn's definition uses even-strength/5v5 GF-GA
  - track name 'raw_points' in PRODUCTION_TRACKS vs 'goals_plus_assists' elsewhere (same quantity, two labels)
  - FHFH weights hard-coded (duplicated in trade.ts FHFH_STANDARD_SCORING via import, consistent)

### BLSH-006 BLSH stage 2b: position cohort production prior (donor moments, signal/noise covariance)

- **Purpose:** Estimate between-player signal covariance and per-second noise covariance of the 3 tracks from 50-game donor histories.
- **Where:** `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/productionReference.ts:122 (summarizeHistory)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/productionReference.ts:230 (fitProductionPrior)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/productionReference.ts:100 (asPsd)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/productionReference.ts:107 (metricInverse)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/currentWindows.ts:192 (donor selection; cutoff '2026-07-01' at :199)`
- **Inputs:** donor 50-game histories (rates per second, residual_per_second)
- **Source tables:** development history export
- **Method:** Donors: same position, exactly 50 prior games, single position, excluding target. Per donor rate=Σy/Σt; residual cov from ten 5-game blocks Σ e_i e_j / t_b / 9. mu=mean donor rate; observedCov (n-1); omega=mean residual cov; noise=mean(omega/seconds); base=observedCov+noise; signal = PSD projection (eigen-clip) of (observedCov-noise) in standardised units; metric = pseudo-inverse of base (correlation eigen, tol eps). Needs ≥2 donors.
- **Outputs:** mu; omega; signal; mean_cov; metric
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-second rates
- **Output scale:** covariance matrices
- **Status:** live (frozen) — runs offline via web/scripts/blsh/currentDryRun.test.ts; output frozen JSON web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/research-snapshots/2026-10-28.arm-a-canonical-repaired.v2.json served by pages/buy-low-sell-high/preview.tsx
- **Tests:** `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/productionReference.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** BLSH stage 2c
- **Reference standard:** Empirical Bayes / random-effects method-of-moments (multivariate Tango regression)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - donor cutoff date '2026-07-01' hard-coded in currentWindows.ts:199
  - donors restricted to complete 50-game runs (survivor/role bias toward regulars)

### BLSH-015 BLSH stage 4a: process-support sensitivity model (within-player beta, SHRINK 0.5)

- **Purpose:** Fit how 5-game changes in process (ixG/60, on-ice xGF/60, xGA/60) move production, on disjoint training blocks.
- **Where:** `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/supportGap.ts:7 (PROCESS, SHRINK, SEASONS)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/supportGap.ts:101 (covarianceGeometry)`; `web/lib/buyLowSellHigh/supportGap.ts:131 (fitPrior)`
- **Inputs:** training blocks: 5 ordered games, seconds, X=process per-60, Y=track per-hour rates, teams, positions
- **Source tables:** development history export 2022-23, 2023-24
- **Method:** Exclude target player, other positions, unqualified blocks, blocks with team/position change. Group by player-season (≥2 blocks). Exposure-weighted within-player-season deviations dx, dy; weights q/(players*seasonsPerPlayer). Cxx=Σ w dx dx', Cxy=Σ w dx dy'. beta = 0.5 × pinv(Cxx)·Cxy (eigen pseudo-inverse in correlation units). cohortX=weighted mean process; deltaMin/Max = observed deviation range.
- **Outputs:** beta (3x3); Cxx; cohortX; deltaMin/Max; rank
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** process per-60 (NST all-situations); Y per-hour
- **Output scale:** beta: production per hour per unit process/60

- **Consumers:** BLSH stage 4b/4c; forecastEvaluation P2_transfer
- **Reference standard:** Fixed-effects (within) regression with ridge-like shrinkage

### GPR-003 Game stats page moneyline implied win probability with proportional de-vig

- **Purpose:** Show each team's market-implied win probability on the single-game stats page.
- **Where:** `web/pages/stats/game/[gameId].tsx:118 (getImpliedProb)`; `web/pages/stats/game/[gameId].tsx:186-197 (normalise away/home, round to %)`
- **Inputs:** away/home moneyline string (American or decimal)
- **Source tables:** NHL gamecenter odds payload (gameOdds.awayTeam/homeTeam.odds)
- **Method:** Decimal odds d>1: p = 1/d*100. American +X: 100/(X+100)*100; -X: X/(X+100)*100. Proportional de-vig: awayProb = round(rawAway/(rawAway+rawHome)*100); homeProb = 100 - awayProb; null unless both sides parse.
- **Outputs:** awayProb %; homeProb %
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** American or decimal odds (auto-detected by sign)
- **Output scale:** integer percent 0-100

### GPR-006 Simple baseline comparators (bounded edge probability)

- **Sub-family:** Game predictions & odds / evaluation
- **Purpose:** Naive benchmarks the model must beat (home 54%, market, standings, goal diff, power composite, goalie).

- **Inputs:** matchup diffs; market no-vig
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** p = 0.5 if edge≈0 else base + min(max-base, \|edge\|/scale) toward the favoured side. home_team_fixed_54 p=0.54; standings point% scale 0.3 (0.53-0.68); goal diff scale 100 (0.53-0.68); recent10 GD/game scale 3 (0.53-0.68); power composite sum of 4 rating diffs scale 120 (0.53-0.72); goalie GSAA scale 2 (0.52-0.65); market no-vig. Clip [0.05,0.95]; correct if p>=0.5. Strongest floor = lowest log loss excluding market.
- **Outputs:** BacktestBaselineComparison[]; simpleBaselineFloor
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** see method
- **Output scale:** probability 0.05-0.95
- **Status:** live in backtest/accountability admin routes
- **Tests:** `web/lib/game-predictions/accountability.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/game-predictions/accuracy-loop.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** decidePromotion
- **Reference standard:** Naive forecasts (home-ice prior, standings log5)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - boundedEdgeProbability jumps from 0.5 to base (0.53) on any nonzero edge (discontinuous), so tiny edges get 53%
  - home baseline is not a log5/Elo model

### GPR-009 Prediction evaluation metrics (log loss, Brier, accuracy, AUC, calibration bins)

- **Sub-family:** Game predictions & odds / evaluation
- **Purpose:** Scores stored predictions against outcomes by segment.
- **Where:** `web/lib/game-predictions/evaluation.ts:91 (deriveOutcomeFromScore)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/evaluation.ts:163 (buildCalibrationBins)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/evaluation.ts:192 (calculateAuc)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/evaluation.ts:209 (calculateSegmentMetric)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/evaluation.ts:237 (buildSegmentMetrics)`; `web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:106 (evaluateProbabilityMetrics)`

Segments: overall, confidence_label, season_phase, predicted_side, goalie_confirmation_state, goalie uncertainty bucket (max >= 0.75 high, >= 0.25 medium), market_edge_bucket, has_stale_source, game_type.
- **Outputs:** log_loss; brier_score; accuracy; auc; calibration
- **Tables written:** game_prediction_model_metrics

- **Output scale:** log loss nats; Brier 0-1; AUC 0-1

### GPR-022 Goalie start blend and start uncertainty

- **Sub-family:** Game predictions & odds / features (goalie)
- **Purpose:** Selects the likely starter and computes start-probability-weighted GSAA/60 and start uncertainty.
- **Where:** `web/lib/game-predictions/featureBuilder.ts:1310 (buildGoalieBlendFeatures)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/featureBuilder.ts:1469 (goalieStartUncertainty)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/featureBuilder.ts:1497 (buildRecentUsageGoalieFeatures)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/featureBuilder.ts:1631 (latestGoaliePerformanceGsaa)`
- **Inputs:** lines_ccc accepted tweet goalie; goalie_start_projections start_probability, projected_gsaa_per_60, confirmed_status; lineCombinations goalies; nst_all/5v5 gsaa_per_60
- **Source tables:** lines_ccc, goalie_start_projections, lineCombinations, vw_goalie_stats_unified
- **Method:** Priority: lines_ccc (confirmed, p=1) > goalie_start_projections (confirmed rows equal weight else start_probability normalized) > current lineCombinations first goalie (p=1) > recent usage (mode of last 5 starters, p = count/5) > fallback. weighted GSAA/60 = sum(w * clamp(gsaa,-3,3)). uncertainty: confirmed 0; fallback 1; else max(floor, 1 - topStartProb) with floor 0.1 if >1 candidate else 0.25.
- **Outputs:** weightedProjectedGsaaPer60; topGoalieId; topGoalieStartProbability; startUncertainty; confirmed; source
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** GSAA per 60; probabilities 0-1
- **Output scale:** GSAA/60 clamped -3..3; uncertainty 0-1
- **Status:** live — cron /api/v1/game-predictions/forecast in web/vercel.json:99 (generatePregamePredictionsForWindow)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/game-predictions/featureBuilder.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** homeMinusAwayWeightedGoalieGsaaPer60; homeMinusAwayGoalieStartUncertainty; data-quality penalties; goalie_gsaa baseline
- **Reference standard:** Goalie GSAx/60 (MoneyPuck, Evolving-Hockey); starter probability models
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - GSAA prefers nst_all over 5v5 and mixes them silently
  - projected_gsaa_per_60 and NST GSAA are different estimators combined in one weighted sum
  - served model weight 0 for goalie GSAA (goalie only enters through team goalie_rating diff at 0.02)

### GPR-034 Probability floor, rounding, winner threshold, confidence label, market edge bucket

- **Sub-family:** Game predictions & odds / model
- **Purpose:** Final post-processing of the home-win probability into labels used on the page and in metrics.
- **Where:** `web/lib/game-predictions/baselineModel.ts:318 (applyProbabilityFloor)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/baselineModel.ts:1250 (getConfidenceLabel)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/baselineModel.ts:1259 (marketEdgeBucket)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/baselineModel.ts:18-20 (constants)`
- **Inputs:** quality-adjusted probability; market homeNoVigProbability
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** floor = model.probabilityFloor ?? 0.05, bounded [0,0.49]; p clipped [floor, 1-floor]; round 6 dp. predicted winner = home if p >= 0.52 (BASELINE_WINNER_DECISION_THRESHOLD, clamp 0.01-0.99) also reports threshold-50 winner. confidence: \|p-0.5\| >= 0.15 high, >= 0.07 medium else low. modelVsMarketEdge = p - marketNoVig; bucket \|edge\| >= 0.08 large, >= 0.04 medium, >= 0.015 small, else efficient; null -> no_market.
- **Outputs:** home_win_probability; predicted_winner_team_id; confidence_label; model_vs_market_edge; market_edge_bucket
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** probability 0-1
- **Output scale:** probability 0.05-0.95; labels
- **Status:** live — cron /api/v1/game-predictions/forecast in web/vercel.json:99 (generatePregamePredictionsForWindow)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/game-predictions/baselineModel.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** public prediction payload; evaluation segments (confidence_label, market_edge_bucket)
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 0.52 threshold means p in [0.50,0.52) shows home as favourite in probability but away as predicted winner
  - accuracy and calibration buckets use the 0.52 winner while confidence uses max(p,1-p), inconsistent for p in [0.5,0.52)

### GPR-035 Data-quality dampening toward 50%

- **Sub-family:** Game predictions & odds / model
- **Purpose:** Shrinks probabilities toward a coin flip when inputs are stale, missing or uncertain.
- **Where:** `web/lib/game-predictions/baselineModel.ts:498 (buildDataQualityMultiplier)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/baselineModel.ts:494 (dampenTowardCoinFlip)`
- **Inputs:** sourceCutoffs[].stale; missingFeatures; goalie.source/confirmed/startUncertainty; market availability/age; lineup presence; gameDate - sourceAsOfDate
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** penalties: stale_sources min(0.18, 0.03*n); missing_features min(0.18, 0.025*n); goalie_fallback 0.06 per side; projected (unconfirmed) goalie 0.025 per side; goalie_start_uncertainty min(0.06, 0.025*(uH+uA)); market_odds_unavailable 0.01 or market stale (>24h) 0.02; missing_lineup 0.03 per side; prediction_horizon min(0.14, 0.02*days). multiplier = clamp(1 - sum, 0.55, 1). p' = 0.5 + (p-0.5)*multiplier.
- **Outputs:** data_quality_multiplier; data_quality_penalties; quality_adjusted_home_win_probability
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** counts, hours, days
- **Output scale:** multiplier 0.55-1; probability 0-1
- **Status:** live — cron /api/v1/game-predictions/forecast in web/vercel.json:99 (generatePregamePredictionsForWindow)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/game-predictions/baselineModel.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** predictGameWithBaselineModel; predictGameWithExtraTreesModel; explainBaselineModelPrediction
- **Reference standard:** Ad hoc shrinkage; compare with calibrated uncertainty (Platt/isotonic) rather than fixed penalties
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - penalties are hand-tuned constants; source staleness counted per cutoff entry, and both home and away push the same tables (team_power_ratings_daily appears twice per side), so stale counts double
  - dampening is applied after calibration, so a calibrated model is de-calibrated again
  - goalie start uncertainty double-penalised (projected_goalie and goalie_start_uncertainty both fire)

### GPR-038 Served pregame home-win probability (INITIAL_BASELINE_MODEL hand-weighted logistic)

- **Sub-family:** Game predictions & odds / model
- **Purpose:** The probability actually served for NHL games: logistic score over the baseline feature vector using hard-coded weights.
- **Where:** `web/lib/game-predictions/workflow.ts:48 (INITIAL_BASELINE_MODEL)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/workflow.ts:902 (generatePregamePredictionForGame: model = args.model ?? INITIAL_BASELINE_MODEL)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/baselineModel.ts:1516 (predictGameWithBaselineModel)`; `web/lib/game-predictions/baselineModel.ts:619 (predictBaselineModelRawHomeWinProbability)`
- **Inputs:** 53-element baseline feature vector (buildBaselineFeatureVector)
- **Source tables:** game_prediction_feature_snapshots (via featureBuilder inputs)
- **Method:** p = sigmoid(bias + sum w_i*x_i) with bias=0 and weights [0.018 offRatingDiff, 0.008 defRatingDiff, 0.02 goalieRatingDiff, 0.008 specialRatingDiff, 0.35 pointPctgDiff, 0.18 goalDiff/50, 0.08 recent5GD/3, 0.06 recent10GD/3, 0.18 recent20GD/3, 0.12 recent40GD/3, 0 recent5xGF%, 0.2 recent10xGF%, 0.08 recent20xGF%, 0.04 recent40xGF%, 0.04 seasonToDate xGF%, 0.02 crossSeason xGF%, 0 recent10PointPct] and 0 for all remaining 36 keys. No featureNormalization on this model (raw transformed features), no calibrator. Then data-quality dampening, probability floor 0.05, rounding to 6 dp, winner threshold 0.52.
- **Outputs:** home_win_probability; away_win_probability; predicted_winner_team_id; confidence_label; top_factors
- **Tables written:** game_prediction_history, game_prediction_outputs
- **Input units:** mixed: power ratings centered 100 (15 per sd), point% fraction 0-1, goal diff /50, per-game GD /3, xGF% fraction 0-1
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1, floored to [0.05, 0.95], 6 dp
- **Status:** live — cron /api/v1/game-predictions/forecast in web/vercel.json:99 (generatePregamePredictionsForWindow)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/game-predictions/baselineModel.test.ts`; `web/lib/game-predictions/workflow.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/game-predictions/forecast.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/game-predictions/generate.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** /api/v1/game-predictions/forecast (cron); /api/v1/game-predictions/generate; publicPredictions.ts -> /api/v1/game-predictions/latest; accountability dashboard
- **Reference standard:** Fitted logistic/Elo-style win models (e.g. MoneyPuck, Evolving-Hockey game models); Elo home-ice term ~ +0.08–0.10 logit / ~54-55% home win rate
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - bias = 0 so the served model has no home-ice term although training data (smoothedHomeWinRate fallback 0.54) shows home edge
  - weights are hand-set constants labelled algorithm 'regularized_logistic_baseline' and model version 'v6_roster_ctpi_sos_threshold_52', yet CTPI, SOS, roster, goalie, rest, market features all have weight 0
  - 5 of the non-zero weights (recent20/40 GD, recent20/40/seasonToDate/crossSeason xGF%) hit default-excluded features that are forced to 0, so they never contribute
  - no normalization, so offRating diff (center 100, sd 15 scale) and pointPctg diff (fraction) enter on raw, very different scales

### SKO-001 matview analytics.mv_sko_skater_moments

- **Purpose:** Per-player and per-position robust medians and MADs of sKO input features
- **Where:** `supabase/migrations/20260730233451_reconstruct_hosted_analytics_schema.sql:502 (analytics.mv_sko_skater_moments, WITH NO DATA)`

- **Source tables:** analytics.vw_sko_skater_base
- **Method:** player: percentile_cont(0.5) median and MAD = 1.4826*median(\|x - median\|) over ALL the player's games; league: same by position_code (on-ice SH% and SH% with 0 -> NULL for league only). n_games = count of non-null shots.
- **Outputs:** *_med; *_mad; league_*_med; league_*_mad; n_games
- **Tables written:** analytics.mv_sko_skater_moments
- **Input units:** per-game WGO values; TOI per game (seconds?)
- **Output scale:** medians/MADs in input units

- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/supportedBaselineMigration.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** analytics.vw_sko_skater_zscores
- **Reference standard:** robust z (median/MAD, 1.4826 consistency constant)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - player moments span all seasons including future games relative to any date (look-ahead leakage in historical z-scores)
  - zero SH% nulled for league stats but not for player stats

### SKO-002 view analytics.vw_sko_skater_zscores

- **Purpose:** Empirical-Bayes shrunk robust z-scores per skater-game
- **Where:** `supabase/migrations/20260730233451_reconstruct_hosted_analytics_schema.sql:638 (analytics.vw_sko_skater_zscores)`; `web/sql/views/analytics.vw_sko_skater_zscores.sql:4 (repo source)`

- **Source tables:** analytics.vw_sko_skater_base, analytics.mv_sko_skater_moments
- **Method:** kappa = 30; w_player = n/(n+30), w_league = 30/(n+30); z = (x - (w_p*player_med + w_l*league_med)) / (w_p*player_mad + w_l*league_mad) for shots, ixg, ixg_per_60, toi, pp_toi, ozfo%, on-ice SH%, SH%; game_id falls back to row_number.
- **Outputs:** shots_z; ixg_z; ixg_per_60_z; toi_z; pp_toi_z; ozfo_z; onice_sh_z; shooting_pct_z
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-game values
- **Output scale:** robust z-score
- **Status:** legacy/dead — quarantined (web/lib/predictions/legacyQuarantine.ts:130)
- **Tests:** `web/sql/tests/sko_trends_validation.sql`; `web/lib/supabase/supportedBaselineMigration.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** analytics.vw_sko_skater_scores
- **Reference standard:** empirical Bayes shrinkage (kappa pseudo-games)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**

### SKO-004 fn analytics.rpc_sko_player_series (+ public wrapper)

- **Purpose:** Player sKO time series with EWMA and hot/cold streak flags vs training baseline
- **Where:** `supabase/migrations/20260730233451_reconstruct_hosted_analytics_schema.sql:751 (analytics.rpc_sko_player_series)`; `web/sql/functions/analytics.rpc_sko_player_series.sql:4 (repo source)`; `supabase/migrations/20260716112908_production_schema_baseline.sql:4342 (public.rpc_sko_player_series wrapper)`; `web/sql/functions/public.rpc_sko_player_series.sql:4`
- **Inputs:** p_player_id; p_span=5; p_lambda_hot=1.8; p_lambda_cold=1.6; p_l_hot=2; p_l_cold=3

- **Method:** baseline mu0 = median sko over seasons 20212022-20232024; sigma0 = 1.4826*MAD. EWMA alpha = 2/(span+1) recursive by game order. hot_flag if ewma - mu0 >= 1.8*sigma0; cold if mu0 - ewma >= 1.6*sigma0; streak start when flag=1 and lag(flag, L-1)=1; streak ids = cumulative sum of starts.
- **Outputs:** series[].ewma; hot_flag; cold_flag; hot_streak_id; cold_streak_id; baseline.mu0; baseline.sigma0
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** sko (-1,1)

- **Tests:** `web/sql/tests/sko_trends_validation.sql`; `web/lib/supabase/supportedBaselineMigration.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** no runtime caller (legacyQuarantine.ts:125)
- **Reference standard:** EWMA control chart / CUSUM-like streak detection
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - training seasons hard-coded (2021-22..2023-24); players without them get sigma0=0 so every game flags
  - streak test checks only the flag L-1 games back, not all L consecutive games

### SKO-006 sKO points prediction (moving-average blend with volatility penalty)

- **Purpose:** Predict a skater's points over the next N games and a sKO score penalised for recent volatility.
- **Where:** `web/pages/api/v1/ml/update-predictions-sko.ts:106 (mean)`; `web/pages/api/v1/ml/update-predictions-sko.ts:112 (stddev)`; `web/pages/api/v1/ml/update-predictions-sko.ts:120 (smoothstepMultiplier)`; `web/pages/api/v1/ml/update-predictions-sko.ts:305 (buildPredictionRecord)`
- **Inputs:** player_stats_unified points per game, lookbackDays default 120; horizon default 5; stabilityWindow default 10
- **Source tables:** player_stats_unified
- **Method:** avg5 = mean(last 5), avg10 = mean(last 10); recentBlend = 0.6*avg10 + 0.4*avg5; pred_points = recentBlend*horizon. stdevShort = population SD of last stabilityWindow games; stdevLong = SD of last 20; t1 = 0.8*stdevLong, t2 = max(t1+1e-6, 1.2*stdevLong); ratio = clamp((stdevShort-t1)/(t2-t1)); smooth = 3r^2-2r^3; multiplier = 0.8 + 0.2*(1-smooth) in [0.8,1]; sko = pred_points*multiplier. MODEL_VERSION v0.3.
- **Outputs:** pred_points; pred_points_per_game; stability_cv; stability_multiplier; sko
- **Tables written:** predictions_sko
- **Input units:** points per game
- **Output scale:** projected points over horizon (default 5 games); multiplier 0.8-1.0

- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/ml/update-predictions-sko.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/pages/api/v1/ml/get-predictions-sko.ts; web/components/Predictions/PredictionsLeaderboard.tsx; web/lib/hooks/useQuarantinedPredictionsSko.ts
- **Reference standard:** Weighted moving average baseline; Marcel-style regression would add a league prior

  - stability_cv stores a standard deviation, not a coefficient of variation
  - with default stabilityWindow=10 the short SD is last-10 vs long last-20, overlapping windows
  - no regression to a league/career prior and no TOI, opponent or schedule terms; points from player_stats_unified only
  - magic constants 0.6/0.4, 0.8/1.2, floor 0.8

### SKO-018 Legacy sKO characteristic-game classification (weighted squared z)

- **Sub-family:** sKO / legacy characteristic

### SKO-023 sKO stability multiplier (smoothstep 0.8-1.0)

- **Sub-family:** sKO / legacy predictions
- **Purpose:** Discounts the prediction for players more volatile lately than usual.

- **Outputs:** stability_multiplier
- **Tables written:** predictions_sko
- **Input units:** SD of points
- **Output scale:** multiplier 0.8-1.0

## Team ratings / power / CTPI / SOS (TEAM, 54)

### TEAM-001 matview team_power_ratings_daily__new (sql/001)

- **Purpose:** Daily team offense/defense/pace ratings via EWMA, shrinkage and z-scores, plus finishing/goalie/danger/special/discipline components
- **Where:** `sql/001_team_power_ratings.sql:4 (team_power_ratings_daily__new)`; `supabase/migrations/20260716112908_production_schema_baseline.sql:3086 (refresh_team_power_ratings stub: 'team_power_ratings_daily is a table now')`
- **Inputs:** NST team per-60 rates and 5v5 counts; WGO PP%/PK%/discipline
- **Source tables:** nst_team_gamelogs_as_rates, nst_team_5v5, nst_team_gamelogs_pp_rates, nst_team_gamelogs_pk_rates, wgo_team_stats
- **Method:** params lookback 25 games, half-life 10 games, mode setting team_power_mode (all\|5v5). pace = (CF60+CA60)/2. EWMA weight 0.5^(age/10) over last 25 games in season. Shrink: w = min(1, gp_to_date/10); metric = w*EWMA + (1-w)*league daily avg. z = (metric - daily league mean)/daily league stddev_samp. off_raw = 0.7 z_xGF + 0.2 z_SF + 0.1 z_GF; def_raw = 0.7(-z_xGA) + 0.2(-z_SA) + 0.1(-z_GA); ratings = 100 + 15*z-standardized raw. PP/PK tiers via percentile_cont 0.33/0.67 per date. trend = AVG(off_rating) prior 10 rows. extras (single-game, per date): finishing = GF60-xGF60, goaltending = xGA60-GA60, danger = HDCF/(HDCF+HDCA), PP xGF60, PK xGA60, discipline diff, PDO; each z per date; component rating = 100+15*z; special = 100+15*(0.20 z_pp_off + 0.20(-z_pk_def)); variance_flag if \|z_pdo\|>=1.
- **Outputs:** off_rating; def_rating; pace_rating; pp_tier; pk_tier; off_rating_last10; finishing_rating; goalie_rating; danger_rating; special_rating; discipline_rating; variance_flag
- **Tables written:** team_power_ratings_daily__new (matview, now a table in production)
- **Input units:** per-60 and seconds
- **Output scale:** 100-centred, SD-15 ratings; tiers 1-3
- **Status:** legacy/dead — repo SQL file not in a migration tree; writer route update-team-power-ratings-new returns 'DO NOT RUN'; canonical team_power_ratings_daily is written by TS
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/update-team-power-ratings-new.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/pages/api/v1/db/update-team-power-ratings-new.ts (disabled stub)
- **Reference standard:** Elo/SRS-style team ratings; EWMA; empirical-Bayes shrinkage
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - extras z-scores use single-game values among only teams that played that date (tiny, noisy cross-sections)
  - special_rating weights 0.20+0.20 shrink the scale vs other components
  - in 5v5 mode toi_seconds and HD columns NULL so danger rating defaults to 100

### TEAM-015 Team power ratings daily writer (PP/PK tiers and carry-forward)

- **Purpose:** Orchestrate daily team power ratings and add special-teams tiers; carry forward the last rating for teams without fresh games.
- **Where:** `web/pages/api/v1/db/update-team-power-ratings.ts:69 (handler)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/update-team-power-ratings.ts:281 (getPercentile)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/update-team-power-ratings.ts:292 (getTier)`

- **Method:** Delegates EWMA -> league metrics -> z-scores -> raw scores -> distribution -> final rating to lib/power-ratings. - **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/update-team-power-ratings.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/lib/underlying-stats/teamLandingRatings.ts; web/lib/game-predictions/featureBuilder.ts; web/components/TeamScheduleCalendar/TeamScheduleCalendar.tsx; start-chart (via lib/teamRatingsService xga60)
- **Reference standard:** Tercile tiering; EWMA/z-score composite (see lib/power-ratings audit)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - a missing PP/PK% assigns the WORST tier (3) instead of unknown
  - carried-forward rows keep the old source_through_date but get the new date, so stale ratings look current by date

### TEAM-031 Power ratings: EWMA of team rates (half-life 10, 25-game window)

- **Method:** Only if the team's newest row is ON targetDate; window = 25 most recent rows; weight_i = 0.5^(i/10); EWMA of xGF60, GF60, SF60, xGA60, GA60, SA60, pace, HDCF60, HDCA60, PP xGF60, PK xGA60, discipline diff (drawn - taken per 60); PDO EWMA over non-null only. Nulls count as 0 for all other metrics.
- **Outputs:** *60_ewma; pdo_ewma; gp_to_date
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per 60
- **Output scale:** per 60
- **Status:** live — /api/v1/db/update-team-power-ratings (withCronJobAudit; pg_cron schedule not in repo)

- **Consumers:** calculateLeagueMetrics; calculateZScores
- **Reference standard:** Exponentially weighted moving average (half-life parametrization)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - the writer passes BOTH 'all' and '5v5' rows to calculateEwma (only teamRatingsTrend filters data_mode='all'), so each game appears twice: effective window ~12.5 games, half-life ~5 games, all-situation and 5v5 rates averaged together, 5v5 rows contribute 0 for pace/HD/PP/PK
  - gp_to_date counts rows (doubled) across the 150-day window and across seasons
  - missing values become 0 in the weighted sums

### TEAM-032 Power ratings: league distribution, early-season blend, z-scores

- **Sub-family:** Team ratings / power / CTPI / SOS / power ratings
- **Purpose:** Standardizes each team's EWMA rates against the league for the date.
- **Where:** `web/lib/power-ratings.ts:405 (calculateLeagueMetrics)`; `web/lib/power-ratings.ts:503 (calculateZScores)`
- **Inputs:** EWMA metrics of teams with a game on targetDate
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** league avg and sample SD (n-1) per metric; gpWeight = clamp(gp_to_date/10,0,1); blended = gpWeight*ewma + (1-gpWeight)*leagueAvg for xGF/GF/SF/xGA/GA/SA/pace; z = (blended - avg)/sd (0 if sd=0). Derived: finishing = GF60 - xGF60, goalie = xGA60 - GA60, danger = HDCF/(HDCF+HDCA) (0.5 if 0), ppOff, pkDef, discipline, pdo (pdo_z 0 if null).
- **Outputs:** *_z; blended rates
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per 60
- **Output scale:** z-scores
- **Status:** live — /api/v1/db/update-team-power-ratings (withCronJobAudit; pg_cron schedule not in repo)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/power-ratings.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/update-team-power-ratings.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** calculateRawScores; calculateFinalRating
- **Reference standard:** Z-score standardization; Bayesian shrinkage to league mean
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - league distribution uses only teams that played on targetDate (calculateEwma returns null otherwise), so the reference set is ~half the league and changes daily
  - z of the shrunk value is taken against the unshrunk distribution's SD
  - finishing/goalie/danger/special/discipline are not shrunk by gpWeight

### TEAM-033 Power ratings: offense / defense / pace ratings (100 + 15z)

### TEAM-041 SOS ratings (win% of opponents; combined sosScore)

- **Sub-family:** Team ratings / power / CTPI / SOS / SOS
- **Purpose:** Turns opponent totals into past/future/combined SOS.
- **Where:** `web/lib/trends/strengthOfSchedule.ts:53 (pct)`; `web/lib/trends/strengthOfSchedule.ts:62 (computeSosRatings)`; `web/lib/trends/strengthOfSchedule.ts:117 (buildCanonicalSosRankings)`; `web/pages/api/v1/trends/team-sos.ts:89-150`
- **Inputs:** latest sos_standings row per team
- **Source tables:** sos_standings
- **Method:** winPct = W/(W+L+OTL) (OTL counted as non-wins); combined = (pastPct*pastGames + futurePct*futureGames)/(pastGames+futureGames) where games are opponent game totals; sosScore = combined*100; canonical rankings use latest row with nonzero totals, sos rounded 3 dp, sorted desc.
- **Outputs:** past.winPct; future.winPct; combinedWinPct; sosScore
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** counts
- **Output scale:** fraction 0-1; sosScore 0-100
- **Status:** live — /api/v1/trends/team-sos
- **Tests:** `web/lib/trends/strengthOfSchedule.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/trends/team-sos.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** /api/v1/trends/team-sos; UnderlyingStats / trends pages
- **Reference standard:** RPI-style OWP/OOWP; points% SOS
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - no opponents-of-opponents term despite RPI reference
  - combined weights by opponents' games played, not by number of meetings
  - win% excludes OT losses entirely (comment strengthOfSchedule.ts:56-58) while NHL standings use points%

### TEAM-051 Team trend category percentiles (offense/defense/PP/PK by game number)

- **Sub-family:** Team ratings / power / CTPI / SOS / trends
- **Purpose:** Weighted percentile score per category for the team-power trends view.

- **Inputs:** per-game team snapshots (as/pp/pk/wgo)
- **Source tables:** nst_team_gamelogs_* (as, pp, pk), wgo_team_stats
- **Method:** For each game number gp (1..max), rank teams' gp-th game value per metric: percentile = idx/(n-1)*100 (inverted if lower is better); category = weighted mean of metric percentiles with weights 5/4/3/2/1 (e.g. offense GF 5, xGF 4, SF 3, CF 2, SCF 3, HDSF 2, HDGF 3, SH% 2, PP opp 1); rankings from latest point, delta = previous rank - rank.
- **Outputs:** series {gp, percentile}; rankings
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-game counts/percent
- **Output scale:** percentile 0-100
- **Status:** live — /api/v1/trends/team-power

- **Consumers:** /api/v1/trends/team-power
- **Reference standard:** Percentile ranks
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - compares teams' Nth games (different dates/opponents), single-game values, not cumulative or rate-adjusted
  - ties broken by sort order, not averaged ranks

### UST-009 views nst_percentile_{es,pk,pp}_{offense,defense}_filtered

- **Purpose:** Mid-rank percentiles of per-60 metrics within season among players with >= 25% of the player's GP
- **Where:** `supabase/migrations/20260716112908_production_schema_baseline.sql:18890 (nst_percentile_es_defense_filtered)`; `supabase/migrations/20260716112908_production_schema_baseline.sql:19009 (nst_percentile_es_offense_filtered)`; `supabase/migrations/20260716112908_production_schema_baseline.sql:19320 (pk_defense_filtered)`; `supabase/migrations/20260716112908_production_schema_baseline.sql:19447 (pk_offense_filtered)`; `supabase/migrations/20260716112908_production_schema_baseline.sql:19744 (pp_defense_filtered)`; `supabase/migrations/20260716112908_production_schema_baseline.sql:19871 (pp_offense_filtered)`
- **Inputs:** nst_percentile_* base views
- **Source tables:** nst_percentile_es_offense, nst_percentile_es_defense, ...
- **Method:** pct(metric) = (COUNT(b: b.metric <= a.metric) + 0.5*COUNT(b: b.metric = a.metric)) / COUNT(b non-null), pool b = same season with b.gp >= ceil(a.gp*0.25). Correlated subquery per metric. ga/sa percentiles hard-coded NULL::text in defense.
- **Outputs:** *_percentile
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-60
- **Output scale:** fraction 0-1 (can exceed 1)
- **Status:** legacy/dead — only referenced in web/e2e/fixtures/wigo/schema.json; client reads unfiltered base views
- **Tests:** none found
- **Consumers:** no reader except web/e2e/fixtures/wigo/schema.json
- **Reference standard:** percent_rank / cume_dist; mid-rank = (count(<) + 0.5*count(=))/N
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - ties double-counted - count(<=) already includes equals, so +0.5*count(=) gives 1.5x weight and percentiles can exceed 1
  - comparison pool depends on the subject's own GP (each player ranked against a different population)
  - defense metrics (CA/60 etc.) ranked ascending, so more shots against = higher percentile (no inversion)

### UST-017 Legacy NST three-year and career count averages (ThreeYearAverages)

- **Purpose:** Scrape a player's NST season-by-season individual and on-ice counts and return 3-year and career per-season averages plus derived shares.
- **Where:** `web/pages/api/ThreeYearAverages/[playerId].ts:227 (parseTime)`; `web/pages/api/ThreeYearAverages/[playerId].ts:331 (addTotalRows)`; `web/pages/api/ThreeYearAverages/[playerId].ts:654 (GetThreeYearStats)`; `web/pages/api/ThreeYearAverages/[playerId].ts:1368 (GetCareerStats)`
- **Inputs:** NST playerreport.php sit=all rate=n tables indreg and reg: Shots, Goals, assists, A1/A2, TOI, iCF/iFF/ixG/iSCF/iHDCF, CF/CA/FF/FA/SF/SA/GF/GA/xGF/xGA/SCF/SCA/HD/MD/LD, zone starts
- **Source tables:** Natural Stat Trick playerreport.php (scraped HTML, cached)
- **Method:** Per season: multi-team seasons summed into a TOT row (S% = G/SOG, secA% = A2/A, oZS% = oZS/(oZS+dZS), SOG/60 = SOG/TOI*60, IPP = (G+A)/oiGF, CF%/FF%/SF%/SCF%/xGF%/GF% = F/(F+A)). 3YA picks the 3 most recent seasons EXCLUDING the latest season (TOT row if traded), sums each count and divides by 3; throws if fewer than 3 prior seasons. Shares recomputed from 3-season totals. Career = same over all seasons except the latest, divided by number of seasons.
- **Outputs:** yearlyCounts; threeYearCountsAverages (toi, counts, CF%, FF%, SF%, GF%, xGF%, SCF%, IPP, S%, xS%, SOG/60, oZS%, oiSH%, secA%); careerAverageCounts
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** NST TOI decimal minutes converted to seconds by local parseTime; counts are season totals; percentages as fractions 0-1
- **Output scale:** per-season average counts; shares as fraction 0-1; SOG/60 mislabelled (per-minute)
- **Status:** legacy/dead — no callers found in components/hooks/pages; route ledger incoming_counts {}; wrapped by NST job lifecycle; only referenced by functions/tests/test_nst_legacy_lifecycle.py and lib/nst/callerLifecycle.test.ts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/nst/callerLifecycle.test.ts (lifecycle only, not math)`
- **Consumers:** none found in web/components, hooks or pages (route ledger shows 0 incoming calls)
- **Reference standard:** NST per-60 convention (count / TOI minutes * 60); IPP = points / on-ice GF
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - local parseTime converts NST decimal-minute TOI to SECONDS, then SOG/60 = SOG/TOI*60 yields shots per MINUTE, not per 60 (lib/NHL/TOI parseTime returns minutes, so the two files disagree)
  - data.IPP is written as goals + assists/oiGF (operator precedence) instead of (goals+assists)/oiGF; the correct rateAverages IPP is computed but not used in the returned object
  - addTotalRows adds count.SOG twice to the TOT row (lines ~411 and ~419)
  - rateAverages oiSH% and SOG/60 divide 3-season TOTAL numerators by 3-season AVERAGED denominators (SF and TOI already divided by 3), inflating by 3x
  - 'current season' is assumed to be the latest season in the NST table; in the offseason that excludes a completed season
  - mixes \|\| 1 and \|\| 0 guards, so zero denominators silently produce 0 rather than null

Shares (CF%, FF%, SF%, GF%, xGF%, SCF%) computed from SUMS of per-60 rates across seasons.

### UST-023 Goalie danger-split goals-against and xG-against accumulation

- **Sub-family:** Underlying stats summaries / goalie
- **Purpose:** Per-goalie HD/MD/LD goals against and xG against from shot features.
- **Where:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:3420 (accumulateGoalieShotFeatureBucketMetrics)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:3537 (goalie branch of accumulateLandingMetrics)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1876 (filterGoalieShotFeaturesForState)`
