- **Method:** For goal or shot-on-goal faced by the goalie (filtered by strength + score state): bucket as above; xG value high=0.25 if goal else 0.18, medium=0.08, low=0.02 (no rebound/rush bonuses); adds goals to hd/md/ldGoalsAgainst and xG to hd/md/ldXgAgainst. Separately adds parity md_goals_against/ld_goals_against, hd/md/ld shots and saves. xG proxy here INCLUDES only the danger bucket and the goal flag (0.25 if a high-danger goal); EXCLUDES rebound/rush/royal-road bonuses, shot type, strength, score, shooter/goalie effects, training data and calibration.
- **Outputs:** hdGoalsAgainst; mdGoalsAgainst; ldGoalsAgainst; hdXgAgainst; mdXgAgainst; ldXgAgainst
- **Tables written:** nhl_api_game_payloads_raw (derived://underlying-player-summary-v2/... partitions), goalie_underlying_summary_partitions (copied by goalieStatsSummaryRefresh.ts)
- **Input units:** shot counts; feet/degrees for buckets
- **Output scale:** goals (integers) and xG (goals) per danger bucket
- **Status:** live — read by pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players.ts and goalies.ts (+[playerId], chart) for /underlying-stats/playerStats and /goalieStats; summaries written by pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts, which runs from the lineCombinations insert trigger (supabase/migrations/20260716112910_harden_line_combination_trigger_auth.sql:130) and the pg_cron job 'update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday' at 09:35 UTC (tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382,827) (goalie mode)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.test.ts (danger goals appear only as zero/one-valued fixture fields at :662-1037)`
- **Consumers:** goalie landing/detail/chart
- **Reference standard:** NST goalie HDSV%/HDGA; GSAx by danger
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - mdGoalsAgainst and ldGoalsAgainst are added twice — once from parity counts (lines 3548, 3551) and again in accumulateGoalieShotFeatureBucketMetrics (lines 3459, 3461) — while hdGoalsAgainst is only added once; MD/LD GAA and GSAA are likely inflated/understated
  - danger-bucket xG (0.18/0.08/0.02, goal floor 0.25) differs from the parity xg_against model, so hdXg+mdXg+ldXg != xgAgainst
  - hdSavePct uses parity hd_saves/hd_shots_against while hdGoalsAgainst comes from the local heuristic — two sources for one split

### UST-036 NHL Edge metric ingestion and snapshot freshness gate

- **Sub-family:** Underlying stats summaries / NHL Edge
- **Purpose:** Map NHL Edge payloads (speeds, distances, zone time, shot location, goalie Edge stats) into daily metric rows and gate feature use on snapshot age.
- **Where:** `web/lib/NHL/edgeIngestion.ts:393 (edgeMeasure)`; `web/lib/NHL/edgeIngestion.ts:421 (edgeStatTriple)`; `web/lib/NHL/edgeIngestion.ts:744 (buildEdgeSkaterMetricRow)`; `web/lib/NHL/edgeIngestion.ts:816 (buildEdgeTeamMetricRow)`; `web/lib/NHL/edgeIngestion.ts:901 (buildEdgeGoalieMetricRow)`; `web/lib/NHL/edgeIngestion.ts:993 (buildEdgeSkaterSkatingDistanceGameRows)`; `web/lib/NHL/edgeFeatureContract.ts:245 (validateNhlEdgeSnapshotFreshness)`
- **Inputs:** Edge payload imperial/metric values, percentile, leagueAvg; zone Pctg/Percentile/LeagueAvg; shootingPctg by area; snapshotDate, asOfDate
- **Source tables:** NHL Edge API (api-web.nhle.com /edge/*), nhl_edge_stats raw rows
- **Method:** Pass-through mapping: values copied as given (mph & kph, miles & km, NHL-computed percentile and league average); integers truncated with Math.trunc; no in-house derivation. Freshness: ageDays = floor((asOf - snapshot)/86,400,000); fail if missing, snapshot after asOf, or ageDays > 14 (default maxAgeDays).
- **Outputs:** top_shot_speed_mph/kph/_percentile; max_skating_speed_*; bursts_over_20_*; total_distance_*; offensive/neutral/defensive_zone_pct/_percentile/_league_avg; edge_goals_against_avg_percentile, games_above_900_percentile, goal_differential_per_60_percentile, point_pct_percentile; freshness {passed, ageDays, blockingReasons}
- **Tables written:** nhl_edge_skater_metrics_daily, nhl_edge_team_metrics_daily, nhl_edge_goalie_metrics_daily, Edge detail / shot-location / skating-distance tables
- **Input units:** NHL Edge payload: speeds mph and kph, distances miles and km, NHL-published percentile (scale not declared), zone time pct as published, shooting pct by area as published; dates YYYY-MM-DD
- **Output scale:** pass-through values; freshness ageDays integer, passed boolean (max 14 days)
- **Status:** live — buildEdge*Row used by web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-edge-stats.ts and update-nhl-edge-teams.ts (route runner registry web/lib/routeRunner/registry.ts); freshness gate used by buildNhlEdgeFeatureJoinPlan
- **Tests:** `web/lib/NHL/edgeIngestion.test.ts`; `web/lib/NHL/edgeFeatureContract.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-edge-stats.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** analytics.vw_nhl_edge_latest_* views; Edge feature join plan (buildNhlEdgeFeatureJoinPlan)
- **Reference standard:** NHL Edge definitions (NHL.com); percentile scale as published by NHL Edge
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - NHL-provided percentile and zone-pct values are stored without unit normalization (0-1 vs 0-100 not declared)
  - 14-day staleness tolerance is a hard-coded default

### UST-041 Score-state classifier (score differential before event)

- **Sub-family:** Underlying stats summaries / player landing
- **Purpose:** Bucket events/shots/segments into tied, leading, trailing, withinOne, upOne, downOne.
- **Where:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1722 (getTeamScoreDiffBucket)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1738 (matchesPlayerStatsScoreState)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1835 (getTeamScoreDiffBeforeEvent)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamStatsSummaryRefresh.ts:349 (getTeamScoreDiffBucket, duplicate)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamStatsSummaryRefresh.ts:365 (matchesTeamScoreState)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamStatsSummaryRefresh.ts:525 (resolveTeamScoreDiffForShot)`

- **Outputs:** score-state bucket / match

- **Input units:** goals (integers)
- **Output scale:** bucket label / boolean
- **Status:** live — read by pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players.ts and goalies.ts (+[playerId], chart) for /underlying-stats/playerStats and /goalieStats; summaries written by pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts, which runs from the lineCombinations insert trigger (supabase/migrations/20260716112910_harden_line_combination_trigger_auth.sql:130) and the pg_cron job 'update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday' at 09:35 UTC (tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382,827); live — team_underlying_stats_summary written by pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts:242 and sweep-gamecenter-normalization.ts:352 (plus manual catch-up/backfill/rebuild routes); read by pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/teams.ts for /underlying-stats/teamStats
- **Tests:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.test.ts:809 (legacy rows default to allScores)`
- **Consumers:** summary partition builder; team summary refresh
- **Reference standard:** NST score-state filters (Leading/Trailing/Tied/Within 1)

  - 'leading'/'trailing' here mean lead/deficit of 2+ only (upOne/downOne excluded), unlike NST where Leading includes up-1; users may compare against NST 'Leading' and see mismatches

- **Where:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:2449 (buildIndividualContextsForGame)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:2859 (buildOnIceContextsForGame)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:2929 (buildGoalieContextsForGame)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:2997 (buildPlayerStatsLandingContexts)`

### UST-046 PBP-only individual counts fallback (games without shift data)

- **Sub-family:** Underlying stats summaries / player landing
- **Purpose:** Produce individual counting stats when shift rows are missing but roster spots exist.
- **Where:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:2515 (buildPbpOnlyIndividualContextsForGame)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:3045 (fallback selection in buildPlayerStatsLandingContexts)`

TOI=0, hasReliableToi=false, ipp=null, gp=1. Only used for individual COUNTS when shiftRows.length==0 and rosterSpots>0.
- **Outputs:** SkaterCountsRow-like counts per player-game
- **Tables written:** nhl_api_game_payloads_raw (derived://underlying-player-summary-v2/... partitions), goalie_underlying_summary_partitions (copied by goalieStatsSummaryRefresh.ts)
- **Input units:** event ids; penalty_duration_minutes (minutes); shot features
- **Output scale:** integer counts per player-game; ixG in goals; TOI=0 (unknown)
- **Status:** live — read by pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players.ts and goalies.ts (+[playerId], chart) for /underlying-stats/playerStats and /goalieStats; summaries written by pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts, which runs from the lineCombinations insert trigger (supabase/migrations/20260716112910_harden_line_combination_trigger_auth.sql:130) and the pg_cron job 'update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday' at 09:35 UTC (tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382,827) (fallback path only)

- **Reference standard:** NST individual counts definitions
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - score-state filter is applied to event-based counts but NOT to shot-derived counts (shots, iCF, iFF, ixG, iSCF, iHDCF) in the shot loop

### UST-049 Ratio-of-sums aggregation across games (nullable-sum semantics)

- **Sub-family:** Underlying stats summaries / player landing
- **Purpose:** Sum per-game counts into window totals before computing rates/percentages.
- **Where:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:3467 (accumulateLandingMetrics)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:3693 (mergeLandingAggregateMetrics)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:2092 (addNullable)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:4441 (buildPlayerStatsLandingAggregationFromSummaryRows)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:5242 (buildPlayerStatsLandingAggregation)`
- **Inputs:** per-game summary metrics
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_game_payloads_raw derived summary partitions
- **Method:** Integer counts summed; nullable metrics (ixg, iScf, iHdcf, xgf, xga, scf, hdcf, md*, xgAgainst...) summed with addNullable (null deltas skipped, total stays null only if every game is null). TOI summed only when every game has reliable TOI (else toiSeconds=null). Goalie avg shot/goal distance = sum(avg_distance*count)/sum(count) (count-weighted). Rates/percentages are then computed from the totals (ratio of sums).
- **Outputs:** aggregate metrics per player or player-team
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** counts (integers), xG (goals), TOI seconds
- **Output scale:** window totals (ratio-of-sums inputs)
- **Status:** live — read by pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players.ts and goalies.ts (+[playerId], chart) for /underlying-stats/playerStats and /goalieStats; summaries written by pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts, which runs from the lineCombinations insert trigger (supabase/migrations/20260716112910_harden_line_combination_trigger_auth.sql:130) and the pg_cron job 'update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday' at 09:35 UTC (tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382,827)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.test.ts:1583 (buildPlayerStatsLandingAggregationFromSummaryRows)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.test.ts:2009 (null rates when denominator zero)`
- **Consumers:** pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players.ts; pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players/[playerId].ts; pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players/[playerId]/chart.ts; pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/goalies.ts; pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/goalies/[playerId].ts; pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts
- **Reference standard:** Ratio-of-sums convention (NST season totals)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - addNullable silently treats missing per-game xG/SCF as 0 when at least one game has a value, so window xG totals can undercount without any flag
  - a single PBP-only fallback game (hasReliableToi=false) nulls TOI and every per-60 for the whole window
  - goal-distance weighting uses goals_against (includes own goals) while the parity average excludes own goals

### UST-056 PBP game-clock reconstruction (period duration, game seconds elapsed, seconds since previous event)

- **Sub-family:** Underlying stats summaries / player landing
- **Purpose:** Derive absolute game time per stored PBP event before running shot features / NST parity.
- **Where:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:895 (resolvePeriodDurationSeconds)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:921 (resolveGameSecondsElapsed)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1006 (buildStoredPbpEventSequence)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamStatsSummaryRefresh.ts:243 (resolvePeriodDurationSeconds, copy)`
- **Inputs:** period_number; period_seconds_elapsed; time_remaining_seconds; period_type; sort_order; event_id
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** Period duration = elapsed + remaining if both known, else SO=0, OT=300 s, otherwise 1200 s. gameSecondsElapsed = (period_number-1) * base + elapsed where base = 1200 when period<=3 OR duration unknown, else base = that period's own duration. secondsSincePrevious = elapsed(this) - elapsed(previous). Also tags own goals from landing payload summary.scoring goalModifier.
- **Outputs:** period_duration_seconds; game_seconds_elapsed; seconds_since_previous_event; event_index; previous/next event ids; raw_event own-goal tag
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** seconds (period_seconds_elapsed, time_remaining_seconds); period_number integer
- **Output scale:** seconds of game time
- **Status:** live — read by pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players.ts and goalies.ts (+[playerId], chart) for /underlying-stats/playerStats and /goalieStats; summaries written by pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts, which runs from the lineCombinations insert trigger (supabase/migrations/20260716112910_harden_line_combination_trigger_auth.sql:130) and the pg_cron job 'update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday' at 09:35 UTC (tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382,827)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.test.ts:388 (buildStoredPbpEventSequence)`
- **Consumers:** buildShotFeatureRows (rebound/rush timing); buildNstParityMetrics
- **Reference standard:** NHL API period clock (20-min regulation, 5-min regular-season OT, 20-min playoff OT)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - for a regular-season OT event (period 4, duration 300) gameSecondsElapsed = 3*300 + elapsed (= 900+x) instead of 3600+x, so seconds_since_previous_event across the regulation->OT boundary is negative; any rebound/rush logic using it may misfire in OT
  - playoff 2nd+ OT uses own-period duration for all completed periods (fine only because playoff OT is also 1200 s)

### UST-058 Power rankings STD/L10 aggregation

- **Sub-family:** Underlying stats summaries / power rankings
- **Purpose:** Aggregate WGO daily team rows into season-to-date and last-10 power-ranking stats.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchPowerRankings.js:74 (calculateAggregatedStats)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchPowerRankings.js:574 (fetchTeamSummaries)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchPowerRankings.js:784 (average)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchPowerRankings.js:1050 (calculateAndUpsertPowerRankings)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchPowerRankings.js:1097 (l_ten_goals_for_pct)`
- **Inputs:** wgo_team_stats per date: pim, point_pct, hits, blocked_shots, pp_opportunities, goals_for, goals_against, shots_for_per_game, power_play_pct, penalty_kill_pct
- **Source tables:** wgo_team_stats, games
- **Method:** fetchTeamSummaries: STD = all season rows up to date, L10 = last 10 rows; counts summed, point_pct/shots/PP%/PK% mean-of-rows; goals_for_pct = GF/GA (0 if GA=0). calculateAndUpsertPowerRankings: L10 every column = mean of last 10 rows (incl. pim/hits counts) and l_ten_goals_for_pct = avgGF / (avgGA or 1).
- **Outputs:** std_* and l_ten_* (pim, pts_pct, hits, blocks, ppo, gf, ga, goals_for_pct, shots_for, pp_pct, pk_pct)
- **Tables written:** power_rankings_store
- **Input units:** wgo_team_stats daily single-game rows (NHL REST pct as 0-1 fractions, shots per game, counts)
- **Output scale:** means of per-game pct (0-1) and sums/means of counts; goals_for_pct = GF/GA ratio
- **Status:** legacy/dead — pages/api/v1/db/update-power-rankings.ts returns 410 'Legacy power-rankings loader has been disabled'; pg_cron update-power-rankings active=false (cron-schedule.md:723); no in-repo reader of power_rankings_store
- **Tests:** `web/lib/NHL/seasonAwareWriterTeams.test.js (team map only)`
- **Consumers:** pages/api/v1/db/update-power-rankings.ts (no in-repo reader of power_rankings_store found)
- **Reference standard:** GF% = GF/(GF+GA); PP% = PPG/PPO ratio-of-sums
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 'goals_for_pct' is GF/GA ratio, not GF/(GF+GA); a 0 GA game gives 0 in one path and divides by 1 in the other
  - l_ten_pim/hits/blocks are sums in fetchTeamSummaries but per-game averages in calculateAndUpsertPowerRankings - same column, two meanings
  - fetchTeamSummaries upsert omits 'date' (commented out) but onConflict uses team_id,season_id,date
  - PP%/PK% averaged across games (mean of ratios)

### UST-063 Strength of schedule (direct + indirect opponent point %)

- **Sub-family:** Underlying stats summaries / schedule strength
- **Purpose:** Past and future schedule strength per team for the ratings landing.
- **Where:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamScheduleStrength.ts:136 (computePointPctFromRecord)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamScheduleStrength.ts:195 (computeScheduleBucket)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamScheduleStrength.ts:174 (buildRankMap)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamScheduleStrength.ts:241 (computeUnderlyingStatsTeamScheduleStrength)`; `web/lib/trends/strengthOfScheduleContract.ts:21 (recordPercentage)`
- **Inputs:** sos_standings past/future opponent total W/L/OTL; past_opponents/future_opponents lists
- **Source tables:** sos_standings
- **Method:** Direct = opponents' combined point% = (2W + OTL)/(2*(W+L+OTL)). Indirect = games-weighted mean of each opponent's own direct value for the same bucket (opponents' opponents). Bucket SOS = (2*direct + indirect)/3 (falls back to whichever exists). Overall sos = mean(past, future). Rank 1 = highest SOS (hardest), ordinal, null-last.
- **Outputs:** sos; past.sos/rank; future.sos/rank; directOpponentPointPct; indirectOpponentPointPct; uniqueOpponents
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** opponent W/L/OTL (integers)
- **Output scale:** point% fraction 0-1; SOS fraction 0-1; rank 1..N (1 = hardest)
- **Status:** live — pages/api/underlying-stats/landing.ts and team-ratings.ts feed pages/underlying-stats/index.tsx
- **Tests:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamScheduleStrength.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** teamLandingRatings.ts; teamRatingNarrative.ts context bullet; pages/api/underlying-stats/team-ratings.ts; pages/underlying-stats/index.tsx
- **Reference standard:** RPI-style SOS (2/3 OWP + 1/3 OOWP); NHL point %
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - for the future bucket, 'indirect' uses each opponent's FUTURE opponents' record, not their record to date
  - opponents' records include games against the team itself (no head-to-head exclusion as in RPI)
  - overall SOS averages past and future equally regardless of games remaining
  - PRD (tasks/TASKS/three-pillars-analytics/underlying-stats/prd/prd-underlying-stats-landing-page-sos.md:64-80) requires SoS = 50% record-based + 50% predictive/context component; code is record-only ((2*direct + indirect)/3) with past/future averaged — no predictive half

- **Purpose:** Assign an expected-goal value to each unblocked/blocked attempt for team and fallback individual xG.
- **Where:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.ts:2344 (getPbpOnlyApproximateXgValue)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamStatsSummaryRefresh.ts:481 (getApproximateXgValue)`
- **Inputs:** dangerBucket; isReboundShot; isRushShot; crossedRoyalRoad; isGoal
- **Source tables:** derived shot features
- **Method:** Hand-set lookup, not a trained model. Per shot: base 0.18 high / 0.08 medium / 0.02 low danger; +0.03 rebound, +0.02 rush, +0.02 royal-road crossing; if goal, value=max(value,0.25); cap 0.95; null if distance/angle missing. INCLUDES: x,y normalized to the attacking direction by mirroring (x,y)->(-x,-y) when the shooting team attacks the left side, from home_team_defending_side (web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.ts:51); net fixed at (89,0); distance = Euclidean feet to (89,0) (nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:182); angle = atan2(\|dy\|,\|dx\|) degrees (nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:192), used only through the danger buckets (<=20 ft & <=35 deg high; <=40 ft & <=50 deg medium; else low); rebound flag (DEFAULT_REBOUND_WINDOW_SECONDS=3, web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.ts:6); rush flag (DEFAULT_RUSH_WINDOW_SECONDS=10, web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:5); royal-road crossing (prior and current event y of opposite sign, both x>=25, nhlContextualFeatures.ts:277); goal outcome (as a floor). EXCLUDES: shot type, distance/angle as continuous terms (bucketed only), strength state, score state/score effects, shooter talent, goalie effects, venue/rink scorer bias adjustment, time/period, empty-net handling, training set or seasons (none — constants are hand-set), model type (none; lookup table, not logistic/GBM), calibration to league goal rate (none). Blocked attempts are not excluded in team summaries (attempt type not checked before assigning xG). A copy of the same proxy is in nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:~410 (other slice).
- **Outputs:** xgValue per shot; team xgf/xga; individual ixg (fallback)
- **Tables written:** team_underlying_stats_summary.xgf/xga
- **Input units:** bucket label; booleans (rebound/rush/royal road); isGoal
- **Output scale:** expected goals per shot, 0.02-0.95 (sum = goals)
- **Status:** live — team_underlying_stats_summary written by pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts:242 and sweep-gamecenter-normalization.ts:352 (plus manual catch-up/backfill/rebuild routes); read by pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/teams.ts for /underlying-stats/teamStats; live — read by pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players.ts and goalies.ts (+[playerId], chart) for /underlying-stats/playerStats and /goalieStats; summaries written by pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts, which runs from the lineCombinations insert trigger (supabase/migrations/20260716112910_harden_line_combination_trigger_auth.sql:130) and the pg_cron job 'update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday' at 09:35 UTC (tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382,827) (fallback ixG)
- **Tests:** none found
- **Consumers:** team landing xGF%, xGF/60; PBP-only ixG
- **Reference standard:** MoneyPuck / Evolving-Hockey / NST logistic xG models (outcome-blind, calibrated to league goal rate)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - outcome leakage — goals get a floor of 0.25, so xG is not independent of the result and xGF/xGA/GSAx are biased toward actual goals
  - blocked shots receive xG in team summaries (attempt type not checked), unlike NST/MoneyPuck which exclude blocked attempts from xG
  - uncalibrated magic constants; team xG differs from the trained xG model used elsewhere (nhl_xg_* tables, xG explorer)
  - angle uses \|dx\|, so shots from behind the goal line (x>89) get the same small angle as shots from in front and can land in the high-danger bucket

### UST-069 Skater week rating z-score (Elite..Really Bad) and value overview

- **Sub-family:** Underlying stats summaries / skater variance
- **Purpose:** Classify each player-week against same-bucket peers and summarise consistency
- **Where:** `web/components/SkaterPage/skaterCalculations.ts:390 (buildSkaterBucketWeeklyAverages)`; `web/components/SkaterPage/skaterCalculations.ts:426 (classifySkaterWeek)`; `web/components/SkaterPage/skaterCalculations.ts:480 (buildSkaterValueOverviewRowsFromAggregates)`; `web/components/SkaterPage/skaterCalculations.ts:76 (calculateStandardDeviation)`
- **Inputs:** weekly aggregates
- **Source tables:** wgo_skater_stats, Yahoo tables above
- **Method:** Bucket-week mean FP, mean FP/G, sample SD (n-1). z = (FP - mean)/SD; >=1.5 Elite, >=0.5 Quality, >-0.5 Average, >-1.5 Bad, else Really Bad; buckets with <3 players or SD 0 -> Average. percentOkWeeks = (Elite+Quality+Average)/weeks*100; percentGoodWeeks = (Elite+Quality)/weeks*100; weeklyVariance = SD of weekly FP; gameToGameVariance = SD of game FP; FP above average = mean(player - bucket avg) by week or game basis.
- **Outputs:** weekCounts; percentOkWeeks; percentGoodWeeks; weeklyVariance; gameToGameVariance; averageFantasyPointsPerGame; averageFantasyPointsPerWeek; fantasyPointsAboveAverage
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** weekly fantasy points
- **Output scale:** z-score bands; percents 0-100; SDs in fantasy points
- **Status:** live — pages/variance/skaters.tsx
- **Tests:** `web/components/SkaterPage/skaterCalculations.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** SkaterLeaderboard; SkaterTable; pages/variance/skaters.tsx
- **Reference standard:** z-score banding
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - fields named 'Variance' hold standard deviations
  - bucket mean/SD include the player being classified
  - weeks the player did not play are absent rather than zero, so % good weeks ignores missed weeks

### UST-073 Power rankings strength of schedule and opponent records

- **Sub-family:** Underlying stats summaries / SoS

- **Inputs:** games schedule; power_rankings_store.l_ten_pts_pct; standings; gameOutcomes
- **Source tables:** games, power_rankings_store, standings, gameOutcomes
- **Method:** Split schedule at current date into past/future opponent id lists; SoS = mean of l_ten_pts_pct over all store rows for those opponents (past: date <= current; future: date >= current), toFixed(3) string. Season record = sums of wins/losses/OTL over all standings rows for the season. Opponent aggregate = count of WIN/LOSS/other outcomes in gameOutcomes for opponent team ids, split by now().
- **Outputs:** sos_past; sos_future; season_avg_pts_pct; season_avg_record; opponent_past_aggregate_record; opponent_future_aggregate_record
- **Tables written:** power_rankings_store
- **Input units:** l_ten_pts_pct (0-1 fraction); standings cumulative counts
- **Output scale:** SoS string toFixed(3) in 0-1; W-L-T strings
- **Status:** legacy/dead — 410 stub pages/api/v1/db/update-power-rankings.ts
- **Tests:** none found
- **Consumers:** update-power-rankings route
- **Reference standard:** Opponent points % SoS weighted by games played against each opponent
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - standings are daily cumulative snapshots, so summing wins over all rows massively inflates season_avg_record
  - .in(team_id, opponents) dedupes opponents and averages over all their historical rows, so SoS is not weighted by games faced; future SoS reads rows dated >= today which usually do not exist -> 0
  - opponent aggregate uses new Date() instead of the row date and gameOutcomes with no season filter; OTL counted as 'ties'
  - standings delta stores goal_differential hard-coded 0 and reads 'regulatioinPlusOtWinPctg' (typo, likely always 0) at fetchPowerRankings.js:205/246

- **Sub-family:** Underlying stats summaries / team ratings

### UST-086 WGO team game aggregation (PP%, PK%, shots/game, FO%)

- **Where:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamStatsSummaryRefresh.ts:781 (resolveGameOutcomeFromEvents)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamStatsSummaryRefresh.ts:874 (resolveGameOutcomeFromOfficialPayload)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamStatsSummaryRefresh.ts:909 (resolveGameOutcome)`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamStatsSummaryRefresh.ts:931 (buildStandingsOutcome)`
- **Inputs:** official landing payload homeTeam/awayTeam score, periodDescriptor; PBP max scores and period types
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_game_payloads_raw (official landing), nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** Prefer official payload: winner by score, outcome type from periodDescriptor/scoring/gameOutcome (REG/OT/SO). Fallback from events: max home/away score seen; OT/SO detected from period types. Winner: W=1, points=2, ROW=1 unless shootout. Loser: OT or SO -> OTL=1, points=1; else L=1. Tie/unresolved -> all zeros.
- **Outputs:** wins; losses; otl; row_wins; points
- **Tables written:** team_underlying_stats_summary
- **Input units:** scores (integers); period type strings
- **Output scale:** W/L/OTL/ROW 0/1; points 0/1/2
- **Status:** live — team_underlying_stats_summary written by pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts:242 and sweep-gamecenter-normalization.ts:352 (plus manual catch-up/backfill/rebuild routes); read by pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/teams.ts for /underlying-stats/teamStats
- **Tests:** `web/lib/underlying-stats/teamStatsSummaryRefresh.test.ts:96 (official payload shootout/OT/tied cases)`
- **Consumers:** pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/teams.ts; components/underlying-stats/TeamStatsFilters.tsx + teamStatsColumns.ts table
- **Reference standard:** NHL standings (2 pts W, 1 pt OTL/SOL; ROW = regulation + OT wins)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - event fallback cannot resolve shootout winners (scores tied in PBP) -> both teams get 0 W/L/pts for that game
  - playoff OT losses are recorded as OTL with 1 point (no playoff special-case)
  - identical standings are repeated on all 70 split rows per team-game, so split-filtered tables show W/L/points for games where the team merely had split time

### UST-093 Legacy NHL statsapi TOI parsing, TOI% and PP-time share

- **Sub-family:** Underlying stats summaries / TOI
- **Purpose:** Parse mm:ss TOI to minutes and (legacy) chart a player's per-game TOI% and share of team PP time.
- **Where:** `web/lib/NHL/TOI.ts:82 (parseTime)`; `web/lib/NHL/TOI.ts:31 (fetchTotalPowerPlayTime)`; `web/lib/NHL/TOI.ts:71 (team PP TOI = sum/5)`; `web/lib/NHL/TOI.ts:93 (fetchTOIData)`; `web/pages/api/SustainabilityStats/[playerId].ts:141 (parseTime*60 consumer)`; `web/pages/api/CareerAverages/[playerId].ts:165 (consumer)`; `web/pages/api/Teams/[teamAbbreviation].ts:153 (consumer)`
- **Inputs:** timeOnIce 'mm:ss'; powerPlayTimeOnIce 'mm:ss'; team roster game logs
- **Source tables:** statsapi.web.nhl.com /people/{id}/stats?stats=gameLog, statsapi.web.nhl.com /teams/{id}/roster
- **Method:** parseTime: if string contains '.', return Number(string) unchanged; else minutes = mm + ss/60. TOI% per game = TOI minutes*100/60. Team PP time per date = (sum of every current-roster player's PPTOI minutes on that date)/5; player PP share = player PPTOI / team PP time * 100. Callers convert parseTime output to seconds with *60.
- **Outputs:** TOI[] (% of 60 min); PPTOI[] (% of team PP time); minutes (parseTime)
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** 'mm:ss' strings -> MINUTES (parseTime); strings containing '.' passed through unchanged (assumed minutes); callers multiply by 60 to get SECONDS
- **Output scale:** parseTime: decimal minutes; fetchTOIData TOI: percent of 60 minutes (0-100+, OT can exceed 100); PPTOI: percent 0-100 of estimated team PP time
- **Status:** live — parseTime live — imported by pages/api/SustainabilityStats/[playerId].ts:8, pages/api/CareerAverages/[playerId].ts:6, pages/api/Teams/[teamAbbreviation].ts:17; fetchTOIData legacy/dead — no importer found and targets decommissioned statsapi.web.nhl.com
- **Tests:** none found
- **Consumers:** parseTime: SustainabilityStats, CareerAverages, Teams/[teamAbbreviation] API routes; fetchTOIData default export: no importer found
- **Reference standard:** NHL.com TOI mm:ss; NST TOI convention (seconds or minutes) and PP share = player PP TOI / team PP TOI
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - fetchTOIData targets the decommissioned statsapi.web.nhl.com API and has no importer - dead code
  - TOI% divides by a fixed 60 minutes (OT games can exceed 100%)
  - team PP time estimated as sum of current-roster players' PPTOI / 5, which ignores traded/departed players and 5v3/4-skater units
  - parseTime returns minutes for 'mm:ss' but passes through any string containing '.' unchanged, so a decimal seconds string would be misread as minutes; no-colon strings give NaN
  - pages/api/toi.ts:163 defines a separate duplicate parseTime - divergent TOI parsers

## Rolling player averages & trends (ROLL, 45)

### ROLL-001 Social share Hot/Cold Recent Form (recent-form-v1-early)

- **Purpose:** Rank skaters whose points per game over their last 5 appearances rose or fell most versus the 5 appearances before.
- **Where:** `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:185 (trendShortlists form)`; `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:118 (activeSkaters)`; `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:64-72 (TREND_WINDOW_GAMES, RECENT_FORM_GAMES, MIN_TREND_SEASON_GAMES, TREND_MAX_GAME_AGE_DAYS)`; `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:175 (hotOrder)`
- **Inputs:** season_games_played; points_total_last5; points_total_last10; points_avg_season; game_date; updated_at; strength_state=all
- **Source tables:** rolling_player_game_metrics
- **Method:** Active skater = strength 'all' row from this season with latest game within 7 days of the New York edition date and a known team; whole layer stale if newest row update > 72 h (PLAYER_STATS_MAX_AGE_MS). Qualifier: GP >= 10 and season points proven whole (\|points_avg_season*GP - round\| <= 0.01 and last10 <= season points). recent = last5/5, preceding = (last10-last5)/5 (both rounded 2 dp), delta = recent - preceding. Hot = delta>0 sorted delta desc, then recent desc, then id; Cold = delta<0 mirror. List 5 (+5 slack before name filter).
- **Outputs:** recent; preceding; delta; qualifiers
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** points counts; windows in appearances
- **Output scale:** points per game (2 dp) and delta in P/GP
- **Status:** live — built into every social-share edition by lib/socialShare/server.ts via buildTrendLayer
- **Tests:** `web/lib/socialShare/trends.test.ts`; `web/lib/socialShare/trendSources.test.ts`; `web/components/SocialShare/SocialShare.test.tsx`; `web/e2e/social-share.spec.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/lib/socialShare/server.ts (Tuesday trend layer of the social-share edition); web/components/SocialShare/SocialShare.tsx (Hot/Cold, Deployment, Rate, Movers cards)
- **Reference standard:** Simple recent-vs-prior form split; compare with hot/cold streak rules (MISC-033) and trends hot/cold (ROLL-028)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 5-game windows of points are very noisy; no regression to the mean or TOI normalisation
  - third distinct hot/cold definition in the repo (MISC-033 streakOf, ROLL-028 streakIntensity, this) with different windows
  - the 'season points proven whole' check uses a rounded avg*GP heuristic (0.01 tolerance) to infer no missing games

### ROLL-003 Social share per-game series reconstruction from cumulative and window sums (sparklines)

- **Purpose:** Solve each of a skater's last 10 per-game values exactly from stored season-to-date totals and last-N window totals, then check them against the row's own L5.
- **Where:** `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:301 (gameSeries)`; `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:407 (pointsSeries)`; `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:415 (toiSeries)`; `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:424 (rateSeries)`; `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:77-78 (SERIES_GAMES=10, SERIES_LOOKBACK_DAYS=35)`
- **Inputs:** points_avg_season; toi_seconds_avg_season; season_games_played; points_total_last5; points_total_last10; toi_seconds_total_last5; sog_per_60_shots_season; sog_per_60_toi_seconds_season; shot_attempts_per_60_*_season; ixg_per_60_*_season
- **Source tables:** rolling_player_game_metrics
- **Method:** Ranges: season totals (games 1..n, total = avg_season*GP; points must round to an integer within 0.01) plus writer windows (n-N+1..n). Nested ranges sharing a start or end are subtracted into new ranges (<= 12 rounds, <= 400 ranges); a range with one unknown game solves it; points ranges with total 0 set all games 0. Points series rejected unless sums of last 5/10 equal stored totals; TOI series rejected if \|mean of last 5 - toi_avg_last5\| > 2 s; rate series per game = count/TOI*3600 and rejected if pooled L5 rate differs from stored L5 by > max(2% of L5, 0.05).
- **Outputs:** series (10 per-game values or null)
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** seconds TOI; counts; per-60 parts
- **Output scale:** per-game values (points, TOI seconds, per-60)
- **Status:** live — sparklines on trend cards
- **Tests:** `web/lib/socialShare/trends.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/lib/socialShare/server.ts (Tuesday trend layer of the social-share edition); web/components/SocialShare/SocialShare.tsx (Hot/Cold, Deployment, Rate, Movers cards)
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - per-game values are back-solved from averages*GP, so float error in stored averages propagates (TOI rounded to whole seconds)
  - per-game per-60 sparklines from single games are extremely noisy

### ROLL-004 Additive metric rolling sums/means and historical per-game averages

- **Purpose:** Rolling totals and per-game averages for count metrics (goals, assists, shots, hits, blocks, points, pp_points, ixg, iscf, ihdcf, penalties, on-ice counts, zone starts, TOI).
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:2618 (updateAccumulator)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:2900 (deriveOutputs simple branch)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingHistoricalAverages.ts:85 (updateHistoricalAverageAccumulator)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingHistoricalAverages.ts:104 (getHistoricalAverageSnapshot)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1972 (getHistoricalSimpleTotalSnapshot)`
- **Inputs:** per-game metric value (null skipped); season
- **Source tables:** nst_gamelog_{as,es,5v5,pp,pk}_counts, nst_gamelog_*_counts_oi, wgo_skater_stats
- **Method:** Each non-null value pushes into windows 3/5/10/20 (FIFO). _total_lastN = window sum; _avg_lastN = sum / count of defined values; _total_all / _avg_all over every value read; _avg_season / _avg_3ya / _avg_career = mean per game over season buckets (3YA = current and 2 prior seasons). Metrics: primary_assists, secondary_assists, ixg, penalties_drawn, penalties_taken, iscf, ihdcf, oz_starts, dz_starts, nz_starts, oi_gf, oi_ga, oi_xgf, oi_xga, oi_sf, oi_sa, toi_seconds, pp_toi_seconds, cf, ca, ff, fa, goals, assists, shots, hits, blocks, pp_points, points. Support accumulators: oz_start_neutral_zone_starts, primary/secondary assists raw, shot attempts (icf).
- **Outputs:** <metric>_total_lastN; <metric>_avg_lastN; <metric>_total_all; <metric>_avg_all; <metric>_avg_season; <metric>_avg_3ya; <metric>_avg_career
- **Tables written:** rolling_player_game_metrics (non-pruned columns e.g. *_avg_last5 kept only if in ROLLING_RANKING_SELECT_FIELDS), rolling_player_metric_support_payloads.support_payload.historicalCompatibility (pruned _all/_last3/_3ya/_career/_avg_ columns)
- **Input units:** per-game counts; toi_seconds and pp_toi_seconds in seconds; ixg in expected goals
- **Output scale:** _total_* = sums (counts or seconds); _avg_* = per-game mean (counts/game or seconds/game); not per-60
- **Status:** live — written by /api/v1/db/update-rolling-player-averages, invoked by /api/v1/db/run-rolling-forge-pipeline (web/vercel.json cron '5,10,15,20,30,35,40,45,55 10 * * *' UTC, mode=daily_incremental; lib/rollingForgePipeline.ts:102)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingHistoricalAverages.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricWindowContractCases.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** lib/rankings/* (skaterWindowAggregation, trending, metricDefinitions); lib/projections/queries/skater-queries.ts (FORGE); pages/trends/player/[playerId].tsx; lib/socialShare/*; lib/dashboard/commandCenterData.ts
- **Reference standard:** Simple per-game mean over last N games played
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - for split strengths (ev/pp/pk/5v5) a game with an NST row of zeros, or a WGO PP-goals fallback of 0, enters additive windows even when the player had 0 TOI in that state, while ratio windows skip it

  - 'career' only spans wgo_skater_stats coverage for the player, not a true career

### ROLL-005 Player trend rolling averages, running mean and variance

- **Purpose:** Per player per metric per game: raw value, cumulative mean, L3/L5/L10 rolling mean, sample variance and SD
- **Where:** `web/lib/trends/playerTrendCalculator.ts:160 (processMetric)`; `web/lib/trends/playerTrendCalculator.ts:132 (computeRollingAverage)`; `web/lib/trends/playerTrendCalculator.ts:141 (computeSampleVariance)`; `web/lib/trends/playerTrendCalculator.ts:652 (buildPlayerTrendRecords)`
- **Inputs:** per-game player rows sorted by player and date; metric accessor values
- **Source tables:** player_stats_unified, goalie_stats_unified, wgo_skater_stats_playoffs
- **Method:** Accumulator per player+metric across ALL supplied history (no season reset; version 'full-history'). Null values skipped (not zero). average = sum/count; rolling_avg_k = simple mean of last k non-null values, null until k values; variance = (sumSq - sum^2/n)/(n-1), clamped >=0, null if n<2; SD = sqrt. Records emitted only from emitFromDate (7-day repair window).
- **Outputs:** player_trend_metrics.raw_value, average_value, rolling_avg_3, rolling_avg_5, rolling_avg_10, variance_value, std_dev_value, sample_size
- **Tables written:** player_trend_metrics
- **Input units:** per-game metric values in source units (see skater/goalie definitions); one row per player-date
- **Output scale:** same units as input; rolling L3/L5/L10 simple means of non-null values; sample variance/SD; sample_size count
- **Status:** live — cron job update-player-trend-metrics (web/lib/cron/cronInventory.ts:54; tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:752 '0 12 * * *' POST /api/v1/db/update-player-trend-metrics -> rebuildPlayerTrends in pages/api/v1/trends/player-trends.ts); read by pages/api/v1/trends/skater-power.ts:571 and goalie-power.ts:436
- **Tests:** `web/lib/trends/playerTrendCalculator.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/trends/player-trends.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** pages/api/v1/trends/player-trends.ts; skater-power and goalie-power trends APIs; trends pages; scripts/audit-player-trend-*
- **Reference standard:** Simple moving average over last N games; ratio-of-sums vs mean-of-ratios convention
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - rolling and season averages of rate/percent metrics (SH%, PDO, CF%, per-60s, save%, GAA) are means of per-game ratios, not ratio-of-sums (unweighted by shots/TOI)
  - cumulative average and variance span seasons and regular+playoff rows (no season reset)
  - rolling windows count only non-null games, so L10 can span more than 10 games when a metric is missing
  - running sumSquares variance formula is numerically unstable for large totals (mitigated by clamp)

### ROLL-007 Skater trend percentile series with low-sample shrink

- **Purpose:** Rank skaters per trend category by percentile of their windowed value at each game number and compute rank movement.
- **Where:** `web/pages/api/v1/trends/skater-power.ts:278 (computeTrailingAverage)`; `web/pages/api/v1/trends/skater-power.ts:295 (computePercentiles)`; `web/pages/api/v1/trends/skater-power.ts:317 (stabilizePercentileForSample)`; `web/pages/api/v1/trends/skater-power.ts:336 (buildCategoryResult)`
- **Inputs:** player_trend_metrics.raw_value, rolling_avg_3, rolling_avg_5, rolling_avg_10, game_date per metric; window 1/3/5/10/20; positionGroup; category higherIsBetter (lib/trends/skaterMetricConfig)
- **Source tables:** player_trend_metrics, players
- **Method:** Value per player game index gp: stored rolling avg (3/5/10) else trailing mean of last N raw values; window 20 always trailing mean; window 1 raw. At each gp, players are sorted and percentile = idx/(n-1)*100 (inverted if lower is better; single player = 50). If gp < MIN_TREND_SAMPLE_GAMES=10, percentile shrunk toward 50: 50 + (raw-50)*gp/10. Rank by latest percentile; delta = previous qualified rank - current rank; low-sample rows get delta 0.
- **Outputs:** series[playerId] {gp, percentile, rawPercentile, sampleConfidence}; rankings {percentile, rank, previousRank, delta, latestValue}
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-game metric values as stored in player_trend_metrics
- **Output scale:** percentile 0-100; rank 1..N
- **Status:** live — HotColdCard on FORGE dashboard; route ledger calls=7

### ROLL-008 Player trend page: rolling-vs-baseline delta %, hot/cold streak and L7/L14/L30 quick cards

- **Purpose:** Client-side comparison of a player's rolling window value against a chosen baseline, streak labelling, and calendar-day recent averages on /trends/player/[playerId].
- **Where:** `web/pages/trends/player/[playerId].tsx:842 (rechartsData: _absolute and _delta per metric)`; `web/pages/trends/player/[playerId].tsx:869 (streakSummaries)`; `web/pages/trends/player/[playerId].tsx:894 (hot/cold threshold +/-8%)`; `web/pages/trends/player/[playerId].tsx:533 (averageMetricByRecentDays)`; `web/pages/trends/player/[playerId].tsx:924 (quickComparisonCards)`

- **Method:** absolute = rolling - baseline; delta% = (rolling - baseline)/\|baseline\|*100 (null when baseline 0). Streak: latest delta >= +8 -> hot, <= -8 -> cold, else steady; streak length = consecutive most-recent games with delta >= 0 (hot) or <= 0 (cold), a sign test rather than the 8% threshold; averageDelta = mean of all deltas; metrics sorted by \|latestDelta\|. Quick cards: Rolling10 uses the last10 field; L7/L14/L30 = unweighted mean of raw per-game values with game_date in [latest-(days-1), latest] (calendar days anchored to the player's last game, not today), then delta% vs baseline. Metric families: additive_average (goals, assists, points, shots, hits, blocks, pp_points) and weighted_rate per-60 metrics.
- **Outputs:** <metric>_absolute; <metric>_delta (%); StreakSummary {direction, games, latestDelta, averageDelta}; QuickComparisonCard {recentValue, baselineValue, deltaPct, sampleLabel}
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-game counts (additive_average) and per-60 rates (weighted_rate); TOI-average metrics in seconds
- **Output scale:** delta in percent (unbounded, signed); streak length in games; recent value in source metric units
- **Status:** live — /trends/player/[playerId] page, linked from FORGE dashboard handoff (forgeOrigin)
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/trends/player/[playerId].test.tsx`
- **Consumers:** /trends/player/[playerId] page (chart, streak chips 'N straight games above baseline', quick comparison cards)
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - L7/L14/L30 averages of per-60 metrics are simple means of per-game rates (not TOI-weighted sum/sum), inconsistent with the weighted_rate contract used by the rolling writer
  - resolveRawMetricValue reads row[metric.key] (e.g. goals_per_60) as a per-game value; whether that raw column exists/means a single-game rate in rolling_player_game_metrics was not verified
  - hot/cold label uses an 8% threshold but streak length counts any same-sign delta, so a 'hot' streak may include games only +0.1% above baseline
  - delta% on near-zero baselines produces very large swings; magic threshold 8 undocumented

- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingHistoricalAverages.ts:142 (updateHistoricalGpPctAccumulator)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingHistoricalAverages.ts:189 (getHistoricalGpPctSnapshot)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingHistoricalAverages.ts:231 (getRollingGpPctSnapshot)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:2667 (didPlayerCountAsAppearance)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:2755 (applyGpOutputs)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerAvailabilityContract.ts:79 (ROLLING_PLAYER_AVAILABILITY_CONTRACT)`

Ratio = min(1, playerGames/teamGames), null if teamGames 0. 3YA = seasons startYear in [current-2, current]. Rolling last N: teamGames = min(N, current team games), playerGames = player appearances for the current team with team-game index in the last N. - **Sub-family:** Rolling player averages & trends / finishing

- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1317 (shooting_pct)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1364 (expected_sh_pct)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1348 (primary_points_pct)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricScaleContract.ts:27 (ROLLING_METRIC_SCALE_CONTRACTS)`

- **Output scale:** shooting_pct percent 0-100; expected_sh_pct fraction 0-1; primary_points_pct fraction 0-1 (rollingMetricScaleContract.ts:33-35); ratio of sums
- **Status:** live — written by /api/v1/db/update-rolling-player-averages, invoked by /api/v1/db/run-rolling-forge-pipeline (web/vercel.json cron '5,10,15,20,30,35,40,45,55 10 * * *' UTC, mode=daily_incremental; lib/rollingForgePipeline.ts:102)

  - unit mismatch between siblings - shooting_pct is 0-100 while expected_sh_pct and primary_points_pct are 0-1 fractions; any sh% minus xsh% comparison must rescale

### ROLL-018 Legacy smoothstep confidence multiplier

- **Sub-family:** Rolling player averages & trends / legacy sKO
- **Purpose:** Map a 'rolling CV' value to a confidence multiplier between min and max.

### ROLL-020 Legacy sKO characteristic-game classifier (z-scores, weighted chi-square thresholds, stat weights)

- **Sub-family:** Rolling player averages & trends / legacy sKO
- **Purpose:** Label each game as Highly/Moderately/Uncharacteristic versus the player's prior games.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/utils/statistics.ts:26 (computeStatSummaries)`; `web/lib/supabase/utils/statistics.ts:72 (computeCharacteristicResults)`; `web/lib/supabase/utils/constants.ts:47 (RATED_STAT_FIELDS)`; `web/lib/supabase/utils/constants.ts:111 (STAT_WEIGHTS)`
- **Inputs:** shooting_percentage, ipp, on_ice_shooting_pct, zone_start_pct, time_on_ice, pa_to_sa_ratio, sog_per_60, pp_toi_pct_per_game
- **Source tables:** wgo_skater_stats + sko_skater_stats game logs
- **Method:** Weights = normalized inverse of importance ratings (SH% 4.0625, IPP 4.8125, oiSH% 6.263, ZS% 6.583, TOI 4.692, PA/SA 6.571, SOG/60 4.0625, PPTOI% 4.667) -> sum to 1. For game i, baseline = mean and population SD (divide by n) over games 0..i-1; SD 0 -> 1. z capped at +/-5; per-stat label \|z\|<=1 Highly, <=2 Moderately, else Uncharacteristic. Score = sum w*z^2; T1 = sum w (=1), T2 = T1 + 2*sqrt(2*sum w^2) (chi-square-1 mean/variance approximation). PA/SA ratio: current game capped at 10 (SA=0 & PA>0 -> 10); prior games recomputed with Infinity for SA=0, then non-finite values filtered out of mean/SD. First game -> 'Insufficient History'.
- **Outputs:** statResults per stat; sumOfWeightedSquaredZScores; overallStatus; T1; T2
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-game values: shooting_percentage, ipp, on_ice_shooting_pct, zone_start_pct (percent units undeclared), time_on_ice (units undeclared, WGO usually seconds), sog_per_60 (per-60), pp_toi_pct_per_game, PA/SA ratio
- **Output scale:** z-scores capped +/-5; weighted sum of squared z (>=0); T1=1, T2=1+2*sqrt(2*sum w^2); categorical labels
- **Status:** legacy/dead — no importer outside tests; quarantined in web/lib/predictions/legacyQuarantine.ts:64
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/utils/legacySko.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** none found (quarantined in web/lib/predictions/legacyQuarantine.ts:64)
- **Reference standard:** Standard z-score / chi-square approximation; weighted sum of squared z assumes independent normals
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - PA/SA ratio handled inconsistently - current game capped at 10, priors set to Infinity and then dropped from baseline, biasing the baseline low
  - with one prior game SD=0 -> 1, so z equals the raw difference in native units (e.g. TOI seconds) and immediately caps at 5
  - chi-square thresholds assume independent unit-normal z; stats are correlated and z is capped, so T1/T2 are not calibrated
  - percent fields (SH%, IPP, oiSH%, ZS%) units not declared (0-1 vs 0-100)
  - dead/quarantined code

### ROLL-024 Per-60 weighted rate metrics

- **Sub-family:** Rolling player averages & trends / per-60
- **Purpose:** Event rates per 60 minutes over each scope from summed raw events and summed TOI seconds.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerMetricMath.ts:3 (resolvePer60Components)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1175 (sog_per_60)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1207 (shot_attempts_per_60)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1221 (goals_per_60)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1148 (getGoalsPer60ToiSeconds)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1235 (assists_per_60)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1249 (penalties_drawn_per_60)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1263 (penalties_taken_per_60)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1289 (primary_assists_per_60)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1303 (secondary_assists_per_60)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1475 (hits_per_60)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1489 (blocks_per_60)`
- **Inputs:** raw event count per game; resolved TOI seconds per game; NST rates shots_per_60 (sog only, reconstruction)
- **Source tables:** nst_gamelog_*_counts (shots, icf, goals, total_assists, first_assists, second_assists, penalties_drawn, total_penalties, hits, shots_blocked), nst_gamelog_*_rates, wgo_skater_stats
- **Method:** Per game components = {num: raw events, den: TOI seconds}; if raw missing but a per-60 rate exists (sog/ixg only), num = rate * TOI / 3600. Scope value = sum(num)/sum(den) * 3600 (seconds -> per 60 min). No TOI -> component null (slot kept, nothing added). goals_per_60 at PP uses its own TOI chain counts.toi -> countsOi.toi -> rates.toi_per_gp -> PP TOI (builder PPTOI, else WGO pp_toi). Numerators: sog/hits/blocks/goals/penalties use NST counts with WGO all-strength fallback; assists_per_60, primary/secondary_assists_per_60, shot_attempts_per_60 use NST counts only.
- **Outputs:** sog_per_60_*; ixg_per_60_*; shot_attempts_per_60_*; goals_per_60_*; assists_per_60_*; primary_assists_per_60_*; secondary_assists_per_60_*; penalties_drawn_per_60_*; penalties_taken_per_60_*; hits_per_60_*; blocks_per_60_*; (scopes: _last3/5/10/20, _all, _season, _3ya, _career, legacy _avg_/_total_)
- **Tables written:** rolling_player_game_metrics, rolling_player_metric_support_payloads
- **Input units:** raw event counts per game; TOI in seconds (NST mm:ss parsed to seconds); NST rates shots_per_60/ixg_per_60 are per-60 rates
- **Output scale:** per-60 rate (events per 60 minutes) = sum(events)/sum(TOI s)*3600; ratio of sums
- **Status:** live — written by /api/v1/db/update-rolling-player-averages, invoked by /api/v1/db/run-rolling-forge-pipeline (web/vercel.json cron '5,10,15,20,30,35,40,45,55 10 * * *' UTC, mode=daily_incremental; lib/rollingForgePipeline.ts:102)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerMetricMath.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricWindowContractCases.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** lib/rankings/*; FORGE skater projections (lib/projections); pages/trends/player/[playerId].tsx
- **Reference standard:** NST per-60 convention: sum(events) / sum(TOI minutes) * 60
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - goals_per_60 at PP takes TOI from a separate chain that bypasses the TOI sanity checks (no 4000 s cap, no non-positive rejection) and differs from the TOI used by every other per-60 on the same PP row
  - assists_per_60 numerator is NST total_assists only, while the 'assists' additive metric falls back to WGO; games without NST rows add nothing to assists_per_60 (slot kept) but do add to assists
  - sog_per_60 and ixg_per_60 may rebuild numerators from NST rate * TOI where TOI itself came from a different source (WGO), mixing sources inside one component

### ROLL-026 PP TOI and team PP share (pp_share_pct)

- **Sub-family:** Rolling player averages & trends / PP share
- **Purpose:** Player share of total team power-play TOI over each scope, plus raw PP TOI.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerPpShareContract.ts:65 (resolvePpShareComponents)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerPpShareContract.ts:84 (resolvePlayerPpToiSeconds)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerMetricMath.ts:35 (resolveShareComponents)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1130 (getPpShareComponents)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1517 (pp_share_pct)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:4031 (null pp_share for ev/pk/5v5)`
- **Inputs:** powerPlayCombinations.PPTOI; powerPlayCombinations.pp_share_of_team (0-1); wgo_skater_stats.pp_toi; wgo_skater_stats.pp_toi_pct_per_game (0-1)
- **Source tables:** powerPlayCombinations, wgo_skater_stats
- **Method:** Per game: numerator = player PP TOI s, denominator = player PP TOI / share (implied team PP TOI). Builder pair preferred, else WGO pair; requires share > 0. pp_share_pct = sum(player PP TOI)/sum(implied team PP TOI) (0-1), i.e. TOI-weighted share. Only 'all' and 'pp' rows; other strengths nulled. pp_toi_seconds additive = builder PPTOI else WGO pp_toi. Unit-relative builder fields (pp_unit_usage_index, pp_unit_relative_toi, pp_vs_unit_avg) are copied through as context, not used in math.
- **Outputs:** pp_share_pct_*; pp_share_pct_player_pp_toi_*; pp_share_pct_team_pp_toi_*; pp_toi_seconds_*; pp_share_of_team; pp_unit_usage_index; pp_unit_relative_toi; pp_vs_unit_avg
- **Tables written:** rolling_player_game_metrics, rolling_player_metric_support_payloads
- **Input units:** player PP TOI seconds (builder PPTOI, WGO pp_toi); share fraction 0-1 (pp_share_of_team, WGO ppTimeOnIcePctPerGame)
- **Output scale:** pp_share_pct fraction 0-1 (TOI-weighted ratio of sums); pp_toi_seconds seconds
- **Status:** live — written by /api/v1/db/update-rolling-player-averages, invoked by /api/v1/db/run-rolling-forge-pipeline (web/vercel.json cron '5,10,15,20,30,35,40,45,55 10 * * *' UTC, mode=daily_incremental; lib/rollingForgePipeline.ts:102); only all/pp rows
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerPpShareContract.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerMetricMath.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerPpUnitContract.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** lib/rankings/* (deployment); FORGE skater stage; lib/socialShare/modules/roleWatch.ts
- **Reference standard:** PP TOI share of team PP TOI (NHL.com ppTimeOnIcePctPerGame)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - a game where the player had 0 PP TOI contributes nothing (share>0 required and numerator 0 gives 0/0), so pp_share_pct reflects share only in games with PP usage plus slots without components, rather than share of all team PP time in the window
  - team PP TOI is reconstructed from a rounded pp_share_of_team, adding rounding error to the denominator
  - a window can mix builder- and WGO-derived components (validation flags mixedSourceWindow)

### ROLL-027 Power-play unit usage metrics

- **Sub-family:** Rolling player averages & trends / PP usage

- **Output scale:** ratio ~1.0 (usage index), seconds (relative TOI), fraction 0-1 (pp_share_of_team)

- **Consumers:** pages/api/v1/db/update-power-play-combinations/[gameId].ts; rolling player averages (pp share inputs)

### ROLL-029 SKO inputs: IPP and SOG/60

- **Sub-family:** Rolling player averages & trends / SKO
- **Purpose:** Compute per-game and per-season skater IPP and shots-on-goal per 60 for sKO stats.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchSKOskaterStats.js:264 (totalOnIceGoalsFor, ipp, sogPer60)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchSKOyears.js:156 (totalOnIceGoalsFor, ipp, sogPer60)`
- **Inputs:** points; evenStrengthGoalsFor; powerPlayGoalFor; shortHandedGoalsFor; shots; timeOnIce (seconds)
- **Source tables:** NHL stats REST skater summary/goalsForAgainst/timeonice/puckPossessions/powerplay (daily isGame=true aggregate; season isGame=false)
- **Method:** onIceGF = ES GF + PP GF + SH GF; IPP = points / onIceGF * 100 (null if 0). TOI minutes = timeOnIce/60; SOG/60 = shots / TOI minutes * 60. Other columns (shooting %, oiSH%, zone start %, PP TOI %) copied.
- **Outputs:** ipp; sog_per_60
- **Tables written:** sko_skater_stats, sko_skater_years
- **Input units:** points/goals counts; timeOnIce in SECONDS converted to minutes
- **Output scale:** IPP percent 0-100; SOG per 60
- **Status:** legacy/dead — web/lib/predictions/legacyQuarantine.ts:122-123 marks both JS files as legacy manual source-ingest scripts; live equivalent is pages/api/v1/db/update-sko-stats.ts:156-195 (pg_cron update-sko-stats-full-season active=true, cron-schedule.md:514)
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/update-sko-stats.test.ts (tests the live route reimplementation, not these JS files)`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/update-sko-stats.route.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** pages/api/v1/db/update-sko-stats.ts; lib/supabase/utils/dataFetching.ts
- **Reference standard:** NST IPP (points / on-ice GF) and per-60 convention
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - IPP is 0-100 while copied shooting_percentage / on_ice_shooting_pct from NHL API are 0-1 fractions - mixed percent units in one row
  - daily rows are single-game IPP/SOG60; any rolling use must recompute ratio-of-sums
  - fetchSKOyears treats shots=0 as null SOG/60 (truthy check) whereas fetchSKOskaterStats returns 0

- **Sub-family:** Rolling player averages & trends / SKO

- **Reference standard:** Ratio-of-sums convention (e.g. PP% = PPG/PPO over window; SAT% = SATF/(SATF+SATA))
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**

  - rolling_games is fetched across all seasons with no season filter, so STD/LTG and game_number span seasons in 'all' mode
  - in 'recent' mode games are filtered to >= baseline before computing, so STD restarts at the baseline and LTG windows lose earlier games
  - source pages are joined per page while endpoints are sorted differently (summary by date, powerplay by PP%, penalties by PIM), so games can be dropped as 'not found' across pages

### ROLL-036 TOI resolution, trust tiers and WGO minutes/seconds normalization

- **Sub-family:** Rolling player averages & trends / TOI
- **Purpose:** Resolve per-game TOI seconds for each strength with source priority and sanity bounds.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerToiContract.ts:39 (inspectToiSeconds)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerToiContract.ts:66 (normalizeWgoToiPerGame)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerToiContract.ts:112 (resolveFallbackToiSeed)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerToiContract.ts:175 (resolveRollingPlayerToiContext)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1788 (getWgoToiForStrength)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:1854 (getToiSeconds)`
- **Inputs:** NST counts toi; NST counts_oi toi; NST rates toi_per_gp; WGO toi_per_game / es_toi_per_game / pp_toi / pp_toi_per_game / sh_toi_per_game / toi_per_game_5v5
- **Source tables:** nst_gamelog_*_counts, nst_gamelog_*_counts_oi, nst_gamelog_*_rates, wgo_skater_stats
- **Method:** Priority counts (authoritative) -> counts_oi (authoritative) -> rates toi_per_gp (supplementary) -> fallback seed (counts/counts_oi/WGO) -> WGO (fallback). Rejected if non-finite, <0 (or 0 for all strength; 0 allowed for split strengths) or >= 4000 s. WGO all-strength value > 200 is treated as seconds, otherwise minutes*60 (rounded); split-strength WGO fields are always treated as seconds.
- **Outputs:** toi seconds per game; toiSources/toiTrustTiers/toiWgoNormalizations diagnostics
- **Tables written:** rolling_player_game_metrics (toi_seconds_*)
- **Input units:** NST toi and toi_per_gp in seconds; WGO all-strength toi_per_game seconds or minutes (guessed: >200 = seconds); WGO strength-specific fields treated as seconds
- **Output scale:** TOI seconds per game, valid range (0 or >0) to <4000 s
- **Status:** live — written by /api/v1/db/update-rolling-player-averages, invoked by /api/v1/db/run-rolling-forge-pipeline (web/vercel.json cron '5,10,15,20,30,35,40,45,55 10 * * *' UTC, mode=daily_incremental; lib/rollingForgePipeline.ts:102)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingPlayerToiContract.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** all per-60 metrics; split-strength appearance anchor (TOI>0); toi_seconds_avg_last5 / toi_seconds_avg_all read by FORGE
- **Reference standard:** NST TOI in seconds; NHL API timeOnIce seconds
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - the >200 heuristic misreads an all-strength WGO value that is really seconds but below 200 (e.g. 150 s) as minutes -> 9000 s -> rejected as above_max, so very short games lose TOI
  - 4000 s cap (66:40) can reject legitimate multi-overtime all-strength TOI
  - the fallback seed re-runs the same counts/counts_oi candidates already tried, so the 'fallback' tier is effectively just WGO

### ROLL-044 Ratio-of-sums rolling/historical aggregation engine

- **Sub-family:** Rolling player averages & trends / windows
- **Purpose:** Shared accumulator that computes every ratio and per-60 metric from summed numerator/denominator components over last-N, all-processed, season, 3-year and career scopes.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricAggregation.ts:136 (computeRatioValue)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricAggregation.ts:223 (normalizeRatioWindowEntry)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricAggregation.ts:263 (updateRatioRollingAccumulator)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricAggregation.ts:309 (getRatioRollingSnapshot)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricAggregation.ts:355 (updateHistoricalRatioAccumulator)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricAggregation.ts:381 (getHistoricalRatioSnapshot)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricAggregation.ts:210 (getRatioRollingWindowModeForFamily)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts:3943 (processPlayer derive loop: anchor = didPlayerCountAsAppearance)`
- **Inputs:** RatioComponents {numerator, denominator, secondaryNumerator, secondaryDenominator}; RatioAggregationSpec {scale, combine, outputScale, noPrimaryDenominatorBehavior}; window family; anchor (player appeared / TOI>0 in strength); season
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** Value = (sum num / sum den) * scale, optionally + (sum num2 / sum den2) * scale ('sum' combine, used by PDO), then * outputScale, rounded to 6 dp. Never averages per-game ratios. Windows 3/5/10/20 (CANONICAL_ROLLING_GAME_WINDOWS) are FIFO queues of the last N slots. For ratio_performance and weighted_rate_performance families the window mode is 'appearance': a slot is consumed only when anchor=true (all-strength: every WGO row; split strengths: TOI>0), and a slot with missing/invalid components still occupies the slot but adds nothing. A missing numerator beside a present denominator drops the components (explicit 0 still counts). No denominator -> null or 0 per spec. Historical buckets are keyed by season and are NOT anchor-gated; 3YA = seasons with startYear in [current-2, current]; career = every season bucket read.
- **Outputs:** <metric>_lastN / _all / _season / _3ya / _career numeric values; component totals per scope
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** raw component totals (counts, TOI seconds, on-ice counts); season ids like 20242025
- **Output scale:** depends on spec: scale 3600 -> per-60 rate; scale 100 -> percent 0-100; scale 1 -> fraction 0-1; PDO sum*0.01 -> index ~1.0 (0-2). Ratio of sums, never mean of ratios; rounded 6 dp
- **Status:** live — written by /api/v1/db/update-rolling-player-averages, invoked by /api/v1/db/run-rolling-forge-pipeline (web/vercel.json cron '5,10,15,20,30,35,40,45,55 10 * * *' UTC, mode=daily_incremental; lib/rollingForgePipeline.ts:102)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricAggregation.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricWindowContractCases.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/fetchRollingPlayerAverages.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** fetchRollingPlayerAverages deriveOutputs; rollingPlayerValidationPayload recompute
- **Reference standard:** Ratio-of-sums convention (NST/Evolving-Hockey aggregate rates as sum(events)/sum(TOI)); last-N-games windows
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - rolling windows are anchor-gated but historical season/3YA/career buckets are not, so split-strength _season can include zero-TOI games' components that the _lastN windows skip
  - '_all' is computed from the rolling accumulator totals over every row read (full player history, since buildPlayerHistoryReadOptions drops season/startDate) so it is effectively career-to-date, not season-to-date, and is anchor-gated unlike _career
  - 3YA includes the current partial season plus the two prior seasons, so early-season 3YA is mostly prior-season data
  - appearance-mode windows keep slots for games with missing NST components, so an L5 on-ice ratio can rest on fewer than 5 games of real data without any count exposed on the value itself

### ROLL-045 Rolling window contracts and metric-to-family map

- **Sub-family:** Rolling player averages & trends / windows
- **Purpose:** Declares what 'last N' means and which aggregation each metric family uses.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingWindowContract.ts:35 (CANONICAL_ROLLING_WINDOW_CONTRACTS)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingWindowContract.ts:127 (ROLLING_METRIC_WINDOW_FAMILIES)`; `web/lib/predictions/rollingWindows.ts:1 (CANONICAL_ROLLING_GAME_WINDOWS)`
- **Inputs:** metric key
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** Four families: availability (current team's last N chronological team games), additive_performance (sum and mean over the player's last N appearances with a defined value), ratio_performance (ratio of aggregated components over last N appearances in the strength state), weighted_rate_performance (sum events / sum TOI over last N appearances). Windows fixed at 3, 5, 10, 20. Mapping: per-60s -> weighted_rate; shooting_pct, primary_points_pct, expected_sh_pct, ipp, oz_start_pct, pp_share_pct, on_ice_sh_pct, pdo, cf_pct, ff_pct -> ratio; counts, ixg, iscf, ihdcf, toi_seconds, pp_toi_seconds -> additive.
- **Outputs:** window family per metric
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** metric key; windows in games (3/5/10/20)
- **Output scale:** categorical family label
- **Status:** live — imported by rollingMetricAggregation.ts and fetchRollingPlayerAverages.ts on the cron path; ROLLING_METRIC_WINDOW_FAMILIES also read by rollingPlayerValidationPayload.ts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingWindowContract.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/rollingMetricWindowContractCases.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** rollingMetricAggregation; rollingPlayerValidationPayload (inferWindowFamily)
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - ROLLING_METRIC_WINDOW_FAMILIES omits metrics the writer emits (goals_per_60, assists_per_60, primary/secondary_assists_per_60, shot_attempts_per_60, on_ice_sv_pct, oi_* and zone-start counts), so validation inferWindowFamily returns null for them
  - additive metrics use 'valid observation' windows (a slot only when a value exists) while ratio metrics use appearance windows, so two columns on the same row with suffix _last5 can cover different games
