### NST-002 NST goalie catch-up step planner (windows, budgets, burst sizing)

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / goalie catch-up
- **Purpose:** Plan bounded daily NST goalie dataset catch-up: which date/dataset units to fetch, when, with what spacing and attempt cap.
- **Where:** `web/lib/nst/goalieCatchup.ts:3 (GOALIE_DATASETS)`; `web/lib/nst/goalieCatchup.ts:25 (completedGoalieDate)`; `web/lib/nst/goalieCatchup.ts:92 (buildGoalieCatchupManifest)`; `web/lib/nst/goalieCatchup.ts:202 (planGoalieCatchupStep)`; `web/lib/nst/goalieCatchup.server.ts:46 (expectedUnits check)`; `web/lib/nst/goaliePreparation.server.ts:94 (prepareGoalieCatchup)`
- **Inputs:** season, seasonStartDate, regularSeasonEndDate, startDate, now; day coverage (calendar final/no_games, allCounts complete); completion receipts, holds; shared daily budget {steps, attempts}; lastDirectJobFinishedAt
- **Source tables:** goalie catch-up manifest/receipt tables via server adapters (not inspected in detail), NHL final-score schedule payloads
- **Method:** 10 datasets (5v5/ev/all/pp/pk x counts/rates) per date; completed date = yesterday in America/New_York; manifest span max 14 dates (start..min(seasonEnd, completedDate, start+13 days)); expected units = days*10. Daily caps: MAX_STEPS 7, MAX_ATTEMPTS 60; cooldown 600 s after the last direct NST job; operating windows 08:30-08:35 and 11:10-12:50 UTC and a step (220 s) must fit inside the window. Burst iff 0 < plannedRequestCount < 40 -> up to 20 units at 0 ms spacing, else 6 units at 21,000 ms; maxAttempts = min(units*3, 60 - attemptsUsed); deadline = now + 220 s.
- **Outputs:** GoalieStepDecision {allowed, units, plannedRequestCount, minIntervalMs, maxAttempts, deadlineAt} or pause reason/notBefore
- **Tables written:** manifest/receipts via goalieCatchup.server.ts adapters
- **Input units:** dates YYYY-MM-DD (America/New_York completed day, UTC windows as minutes of day), ms durations, request/attempt counts
- **Output scale:** step decision: unit list (<=20 burst / <=6 paced), minIntervalMs 0 or 21000, maxAttempts <=60, deadline epoch ms
- **Status:** draft (opt-in) — only runs when update-nst-goalies is called with ?catchupScope=<sha256> (web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nst-goalies.ts:947-957); goalieCatchup.ts:201 says it 'activates no scheduler'; tables from supabase/migrations/20261101161622_nst_goalie_catchup_v1.sql
- **Tests:** `web/lib/nst/goalieCatchup.test.ts`; `web/lib/nst/goalieCatchup.server.test.ts`; `web/lib/nst/goaliePreparation.server.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/lib/nst/goalieCatchup.server.ts (runGoalieCatchupStep); pages/api/v1/db/update-nst-goalies.ts / check-missing-goalie-data.ts
- **Reference standard:** Repository NST rate-limit policy (21 s spacing, burst only <40 total)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 08:30-08:35 UTC window is 5 minutes but a step needs 220 s, so only starts before ~08:31:20 qualify
  - paced step allows 6 units x 3 attempts = 18 attempts at 21 s = 378 s, exceeding the 220 s step deadline; deadline, not the cap, bounds work
  - burst threshold here is <40 (matches policy) while sharedAdmission semi-burst accepts up to 78 - two different burst rules in the same pipeline
  - magic constants (14 days, 60 attempts, 7 steps, 600 s cooldown, UTC windows) hard-coded

### NST-003 NST goalie freshness assessment (coverage counts and status tiers)

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / goalie freshness
- **Purpose:** Compare expected WGO goalie appearances to NST goalie rows over the last 14 days and classify freshness healthy/warning/critical.
- **Where:** `web/lib/nst/goalieFreshness.ts:31 (assessGoalieFreshness)`; `web/lib/nst/goalieFreshness.ts:50 (14-day floor)`; `web/lib/nst/goalieFreshness.ts:103 (status tiers)`; `web/lib/nst/goalieFreshness.server.ts:44 (readGoalieFreshness)`; `web/lib/nst/goalieFreshness.server.ts:84 (window start)`
- **Inputs:** expected (season, goalieId, date) from WGO; observed NST rows with hdShotsAgainst; final game dates; noProgressWindows; now
- **Source tables:** WGO goalie rows, NST goalie gamelog tables, schedule/final-game calendar, checkpoint progress tables
- **Method:** cutoff = min(yesterday ET, regularSeasonEnd); window = [max(seasonStart, cutoff-13 days), cutoff]. A game is matched when an NST row exists with non-null hdShotsAgainst (>=0). expected = count, matched = expected - missing, per-date expected/matched, oldestGap = earliest missing date, latestCompleteDate = last date with expected==matched. Status: before 13:00 UTC with gaps -> not_due; else gaps -> critical if (cutoff - oldestGap) >= 2 days or noProgressWindows >= 2, otherwise warning; no gaps -> healthy; any incomplete enumeration -> unknown.
- **Outputs:** status; expected; matched; missing[]; perDate[]; oldestGap; latestCompleteDate
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** dates YYYY-MM-DD, now (UTC), counts of expected/observed goalie-games, hdShotsAgainst counts
- **Output scale:** status enum healthy\|warning\|critical\|unknown\|not_due; integer counts expected/matched
- **Status:** live — readGoalieFreshness called by web/pages/api/v1/db/cron-report.ts:1763 (cron-report scheduled in web/vercel.json:131)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/nst/goalieFreshness.test.ts`; `web/lib/nst/goalieFreshness.server.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** pages/api/v1/db/cron-report.ts; pages/api/v1/db/check-missing-goalie-data.ts
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 'matched' only checks hdShotsAgainst non-null; other NST goalie fields (e.g. GSAA/xGA) are not verified
  - hard-coded 13:00 UTC report hour and 2-day / 2-window critical thresholds

### NST-004 Goalie parity counts, SV%, GAA and 'GSAA'

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / goalies
- **Purpose:** Compute goalie shots against, saves, GA, SV%, GAA, xGA, GSAA, HD/MD/LD SV% and GAA, rush/rebound attempts against, average shot/goal distance.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:1468 (goalie accumulation)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:1754 (buildGoalieSplitParity)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:1765 (svPercentage)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:1780 (gsaa)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:1789 (hd_gaa)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:1820 (avg_shot_distance)`
- **Inputs:** shot features with goalieInNetId; goalie TOI by split
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events, nhl_api_shift_rows
- **Method:** Goalie team = team opposite event owner. SA/saves from goal+SOG excluding own goals; GA counts all goals incl. own goals. SV% = saves/SA*100. GAA = GA*3600/TOI. xg_against = sum of approximate xG for all non-own-goal attempts. gsaa = xg_against - GA. HD SV% = hd_saves/hd_SA*100; hd_gaa = (hd_SA - hd_saves)*3600/TOI; md/ld analogous; hd/md/ld_gsaa hard-coded null. avg distances = mean shot/goal distance in feet. Per-60 versions via toPer60 including gsaa_per_60. XG INCLUDES (fallback heuristic): shot x,y mirrored to attacking direction by event-owner side and homeTeamDefendingSide, net at (89,0) ft; distance (ft) and angle (deg, \|dy\|/\|89-x\|) only via danger bucket cut-offs (<=20ft&<=35deg high, <=40ft&<=50deg medium); rebound flag (3 s, same team, immediate prior SOG/miss/block); rush flag (10 s backward scan, D/N-zone takeaway/faceoff win/opp giveaway/opp block); royal-road flag; goal outcome floor 0.25. XG EXCLUDES: shot type, strength state, score state, empty-net adjustment, shooter effects, goalie effects, any trained model or training set/seasons (hand-set constants), calibration (excluded). The trained model (scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts) is NOT wired into this path in production.
- **Outputs:** shots_against; saves; goals_against; sv_percentage; gaa; gsaa; xg_against; hd/md/ld_shots_against; hd/md/ld_saves; hd/md/ld_sv_percentage; hd/md/ld_gaa; rush_attempts_against; rebound_attempts_against; avg_shot_distance; avg_goal_distance; *_per_60
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** shot counts; TOI seconds; distance feet; xG in goals
- **Output scale:** SV% percent 0-100; GAA per 60 (per 3600 s); gsaa in goals (xGA-GA); avg distance feet
- **Status:** live — update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday pg_cron (09:35 UTC, active=true, tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382) -> pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts -> lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsSummaryRefresh.ts -> playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1066 buildPlayerStatsNativeGameParity -> buildNstParityMetrics; also read paths pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players*.ts; goalie views via lib/underlying-stats/goalieStatsServer.ts / goalieStatsSummaryRefresh.ts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.test.ts`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.test.ts`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsSummaryRefresh.test.ts`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/goalieStatsServer.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** underlying stats goalie views via playerStatsLandingServer.ts; scripts/run-nhl-xg-release-validation.ts
- **Reference standard:** NST goalie: GSAA = SA x league-average SV% - GA; GSAx = xGA - GA; SV% 0-100 on NST
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 'gsaa' is computed as xGA - GA, which is GSAx, not GSAA (league-average-SV% baseline) - label mismatch vs NST
  - xg_against includes blocked and missed attempts while GA/SV% use shots on goal, and xG is the leaky heuristic in production
  - GA includes own goals but SA excludes them, so SV% and GA-based GAA disagree
  - shots against are credited to goalieInNetId regardless of whether goalie is on ice; empty-net events have no goalie so are dropped
  - hd/md/ld_gsaa always null but still emitted with per-60 columns

### NST-005 On-ice For/Against counts by danger

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / on-ice
- **Purpose:** Count on-ice CF/CA, FF/FA, SF/SA, GF/GA, xGF/xGA, SCF/SCA, HD/MD/LD CF/CA and GF/GA per player per split.

Own goals excluded from CF/FF/SF/xG/danger but included in GF/GA.
- **Outputs:** cf; ca; ff; fa; sf; sa; gf; ga; xgf; xga; scf; sca; hdcf; hdca; hdgf; hdga; mdcf; mdca; mdgf; mdga; ldcf; ldca; ldgf; ldga
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** event counts; xG in goals
- **Output scale:** integer counts; xGF/xGA sums in goals
- **Status:** live — update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday pg_cron (09:35 UTC, active=true, tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382) -> pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts -> lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsSummaryRefresh.ts -> playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1066 buildPlayerStatsNativeGameParity -> buildNstParityMetrics; also read paths pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players*.ts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.test.ts`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.test.ts`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsSummaryRefresh.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** on-ice % and per-60 in buildNstParityMetrics; playerStatsLandingServer.ts
- **Reference standard:** Natural Stat Trick on-ice: CF = goals+SOG+missed+blocked; FF excludes blocked; SF = goals+SOG
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - GF/GA only counted when a shot feature row exists; goals filtered out of shot features (e.g. delayed-penalty typed rows) would be missing from GF
  - own goals count in GF/GA but not SF/SA, so on-ice SV% = (SA-GA)/SA can be pulled below the save rate of actual shots

### NST-006 Zone starts and zone faceoff shares

### NST-014 Approximate xG fallback heuristic

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / PbP parity
- **Purpose:** Assign an xG value per shot attempt when no model xG is attached.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:407 (getApproximateXgValue)`
- **Inputs:** xgValue (optional); dangerBucket; isReboundShot; isRushShot; crossedRoyalRoad; isGoal
- **Source tables:** shot feature rows (in-memory)
- **Method:** Base 0.18 high / 0.08 medium / 0.02 low; +0.03 rebound, +0.02 rush, +0.02 royal-road; if the shot is a goal, value = max(value, 0.25); cap 0.95. Applied to every shot attempt type including blocked and missed. XG INCLUDES (fallback heuristic): shot x,y mirrored to attacking direction by event-owner side and homeTeamDefendingSide, net at (89,0) ft; distance (ft) and angle (deg, \|dy\|/\|89-x\|) only via danger bucket cut-offs (<=20ft&<=35deg high, <=40ft&<=50deg medium); rebound flag (3 s, same team, immediate prior SOG/miss/block); rush flag (10 s backward scan, D/N-zone takeaway/faceoff win/opp giveaway/opp block); royal-road flag; goal outcome floor 0.25. XG EXCLUDES: shot type, strength state, score state, empty-net adjustment, shooter effects, goalie effects, any trained model or training set/seasons (hand-set constants), calibration (excluded). The trained model (scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts) is NOT wired into this path in production.
- **Outputs:** xG per attempt -> ixg, xgf, xga, goalie xg_against, gsaa
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** danger bucket from feet/degrees; booleans
- **Output scale:** xG per attempt, probability-like 0.02-0.95 (summed to xGF/xGA in goals)
- **Status:** live — update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday pg_cron (09:35 UTC, active=true, tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382) -> pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts -> lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsSummaryRefresh.ts -> playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1066 buildPlayerStatsNativeGameParity -> buildNstParityMetrics; also read paths pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players*.ts (no xgValue is attached on this path, so this heuristic is what ships); identical copy at web/lib/underlying-stats/teamStatsSummaryRefresh.ts:489-515
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** ixG, xGF, xGA, xGF%, goalie xG against / 'gsaa' in buildNstParityMetrics; underlying-stats player landing
- **Reference standard:** Evolving-Hockey / MoneyPuck / NST xG (Fenwick-based logistic models; outcome never an input)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - target leakage - goals are floored to 0.25 xG, so xG depends on the outcome and inflates xGF/ixG for scorers
  - blocked shots receive xG (NST and most public models compute xG on unblocked attempts only)
  - magic constants 0.18/0.08/0.02/+0.03/+0.02/+0.02/0.25/0.95 with no calibration reference
  - overlap: xG slice

- **Reference standard:** Natural Stat Trick on-ice share definitions (CF% = CF/(CF+CA)); NST per-60 = count*3600/TOI seconds; percentile-rank conventions (inclusive vs exclusive ties)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - uses all-strength (as) views for possession shares; community-standard CF%/xGF% comparisons are usually 5v5, so PP/PK usage distorts shares
  - hdcf_per_60 radar key is mapped to individual ihdcf_per_60 while hdca_per_60 is on-ice HDCA - asymmetric/misleading naming vs NST 'HDCF' (on-ice)
  - league minima are very low (GF+GA>=1, xGF+xGA>=1, SF+SA>=10) so tiny samples produce extreme 0%/100% shares in the comparison set
  - the player's own value is not subject to the minimum, and the player's row is included in leagueValues if it clears it; ties count as neither worse nor better so percentile tops out below 100
  - shares are 0-100 here whereas web/lib/stats/percentUnits.ts aggregates return fractions (0-1) - mixed percent units across modules
  - position filter reads wgo_skater_stats_per_game with season as String(season) while NST views are filtered by numeric season

### NST-018 NST rate-limit admission window math (local ledger + shared RPC + Python admission)

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / request admission
- **Purpose:** Decide when the next NST request may start so the rolling 1m/5m/15m/1h windows and 21 s spacing are never exceeded across callers.
- **Where:** `web/lib/nst/requestBudget.ts:83 (withNstRequestBudget)`; `web/lib/nst/requestBudget.ts:107 (1h ledger prune + window wait loop to :120)`; `web/lib/nst/sharedAdmission.ts:68 (admitSharedNstAttempt)`; `web/lib/nst/sharedAdmission.ts:78 (burst eligibility)`; `web/lib/cron/nstRateLimitPolicy.ts:28 (NST_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOWS)`; `web/lib/cron/nstRateLimitPolicy.ts:57 (getProjectedRequestsInWindow)`; `web/lib/cron/nstRateLimitPolicy.ts:122 (canUseNstSemiBurst)`; `functions/lib/nst_admission.py:169 (admit_nst_attempt)`; `functions/lib/nst_admission.py:184 (burst eligibility)`; `web/lib/nst/client.ts:281 (admission deadline = run deadline - timeout - 5 s)`
- **Inputs:** request URL (key param stripped, sorted, sha256); NstRequestControl.deadlineAt/maxAttempts/minIntervalMs/plannedRequestCount; ledger attempts (startedAt, intervalMs, active); RPC receipt {allowed, waitMs, permitTtlMs}
- **Source tables:** local /tmp ledger file fhfhockey-nst-budget-<uid>/attempts.json, Supabase RPC nst_admit_attempt_v1 / nst_admit_job_attempt_v1
- **Method:** Windows: 1m max 39, 5m max 80, 15m max 100, 1h max 180; min spacing 21,000 ms. Local ledger: drop inactive attempts older than 1 h; wait = max(100 ms if same URL in flight, last.startedAt + max(last.intervalMs, intervalMs) - now, for each window with count>=max: the (count-max)-th oldest startedAt + windowMs + 1 - now). Interval = 0 only when minIntervalMs==0 AND plannedRequestCount is a safe integer 1..78 (semi-burst, 'two 39-attempt waves'); else max(21000, minIntervalMs). Every network attempt (incl. retries) counts. Shared RPC: POST with p_burst/p_planned_requests; if allowed, permit must be used within permitTtlMs=1000 ms measured from before the POST; if denied sleep max(25 ms, waitMs). Python mirror: same receipt checks, burst iff min_interval_ms==0 and 1<=planned_requests<=78, default min_interval_ms 21000, default deadline now+220 s, sleep max(0.025 s, waitMs/1000). Static plan check: projected requests in a window at fixed cadence = min(n, floor(window/interval)+1).
- **Outputs:** waitMs / dispatch permission; ledger attempt rows; NstExecutionLimitError / NstAdmissionError
- **Tables written:** local ledger file (attempts.json), shared admission ledger via RPC (server-side SQL, not in this slice)
- **Input units:** milliseconds (TS: windowMs, intervalMs, waitMs, Date.now epoch ms); seconds (Python: time.monotonic, waitMs/1000); request counts per rolling window
- **Output scale:** wait time in ms (>=0) or permit/deny; ledger counts per window 0..39/80/100/180
- **Status:** live — every NST fetch goes through web/lib/nst/client.ts:280 (withNstRequestBudget) and admitSharedNstAttempt; used by update-nst-goalies, update-nst-team-daily, update-nst-gamelog etc.; scheduled per web/lib/cron/nstCoordination.ts:20-23 (update-nst-goalies 08:30 UTC, team-daily 09:55 UTC); job lifecycle gated by env NST_JOB_LIFECYCLE_ENABLED (web/lib/nst/jobLifecycle.server.ts:76)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/nst/requestBudget.test.ts`; `web/lib/nst/sharedAdmission.test.ts`; `web/lib/nst/client.test.ts`; `web/lib/nst/clientOperationControls.test.ts`; `web/lib/nst/nstBypassGuard.test.ts`; `web/lib/nst/jobLifecycle.server.test.ts`; `web/lib/cron/nstRateLimitPolicy.test.ts`; `web/lib/cron/nstBurstPlans.test.ts`; `web/lib/cron/nstCoordination.test.ts`; `functions/tests/test_nst_admission.py`; `functions/tests/test_nst_legacy_lifecycle.py`; `functions/tests/test_fetch_team_table_contract.py`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/update-nst-gamelog.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/lib/nst/client.ts (all NST page fetches); pages/api/v1/db/update-nst-*.ts routes; functions/api/fetch_team_table.py and other Python NST callers
- **Reference standard:** Repository NST policy (AGENTS.md / memory): 40/1m, 80/5m, 100/15m, 180/h unique URLs, 21 s spacing, only jobs <40 requests may burst
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 1m window is coded as 39 (stricter than documented 40) - fine, but differs from the policy text
  - semi-burst eligibility allows plannedRequestCount up to 78 (TS canUseNstSemiBurst and Python <=78), looser than the documented 'only a job needing fewer than 40 requests may burst'; safety then depends entirely on the server-side RPC enforcing windows
  - local ledger is per-host /tmp (explicitly not distributed); the authoritative window math lives in the nst_admit_attempt_v1 SQL, outside this slice
  - window membership uses now - startedAt <= windowMs (inclusive) and adds +1 ms; startedAt is stamped after dispatch, so window expiry is measured from dispatch not completion
  - limits are documented as unique-URL limits but both TS and Python count every attempt including retries (conservative)

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / score state
- **Purpose:** Restrict parity counts and TOI to tied/leading/trailing/withinOne/upOne/downOne score states.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:782 (getScoreStateBucketFromDiff)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:802 (matchesScoreStateFromDiff)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:818 (getTeamScoreDiff)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:840 (getPreEventScores)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:863 (matchesEventScoreState)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:887 (matchesSegmentScoreState)`
- **Inputs:** event home_score/away_score; event_owner_team_id; teamId
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** Team diff = own score - opponent score; for goal events subtract the goal from the scorer to get pre-event score. Buckets: 0 tied, +1 upOne, -1 downOne, >1 leading, <-1 trailing; withinOne = \|diff\|<=1. Note leading/trailing buckets exclude +-1 by construction. Null diff fails any non-allScores filter.
- **Outputs:** boolean filter per event/segment
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** goal counts (home/away score)
- **Output scale:** boolean filter
- **Status:** live — update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday pg_cron (09:35 UTC, active=true, tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382) -> pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts -> lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsSummaryRefresh.ts -> playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1066 buildPlayerStatsNativeGameParity -> buildNstParityMetrics; also read paths pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players*.ts (scoreState option exposed by player underlying-stats views)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.test.ts`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.test.ts`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsSummaryRefresh.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** buildNstParityMetrics(scoreState option); playerStatsLandingServer.ts score-state views
- **Reference standard:** NST score states (Tied, Leading, Trailing, Within 1, Up 1, Down 1, Close); NST Leading includes all leads
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 'leading'/'trailing' mean lead/trail by 2+ only (diff==1 maps to upOne), unlike NST where Leading includes +1
  - relies on per-event home_score/away_score; in api-web these are populated on goal events only, so for most events/segments diff is null and the score-state filter returns false unless an upstream step back-fills running scores - verify
  - duplicate score logic exists in nhlScoreState.ts (running score) with different semantics

### NST-021 Shift interval normalization, stints and stint lookup

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / shifts
- **Purpose:** Clean NHL shift rows into intervals, dedupe, build constant-personnel stints and find on-ice players at an event second.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShiftStints.ts:84 (normalizeShiftInterval)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShiftStints.ts:136 (normalizeShiftIntervals)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShiftStints.ts:195 (buildShiftStints)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShiftStints.ts:270 (findShiftStintAtTime)`
- **Inputs:** start_seconds; end_seconds; duration_seconds; period; player_id; team_id
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_shift_rows
- **Method:** If end<=start or null, end = start + duration; drop non-positive durations. Dedupe on game/player/team/period/start/end keeping lowest shift_id. Stints: split each period at every shift start/end boundary, players active if interval overlaps [start,end); merge adjacent identical personnel. Lookup at second s: candidates with start<=s<=end; prefer the stint ENDING at s, else start<=s<end.
- **Outputs:** NhlShiftInterval[]; NhlShiftStint[] (teams, playerIds)
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** seconds within period
- **Output scale:** intervals/stints in period seconds
- **Status:** live — used by parity path and contextual features (see buildNstParityMetrics status)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShiftStints.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlOnIceAttribution.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNormalizedLayer.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** nhlOnIceAttribution; nhlNstParityMetrics; nhlContextualFeatures
- **Reference standard:** NST shift-change convention (events at a change second credited to outgoing players except faceoffs credited to incoming)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - tie-break prefers the stint ending at the event second for ALL event types, including faceoffs; parity only uses the incoming stint for faceoffs that qualify as zone starts
  - goalies are included in stints, so on-ice player lists include goalies (affects contextual shift-age averages)

### NST-022 Contextual shot features (shift age, PP age, movement, royal road)

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / shot context
- **Purpose:** Per-shot shooter/team shift ages, previous shift gaps/durations, power-play age, east-west/north-south movement and royal-road crossing.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlContextualFeatures.ts:149 (computePlayerShiftAgeSeconds)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlContextualFeatures.ts:187 (computePlayerPreviousShiftGapSeconds)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlContextualFeatures.ts:212 (computePlayerPreviousShiftDurationSeconds)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlContextualFeatures.ts:237 (computeShiftAgeStats)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlContextualFeatures.ts:277 (computeCrossedRoyalRoad)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlContextualFeatures.ts:303 (buildContextualFeatureContexts)`
- **Inputs:** shift intervals; stints; strength state; prior-event normalized coords
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events, nhl_api_shift_rows
- **Method:** Shift age = event period second - active shift start; previous gap/duration from player's prior shift; owner/opponent averages and max over on-ice players. PP age = seconds since the team's current PP segment started (restarts if strength_exact changes). Movement (same-team prior event only): east-west = \|dy\|, north-south = dx. Royal road crossed if both x>=25 and y sign flips (non-zero). XG ROLE: INCLUDES shooter shift age, owner PP age, east-west/north-south movement and royal-road crossing (x>=25 ft both events, y sign flip) as model features; EXCLUDES opponent PP age, owner/opponent average shift age and previous-shift gaps from first_pass_v1 (computed but unused there), pre-shot passes (not in NHL PbP).
- **Outputs:** shooterShiftAgeSeconds; owner/opponent Average/Max ShiftAgeSeconds; owner/opponentPowerPlayAgeSeconds; eastWestMovementFeet; northSouthMovementFeet; crossedRoyalRoad
- **Tables written:** nhl xG shot feature table
- **Input units:** seconds (shift/PP age), feet (normalized coords)
- **Output scale:** seconds; feet; boolean
- **Status:** live — built in-memory on the parity path (playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1078 buildShotFeatureRows); persisted feature job update-nhl-xg-shot-features exists (pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts) but its pg_cron SQL is commented out in tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:1645-1655 (manual/backfill only)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlContextualFeatures.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** approximate xG (+0.02 royal road); xG model
- **Reference standard:** —
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - on-ice averages include goalies, whose long shifts inflate average shift age
  - PP age resets when 5v4 becomes 5v3 or back, so it is time-in-exact-strength not time-on-PP
  - royal-road uses the previous event of any type, not a pass (passes are not in NHL PbP)
  - overlap: xG slice

  - previous-event normalized coords use the previous owner's frame, so cross-team comparisons mix frames (only used when same team)
  - overlap: xG slice

### NST-027 Rebound detection and rebound control outcome

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / shot context
- **Purpose:** Flag rebound shots and classify what each source shot produced.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.ts:6 (DEFAULT_REBOUND_WINDOW_SECONDS)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.ts:108 (classifyReboundControlOutcome)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.ts:173 (buildReboundContexts)`
- **Inputs:** previous event; timeSincePreviousEventSeconds; previousEventSameTeam; normalized coordinates
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** Rebound shot = shot-feature-eligible attempt whose immediately previous event (same period, same owner team) is a SOG/missed/blocked shot within 0<dt<=3 s. Also distance from source, lateral displacement \|dy\|, distance delta and \|angle change\|. Source outcome: has rebound target -> second_chance_allowed; SOG followed by stoppage within 3 s -> goalie_freeze/covered puck; else no_danger_continuation. XG ROLE: rebound definition = time window 3 s, immediate prior event only, same team, same period; NO distance window (excluded); rebound distance/angle-change are recorded but not used by first_pass_v1; fallback xG adds +0.03.
- **Outputs:** isReboundShot; createsRebound; rebound* deltas; reboundControlOutcome
- **Tables written:** nhl xG shot feature table
- **Input units:** seconds (time delta), feet, degrees
- **Output scale:** booleans; deltas in feet/degrees; categorical outcome
- **Status:** live — built in-memory on the parity path (playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1078 buildShotFeatureRows); persisted feature job update-nhl-xg-shot-features exists (pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts) but its pg_cron SQL is commented out in tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:1645-1655 (manual/backfill only)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.test.ts`; `web/lib/xg/reboundRichLabels.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** approximate xG (+0.03); rebounds_created / rebound_attempts_against in parity; xG model
- **Reference standard:** NST rebound: attempt within 3 s of a blocked/missed/saved attempt by same team without stoppage
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - requires the immediately previous event to be the source; any intervening event (hit, giveaway) breaks it, stricter than NST
  - blocked-shot sources depend on blocked-shot owner semantics (see attribution flag)
  - overlap: xG slice

### NST-028 Rush shot detection

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / shot context
- **Purpose:** Flag rush attempts from transition events in the neutral/defensive zone.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:5 (DEFAULT_RUSH_WINDOW_SECONDS)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:91 (isQualifyingRushSource)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:122 (isHardRushBreak)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:149 (buildRushContexts)`
- **Inputs:** prior events within window; zone_code; event owner
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** Non-rebound eligible attempt; scan back up to 10 s in same period; qualifying source = own takeaway, own faceoff win, opponent giveaway, opponent blocked shot, located in team-relative D or N zone. Stoppages/penalties/period boundaries/any shot or goal/opponent possession events break the scan. XG ROLE: rush definition = up to 10 s backward, sources limited to own takeaway/faceoff win, opponent giveaway/blocked shot in own D or N zone; rebounds cannot be rushes; NO distance or speed threshold (excluded); rush distance/speed are speed_context_v3 features only; fallback xG adds +0.02.
- **Outputs:** isRushShot; rushTimeSinceSourceSeconds; rushDistanceFromSourceFeet; rushEventsSinceSource
- **Tables written:** nhl xG shot feature table
- **Input units:** seconds (10 s window), feet
- **Output scale:** boolean; seconds; feet; event count
- **Status:** live — built in-memory on the parity path (playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1078 buildShotFeatureRows); persisted feature job update-nhl-xg-shot-features exists (pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts) but its pg_cron SQL is commented out in tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:1645-1655 (manual/backfill only)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** approximate xG (+0.02); rush_attempts / rush_attempts_against in parity; xG model
- **Reference standard:** NST rush: attempt within 4 s of any event in the neutral or defensive zone without stoppage
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 10 s window vs NST 4 s, and restricted source event types; rush counts will exceed/differ from NST
  - rush distance uses raw (non-normalized) coordinates of source and shot
  - overlap: xG slice

### NST-029 Shot feature row assembly

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / shot context
- **Purpose:** Assemble one feature row per eligible shot attempt combining geometry, context and inclusion flags.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:384 (resolveGoalieOnIceFlags)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:410 (buildShotFeatureRows)`
- **Inputs:** parsed events; shift rows; home/away team ids
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events, nhl_api_shift_rows
- **Method:** Filter is_shot_like and includeInShotFeatures; isShotOnGoal = SOG or non-own goal; isUnblockedShotAttempt = not blocked and not own goal; goalie-on-ice flags from situationCode by owner side; shooter = shooting ?? scoring player; merges score-state, rebound, rush, flurry, miss reason, contextual features. Several features hard-coded null (roster position, handedness, F/D counts, deployment buckets). XG MODEL (trained, consumes these feature rows; scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts + web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.ts): model type default xgboost_js (train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:665), alternatives logistic_unregularized/logistic_l2/logistic_elastic_net (:2003); training set = unblocked attempts (goal, SOG, missed; blocked excluded; own goals excluded via isUnblockedShotAttempt) excluding penalty shots and shootouts (baselineDataset.ts:281-296), empty-net shots INCLUDED with isEmptyNetEvent as a feature; default season 20252026 single season (train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:298,:660), game-level train/validation/test split; features first_pass_v1 = normalizedX/Y, shotDistanceFeet, shotAngleDegrees, period, period/game seconds, time and distance since previous event, ownerPowerPlayAgeSeconds, shooterShiftAgeSeconds, east-west/north-south movement, isReboundShot, isRushShot, isFlurryShot, isEmptyNetEvent, isOvertimeEvent, crossedRoyalRoad, previousEventSameTeam, shotType, strengthState, strengthExact, zoneCode, previousEventTypeDescKey; expanded_v2 adds score diffs, ownerScoreDiffBucket, late-game flags, possession features, isDefensemanShooter and shooter roster position; speed_context_v3 adds speeds/rush distance. EXCLUDED: shooter identity/talent, goalie identity/talent, handedness and goalie catch hand (null in feature v1), F/D on-ice counts (null), shotEventType/missReasonBucket/isShortSideMiss (forbidden as leakage, baselineDataset.ts:241). Calibration: raw by default, Platt or isotonic optional (web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:46). Released artifact seasons not checked here (overlap: xG slice).
- **Outputs:** NhlShotFeatureRow (featureVersion 1)
- **Tables written:** nhl xG shot feature table via pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts
- **Input units:** feet, degrees, seconds, booleans, categorical strings
- **Output scale:** one feature row per eligible attempt (featureVersion 1)
- **Status:** live — built in-memory on the parity path (playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1078 buildShotFeatureRows); persisted feature job update-nhl-xg-shot-features exists (pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts) but its pg_cron SQL is commented out in tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:1645-1655 (manual/backfill only)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.test.ts`; `web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.test.ts`; `web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.test.ts`; `web/lib/xg/featureCoverage.test.ts`; `web/lib/xg/shotFeatureEnrichment.test.ts`; `web/lib/xg/deploymentContext.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** buildNstParityMetrics; playerStatsLandingServer.ts; scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts; scripts/run-nhl-xg-release-validation.ts

### NST-030 Coordinate normalization, shot distance and angle

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / shot geometry
- **Purpose:** Mirror raw rink coordinates to the attacking direction and compute distance/angle to the net at (89,0).
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.ts:37 (getTeamAttackingSide)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.ts:51 (normalizeCoordinatesToAttackingDirection)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:182 (computeShotDistanceFeet)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:192 (computeShotAngleDegrees)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.ts:49 (computeShotDistanceFeet duplicate)`
- **Inputs:** x_coord; y_coord; home_team_defending_side; event_owner_side
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events
- **Method:** Attacking side: home attacks opposite its defending side, away attacks the home defending side. If attacking 'left', negate x and y. Distance = sqrt((89-x)^2 + (0-y)^2) ft; angle = atan2(\|y\|, \|89-x\|) in degrees (0 = straight on). XG ROLE: x,y mirrored only when the owner attacks 'left' (both x and y negated); net fixed at (89,0); no rink-bias/scorekeeper adjustment (excluded); distance and angle are both trained-model features and fallback-bucket inputs.
- **Outputs:** normalizedX; normalizedY; shotDistanceFeet; shotAngleDegrees
- **Tables written:** nhl xG shot feature table
- **Input units:** NHL rink coordinates in feet (x -100..100, y -42.5..42.5)
- **Output scale:** normalized feet; distance feet; angle degrees 0-90
- **Status:** live — built in-memory on the parity path (playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1078 buildShotFeatureRows); persisted feature job update-nhl-xg-shot-features exists (pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts) but its pg_cron SQL is commented out in tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:1645-1655 (manual/backfill only)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNormalizedLayer.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** danger buckets; xG model; rebounds/rush/royal road
- **Reference standard:** Standard NHL rink coordinates (goal line x=89); MoneyPuck/EH distance-angle features
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - owner side drives mirroring, so blocked-shot coordinates (block location) and owner semantics both affect distance
  - shots from behind the net (x>89) get the same angle as in front because \|89-x\| is used
  - overlap: xG slice

### NST-031 Team-relative strength-state and split classification

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / strength state
- **Purpose:** Classify each event/time segment into all/EV/5v5/PP/PK/5v4/4v5/3v3/withEN/againstEN splits from the NHL situationCode.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlStrengthState.ts:24 (parseSituationCode)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlStrengthState.ts:64 (isEmptyNetSituation)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlStrengthState.ts:71 (classifyTeamStrengthState)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:654 (resolveTeamRelativeSituation)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:688 (matchesRelativeStrengthSplit)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:740 (getSplitKeysForTeamSituation)`
- **Inputs:** situation_code (4 digits awayGoalie,awaySkaters,homeSkaters,homeGoalie); teamId; homeTeamId; awayTeamId
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events (parsed NHL api-web play-by-play)
- **Method:** Parse situationCode digits. classifyTeamStrengthState: if either goalie=0 -> 'EN'; else equal skaters -> EV, more -> PP, fewer -> SH. Splits: ev = teamState EV; fiveOnFive = both goalies in and 5v5 skaters; pp = PP; pk = SH; fiveOnFourPP/fourOnFivePK require goalies in and exact 5v4/4v5; threeOnThree = goalies in and 3v3; withEmptyNet = own goalie 0; againstEmptyNet = opponent goalie 0. An event can belong to several splits; 'all' always added.
- **Outputs:** split keys per event/segment; strength_state (EV/PP/SH/EN); strength_exact 'AvH'
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** situationCode 4-digit string (goalie/skater counts)
- **Output scale:** categorical split keys; strength_state EV/PP/SH/EN; strength_exact 'awayvhome'
- **Status:** live — update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday pg_cron (09:35 UTC, active=true, tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382) -> pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts -> lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsSummaryRefresh.ts -> playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1066 buildPlayerStatsNativeGameParity -> buildNstParityMetrics; also read paths pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players*.ts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlStrengthState.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.test.ts`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlPlayByPlayParser.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** buildNstParityMetrics (all splits); nhlOnIceAttribution; nhlContextualFeatures (PP age); nhlPlayByPlayParser strength_state column
- **Reference standard:** Natural Stat Trick strength definitions (5v5 = both goalies in; EV = 5v5+4v4+3v3; PP/PK exclude empty-net; all situations includes EN)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - any pulled goalie maps to 'EN', so EV/PP/PK splits exclude all extra-attacker time (incl. delayed-penalty 6v5); matches NST EV but differs from NHL.com EV which counts by skater strength
  - strength_exact is formatted away-first ('awayvhome'), whereas NST/most sites report team-relative (e.g. 5v4 from PP team view); COMMON_MANPOWER_STATES in nhlEventInclusion uses the same away-first string
  - 'ev' requires equal skaters so 4v4 and 3v3 OT are EV (consistent with NST)

### NST-032 NST team count aggregation (CF%, xGF%, HDCF%, SCF%, SH%, SV%, PDO)

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / team aggregates
- **Purpose:** Aggregate dated NST team rows into season/period team shares via ratio of sums.
- **Where:** `web/lib/stats/percentUnits.ts:107 (aggregateNstTeamCounts)`
- **Inputs:** gp, toi (seconds), cf, ca, xgf, xga, hdcf, hdca, scf, sca, gf, ga, sf, sa
- **Source tables:** NST team per-date tables written by pages/api/Teams/nst-team-stats.ts (e.g. 5v5 rows)
- **Method:** Exclude rows with gp==0; games = sum gp (null if any unknown). CF%/xGF%/HDCF%/SCF% = sum for / (sum for + sum against) as fractions; SH% = sum GF / sum SF; SV% = 1 - sum GA / sum SA; PDO = SH% + SV% (1.000 scale); xGF/game, xGA/game = sum / games.
- **Outputs:** games; toiSeconds; goalsFor; goalsAgainst; cfPct; xgfPct; hdcfPct; scfPct; shootingPct; savePct; pdo; xgfPerGame; xgaPerGame
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** NST team per-date COUNTS (cf, ca, xgf, xga, hdcf, hdca, scf, sca, gf, ga, sf, sa), gp, toi in SECONDS; strength set by caller's table (5v5 in TeamDashboard)
- **Output scale:** shares as FRACTIONS 0-1 (ratio of sums); SH%/SV% fractions; PDO on 1.000 scale; xGF/xGA per game
- **Status:** live — TeamDashboard.tsx:199/:494, AdvancedL10Metrics.tsx:187/:228 (L10/L5), GameStateAnalysis.tsx:65
- **Tests:** `web/lib/stats/percentUnits.test.ts`; `web/components/TeamDashboard/AdvancedL10Metrics.test.tsx`
- **Consumers:** web/components/TeamDashboard/TeamDashboard.tsx:199 and :494 (5v5 season shares); web/components/TeamDashboard/AdvancedL10Metrics.tsx:187 and :228 (L10/L5); web/components/GameStateAnalysis/GameStateAnalysis.tsx:65
- **Reference standard:** Natural Stat Trick team on-ice definitions; PDO = on-ice SH% + SV%
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - PDO on 1.000 scale while NST displays PDO on ~100 scale - unit mismatch risk when compared to NST
  - strength state depends on caller's table (5v5 vs all); not enforced here
  - one missing count in any row nulls that metric for the whole sample

### NST-033 Strength segments and TOI by split (skater and goalie)

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / TOI
- **Purpose:** Derive per-player TOI (seconds) for each strength split by overlapping shift intervals with event-to-event strength segments.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:588 (buildStrengthSegments)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:906 (accumulateToiBySplit)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:989 (accumulateGoalieToiBySplit)`
- **Inputs:** parsed PbP events (period_seconds_elapsed, period_duration_seconds, situation_code, home_score, away_score); normalized shift intervals
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_pbp_events, nhl_api_shift_rows
- **Method:** Segments run from each included event's period_seconds_elapsed to the next included event's time in the same period (last segment ends at period_duration_seconds); each carries its situation and score. For each shift interval, overlap = min(end)-max(start) with each segment of the same game/period; overlap seconds added to every split the segment matches. 'all' TOI uses full shift durationSeconds when scoreState=allScores, otherwise only overlapped seconds passing the score filter. Goalie TOI same, restricted to goalieIds (goalies seen as goalieInNetId on shots).
- **Outputs:** toi (seconds) per player per split
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** seconds (period_seconds_elapsed, shift start/end/duration seconds)
- **Output scale:** TOI in SECONDS per player per split (not minutes)
- **Status:** live — update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday pg_cron (09:35 UTC, active=true, tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382) -> pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts -> lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsSummaryRefresh.ts -> playerStatsLandingServer.ts:1066 buildPlayerStatsNativeGameParity -> buildNstParityMetrics; also read paths pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players*.ts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlNstParityMetrics.test.ts`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsLandingServer.test.ts`; `web/lib/underlying-stats/playerStatsSummaryRefresh.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** per-60 rates and GAA in buildNstParityMetrics; playerStatsLandingServer.ts (buildPlayerStatsNativeGameParity)
- **Reference standard:** NST TOI by strength (shift-chart based, seconds)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 'all' TOI (full shift duration) and split TOI (segment overlap) use different bases, so sum of splits can differ from 'all' when segments have gaps (e.g. before first included event)
  - segment boundaries come from event timestamps, so strength changes between events (penalty expiry with no event) are assigned to the prior strength until the next event
  - goalieIds derived only from shot goalieInNetId; a goalie who faced no shots is treated as a skater and gets skater TOI/on-ice rows
  - O(intervals x segments) filter per interval; fine per game but costly for multi-game inputs

### NST-034 NHL-vs-legacy NST parity validation tolerances

- **Sub-family:** NST-derived stats / validation
- **Purpose:** Compare legacy NST gamelog rows to NHL-derived parity rows and classify mismatches for release.
- **Where:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlXgValidation.ts:125 (tolerance constants)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlXgValidation.ts:281 (getToleranceForMetric)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlXgValidation.ts:446 (compareLegacyAndNhlParitySample)`; `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlXgValidation.ts:564 (classifyParityMismatchForRelease)`
- **Inputs:** legacy NST row; new parity row
- **Source tables:** nst_gamelog_* tables (legacy), parity output
- **Method:** Exact metrics tolerance 1e-6; approximate metrics (xG, SC, HD/MD/LD, rush, rebound, gsaa, distances): pct/pdo/ipp 0.02, per-60/GAA/avg 0.25, xG 0.15, counts 1. Warnings for approximate drift; errors for exact drift unless family is on-ice (nst_gamelog_as_counts_oi/rates_oi), metric is toi, or an approved individual exact metric - then 'approved-exception'. XG ROLE: validation compares outputs only; xG metrics are 'close approximation' with absolute tolerance 0.15 goals and warnings never block release; no calibration check here (calibration lives in web/lib/xg/calibration.ts, excluded from this module).
- **Outputs:** mismatch list; passed flag; release disposition counts
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** metric values in each table's native units (percent scale of legacy NST not confirmed)
- **Output scale:** pass/warn/error per metric; release disposition counts
- **Status:** live (manual) — used only by scripts/run-nhl-xg-release-validation.ts; no route/cron
- **Tests:** `web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlXgValidation.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** scripts/run-nhl-xg-release-validation.ts
- **Reference standard:** Natural Stat Trick gamelog values
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - percent tolerance 0.02 is tiny if both sides are 0-100 and meaningless if legacy NST stores 0-1 - percent unit scale should be confirmed
  - every on-ice metric and TOI drift is auto-approved, so the gate cannot catch on-ice/TOI regressions
  - overlap: xG slice

Value = sum (total), sum/observed (per appearance), or per60 over games with both count and time (PP strength uses PP TOI). Refuses mixed strength/basis/window. 'higher' decided on printed values (equal printed = tie); totals not compared when sample sizes differ. NST row joined by player+date; duplicate dates join nothing; gp=0 rows skipped. Discussion summary counts sides of hand-picked posts but never claims consensus.
- **Outputs:** metric rows a/b value, shown, observed, expected, missing, admitted, higher; notes
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** counts; TOI seconds
- **Output scale:** totals, per appearance, per 60
- **Status:** live — share module playerVsPlayerModule
- **Tests:** `web/lib/socialShare/modules/playerVsPlayer.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/lib/socialShare/modules/lanes/comparison.ts; Player vs Player share card
- **Reference standard:** NST per-60 convention
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - per-appearance basis divides by observed (known) games, not window games, so missing games inflate per-game values
  - NST ixG/iSCF are NST-model values, joined by date_scraped which may differ from game date

### CARD-019 Player-card pooled NST metric (ATOI, per-60, percentage)

- **Sub-family:** Player cards & homepage stats / NST card metrics
- **Purpose:** Pool a player's selected appearance-window NST game rows into 12 card metrics using ratio-of-sums
- **Where:** `web/lib/player-cards/aggregation.ts:42 (pooledMetric)`; `web/lib/player-cards/aggregation.ts:62 (aggregateWindow)`; `web/lib/player-cards/registry.ts:10 (METRICS)`
- **Inputs:** individual.toi/shots/icf/iscfs/ixg/total_points/goals; onIce.toi/cf/scf/xgf/xga/gf/sf (seconds TOI); actual GP
- **Source tables:** nst_gamelog_{as\|es?\|pp}_counts, nst_gamelog_*_counts_oi (via nstCapture mapping)
- **Method:** Per metric: sum numerator components and denominator components over all selected games (ratio of sums). atoi = sum(individual.toi sec)/GP/60 (min/GP); per60 = 3600*sum(num)/sum(TOI sec) (individual metrics use individual.toi, on-ice metrics cf60/scf60/xgf60 use onIce.toi); percentage = 100*sum(num)/sum(den): xG% = xgf/(xgf+xga), IPP = total_points/onIce.gf, SH% = goals/shots, oiSH% = onIce.gf/onIce.sf. Per-game validation: any negative/missing component -> missing; per60 with zero TOI but events>0 -> missing; percentage num>den -> missing; pooled zero denominator -> state 'undefined'.

### LINE-003 fn refresh_player_lineup_deployment_tallies

- **Purpose:** Counts games each player spent in each forward line slot, D pair slot and PP unit; share within deployment group
- **Where:** `supabase/migrations/20260716112908_production_schema_baseline.sql:2866 (refresh_player_lineup_deployment_tallies)`; `web/supabase/migrations/20260629020121_create_player_lineup_deployment_tallies.sql:68 (original)`

PP: unit 1/2, one row per player-game (lowest unit). games = count distinct games; total_games = SUM(games) over (player,season,game_type,group); share = round(games/total_games,4). Regular season+playoffs (type 2,3).

### LINE-006 Social share deployment change (TOI/GP L5 vs season, line and PP unit step)

- **Purpose:** Classify skaters as deployment up/down from TOI change and line/PP-unit moves between the last two contiguous games.
- **Where:** `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:209 (trendShortlists deployment)`; `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:153 (ppEvidence)`; `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:172-173 (ppRank, step)`; `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:73 (MIN_DEPLOYMENT_TOI_DELTA_SECONDS=60)`
- **Inputs:** toi_seconds_avg_last5; toi_seconds_avg_season; line_combo_group; line_combo_slot; pp_unit; pp_toi_seconds_total_last5; pp_toi_seconds_avg_season; powerPlayCombinations unit; team_id; season_games_played
- **Source tables:** rolling_player_game_metrics, powerPlayCombinations
- **Method:** Qualifier GP >= 10. TOI delta = round(L5 avg TOI s) - round(season avg TOI s). Line bucket via normalizeEvDeploymentBucket; lineChange = step(now, before) = +1 if line number fell (promotion), -1 if rose, 0 if equal/unknown/different group. PP state: unit 1/2 from game's PP rows, 'none' if game has PP rows but player not in unit 1-2 (unit 3 = incidental), else rolling row pp_unit 1-2, else unknown; ppRank none=9; ppChange = step. Previous game used only if season GP steps by exactly 1 and same team. Driver = 'toi' if \|delta\| >= 60 s (direction = sign), else 'role' (requires a line or PP change, mixed signs dropped; direction = sign of lineChange+ppChange). Sort: any role change first, \|role\|, \|delta\|, id. PP L5 per game = pp_toi_total_last5/5. 4 rows each side.
- **Outputs:** up; driver; delta; lineChange; ppChange; pp.l5; pp.season; ev.l5; ev.season
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** TOI seconds per game; line/unit ordinals
- **Output scale:** seconds delta; -1/0/+1 steps; up/down flag
- **Status:** live — social-share edition trend layer (deployment section)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/socialShare/trends.test.ts`; `web/lib/socialShare/trendSources.test.ts`; `web/components/SocialShare/SocialShare.test.tsx`; `web/e2e/social-share.spec.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/lib/socialShare/server.ts (Tuesday trend layer of the social-share edition); web/components/SocialShare/SocialShare.tsx (Hot/Cold, Deployment, Rate, Movers cards)
- **Reference standard:** —

  - pp.l5 divides L5 PP total by a hard 5 regardless of PP appearances

### LINE-010 Shift-chart overlap, percent-TOI-with and greedy line/pair assignment

- **Purpose:** From NHL shifts, compute per-player PP/ES TOI, time and percent of game spent with each teammate, and assign 4 forward lines and 3 D pairs.
- **Where:** `web/pages/api/v1/db/shift-charts.ts:306 (sumDurations)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/shift-charts.ts:382 (getPairwiseTOI)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/shift-charts.ts:415 (generateTeamLogs)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/shift-charts.ts:880-990 (overlap loop)`
- **Inputs:** NHL shift chart rows (period, start/end mm:ss, duration); PBP-bound strength segments (lib/projections/ingest); game_length
- **Source tables:** NHL shiftcharts API, games, nhl_api_game_roster_spots, yahoo_positions
- **Method:** total_pp_toi / total_es_toi = sum of PP/ES segment durations. For each same-team teammate: overlap seconds = sum over same-period shift pairs of max(0, min(end)-max(start)); percent_toi_with = overlap / game length seconds * 100 (split same-position vs mixed). Lines: pivot = highest-TOI unused forward, add the 2 unused forwards with most time_spent_with pivot; repeat 4 times. Pairs: same with 1 partner, 3 times.
- **Outputs:** total_pp_toi; total_es_toi; time_spent_with; percent_toi_with; line_combination; pairing_combination
- **Tables written:** shift_charts, projection_game_materialization_status
- **Input units:** mm:ss clocks -> seconds

### LINE-011 Power-play unit assignment and PP time from play-by-play

Completeness check: player PP seconds >= 3 * team PP seconds else abort.
- **Outputs:** unit; PPTOI; percentageOfPP; pp_unit_usage_index; pp_unit_relative_toi; pp_vs_unit_avg; pp_share_of_team
- **Tables written:** powerPlayCombinations

### LINE-041 team_unit_toi 5v5 forward-line / D-pair pooled TOI

- **Sub-family:** Lines / TOI / PP units / unit TOI
- **Purpose:** Derive per-game 5v5 forward trios and D pairs with pooled player-seconds and rank them as units 1..N.
- **Where:** `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiBuilder.ts:264 (buildEvenStrengthTeamUnitToiRows)`; `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiBuilder.ts:218 (emitRankedRows)`; `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiBuilder.ts:94 (positionGroup)`
- **Inputs:** nhl_api_shift_rows start_seconds,end_seconds,period,team_id,player_id; players.position
- **Source tables:** nhl_api_shift_rows, players
- **Method:** Per game-period sweep over all shift boundaries; segment counted only when exactly two teams are active and each has 5 skaters (F or D, goalies excluded); a team's segment then needs exactly 3F+2D. forwardSeconds = duration*3, defenseSeconds = duration*2 credited to the sorted-id unit key and to the team pool. Units ranked by pooled seconds desc -> unit_number. coverage 'partial' if any skater position unclassified.
- **Outputs:** unit_type forward_line/defense_pair; unit_number; player_ids; unit_toi_seconds (pooled); team_unit_pool_toi_seconds; coverage_status
- **Tables written:** team_unit_toi
- **Input units:** seconds
- **Output scale:** pooled seconds; unit rank 1..N
- **Status:** live — pg_cron update-team-unit-toi-nightly 08:55 UTC (season=20262027&mode=nightly, max 40 games/run)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiBuilder.test.ts`; `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiNightly.test.ts`; `web/lib/rankings/teamUnitToiWriter.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/update-team-unit-toi.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/lib/rankings/trending.ts; web/lib/rankings/teamMatrix.ts; web/lib/rankings/availableFilters.ts; Rankings caveatLabels
- **Reference standard:** NST line/pair 5v5 TOI (clock seconds together), Evolving-Hockey line tools
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - unit_toi_seconds is pooled player-seconds (clock*3 for lines, *2 for pairs), not clock time; share = unit/pool is fine but absolute 'TOI' is 3x/2x NST line TOI
  - 5v5 detected from shift skater counts, not goalie presence; 5v5 with an empty net (6v5 minus a skater) or shift-feed gaps are misclassified
  - activeShiftsForSegment uses start<=s && end>=e so back-to-back shift boundaries are handled, but missing shifts silently drop segments (no unknown accounting)
  - cron route hard-codes season=20262027 in pg_cron URL

### LINE-042 team_unit_toi power-play units (from powerPlayCombinations)

- **Sub-family:** Lines / TOI / PP units / unit TOI
- **Purpose:** Write PP1/PP2/PP3 unit rows per team-game by summing player PPTOI within the stored PP unit label.

- **Outputs:** unit_type power_play; unit_number; unit_toi_seconds; team_unit_pool_toi_seconds
- **Tables written:** team_unit_toi

  - PPTOI pooled across 5v4, 5v3, 4v3 and 6v5-with-skater-advantage blocks

### WIGO-003 WiGO career and recent stat builder (STD/LY/3YA/CA, L5/L10/L20)

- **Purpose:** Compute WiGO period rows: per-season averages, ATOI, PP share, shooting, IPP, oiSH%, OZS% and per-60s for season periods and last 5/10/20 games.
- **Where:** `web/pages/api/v1/db/calculate-wigo-stats.ts:144 (safeDivide)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/calculate-wigo-stats.ts:153 (calculatePer60)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/calculate-wigo-stats.ts:160 (calculatePer60FromSeconds)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/calculate-wigo-stats.ts:607 (writePeriod)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/calculate-wigo-stats.ts:784-990 (recent intervals)`
- **Inputs:** wgo_skater_stats_totals (season); wgo_skater_stats (game: toi_per_game s, pp_toi, pp_toi_pct_per_game, G, A, A1, SOG, PPG/PPA/PPP, HIT, BLK, PIM); nst_seasonal_individual_counts / on_ice_counts; nst_gamelog_as_counts / _oi
- **Source tables:** wgo_skater_stats_totals, wgo_skater_stats, nst_seasonal_individual_counts, nst_seasonal_on_ice_counts, nst_gamelog_as_counts, nst_gamelog_as_counts_oi, players
- **Method:** Periods: STD=current season, LY=last season, 3YA=3 prior seasons, CA=all but current. Counts = per-season mean (sum/seasons). ATOI = sum TOI min / sum GP (WGO TOI, NST fallback). pp_pct GP-weighted mean of pp_toi_pct. pts1_pct = (G+A1)/PTS; s_pct = G/SOG; ipp = PTS/on-ice GF (NST); oi_sh_pct = GF/SF; ozs_pct = OZS/(OZS+DZS). Per-60 = count/(TOI_min/60); PP per-60 uses PP seconds. Recent L5/L10/L20: totals over last N games, ATOI = sum seconds/60/gp, pp_pct = unweighted mean of per-game pp_toi_pct, per-60 from seconds; metrics nulled when any game lacks TOI or the source field.
- **Outputs:** wigo_career std_/ly_/ya3_/ca_ columns; wigo_recent l5_/l10_/l20_ columns
- **Tables written:** wigo_career, wigo_recent
- **Input units:** WGO TOI seconds (game) / minutes (season-converted); NST TOI minutes (seasonal) and seconds (gamelog)
- **Output scale:** per-season averages, fractions 0-1, per-60 rates, ATOI minutes
- **Status:** live — route ledger calls=2; utils/fetchWigoPlayerStats.ts reads outputs
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/db/calculate-wigo-stats.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/utils/fetchWigoPlayerStats.ts (WiGO charts)
- **Reference standard:** NST per-60; IPP = points / on-ice GF
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - recent pp_pct is an unweighted mean of per-game PP shares while season pp_pct is GP-weighted (and neither is PP-TOI-weighted)
  - IPP mixes WGO points (all situations) with NST on-ice GF; strength match not verified
  - season counts are per-season averages for 3YA/CA but raw totals for L5/L10/L20 in the same UI family

- **Reference standard:** NST per-60 convention (count / TOI minutes * 60); pooled ratio estimators
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 3YA/CA counts are per-season averages while STD/LY are single-season totals and L5-L20 are window totals - mixed scales shown side by side (DIFF divides by GP to compensate)
  - recent pp_pct is an unweighted mean of per-game PP% while career pp_pct is GP-weighted
  - IPP numerator WGO points (all strengths) over NST on-ice GF (all strengths) - two providers
  - 3YA year arithmetic hard-codes the YYYYYYYY season id shape

### WIGO-013 WiGO player ratings (offense/defense/overall by strength)

- **Sub-family:** WiGO / ratings
- **Purpose:** Weighted composite of stat percentiles per strength (AS/ES/PP/PK) into 0-100 offense, defense and overall ratings.
- **Where:** `web/utils/calculateWigoRatings.ts:71 (calculatePlayerRatings)`; `web/utils/calculateWigoRatings.ts:22 (applyRegression)`; `web/components/WiGO/ratingWeights.ts:11 (RATING_WEIGHTS)`; `web/components/WiGO/ratingWeights.ts:95 (REGRESSION_CONFIG)`; `web/utils/fetchWigoRatingStats.ts:41 (fetchRawStatsForAllStrengths)`; `web/components/WiGO/PlayerRatingsDisplay.tsx:76`
- **Inputs:** per-60 rates and on-ice % per strength; gp; toi_seconds; cohortMinGp (UI slider)
- **Source tables:** nst_percentile_as/es/pp/pk_offense, nst_percentile_as/es/pk_defense
- **Method:** Per stat percentile (x100) vs cohort with gp >= cohortMinGp; withheld if < 20 peers (WIGO_RATING_MIN_COHORT_PEERS). If player GP < 10 at that strength: regressed = (GP*pct + (10-GP)*mean pct of peers with GP>=10)/10, clamped 0-100. Offense weights AS/ES: P/60 25, ixG/60 20, SOG/60 15, iSCF/60 10, iHDCF/60 10, xGF% 10, CF% 5, PEND/60 5; defense AS/ES: xGA/60 30, SCA/60 20, HDCA/60 15, BLK/60 10, TK/60 10, minor pen/60 5, GV/60 10 (lower better where noted); PP offense: GF/60 25, xGF/60 20, P/60 15, SCF/60 10, SOG/60 15, HDGF/60 10, PEND/60 5; PK defense: GA/60 25, xGA/60 20, SCA/60 15, SA/60 10, HDCA/60 10, BLK/60 10, TK/60 5. Rating = weighted mean of available percentiles. overall.as/es = mean(off,def); overall.st = PP-off and PK-def weighted by PP/PK TOI; final = mean(as, es, st).
- **Outputs:** offense{as,es,pp,pk}; defense{as,es,pp,pk}; overall{as,es,st,final}
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-60 rates; percent fields as stored by NST import
- **Output scale:** 0-100 rating
- **Status:** live — WiGO charts page (/wigoCharts)
- **Tests:** `web/utils/calculateWigoRatings.test.ts`; `web/utils/fetchWigoRatingStats.test.ts`; `web/components/WiGO/PlayerRatingsDisplay.test.tsx`
- **Consumers:** web/components/WiGO/PlayerRatingsDisplay.tsx (wigoCharts page)
- **Reference standard:** Percentile composite ratings (e.g. Evolving-Hockey RAPM/GAR as stronger alternative); Tango regression to the mean
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - overall.final averages AS, ES and ST although AS already contains ES and ST time - ES is double weighted
  - regression shrinks the percentile (not the rate) toward the mean percentile of >=10 GP peers (~50); GP is a poor reliability proxy vs TOI
  - on-ice CF%/xGF% are not relative-to-team; defense mixes on-ice suppression with individual counts (takeaways, giveaways) that are rink-biased
  - PK defense weights sum to 95 (normalized away)
  - higher-is-better TK/60 and BLK/60 placed in defense while GV/60 lower-is-better; blocks are fantasy-relevant but weak defensive signal

### GST-013 goalie_start_projections v2 (L10 start share + GSAA/60)

- **Sub-family:** Goalie starters & starter odds / start projections
- **Purpose:** Nightly per game-goalie start probability = last-10 team-game start share, plus season start %, GP and GSAA/60.
- **Where:** `web/pages/api/v1/db/update-goalie-projections-v2.ts:351-440 (handler loop)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/update-goalie-projections-v2.ts:158 (historicalGoalieTeams)`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/update-goalie-projections-v2.ts:133 (fetchCurrentGoalieTeams)`
- **Inputs:** NHL goalie/summary game logs by franchise (gamesStarted, gamesPlayed, saves, shotsAgainst, timeOnIce); rosters is_current
- **Source tables:** api.nhle.com/stats/rest/en/goalie/summary, games, rosters
- **Method:** For each game-team: logs with gameDate <= game date; L10 = last 10 distinct team game dates; start_probability = l10_start_pct = goalie starts in L10 / L10 dates; season_start_pct = starts / distinct season dates; GSAA = saves - 0.9*shots; GSAA/60 = GSAA/minutes*60 (TOI seconds/60). Goalies not on the team (current roster for today+, latest observed team historically) excluded and pruned. Processes from last projection date, up to 30 dates, endDate <= today+7.
- **Outputs:** start_probability; l10_start_pct; season_start_pct; games_played; projected_gsaa_per_60; confirmed_status=false
- **Tables written:** goalie_start_projections
- **Input units:** seconds (timeOnIce), counts
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1; GSAA per 60
- **Status:** live — pg_cron update-goalie-projections-v2 09:30 UTC
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/forge/goalies.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/start-chart.test.ts`; `web/lib/projections/goaliePipeline.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** FORGE goalie-stage priors (skater-stage.ts:3556); start-chart API goalie rows + mixtures; lineupSourceIngestion model goalie source; update-goalie-starter-mixtures
- **Reference standard:** Goalie usage studies (rest/B2B splits); MoneyPuck GSAx; NHL league SV% ~.900-.905
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - logs filter gameDate <= game.date includes the target game itself for completed games (leakage in historical rows)
  - league SV% hard-coded 0.9; GSAA uses all shots, no shot quality
  - no rest, back-to-back, workload or news inputs - pure L10 share; probabilities need not sum to 1 after excluded goalies
  - confirmed_status always false (never set by this writer)

### GST-016 FORGE starter probability model (computeStarterProbabilities)

- **Sub-family:** Goalie starters & starter odds / starter odds
- **Purpose:** Score each candidate goalie and convert to start probabilities (sigmoid for 2, softmax for 3).
- **Where:** `web/lib/projections/calculators/goalie-starter.ts:126 (computeStarterProbabilities)`; `web/lib/projections/constants/projection-weights.ts:3-25`; `web/lib/projections/stages/goalie-stage.ts:394-470`
- **Inputs:** L10 starts by goalie (forge_goalie_game, starter = max TOI per date); prior start prob (goalie_start_projections); line-combo goalie prior; projected GSAA/60; season start %; season GP; team/opponent goals-for; previous game date + starter; last played date
- **Source tables:** forge_goalie_game, games, goalie_start_projections, lineCombinations
- **Method:** score = 2.4*(L10share-0.5) + 0.7*logit(prior clamp .01-.99) + 0.45*logit(lineCombo prior clamp .05-.95) + 0.5*clamp(GSAA60,+-0.6) + 0.28*(seasonStart%-0.5)*GP/(GP+10) + 0.2*GP/(GP+10); B2B: starter of previous game -2.75, other goalie +0.65; B2B & team weaker (GF + 0.35 < opp GF): primary (L10share>=0.6) -1.1, backup +0.45; weak opponent (GF <= 2.6): primary -0.7, backup +0.3; rust: >75 d -6, >30 d -3, >14 d -0.8, <=7 d +0.2. Two candidates: p = clamp(sigmoid(diff), .02, .98); three: softmax clamped .01-.98 (not renormalized). One candidate -> 1.
- **Outputs:** probability per goalie; top-2 scenarios
- **Tables written:** forge_goalie_projections (via goalie stage)
- **Input units:** counts, days, goals/game, GSAA per 60
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1
- **Status:** live — FORGE run (run-forge-projections) goalie stage
- **Tests:** `web/lib/projections/module-imports.test.ts`; `web/lib/projections/runProjectionV2.test.ts`; `web/lib/projections/goaliePipeline.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** FORGE goalie stage -> starter board / start chart (serving flag); RSO, player forecasts
- **Reference standard:** Goalie usage studies (B2B starter rates ~10-20% for repeat starter); Daily Faceoff confirmations; logistic starter models
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - L10 share enters twice - directly (2.4*) and via goalie_start_projections prior (which is itself the L10 share)
  - 'starter' in L10 context is max-TOI goalie, so relief-heavy games credit the backup
  - 3-candidate softmax clamps after normalization so probabilities may not sum to 1; uncalibrated heuristic weights (doc status 'heuristic probability')
  - line-combo prior counts every listed goalie in lineCombinations (both dressed goalies) with decay 0.82 - may be near-uninformative

### GST-017 Starter candidate selection + scenario blend

- **Sub-family:** Goalie starters & starter odds / starter odds
- **Purpose:** Choose up to 3 candidate goalies, form top-2 normalized scenarios, and blend goalie outputs by start probability with residual mass.
- **Where:** `web/lib/projections/calculators/goalie-starter.ts:76 (selectStarterCandidateGoalieIds)`; `web/lib/projections/calculators/goalie-starter.ts:245 (buildTopStarterScenarios)`; `web/lib/projections/calculators/goalie-starter.ts:27 (blendTopStarterScenarioOutputs)`
- **Inputs:** raw candidate ids (projections, line combos, recent starters, fallback); current team goalies; starts, prior prob, confirmed, last played
- **Source tables:** players, forge_goalie_game, goalie_start_projections
- **Method:** Exclude non-roster and >75 days unplayed; rank score = 100 override + 25 confirmed + 10*prior + 1.5*L10 starts - min(days,120)/30; keep 3. Scenarios: top-2 probabilities renormalized to sum 1. Blend: sum w*metric over scenarios + (1 - sum w)*fallback for SA, saves, GA, win, shutout, SV%.
- **Outputs:** candidateGoalieIds; scenarios; blended goalie projection
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** —
- **Output scale:** probabilities 0-1
- **Status:** live — FORGE goalie stage
- **Tests:** `web/lib/projections/module-imports.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** goalie stage
- **Reference standard:** Mixture expectation
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - top-2 renormalization discards third-goalie mass for scenario probabilities

### GST-018 Goalie starter mixture (B2B adjust, normalize, confidence, staleness)

- **Sub-family:** Goalie starters & starter odds / starter odds
- **Purpose:** Turn goalie_start_projections rows into adjusted/normalized start probabilities with confidence and stale flags.
- **Where:** `web/lib/projections/goalieStarterMixtures.ts:111 (buildGoalieStarterMixtureRows)`; `web/lib/projections/goalieStarterMixtures.ts:93 (confidenceFor)`; `web/lib/projections/goalieStarterMixtures.ts:238 (buildGoalieStarterBranchProjectionRows)`; `web/pages/api/v1/start-chart.ts:1539`; `web/pages/api/v1/db/update-goalie-starter-mixtures.ts`
- **Inputs:** start_probability; confirmed_status; updated_at; manual overrides; previous starters; B2B game-teams

- **Method:** Manual override -> 1/0; conflicting evidence (>1 confirmed, duplicate ids, out-of-range, sum > 1) -> 0; confirmed -> 1/count; B2B and previous starter -> p*0.65; normalized = p / max(1, mass) (missing mass kept as residual); confidence high if confirmed or p>=0.8, low if stale >= 36 h, medium if stale >= 12 h or p>=0.6, else low. Branch rows weight SA/saves/GA/win/shutout by branch probability.
- **Outputs:** normalized_start_probability; source_confidence; is_stale; is_hard_stale; residual_probability_mass

- **Consumers:** web/pages/api/v1/start-chart.ts (goalie start_probability shown when not revisionMode)

### DRF-005 Social share rostered-% movers (Yahoo ownership pp change)

- **Purpose:** Rank players by percentage-point change in Yahoo rostered % between the latest observation and one on/before 5 days earlier.
- **Where:** `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:231-247 (trendShortlists movers)`; `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:74-85 (MOVER_WINDOW_DAYS=5, MIN_MOVER_POINTS=1, MOVER_CANDIDATES=30, OWNERSHIP_MAX_AGE_DAYS=1)`; `web/lib/socialShare/trends.ts:283 (ownershipSeriesDates)`
- **Inputs:** ownership_pct; ownership_date; player_key; player_id; yahoo_nhl_player_map
- **Source tables:** yahoo ownership timeline rows, yahoo_nhl_player_map, rolling_player_game_metrics
- **Method:** latestDate = newest ownership date; previousDate = newest date <= latestDate - 5 days. Values must be 0..100. Both rounded to 0.1 before differencing; delta = latest - previous (0.1). Keep \|delta\| >= 1 pp; missing previous observation = no mover (not 0%). ### DRF-008 Mock draft ADP aggregation (mock_draft_adp RPC)

ADP and quantiles NULL unless contributors >= 5. 30-day rolling window; cohort = canonical JSON of league settings (teamCount, roster, scoring); sorted by ADP nulls last; 50/page.

### DRF-018 Community draft rankings: regularized Bradley-Terry with ADP prior

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP)
- **Purpose:** Aggregate users' pairwise preferences into a public community top-250.
- **Where:** `web/lib/draft-ranker/communityModel.ts:196 (computeCommunityRanking)`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/communityModel.ts:120 (priorScore), :126 (stabilityBuffer), :139 (deduplicateCommunityPreferences)`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/communityServer.ts:197-215 (market rank = prior Yahoo ADP)`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/communityServer.ts:348 (publicRanks)`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/communityServer.ts:417-470 (persist, rank_delta)`
- **Inputs:** pair preferences (latest per user+pair, consent/moderation filtered); candidates with marketRank = prior-season Yahoo preseason_average_pick (fallback average_draft_pick, min across mapped keys)
- **Source tables:** draft_ranker_pair_preferences, draft_ranker_pair_comparisons, draft_ranker_contribution_preferences, draft_ranker_community_moderation_exclusions, yahoo_players (prior season), fhfh_player_external_identities, fhfh_player_identities
- **Method:** Scores s_i, prior mean m_i = ln((F+1-r)/r) for market rank r (F = field size), 0 if unranked. Market prior weight = 4*max(0, 1-independentUsers/20). Objective: Bradley-Terry log-likelihood with P(i beats j)=sigmoid(s_i-s_j) - 0.25/2*s^2 (L2) - w_i/2*(s_i-m_i)^2. Diagonal (Jacobi) Newton: delta = clamp(0.5*grad/curvature, +/-1), up to 500 iters, tol 1e-8; must converge. Evidence states: emerging (>=5 users, >=10 comparisons, >=5 opponents), established (>=20 users, >=40 comparisons, >=10 opponents, >=2 opponents ranked 200-250 and >=2 ranked 251-300). stabilityBuffer = ceil(30/sqrt(users)+40/sqrt(comparisons)+10/sqrt(opponents)) (75 with no comparisons); conservativeRank = modelRank + buffer. Public top-250: market rank <=250 and not established (market prior), OR established and conservativeRank <= 250; renumbered 1..250 by model rank. rank_delta = previousPublicRank - publicRank.
- **Outputs:** model_rank; public_rank; model_score; market_prior_weight; evidence_state; confidence_label; stability_buffer_ranks; conservative_rank; rank_delta
- **Tables written:** draft_ranker_community_snapshots, draft_ranker_community_player_results
- **Input units:** pairwise outcomes (binary); ADP pick numbers
- **Output scale:** latent score (log-odds scale); ranks 1..N; public rank 1..250
- **Status:** live — community snapshot job (draft-ranker community route)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/draft-ranker/communityModel.test.ts`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/communityRedTeam.test.ts`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/communityServer.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** components/DraftRanker/CommunityRankingsPage.tsx; lib/draft-ranker/communityReadServer.ts; lib/draft-ranker/exportServer.ts
- **Reference standard:** Bradley-Terry / Elo-style paired comparison models with Gaussian prior (e.g. Glicko/TrueSkill shrinkage); Hunter MM algorithm
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - each user's comparisons count individually, so one prolific user can dominate likelihood (independentUsers only gates labels and prior decay)
  - priorScore uses ADP as a rank directly (fractional ADP), and field size includes ceil(max ADP)
  - cutoffOpponentsInside counts ranks 200-250 only (not the whole top-250)
  - Jacobi updates with fixed 0.5 damping may converge slowly; non-convergence throws

### DRF-019 Draft Ranker discovery signals: projection consensus gap, ownership risers, opportunity change

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP)
- **Purpose:** Surface players whose projections, ownership or role outpace market ADP.
- **Where:** `web/lib/draft-ranker/discovery.ts:158 (buildProjectionConsensus)`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/discovery.ts:251 (buildProjectionBackedSignals)`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/discovery.ts:330 (buildOwnershipRiserSignals)`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/discovery.ts:413 (buildOpportunityChangeSignals)`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/discovery.ts:500 (deriveOwnerRelativeDiscovery)`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/discoveryServer.ts:289-390 (opportunity candidates)`
- **Inputs:** projection rank observations per source; prior ADP evidence; Yahoo ownership timeline; forge_roster_events; prior-season team
- **Source tables:** yahoo_players_with_normalized_history, fhfh_player_external_identities, fhfh_player_identities, forge_roster_events, nhl_api_game_roster_spots, seasons
- **Method:** Consensus rank = MEDIAN of per-source projection ranks (>=2 sources; conflicting duplicates drop the source). projection_gap if priorADP - consensus >= 25 (score = gap). previously_undrafted if consensus <= 300 (score = 301 - consensus). Ownership riser: latest vs point ~7 days earlier (gap 6-10 days, latest <=2 days old in season / 7 offseason); qualifies if delta >= 5 pp or >= top-decile (ceil(0.9n)-th) of positive deltas. Opportunity: verified event types with confidence >= 0.75 and unexpired, or team change; deployment share gain >= 0.15; score = max(rankGain, shareGain*100). Owner-relative: personalRank - consensusRank >= 25 -> cutoff_challenger if personal rank 251-275 else projection_gap.
- **Outputs:** discovery signals {signal_type, score, reason}
