### DRF-020 Draft Ranker assisted placement: binary-search rank interval engine

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP)
- **Purpose:** Place a new player in a personal ranking with pairwise questions.
- **Where:** `web/lib/draft-ranker/placementEngine.ts:64 (initialPlacementInterval)`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/placementEngine.ts:116 (finish)`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/placementEngine.ts:233 (issueNextPlacementAnchor)`; `web/lib/draft-ranker/placementEngine.ts:288 (answerPlacementEngine)`
- **Inputs:** roughRange bucket; ranked entries; answers target_over_anchor\|anchor_over_target\|too_close\|skip
- **Source tables:** draft_ranking_entries (via hooks/useDraftPlacement)
- **Method:** Initial interval by bucket (top_50 [1,50], 51-100, ..., outside_250 [251,N+1], unsure [1,N+1]). Ask the anchor nearest the interval midpoint; target_over_anchor -> high=min(high, rank); anchor_over_target -> low=max(low, rank+1); too_close -> [rank, rank+1]. When width<=1, validate ranks suggested-1, suggested and 250/251 cutoff; contradiction -> one retry then finish broadened. suggestedRank = floor((low+high)/2); plausible width +/-4 (<=100), 7 (<=200), 10 otherwise when broadened; confidence developing if contradictions, strong if >=5 questions else moderate. Cap 12 questions (16 with contradictions).
- **Outputs:** suggestedRank; plausibleLow/High; confidence
- **Tables written:** draft_ranking_entries/events (on confirm)
- **Input units:** rank positions
- **Output scale:** rank 1..N
- **Status:** live — Draft Ranker
- **Tests:** `web/lib/draft-ranker/placementEngine.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** components/DraftRanker/AssistedPlacementPanel.tsx
- **Reference standard:** Binary insertion sort / noisy binary search
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - confidence labels are heuristic counts, not probabilistic

### DRF-023 aggregateTeamCategoryTotals / rankTeamCategories / categoryRankBand

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP)
- **Purpose:** Team category totals without averaging rates, and per-category standings ranks.
- **Where:** `web/lib/draftDashboard/categoryStandings.ts:122 (aggregateTeamCategoryTotals)`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/categoryStandings.ts:58 (ratioAggregate), :88 (weightedRateAggregate)`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/categoryStandings.ts:242 (categoryRankBand)`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/categoryStandings.ts:255 (rankTeamCategories)`
- **Inputs:** drafted players' projected stats; categories
- **Source tables:** in-memory
- **Method:** Counting categories: sum. Rates exact from summed parts when all inputs present: SV% = sum saves/sum SA (SA = SAVES+GA fallback); GAA = sum GA/sum TOTAL_TOI*3600; S% = G/SOG; FO% = FOW/(FOW+FOL); TOI/G = sum TOTAL_TOI/sum GP. Otherwise 'estimated' workload-weighted mean of the rate (SV% by SA; GAA by starts then appearances; S% by SOG; FO% by attempts; TOI by GP); any invalid input -> unavailable. Ranks: competition ranking (ties share rank) ascending/descending by higherIsBetter (points league negative weights invert). Band: percentile=(N-rank+1)/N*100: <=25 red, <=50 orange, <=75 yellow, else green.
- **Outputs:** {value, quality}; rank per team/category; colour band
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** season totals; TOI seconds
- **Output scale:** totals; SV% fraction; GAA goals/60; rank 1..N
- **Status:** live
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/components/DraftDashboard/GodView.test.tsx`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/draftWorkflow.integration.test.tsx`; `web/__tests__/components/DraftDashboard/LeagueStandings.test.tsx`
- **Consumers:** LeagueStandings; DraftDashboard teamStats; GodView
- **Reference standard:** Roto/H2H category standings conventions
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - GAA ratio assumes TOTAL_TOI in seconds

### DRF-025 buildPositionTiers / advisePosition: 1-D k-means positional tiers + take-now advice

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP)
- **Purpose:** Automatic value tiers per position and Take now / Can wait advice.
- **Where:** `web/lib/draftDashboard/positionalTiers.ts:14 (cluster)`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/positionalTiers.ts:81 (buildPositionTiers)`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/positionalTiers.ts:93 (remainingBands)`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/positionalTiers.ts:102 (advisePosition)`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/tierDashboardAdapter.ts:11 (buildDashboardTiers)`
- **Inputs:** per-position player values (buildPlayerValues); ADP; horizon; spread; onClock/openSlot
- **Source tables:** projection source tables configured in lib/projectionsConfig/projectionSourcesConfig.ts (e.g. projections_* per source), yahoo_players (average_draft_pick, percent_drafted, eligible_positions), yahoo_nhl_player_map / yahoo player map, current-season actual stats tables (ACTUAL_STATS_COLUMN_MAP)
- **Method:** Values min-max scaled to 0..1; exact contiguous 1-D k-means (DP on prefix sums), k=2..min(8,unique,n-1), best k by mean silhouette (neighbour-group 1-D silhouette); n<4 -> one band. Then recursively split any band wider than 0.05 of the scaled range at its min-SSE boundary. Tied values never split. breakThreshold = max(3*median adjacent gap, 0.25*IQR). Remaining band gap = last remaining in band minus first remaining in next non-empty band; meaningfulBreak if gap > breakThreshold. Advice: expected = sum availability over remaining band players; 'Can wait' if opposingPicks=0 or expected>=1.5 (and gap known); 'Take now' if expected<0.5 and meaningfulBreak. Tier adapter nulls values whose required inputs (SV% needs SA>0, GAA needs starts) are incomplete.
- **Outputs:** bands {tier,players,min,max}; breakThreshold; advice label + expected count
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** fantasy points or z-score sum; ADP pick numbers
- **Output scale:** tier index 1..N; expected remaining count (players)
- **Status:** live — Draft Pro tiers tab (gated) and mock draft pro bots
- **Tests:** `web/lib/draftDashboard/positionalTiers.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/components/DraftDashboard/SuggestedPicks.test.tsx`
- **Consumers:** SuggestedPicks tiers tab / TierCards; mockDraft engine (pro tier scarcity)
- **Reference standard:** Jenks natural breaks / 1-D k-means tiering (e.g. Boris Chen Gaussian-mixture tiers)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - 5%-of-range band width cap is a product heuristic that can override silhouette-optimal clustering
  - thresholds 1.5 / 0.5 expected players are heuristics

### DRF-027 calculateSourceAccuracy: projection source accuracy (mean normalized abs error)

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP)
- **Purpose:** Rank projection sources by error vs actuals.
- **Where:** `web/lib/draftDashboard/sourceAccuracy.ts:21 (calculateSourceAccuracy)`
- **Inputs:** per-source contributing values; actual stats; projected/actual GP
- **Source tables:** projection source tables configured in lib/projectionsConfig/projectionSourcesConfig.ts (e.g. projections_* per source), yahoo_players (average_draft_pick, percent_drafted, eligible_positions), yahoo_nhl_player_map / yahoo player map, current-season actual stats tables (ACTUAL_STATS_COLUMN_MAP)
- **Method:** For every stat (excluding GP) and source: normalizedError += \|proj-actual\| / max(\|actual\|, 0.01); 'perGame' mode divides counting stats by source projected GP and actual GP (rate stats by regex PER_GAME\|PER_60\|AVERAGE\|PERCENTAGE\|_PCT\|RATE untouched). meanError% = sum/matched*100; accuracy = clamp(100-meanError, 0, 100); coverage = matched/projected*100.
- **Outputs:** SourceAccuracyRow
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** season totals or per-game
- **Output scale:** percent 0-100
- **Status:** live
- **Tests:** `web/lib/draftDashboard/sourceAccuracy.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** components/DraftDashboard/ProjectionSourceAccuracy.tsx
- **Reference standard:** Forecast accuracy metrics (MAPE / sMAPE / MAE)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - dividing by max(\|actual\|,0.01) explodes errors on near-zero actuals (e.g. 0 SHG -> 1/0.01*proj = huge), dominating the mean
  - all stats equally weighted regardless of fantasy relevance; accuracy floors at 0 quickly

### DRF-029 calculateWeightedProjection / source shares: multi-source projection blend

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP)
- **Purpose:** Blend projections from several selected sources with user weights.
- **Where:** `web/lib/draftDashboard/sourceWeights.ts:40 (calculateWeightedProjection)`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/sourceWeights.ts:3 (getEffectiveSourceShares), :21 (normalizeSourceWeights), :60 (equalizeSourceWeights)`; `web/hooks/useProcessedProjectionsData.tsx:1080-1137 (per-stat blend)`; `web/hooks/useProjectionSourceAnalysis.ts:84 (setWeight clamp 0..2), :100 (effectiveShares duplicate)`
- **Inputs:** per-source parsed stat values; sourceControls {isSelected, weight}

- **Method:** Per stat: weighted mean = sum(value*w)/sum(w) over selected sources with finite value and w>0; sources missing the player/stat are skipped (implicit renormalization). Shares = w/sum(selected w); normalize rounds shares to 3 decimals; equalize sets 1/count. Weights clamped 0..2 in UI hook (MIN_ENABLED_WEIGHT 0.1).
- **Outputs:** combinedStats[stat].projected; projectedDetail.contributingSources; effective shares
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** source-native units (totals; SV% fraction; TOI as parsed)
- **Output scale:** same units as inputs
- **Status:** live

- **Consumers:** useProcessedProjectionsData -> all draft valuation; ProjectionSourceSettings UI
- **Reference standard:** Projection aggregation (FantasyPros-style weighted consensus)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - rate stats (SV%, GAA, TOI/G) are averaged across sources unweighted by each source's volume (e.g. SV% not recomputed from blended saves/SA)
  - per-stat renormalization means a player's G and A can come from different source mixes (internally inconsistent stat lines, e.g. P != G+A)
  - duplicate share logic in useProjectionSourceAnalysis.ts and sourceWeights.ts

### DRF-031 Mock draft bot pick model (decide): utility score + softmax sampling

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP)
- **Purpose:** Simulate opponent picks in mock drafts with personalities.
- **Where:** `web/lib/mockDraft/engine.ts:169 (decide)`; `web/lib/mockDraft/engine.ts:46 (tuning)`; `web/lib/mockDraft/engine.ts:53 (random seeded RNG)`; `web/lib/mockDraft/engine.ts:142 (makeRoom)`; `web/lib/mockDraft/engine.ts:414 (delayMs)`
- **Inputs:** session players {value, adp, positions, categories, workload}; picks; bots {personality, position, variation}; config tier/leagueType/roster/teamCount
- **Source tables:** frozen projection pool (freezePlayers), components/DraftDashboard/mock-sleepers-value-list.json (Contrarian research)
- **Method:** range = max(1, top value - value at rank teamCount*3). score = (v - top)/range + 0.15*(v - baseline_pos)/range [baseline = value at index roster_pos*teamCount-1 in full pool] - max(0, ADP - pick)/(teamCount*(Vanilla?1:4)) + (needed ? (Conservative 0.65 : 0.28) : -0.25) - 0.25*max(0, heldAtPos - slots). Pro: + scarcity*0.22*min(2, planningWait/teamCount) where scarcity = max(0, v - replacement_value)/range and replacement = available player at index round(demand) (demand = sum over opponents picking before my next turn of 1 if they still need the position else 0.25); + min(0.3, gap/range) if needed and a meaningful tier break is nearly exhausted; categories weakness bonus clamp(+/-0.2, 0.04*sum cat_k/(1+held_k)). Free: + min(0.15, 0.08*scarcity). Personalities: Zero-G -1.5*max(0,0.9-progress) for G; Fade -0.65*(1-progress) at position; Reach +0.5+0.3*scarcity; Hero-G +min(0.9, workload/70)*(games?0.6:1); BPA +0.4*(v-top)/range; Contrarian + (0.4*positive - 0.6 fade\|0.3 bust)*confidence(1/0.7/0.4). Shortlist (6, Aggressive pro 10) from plausible (rank<2T or ADP<=pick+2T or needed&scarcity>0.2) that keep rosters completable (max-flow feasibility). Turn planning (pro, consecutive picks): +0.3*max(next best + 0.35 if fits open slot). Choice ~ softmax(score/temperature), temperature 0.08 (Vanilla/BPA) else 0.13 (+0.22 Aggressive) + 0.04*variation; seeded FNV/mulberry RNG.
- **Outputs:** BotDecision {playerId, reasons, shortlist scores}
- **Tables written:** mock_draft_events (via mock_draft_ingest, only human picks contribute to ADP)
- **Input units:** value in FP or z units; ADP picks
- **Output scale:** dimensionless score; pick probabilities via softmax
- **Status:** live — mock drafts (lib/mockDraft/flags.ts gates)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/mockDraft/engine.test.ts`; `web/hooks/useMockDraft.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** hooks/useMockDraft.ts; components/DraftDashboard/MockDraftWorkspace.tsx
- **Reference standard:** Opponent modelling in draft simulators (ADP-based pick probability / softmax over value)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - many magic constants (0.28, 0.22, 0.15, 0.25, 0.65, 70-start workload, temperatures) without calibration
  - ADP penalty only punishes reaching (ADP > pick) - no bonus for fallers beyond value term
  - category 'weakness' uses per-category z-values that may be negative; held totals clamped at 0

### DRF-032 DraftDashboard roster needs: posNeeds, catNeeds, teamVorp, team projected points, picksUntilNext

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) \| Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
- **Purpose:** Derive per-team totals and my-team needs feeding recommendations and standings.
- **Where:** `web/components/DraftDashboard/DraftDashboard.tsx:2232 (picksUntilNext)`; `web/components/DraftDashboard/DraftDashboard.tsx:2464-2523 (teamStats: projectedPoints, teamVorp, categoryTotals)`; `web/components/DraftDashboard/DraftDashboard.tsx:2534 (posNeeds)`; `web/components/DraftDashboard/DraftDashboard.tsx:2616 (catNeeds)`
- **Inputs:** draftSettings; draftedPlayers; keepers; pickTrades; draftOrderPattern; vorpMetrics; allPlayers
- **Source tables:** in-memory draft state
- **Method:** picksUntilNext = findPicksUntilTeamTurn over draft order/trades/keepers (span teamCount*max(2,rosterSlots)); returns teamCount if my team absent. Team projectedPoints = sum projected FP of drafted players; teamVorp = sum VORP; categoryTotals via aggregateTeamCategoryTotals. posNeeds_p = min(1, (slots_p - filled_p)/max(1,slots_p)). catNeeds_k = max(0, leagueMean_k - myTotal_k) for HARD-CODED keys G, A, PPP, SOG, HIT, BLK.
- **Outputs:** picksUntilNext; teamStats[]; posNeeds; catNeeds
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** counts / fantasy points / picks

- **Consumers:** useVORPCalculations (picksUntilNext); SuggestedPicks / usePlayerRecommendations (needs); LeagueStandings; DraftSummaryModal
- **Reference standard:** Classic VBD (Joe Bryant, footballguys 'Value Based Drafting': value minus baseline player at position); VORP (Baseball Prospectus-style value over replacement, replacement = first non-starter at T*starters+1); VONA (Value Over Next Available, e.g. Draft Buddy/Fantasy Football Calculator: best at position now minus best expected at your next pick); VOLS (value over last starter, baseline = T*starters-th player); Man-games baseline (Lammey/Dodds 100/120-pick baseline) as alternative
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - catNeeds keys are hard-coded to six skater categories regardless of the league's categories (goalie categories never produce need)
  - catNeeds are raw count deficits (hits ~ hundreds vs PPP ~ tens) - unstandardized, so high-volume categories dominate category fit
  - teamVorp sums VORP against a moving 'remaining' replacement baseline

### DRF-035 useVORPCalculations: VORP / VOLS / VONA / VBD per player

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) \| Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
- **Purpose:** Compute league-wide draft value over replacement (VORP), over last starter (VOLS), over next available (VONA) and the blended VBD rank value for every projected player.
- **Where:** `web/hooks/useVORPCalculations.ts:67 (useVORPCalculations)`; `web/hooks/useVORPCalculations.ts:125-136 (replacement indices)`; `web/hooks/useVORPCalculations.ts:166-181 (expectedTaken / next-turn depletion)`; `web/hooks/useVORPCalculations.ts:211-253 (best position, VONA, VBD)`
- **Inputs:** players (full pool); availablePlayers (undrafted); draftSettings.teamCount, rosterConfig incl. utility; picksUntilNext; leagueType points\|categories; baselineMode remaining\|full; categoryWeights; forwardGrouping split\|fwd; myFilledSlots + personalizeReplacement; prorate84; fantasyPointSettings; positionWeightMultipliers; player.yahooAvgPick (ADP)
- **Source tables:** projection source tables configured in lib/projectionsConfig/projectionSourcesConfig.ts (e.g. projections_* per source), yahoo_players (average_draft_pick, percent_drafted, eligible_positions), yahoo_nhl_player_map / yahoo player map, current-season actual stats tables (ACTUAL_STATS_COLUMN_MAP)
- **Method:** (1) REPLACEMENT LEVEL: per roster position p (C/LW/RW/D/G, or FWD/D/G when grouped; +FWD pool when rosterConfig.FWD>0) with T=teamCount and starters s_p (minus my filled slots when personalizeReplacement): VORP index = floor(T*(s_p + utilAdj_p) + 1) - 1 = T*(s_p+utilAdj_p) (0-based, i.e. the first player beyond league starters); VOLS index = floor(T*s_p) - 1 (the last league starter). UTIL slots are split 1/3 each to C/LW/RW (UTIL_TO_DEF_ENABLED=false so D gets 0); in 'fwd' grouping UTIL goes wholly to FWD. Bench slots are NOT counted (not handled). Goalies get no UTIL share. Replacement pool = remaining (available) players by default or full pool when baselineMode='full'; index clamped to pool length-1; empty pool -> replacement 0. (2) VALUE SOURCE: buildPlayerValues -> points leagues: projected fantasy points (source-weighted projection x league scoring; optional 84-game proration for skaters); categories leagues: sum of weighted z-scores from calculateCategoryScores. Optional Draft Pro position weight multiplier (0..2) applied to the value before pools. (3) VONA: N = floor(picksUntilNext); take the N available players with lowest Yahoo ADP (players without ADP ignored); each contributes 1/k to each of its k eligible positions -> expectedTaken_p. Baseline = value at index floor(currentIndexOfPlayerInAvailablePool_p + expectedTaken_p) in that position's available pool (or index floor(expectedTaken_p) if the player is not in the pool); VONA = value - baseline. Assumes opponents draft strictly by ADP; ignores opponent roster needs. (4) VBD = 0.6*VORP + 0.3*VONA + 0.1*VOLS (dashboard-specific blend; classic VBD uses one baseline). (5) MULTI-POSITION: eligibility normalized (F/FWD -> C,LW,RW); a player appears in every eligible pool; reported metrics come from the eligible position with max VORP (ties broken by VONA then VOLS) - not summed. Positional scarcity enters only through per-position replacement depth.
- **Outputs:** playerMetrics Map<id,{value,unweightedValue,vorp,vols,vona,vbd,bestPos,eligible}>; replacementByPos {vorp,vols}; expectedTakenByPos; expectedN
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** value: fantasy points (season totals; 84-game pace if prorate84) or dimensionless z-score sum; picksUntilNext in picks; ADP in overall pick number
- **Output scale:** VORP/VOLS/VONA/VBD in same units as value (fantasy points or z-score sum), unbounded, can be negative
- **Status:** live — used by DraftDashboard (pages/draft-dashboard) for every table/recommendation
- **Tests:** `web/hooks/useVORPCalculations.test.tsx`; `web/__tests__/components/DraftDashboard/DraftDashboardRecovery.test.tsx`; `web/__tests__/components/DraftDashboard/DraftRetention.test.tsx`; `web/lib/draft-pro/scenarioDashboardAdapter.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** components/DraftDashboard/DraftDashboard.tsx (vorpMetrics, personalized metrics); ProjectionsTable, SuggestedPicks, MyRoster, DraftBoard, LeagueStandings, DraftSummaryModal; hooks/usePlayerRecommendations.ts; lib/draft-pro/scenarioDashboardAdapter.ts, reportDashboardAdapter.ts (globalVorp)
- **Reference standard:** Classic VBD (Joe Bryant, footballguys 'Value Based Drafting': value minus baseline player at position); VORP (Baseball Prospectus-style value over replacement, replacement = first non-starter at T*starters+1); VONA (Value Over Next Available, e.g. Draft Buddy/Fantasy Football Calculator: best at position now minus best expected at your next pick); VOLS (value over last starter, baseline = T*starters-th player); Man-games baseline (Lammey/Dodds 100/120-pick baseline) as alternative
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - VONA baseline index = player's own index + expectedTaken, so with expectedTaken=0 the top player compares against himself (VONA 0); classic VONA compares to the best player expected at the NEXT pick (own index+1+taken) - possible off-by-one
  - expectedTaken counts the player himself if he is in the top-N ADP list
  - bench slots ignored and UTIL split equally 1/3 to C/LW/RW regardless of positional depth; D never receives UTIL share
  - baselineMode 'remaining' moves replacement level as the draft proceeds, so 'VORP' is a moving target (differs from classic static VBD)
  - VBD blend 0.6/0.3/0.1 is a magic constant; VBD includes VONA which depends on ADP availability, so non-ADP players get understated VONA
  - clamp() helper defined but unused (dead code)
  - VONA uses floor of fractional expectedTaken (e.g. 0.9 -> 0)
  - ProjectionsTable tooltip calls categories Score a '0-100 percentile-weighted composite' but value is a weighted z-score sum (tasks/draft-dashboard-youtube-outline.md:112 notes this)

### DRF-036 buildPersonalizedRecommendations (Draft Pro): need-weighted recommendation score

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) \| Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
- **Purpose:** Personalize suggestion order by roster and category needs without changing league VORP.
- **Where:** `web/lib/draft-pro/recommendations.ts:152 (buildPersonalizedRecommendations)`; `web/lib/draft-pro/recommendations.ts:111 (fitForPosition)`; `web/lib/draft-pro/recommendations.ts:119 (categoryFit)`; `web/lib/draft-pro/recommendations.ts:88 (categoryValuesFor)`
- **Inputs:** candidates {globalVorp, rankValue, baselineScore, categoryValues, adp, eligiblePositions}; positionNeeds 0..1; categoryNeeds; categoryWeights; needAlpha 0..1; selectionHorizon; availabilitySpread; limit<=200
- **Source tables:** in-memory candidates (sent to /api/v1/draft-pro/recommendations for Pro)
- **Method:** (1) Replacement: not recomputed (uses candidate.rankValue/baselineScore). (2) Value source: rankScore = baselineScore ?? rankValue. Category values recomputed: SV% = saves/(saves+GA or SA), GAA = GA*3600/TOTAL_TOI (TOI in seconds); per-category z-scores via calculateCategoryScores over the CANDIDATE pool. (3) No VONA logic here; availability = estimatePlayerAvailability (reason tag only, not in score). (4) Position fit = max(clamp01(need_p)) over eligible positions. Category fit = sum(z_k * need_k)/sum(\|need_k\|*\|w_k\|) over enabled role-applicable categories; categories add position fit. normalizedFit = clamp01(fit / max(1, max\|fit\|)). recommendationScore = rankScore + alpha * normalizedFit * adjustmentScale, adjustmentScale = max(1, max \|rankScore\| over all candidates). (5) Multi-position: best eligible position need.
- **Outputs:** RecommendationResult {rankScore, recommendationScore, globalVorp, availabilityEstimate, reasons, missingCategories}
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** rank values in FP or z units; needs 0..1 (position) or raw counts (categories); TOI seconds
- **Output scale:** recommendation score in rank-value units
- **Status:** live — Draft Pro gated (draftProEligible); free path uses alpha only when needWeightEnabled
- **Tests:** `web/lib/draft-pro/recommendations.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/pages/api/v1/draft-pro/recommendations.test.ts`; `web/__tests__/components/DraftDashboard/SuggestedPicks.test.tsx`
- **Consumers:** pages/api/v1/draft-pro/recommendations (server); SuggestedPicks (remote Pro path); usePlayerRecommendations (local path)
- **Reference standard:** Classic VBD (Joe Bryant, footballguys 'Value Based Drafting': value minus baseline player at position); VORP (Baseball Prospectus-style value over replacement, replacement = first non-starter at T*starters+1); VONA (Value Over Next Available, e.g. Draft Buddy/Fantasy Football Calculator: best at position now minus best expected at your next pick); VOLS (value over last starter, baseline = T*starters-th player); Man-games baseline (Lammey/Dodds 100/120-pick baseline) as alternative; SGP-based category need weighting
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - adjustmentScale = max \|rankScore\| in the whole candidate pool, so with alpha=0.5 a fully-needed player gets +50% of the top player's VBD - need can dominate value
  - category z-scores recomputed over the candidate pool only (different population than league valuation)
  - catNeeds supplied by DraftDashboard are raw count deficits in heterogenous units (see catNeeds entry) yet divided by \|weight\| sums - unit mixing
  - GAA uses TOTAL_TOI assumed seconds (*3600)

### DRF-038 estimatePlayerAvailability: ADP normal-survival availability probability

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) \| Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
- **Purpose:** Probability a player is still available at the user's target pick, conditional on being available now.
- **Where:** `web/lib/draftDashboard/availability.ts:21 (estimatePlayerAvailability)`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/availability.ts:13 (logNormalSurvival)`; `web/lib/draft-pro/recommendations.ts:62 (estimateAvailability wrapper)`; `web/components/DraftDashboard/ProjectionsTable.tsx:768 (risk column)`
- **Inputs:** adp; horizon {currentPick, targetPick, opposingPicks}; spread (default 12, clamped 2..40; ProjectionsTable passes riskSd setting)
- **Source tables:** yahoo_players ADP
- **Method:** Player draft slot ~ Normal(ADP, sd). now = (currentPick-1-ADP)/sd; later = (currentPick-1+opposingPicks-ADP)/sd. P = S(later)/S(now) with S = upper-tail normal survival via Abramowitz-Stegun 26.2.17 polynomial in log space (constants 0.2316419, 0.31938153, -0.356563782, 1.781477937, -1.821255978, 1.330274429). opposingPicks=0 -> 1. Clamped 0..1.
- **Outputs:** availability probability 0-1
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** ADP and picks in overall pick numbers; spread in picks
- **Output scale:** probability 0-1
- **Status:** live
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/components/DraftDashboard/SuggestedPicks.test.tsx`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/positionalTiers.test.ts`; `web/lib/draft-pro/recommendations.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** positionalTiers.advisePosition (expected remaining players); Draft Pro recommendations (availabilityEstimate); SuggestedPicks avail sort / free riskBoost; ProjectionsTable risk column
- **Reference standard:** ADP-normal availability models (e.g. FantasyPros 'chance available'); ADP SD typically scales with ADP
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - constant SD for all ADPs; empirical ADP spread grows with ADP (early picks sd ~2, late ~15+)
  - no calibration against real draft outcomes (code comment says heuristic)
  - no dedicated availability.test.ts found

### DRF-039 buildPlayerValues: comparable draft value (points or category z-sum) + position weights

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) \| Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
- **Purpose:** Shared per-player comparable value and grouped eligibility feeding VORP, tiers and mock drafts.
- **Where:** `web/lib/draftDashboard/playerValues.ts:9 (buildPlayerValues)`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/positionWeights.ts:25 (buildPositionWeightMultipliers)`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/forwardGrouping.ts:30 (normalizePlayerEligibility), :52 (groupPlayerEligibility), :133 (buildPositionPools)`
- **Inputs:** ProcessedPlayer.fantasyPoints.projected; combinedStats.*.projected; displayPosition / eligiblePositions; categoryWeights; prorate84; fantasyPointSettings; positionWeights (0..2 per C/LW/RW/D/G)
- **Source tables:** projection source tables configured in lib/projectionsConfig/projectionSourcesConfig.ts (e.g. projections_* per source), yahoo_players (average_draft_pick, percent_drafted, eligible_positions), yahoo_nhl_player_map / yahoo player map, current-season actual stats tables (ACTUAL_STATS_COLUMN_MAP)
- **Method:** Points: value = projected FP; if prorate84 and not goalie -> computeProratedFantasyPoints (counting stats / projected GP * 84) with league scoring only (mergeWithDefaults=false). Categories: build per-player projected map, derive SHOTS_AGAINST_GOALIE = SAVES+GA when missing and GAMES_STARTED from first of STARTS_GOALIE/GAMES_STARTED_GOALIE/GAMES_GOALIE/GAMES_PLAYED_GOALIE/GP_GOALIE, then calculateCategoryScores. Position weights: multiplier = max over player's eligible positions of weight (default 1), accepted only 0..2 and !=1; value *= multiplier after scoring; unweighted value kept. Eligibility: F/FWD expands to C,LW,RW; 'split' grouping keeps C/LW/RW and adds FWD if roster has a FWD slot; 'fwd' grouping collapses to FWD/D/G.
- **Outputs:** values Map; eligibility Map; unweightedValues Map
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** fantasy points totals or projected counting stats; weights fraction 0-2
- **Output scale:** fantasy points or z-score sum (unbounded)
- **Status:** live — via useVORPCalculations, tierDashboardAdapter, mockDraft adapter
- **Tests:** `web/hooks/useVORPCalculations.test.tsx`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/forwardGrouping.test.ts`; `web/lib/draftDashboard/positionalTiers.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** useVORPCalculations; tierDashboardAdapter.buildDashboardTiers; lib/mockDraft/adapter.freezePlayers
- **Reference standard:** Classic VBD (Joe Bryant, footballguys 'Value Based Drafting': value minus baseline player at position); VORP (Baseball Prospectus-style value over replacement, replacement = first non-starter at T*starters+1); VONA (Value Over Next Available, e.g. Draft Buddy/Fantasy Football Calculator: best at position now minus best expected at your next pick); VOLS (value over last starter, baseline = T*starters-th player); Man-games baseline (Lammey/Dodds 100/120-pick baseline) as alternative
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - GAMES_STARTED fallback uses GAMES_PLAYED_GOALIE (appearances) as starts - inflates GAA regression workload
  - multiplier uses MAX across eligible positions, so a C/LW player gets the more favourable weight
  - negative category composites scaled by weight<1 move toward zero (documented intentional in PRD)

FP = sum over scoring keys (HITS_D/BLOCKED_SHOTS_D position-specific values via pointValueForPlayerStat) of prorated*weight. Goalies, +/-, TOI and rate stats never prorated.

### DRF-041 calculateCategoryScores: weighted category z-score composite with goalie rate shrinkage

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) \| Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
- **Purpose:** Convert projected category stats to one comparable value for categories leagues.
- **Where:** `web/lib/scoring/categoryScores.ts:84 (calculateCategoryScores)`; `web/lib/scoring/categoryScores.ts:67 (regressedGoalieRate)`; `web/lib/scoring/categoryScores.ts:54 (standardDeviation)`
- **Inputs:** players [{id, role skater\|goalie, values}]; categoryWeights (keys define enabled categories; default G,A,PPP,SOG,HIT,BLK)
- **Source tables:** in-memory projections (see buildPlayerValues)
- **Method:** Per role (skater/goalie) and category: mean and SAMPLE std dev (n-1) over every player in the supplied pool with a finite value. Goalie SV% shrunk: (SA*sv + 1200*mean)/(SA+1200) (PRIOR_SHOTS=1200); GAA shrunk: (GS*gaa + 25*mean)/(GS+25) (PRIOR_STARTS=25). z = (value-mean)/sd, inverted for GAA, GOALS_AGAINST_GOALIE, LOSSES_GOALIE. Score = sum weight_k * z_k (weight defaults to 1 if non-finite). GAMES_PLAYED and TOTAL_TOI apply to both roles. Categories with sd=0 or missing values contribute 0.
- **Outputs:** Map playerId -> composite z-sum
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** projected season totals; SV% fraction 0-1; GAA goals/60
- **Output scale:** dimensionless weighted z-score sum (unbounded, ~0 mean)
- **Status:** live — categories leagues in Draft Dashboard, Draft Pro recommendations, mock drafts
- **Tests:** `web/lib/scoring/categoryScores.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** buildPlayerValues; lib/draft-pro/recommendations.ts (per-category scores); lib/mockDraft/adapter.ts (per-category values)
- **Reference standard:** Standard z-score category valuation (e.g. Razzball/FanGraphs z-score method); SGP (standings gain points) as alternative; Tango-style regression to mean for rate stats
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - mean/sd computed over the ENTIRE projection pool, not the draftable top-N (standard z-score methods recompute on the replacement-level pool) - deep pools compress top-player z gaps
  - goalie rates are shrunk toward the mean AFTER mean/sd are computed from unshrunk values, so shrunk rates' z-scores are understated
  - rate categories (SV%, GAA) are not volume-weighted beyond shrinkage; a 10-start goalie with elite SV% scores close to a 60-start goalie
  - PRIOR_SHOTS=1200, PRIOR_STARTS=25 magic constants
  - skater rate categories (e.g. SHOOTING_PERCENTAGE, FACEOFF_PERCENTAGE) get no shrinkage

### DRF-042 Mock draft roster feasibility (Dinic max-flow)

- **Sub-family:** Draft tools / mock draft
- **Purpose:** Check that every team can still fill all roster slots from held plus remaining players, so the bot or user pick never makes the draft infeasible.
- **Where:** `web/lib/mockDraft/feasibility.ts:5 (feasibleRosters)`; `web/lib/mockDraft/engine.ts:121 (canComplete)`; `web/lib/mockDraft/engine.ts:353 (feasibility may force pick outside reach window)`
- **Inputs:** teamCount; slot list from roster config; held picks {player, seat}; available players; fits(player, slot) eligibility
- **Source tables:** in-memory MockSession (players frozen by mockDraft/adapter freezePlayers)
- **Method:** Quick reject if held + available < teamCount × slots. Flow network: source → player groups (key = seat + sorted positions, capacity = group count) → (seat, slot type) nodes (capacity = slot count) → sink. Held groups connect only to their own seat; free players (seat −1) connect to any seat. Dinic max-flow (BFS levels plus DFS augment). Held players must all route (flow = held count); then free players are added to the residual graph and total flow must equal teamCount × slots.
- **Outputs:** boolean feasible
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** counts
- **Output scale:** boolean
- **Status:** live — mock drafts (lib/mockDraft/flags.ts gates)
- **Tests:** `web/lib/mockDraft/engine.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** mock draft engine decide()/canComplete (bot picks and user pick validation)
- **Reference standard:** Bipartite matching / max-flow (Dinic)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - grouping by sorted positions assumes fits() depends only on positions; any fits rule using other player fields (e.g. goalie flags) would be wrong for grouped players

## Stats helpers (HLP, 8)

### HLP-001 Generic projection math primitives (decayBlend, ewsd, slope, shrinkage, poissonMeanFromRate, selectCountDistribution, clip, goalieFinishMult)

- **Purpose:** Reusable EWMA/shrinkage/Poisson-NB/clip helpers for projections.
- **Where:** `web/lib/math/utils.ts:39 (decayBlend)`; `web/lib/math/utils.ts:106 (ewsd)`; `web/lib/math/utils.ts:140 (slope)`; `web/lib/math/utils.ts:169 (shrinkage)`; `web/lib/math/utils.ts:198 (poissonMeanFromRate)`; `web/lib/math/utils.ts:223 (selectCountDistribution)`; `web/lib/math/utils.ts:282 (clip)`; `web/lib/math/utils.ts:296 (goalieFinishMult)`
- **Inputs:** samples {value, daysAgo, weight}; tauDays; recent, prior, nEff, k; ratePer60, toiMinutes; sample mean/variance; svProj, leagueSv
- **Source tables:** —
- **Method:** decayBlend: weights exp(-daysAgo/tau) x optional multiplier; mean = sum(w v)/sum w; nEff = (sum w)^2/sum w^2. ewsd: weighted population SD. slope: OLS slope vs observation index. shrinkage: nEff/(nEff+k)*recent + k/(nEff+k)*prior. poissonMean = rate/60 * TOI minutes * multiplier. selectCountDistribution: NB if Fano = var/mean > 1.25 with r = mean^2/(var-mean), else Poisson. goalieFinishMult = clip(1 - (svProj - leagueSv)/0.070, 0.80, 1.20).
- **Outputs:** mean, nEff; sd; slope; shrunk value; Poisson mean; distribution choice; multiplier
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** days; per-60 rate with TOI in MINUTES (poissonMeanFromRate) — differs from rankings code which uses seconds
- **Output scale:** same units as input; multiplier 0.8-1.2
- **Status:** legacy/dead — only web/lib/math/utils.test.ts references
- **Tests:** `web/lib/math/utils.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** no TypeScript callers found outside tests (rg on each function name)
- **Reference standard:** Tango regression to the mean (k = sample at r=0.5); Poisson/negative-binomial count models
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - legacy/dead — no non-test imports of lib/math/utils found
  - goalieFinishMult constant 0.070 SV% span and 0.8-1.2 clamp are magic numbers

- **Inputs:** count; toiSeconds; saves; shotsAgainst; goalsAgainst; blocks; shots; hits; rows (oldest first)

BSH = blocks+shots+hits, null if any missing. competitionRanks: sort by value (high or low first), ties share rank (1,2,2,4), nulls unranked, id only orders ties. lastN = last n rows (short flag when fewer), previousN = n rows before the last `skip`, versusSeason = recent L-n plus season (overlap disclosed) and seasonExcludingRecent. strictlyAbove: value > x, null if missing. Ownership known only if 0..100.
- **Outputs:** per60; savePct; gaa; bsh; rank; window
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** TOI seconds; counts
- **Output scale:** per-60 rate; fraction 0-1 SV%; goals per 60; integer ranks

### HLP-004 Percent-unit conversion & exposure-correct share aggregation (NST/WGO team rows)

### HLP-006 WiGO player ratings (regressed percentile composite by strength)

- **Purpose:** Offense/defense/overall ratings per strength (AS/ES/PP/PK) from weighted, GP-regressed stat percentiles.
- **Where:** `web/utils/calculateWigoRatings.ts:22 (applyRegression)`; `web/utils/calculateWigoRatings.ts:38 (buildComparisonRows)`; `web/utils/calculateWigoRatings.ts:65 (calculatePlayerRatings)`; `web/components/WiGO/ratingWeights.ts:13 (RATING_WEIGHTS)`; `web/components/WiGO/ratingWeights.ts:96 (REGRESSION_CONFIG)`
- **Inputs:** nst_percentile_{as,es,pp,pk}_{offense,defense} rows (per-60 rates, pct, gp, toi_seconds); cohortMinGp; minCohortPeers (WIGO_RATING_MIN_COHORT_PEERS=20)
- **Source tables:** nst_percentile_as_offense/defense, nst_percentile_es_*, nst_percentile_pp_*, nst_percentile_pk_*
- **Method:** Per stat: mid-rank percentile among cohort with gp>=cohortMinGp (needs >= minCohortPeers peers). If player GP < 10 at that strength: regressed = (GP*pct + (10-GP)*mean pct of >=10-GP players)/10, clamp 0-100. Offense/defense = weighted mean of available stat percentiles (AS/ES offense: P/60 25, ixG/60 20, SOG/60 15, iSCF/60 10, iHDCF/60 10, xGF% 10, CF% 5, PenD/60 5; defense: xGA/60 30, SCA/60 20, HDCA/60 15, blocks 10, TK 10, minors 5, GV 10; PP and PK sets differ). overall.as/es = mean(off, def); ST = PP-offense and PK-defense weighted by PP/PK TOI share; final = mean(as, es, st).
- **Outputs:** offense/defense per strength; overall.as/es/st/final
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** per-60 rates, percentages, GP, TOI seconds
- **Output scale:** 0-100 weighted percentile scores
- **Status:** live — WiGO PlayerRatingsDisplay
- **Tests:** `web/utils/calculateWigoRatings.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** web/components/WiGO/PlayerRatingsDisplay.tsx
- **Reference standard:** Tango regression to the mean (applied to rates, not percentiles)
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - regression applied to percentiles rather than underlying rates; hard step at 10 GP (no regression at >=10 GP)
  - final averages AS and ES (ES is a subset of AS) — double-counts even strength
  - missing stat percentiles silently drop and renormalize weights
  - likely also inventoried by the WiGO family agent

### MISC-015 Dashboard source-date alignment gap (recency state)

- **Sub-family:** Misc / other / dashboard freshness
- **Purpose:** Classify whether the trends/dashboard feeds come from the same date and warn when projection/start context mixes dates.

- **Tables written:** — (in memory)

- **Output scale:** days (integer); categorical status

### MISC-032 NST career / 3-year averages (counts and rates) with multi-team TOT rows

- **Sub-family:** Misc / other \| NST averages API
- **Purpose:** Three-year and career averages of NST individual + on-ice stats.
- **Where:** `web/lib/api/averages/statsService.ts:18 (getAggregatedCountsData)`; `web/lib/api/averages/statsService.ts:152-174 (counts TOT derived)`; `web/lib/api/averages/statsService.ts:300-360 (counts derived)`; `web/lib/api/averages/statsService.ts:371 (getAggregatedRatesData)`; `web/lib/api/averages/statsService.ts:482-520 (rates TOT recompute)`; `web/lib/api/averages/statsService.ts:584-590 (rate averaging)`; `web/lib/api/averages/helpers.ts:61 (addTotalRows), :121 (parseTime)`
- **Inputs:** NST playerreport.php individual (indreg) and on-ice (reg) tables, rate=n\|y
- **Source tables:** Natural Stat Trick HTML (via lib/nst/client cache)
- **Method:** parseTime: TOI float minutes -> seconds. Multi-team seasons: sum aggregateKeys into TOT then recompute derived. Counts TOT: S%=G/SOG, secA%=A2/A, oZS%=oZS/(oZS+dZS), SOG/60 = SOG/TOI*60, oiSH%=oiGF/SF, IPP=(G+A)/oiGF, GF%/CF%/FF%/SF%/SCF%/xGF% = F/(F+A). Seasons = last 3 excluding current (3-year; error if <3) or all (career); counts summed and divided by 3 or N seasons; derived recomputed from averaged counts. Rates TOT: per-60 values SUMMED across teams then (sum / TOI_seconds)*3600; rate averages = simple mean of season per-60 values (divisor 3 or N); percentages from averaged rates.
- **Outputs:** yearlyData; averages (counts, rates)
- **Tables written:** — (in memory)
- **Input units:** NST TOI float minutes -> seconds; counts; NST per-60; percentages /100 to fractions
- **Output scale:** per-season averages; fractions 0-1; per-60 (buggy)
- **Status:** unknown — only consumer found is pages/api/Averages/[playerId].ts; no client caller found
- **Tests:** `web/__tests__/pages/api/Averages/helpers.test.ts`; `web/lib/nst/callerLifecycle.test.ts`
- **Consumers:** pages/api/Averages/[playerId].ts
- **Reference standard:** NST per-60 convention: rate = count / TOI_minutes * 60; multi-season rates should be TOI-weighted
- **Red flags (observation, not audited):**
  - TOI is stored in SECONDS (parseTime) but SOG/60 = SOG/TOI*60 (should be *3600) at statsService.ts:158 and :319 - per-60 understated 60x
  - TOT rates sum per-60 RATES across teams then divide by TOI seconds *3600 (statsService.ts:487-489) - mixes rates and counts; result is not a per-60
  - multi-season rate averages are unweighted means of seasonal per-60s (not TOI-weighted)
  - no in-repo page/component consumer found besides pages/api/Averages route (possibly legacy)

Role Watch: mean TOI/PP TOI seconds per appearance recent vs baseline; qualifies if \|change\| >= minimum. ### MISC-044 WiGO util fallbacks: derived per-60, PP per-60, PTS1%, percentile staleness, rolling average

- **Sub-family:** Misc / other \| utils
- **Purpose:** Fill missing NST per-60s and chart series for WiGO.
